Lawh-i-Ibn-i-Dhi’b (Epistle to the Son of the Wolf)

BH00005

Translated on 9 Qudrat, 183 BE using GPT 6.1 Sol

1

بسم اللّه الفرد الواحد المقتدر العلیم الحکیم

Bi-smi Allāh al-Fard al-Wāḥid al-Muqtadir al-ʿAlīm al-Ḥakīm.

In the name of God, the Unique, the One, the All-Powerful, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.

2

الحمد للّه الباقی بلا فنآء و الدّائم بلا زوال و القائم بلا انتقال المهیمن بسلطانه و الظّاهر بآیاته و الباطن بأسراره الّذى بأمره ارتفعت رایة الکلمة العلیا فى ناسوت الانشآء و نصب علم یفعل ما یشآء بین الوری هو الّذى اظهر امره لهدایة خلقه و انزل آیاته اظهاراً لحجّته و برهانه و زیّن دیباج کتاب الانسان بالبیان بقوله الرّحمن علّم القرآن خلق الانسان علّمه البیان لا اله الّا هو الفرد الواحد المقتدر العزیز المنّان

Al-ḥamdu li-llāh al-Bāqī bi-lā fanāʾ wa-l-Dāʾim bi-lā zawāl wa-l-Qāʾim bi-lā intiqāl, al-Muhaymin bi-sulṭānihi wa-l-Ẓāhir bi-āyātihi wa-l-Bāṭin bi-asrārihi, alladhī bi-amrihi irtafaʿat rāyatu al-kalimati al-ʿulyā fī nāsūti al-inshāʾ wa-nuṣiba ʿalamu yafʿalu mā yashāʾ bayna al-warā. Huwa alladhī aẓhara amrahu li-hidāyati khalqihi wa-anzala āyātihi iẓhāran li-ḥujjatihi wa-burhānihi wa-zayyana dībāja kitābi al-insān bi-l-bayān bi-qawlihi al-Raḥmānu ʿallama al-Qurʾāna khalaqa al-insāna ʿallamahu al-bayān. Lā ilāha illā huwa al-Fard al-Wāḥid al-Muqtadir al-ʿAzīz al-Mannān.

Praise be to God, who remains without perishing, endures without decline, and abides without change; who rules through His sovereignty, is manifest through His signs, and is hidden through His mysteries; at whose command the banner of the Most Exalted Word was raised in the world of creation, and the standard of “He does whatever He wills” was planted among humankind. He is the One who revealed His Cause to guide His creatures, sent down His verses to make His testimony and proof manifest, and adorned the opening page of the book of humanity with utterance through His words: “The All-Merciful taught the Quran, created the human being, and taught him utterance.” There is no God but Him, the Unique, the One, the All-Powerful, the Almighty, the Bestower.

3

النّور السّاطع من افق سمآء العطآء و الصّلوة المشرقة من مطلع ارادة اللّه مالک ملکوت الأسمآء على الواسطة الکبری و القلم الأعلی الّذی جعله اللّه مطلع اسمائه الحسنی و مشرق صفاته العلیا و به اشرق نور التّوحید من افق العالم و حکم التّفرید بین الأمم الّذین اقبلوا بوجوه نورآء الی الأفق الأعلی و اعترفوا بما نطق به لسان البیان فى ملکوت العرفان الملک و الملکوت و العظمة و الجبروت للّه المقتدر العزیز الفیاض

Al-nūru al-sāṭiʿu min ufuqi samāʾi al-ʿaṭāʾ wa-l-ṣalātu al-mushriqatu min maṭlaʿi irādati Allāh Māliki malakūti al-asmāʾ ʿalā al-wāsiṭati al-kubrā wa-l-qalami al-aʿlā alladhī jaʿalahu Allāhu maṭlaʿa asmāʾihi al-ḥusnā wa-mashriqa ṣifātihi al-ʿulyā wa-bihi ashraqa nūru al-tawḥīd min ufuqi al-ʿālam wa-ḥakama al-tafrīd bayna al-umam alladhīna aqbalū bi-wujūhin nawrāʾ ilā al-ufuqi al-aʿlā wa-iʿtarafū bi-mā naṭaqa bihi lisānu al-bayān fī malakūti al-ʿirfān. Al-mulku wa-l-malakūtu wa-l-ʿaẓamatu wa-l-jabarūtu li-llāh al-Muqtadir al-ʿAzīz al-Fayyāḍ.

May the light shining from the horizon of the heaven of bounty, and the blessing radiating from the dawning place of the will of God, the Master of the kingdom of names, rest upon the Supreme Intermediary and the Most Exalted Pen, which God has made the dawning place of His most beautiful names and the dayspring of His most exalted attributes. Through it the light of divine unity has shone from the horizon of the world, and divine oneness has prevailed among the nations who have turned with radiant faces toward the Most Exalted Horizon and acknowledged what the Tongue of Utterance has proclaimed in the kingdom of knowledge: “Sovereignty and dominion, grandeur and might belong to God, the All-Powerful, the Almighty, the All-Bountiful.”

4

یا ایّها العالم الجلیل اسمع ندآء المظلوم انّه ینصحک لوجه اللّه و یعظک بما یقرّبک الیه فی کلّ الأحوال انّه هو الغنیّ المتعال اعلم انّ الآذان خلقت لاصغآء النّدآء فی هذا الیوم الّذی کان مذکوراً فى الکتب و الزّبر و الألواح فی اوّل الأمر طهّر نفسک بمآء الانقطاع و زیّن رأسک باکلیل التّقوی و هیکلک بطراز التّوکّل علی اللّه ثمّ قم عن مقامک مقبلاً الی البیت الأعظم مطاف من فی العالم من لدن مالک القدم و قل

Yā ayyuhā al-ʿālimu al-jalīl, ismaʿ nidāʾa al-Maẓlūm. Innahu yanṣaḥuka li-wajhi Allāh wa-yaʿiẓuka bi-mā yuqarribuka ilayhi fī kulli al-aḥwāl. Innahu huwa al-Ghanī al-Mutaʿāl. Iʿlam anna al-ādhāna khuliqat li-iṣghāʾi al-nidāʾ fī hādhā al-yawmi alladhī kāna madhkūran fī al-kutubi wa-l-zuburi wa-l-alwāḥ. Fī awwali al-amr ṭahhir nafsaka bi-māʾi al-inqiṭāʿ wa-zayyin raʾsaka bi-iklīli al-taqwā wa-haykalaka bi-ṭirāzi al-tawakkuli ʿalā Allāh. Thumma qum ʿan maqāmika muqbilan ilā al-bayti al-aʿẓam maṭāfi man fī al-ʿālam min ladun Māliki al-qidam wa-qul.

Distinguished scholar, listen to the call of the Wronged One. He counsels you for the sake of God and exhorts you to what will draw you near to Him in every circumstance. He is indeed the Self-Sufficient, the Most Exalted. Know that ears were created to hear the call on this Day, which was mentioned in the Books, the Scriptures, and the Tablets. First, cleanse yourself with the water of detachment, adorn your head with the crown of piety, and your body with the vesture of trust in God. Then rise from your place, turning toward the Most Great House, appointed by the Lord of Eternity as the place around which all who are in the world should circle, and say:

5

الهی الهی و مقصودی و معبودی و سیّدی و سندی و غایة املی و رجائی ترانی مقبلاً الیک و متمسّکاً بحبل جودک و متشبّثاً بذیل عطائک و معترفاً بتقدیس نفسک و تنزیه ذاتک مقرّاً بوحدانیّتک و فردانیّتک اشهد انّک انت الفرد الواحد الأحد الصّمد ما اتّخذت لنفسک شریکاً فی الملک و لا نظیراً فی الأرض قد شهدت الکائنات بما شهد به لسان عظمتک قبلها انّک انت اللّه لا اله الّا انت لم تزل کنت مقدّساً عن ذکر عبادک و متعالیاً عن وصف خلقک ای ربّ تری الجاهل قصد بحر علمک و العطشان کوثر بیانک و الذّلیل خبآء عزّک و الفقیر کنز غنائک و السّائل مشرق حکمتک و الضّعیف مطلع قدرتک و المسکین سمآء کرمک و الکلیل ملکوت ذکرک

Ilāhī Ilāhī wa-maqṣūdī wa-maʿbūdī wa-sayyidī wa-sanadī wa-ghāyata amalī wa-rajāʾī, tarānī muqbilan ilayka wa-mutamassikan bi-ḥabli jūdika wa-mutashabbithan bi-dhayli ʿaṭāʾika wa-muʿtarifan bi-taqdīsi nafsika wa-tanzīhi dhātika muqirran bi-waḥdāniyyatika wa-fardāniyyatik. Ashhadu annaka anta al-Fard al-Wāḥid al-Aḥad al-Ṣamad. Mā ittakhadhta li-nafsika sharīkan fī al-mulki wa-lā naẓīran fī al-arḍ. Qad shahidati al-kāʾinātu bi-mā shahida bihi lisānu ʿaẓamatika qablahā annaka anta Allāhu lā ilāha illā anta. Lam tazal kunta muqaddasan ʿan dhikri ʿibādika wa-mutaʿāliyan ʿan waṣfi khalqik. Ay Rabb, tarā al-jāhila qaṣada baḥra ʿilmika wa-l-ʿaṭshāna kawthara bayānika wa-l-dhalīla khibāʾa ʿizzika wa-l-faqīra kanza ghināʾika wa-l-sāʾila mashriqa ḥikmatika wa-l-ḍaʿīfa maṭlaʿa qudratika wa-l-miskīna samāʾa karamika wa-l-kalīla malakūta dhikrik.

My God, my God, my Desire, my Adored One, my Master, my Support, the ultimate object of my hope and expectation! You see me turning toward You, holding fast to the cord of Your generosity, clinging to the hem of Your bounty, acknowledging the sanctity of Your Being and the transcendence of Your Essence, and affirming Your oneness and uniqueness. I testify that You are the Unique, the One, the Single, the All-Sufficing. You have taken for Yourself no partner in sovereignty and no equal on earth. All created things have testified to what the Tongue of Your grandeur testified before them: that You are God; there is no God but You. You have always been sanctified above the mention of Your servants and exalted beyond the description of Your creatures. O Lord, You see the ignorant one seeking the ocean of Your knowledge, the thirsty one the river of Your utterance, the abased one the pavilion of Your glory, the poor one the treasury of Your riches, the petitioner the dayspring of Your wisdom, the weak one the dawning place of Your power, the destitute one the heaven of Your generosity, and the weary one the kingdom of Your remembrance.

6

اشهد یا الهی و سلطانی بأنّک خلقتنی لذکرک و ثنائک و نصرة امرک و انّى نصرت اعدائک الّذین نقضوا عهدک و نبذوا کتابک و کفروا بک و بآیاتک آه آه من غفلتی و خجلتی و خطیئتی و جریرتی الّتی منعتنی عن الورود فی طمطام بحر احدیّتک و قمقام یمّ رحمتک فآه آه ثمّ آه آه من سوء حالی و کبر عصیانی قد اظهرتنی یا الهی لاعلآء کلمتک و اظهار امرک ولکن غفلتی منعتنی و احاطت بی بحیث قمت على محو آثارک و سفک دمآء اولیائک و مطالع آیاتک و مشارق وحیک و مخازن اسرارک

Ashhadu yā Ilāhī wa-Sulṭānī bi-annaka khalaqtanī li-dhikrika wa-thanāʾika wa-nuṣrati amrika wa-annī naṣartu aʿdāʾaka alladhīna naqaḍū ʿahdaka wa-nabadhū kitābaka wa-kafarū bika wa-bi-āyātik. Āh āh min ghaflatī wa-khajlatī wa-khaṭīʾatī wa-jarīratī allatī manaʿatnī ʿan al-wurūdi fī ṭamṭāmi baḥri aḥadiyyatika wa-qamqāmi yammi raḥmatik. Fa-āh āh thumma āh āh min sūʾi ḥālī wa-kibari ʿiṣyānī. Qad aẓhartanī yā Ilāhī li-iʿlāʾi kalimatika wa-iẓhāri amrika wa-lākin ghaflatī manaʿatnī wa-aḥāṭat bī bi-ḥaythu qumtu ʿalā maḥwi āthārika wa-safki dimāʾi awliyāʾika wa-maṭāliʿi āyātika wa-mashāriqi waḥyika wa-makhāzini asrārik.

I testify, my God and my Sovereign, that You created me to remember and praise You and to aid Your Cause, yet I aided Your enemies, who broke Your covenant, cast aside Your Book, and disbelieved in You and Your signs. Alas, alas for my heedlessness, my shame, my sin, and my wrongdoing, which kept me from entering the vast ocean of Your oneness and the fathomless sea of Your mercy! Alas, alas, and again alas, alas for my wretched condition and the enormity of my rebellion! You brought me into being, my God, to exalt Your Word and make Your Cause manifest, but my heedlessness hindered and encompassed me, so that I arose to efface Your signs and shed the blood of Your loved ones, the dawning places of Your verses, the daysprings of Your revelation, and the repositories of Your mysteries.

7

ای ربّ ای ربّ ای ربّ ای ربّ ای ربّ ای ربّ ای ربّ ای ربّ ای ربّ اشهد بظلمی سقطت اثمار سدرة عدلک و بنار عصیانی احترقت افئدة المقرّبین من خلقک و ذابت اکباد المخلصین من عبادک فآه آه من شقوتی فآه آه من ظلمی فآه آه من بعدی و غفلتی و جهلی و ذلّتی و اعراضی و اعتراضی کم من ایّام فیها امرت عبادک و اولیائک علی حفظی و انّی امرتهم بضرّک و ضرّ امنائک و کم من لیال فیها ذکرتنی بفضلک و دللتنی الی صراطک و انّی اعرضت عنک و عن آیاتک وعزّتک یا امل الموحّدین و رجآء افئدة المنقطعین لا اجد لنفسی دونک معیناً و لا سواک سلطاناً و لا ملجأً و لا ملاذاً فآه آه اعراضی احرق ستر عصمتی و اعتراضی شقّ حجاب حرمتی یا لیت کنت تحت اطباق التّراب و ما ظهر سوء اعمالی بین عبادک ای ربّ تری العاصی اقبل الی مطلع عفوک و عطائک و جبل الظّلم اراد سمآء رحمتک و غفرانک فآه آه جریراتی العظمی منعتنی عن التّقرّب الی بساط رحمتک و خطیئاتی الکبری ابعدتنی عن ساحة قربک انا الّذى فرّطت فی جنبک و نقضت عهدک و میثاقک و ارتکبت ما ناح به سکّان مدائن عدلک و مطالع فضلک فی بلادک اشهد یا الهی انّی ترکت اوامرک و اخذت اوامر نفسی و نبذت احکام کتابک و اخذت کتاب هوای فآه آه کلّما زادت شقوتی زاد حلمک و کلّما اشتعلت نار عصیانی سترها عفوک و فضلک وعزّتک یا مقصود العالم و محبوب الأمم صبرک غرّنی و اصطبارک شجّعنی تری یا الهی عبراتی من خجلتی و زفراتی من غفلتی وعظمتک لا اجد لنفسی مقرّاً الّا ظلّ بساط کرمک و لا مهرباً الّا تحت قباب رحمتک ترانی فی بحر الیأس و القنوط بعدما اسمعتنی کلمة لا تقنطوا وعزّتک ظلمی قطع حبل املی و عصیانی سوّد وجهی امام کرسیّ عدلک ای ربّ تری المیّت مطروحاً لدی باب عطائک و یستحیی ان یطلب کوثر عفوک من ید فضلک قد اعطیتنی لساناً لذکرک و ثنائک و انّه نطق بما ذابت به اکباد المقرّبین من اصفیائک و احترقت افئدة المخلصین من اهل حظائر قدسک و اعطیتنی بصراً لمشاهدة آثارک و ملاحظة آیاتک و مظاهر صنعک و انّی نبذت ارادتک و عملت ما ناح به المخلصون من خلقک و المنقطعون من عبادک و اعطیتنی سمعاً لأسمع به ذکرک و ثنائک و ما انزلته من سمآء کرمک و هوآء ارادتک فآه آه انّی ترکت امرک و امرت عبادک بسبّ امنائک و اولیائک و عملت امام کرسیّ عدلک ما ارتفعت به زفرات الموحّدین و المخلصین من اهل مملکتک لم ادر یا الهی ایّ عصیانی اذکره تلقآء امواج بحر جودک و ایّ خطأی انطق به عند تجلّیات انوار شموس مواهبک و الطافک

Ay Rabb, ay Rabb, ay Rabb, ay Rabb, ay Rabb, ay Rabb, ay Rabb, ay Rabb, ay Rabb! Ashhadu bi-ẓulmī saqaṭat athmāru sidrati ʿadlika wa-bi-nāri ʿiṣyānī iḥtaraqat afʾidatu al-muqarrabīna min khalqika wa-dhābat akbādu al-mukhliṣīna min ʿibādik. Fa-āh āh min shiqwatī, fa-āh āh min ẓulmī, fa-āh āh min buʿdī wa-ghaflatī wa-jahlī wa-dhillatī wa-iʿrāḍī wa-iʿtirāḍī. Kam min ayyāmin fīhā amarta ʿibādaka wa-awliyāʾaka ʿalā ḥifẓī wa-innī amartuhum bi-ḍurrika wa-ḍurri umanāʾik. Wa-kam min layālin fīhā dhakartanī bi-faḍlika wa-dalaltanī ilā ṣirāṭika wa-innī aʿraḍtu ʿanka wa-ʿan āyātik. Wa-ʿizzatika yā Amala al-muwaḥḥidīn wa-Rajāʾa afʾidati al-munqaṭiʿīn, lā ajidu li-nafsī dūnaka muʿīnan wa-lā siwāka sulṭānan wa-lā maljaʾan wa-lā malādhan. Fa-āh āh, iʿrāḍī aḥraqa sitra ʿiṣmatī wa-iʿtirāḍī shaqqa ḥijāba ḥurmatī. Yā layta kuntu taḥta aṭbāqi al-turāb wa-mā ẓahara sūʾu aʿmālī bayna ʿibādik. Ay Rabb, tarā al-ʿāṣiya aqbala ilā maṭlaʿi ʿafwika wa-ʿaṭāʾika wa-jabala al-ẓulmi arāda samāʾa raḥmatika wa-ghufrānik. Fa-āh āh, jarīrātī al-ʿuẓmā manaʿatnī ʿan al-taqarrubi ilā bisāṭi raḥmatika wa-khaṭīʾātī al-kubrā abʿadatnī ʿan sāḥati qurbik. Anā alladhī farraṭtu fī janbika wa-naqaḍtu ʿahdaka wa-mīthāqaka wa-irtakabtu mā nāḥa bihi sukkānu madāʾini ʿadlika wa-maṭāliʿu faḍlika fī bilādik. Ashhadu yā Ilāhī annī taraktu awāmiraka wa-akhadhtu awāmira nafsī wa-nabadhtu aḥkāma kitābika wa-akhadhtu kitāba hawāy. Fa-āh āh, kullamā zādat shiqwatī zāda ḥilmuka wa-kullamā ishtaʿalat nāru ʿiṣyānī satarahā ʿafwuka wa-faḍluk. Wa-ʿizzatika yā Maqṣūda al-ʿālam wa-Maḥbūba al-umam, ṣabruka gharranī wa-iṣṭibāruka shajjaʿanī. Tarā yā Ilāhī ʿabarātī min khajlatī wa-zafarātī min ghaflatī. Wa-ʿaẓamatika lā ajidu li-nafsī maqarran illā ẓilla bisāṭi karamika wa-lā mahraban illā taḥta qibābi raḥmatik. Tarānī fī baḥri al-yaʾsi wa-l-qunūṭ baʿdamā asmaʿtanī kalimata lā taqnaṭū. Wa-ʿizzatika ẓulmī qaṭaʿa ḥabla amalī wa-ʿiṣyānī sawwada wajhī amāma kursiyyi ʿadlik. Ay Rabb, tarā al-mayyita maṭrūḥan ladā bābi ʿaṭāʾika wa-yastaḥyī an yaṭluba kawthara ʿafwika min yadi faḍlik. Qad aʿṭaytanī lisānan li-dhikrika wa-thanāʾika wa-innahu naṭaqa bi-mā dhābat bihi akbādu al-muqarrabīna min aṣfiyāʾika wa-iḥtaraqat afʾidatu al-mukhliṣīna min ahli ḥaẓāʾiri qudsik. Wa-aʿṭaytanī baṣaran li-mushāhadati āthārika wa-mulāḥaẓati āyātika wa-maẓāhiri ṣunʿika wa-innī nabadhtu irādataka wa-ʿamiltu mā nāḥa bihi al-mukhliṣūna min khalqika wa-l-munqaṭiʿūna min ʿibādik. Wa-aʿṭaytanī samʿan li-asmaʿa bihi dhikraka wa-thanāʾaka wa-mā anzaltahu min samāʾi karamika wa-hawāʾi irādatik. Fa-āh āh, innī taraktu amraka wa-amartu ʿibādaka bi-sabbi umanāʾika wa-awliyāʾika wa-ʿamiltu amāma kursiyyi ʿadlika mā irtafaʿat bihi zafarātu al-muwaḥḥidīna wa-l-mukhliṣīna min ahli mamlakatik. Lam adri yā Ilāhī ayya ʿiṣyānī adhkuruhu tilqāʾa amwāji baḥri jūdika wa-ayya khaṭaʾī anṭiqu bihi ʿinda tajalliyāti anwāri shumūsi mawāhibika wa-alṭāfik.

O Lord, O Lord, O Lord, O Lord, O Lord, O Lord, O Lord, O Lord, O Lord! I testify that through my injustice the fruits of the tree of Your justice have fallen, and through the fire of my rebellion the hearts of those among Your creatures who are near to You have burned, and the innermost beings of Your sincere servants have melted. Alas, alas for my wretchedness! Alas, alas for my injustice! Alas, alas for my remoteness, my heedlessness, my ignorance, my abasement, my turning away, and my opposition! How many days You commanded Your servants and Your loved ones to protect me, while I commanded them to harm You and Your trusted ones! How many nights You remembered me through Your grace and guided me to Your path, while I turned away from You and Your signs! By Your glory, Hope of those who affirm Your unity and Desire of the hearts of the detached, I find no helper but You, and no sovereign, refuge, or shelter other than You. Alas, alas! My turning away has burned the covering of my protection, and my opposition has torn the veil of my dignity. If only I had been beneath the layers of dust and the evil of my deeds had not appeared among Your servants! O Lord, You see the disobedient one turning toward the dawning place of Your pardon and bounty, and the mountain of injustice seeking the heaven of Your mercy and forgiveness. Alas, alas! My grievous wrongdoings have kept me from approaching the court of Your mercy, and my great sins have removed me far from the precincts of Your presence. I am the one who failed in my duty toward You, broke Your covenant and Your pledge, and committed what caused the inhabitants of the cities of Your justice and the dawning places of Your grace in Your lands to lament. I testify, my God, that I abandoned Your commands and followed the commands of my own self, cast aside the laws of Your Book, and took up the book of my own desire. Alas, alas! The greater my wretchedness grew, the greater Your forbearance became, and whenever the fire of my rebellion blazed, Your pardon and grace concealed it. By Your glory, Desire of the world and Beloved of the nations, Your patience deluded me and Your endurance emboldened me. You see, my God, the tears I shed from shame and the sighs I heave over my heedlessness. By Your grandeur, I find no resting place except the shelter of the court of Your generosity, and no escape except beneath the domes of Your mercy. You see me in the ocean of hopelessness and despair after You have caused me to hear the words “Do not despair.” By Your glory, my injustice has severed the cord of my hope, and my rebellion has blackened my face before the throne of Your justice. O Lord, You see the dead one cast down at the door of Your bounty, ashamed to ask for the river of Your pardon from the hand of Your grace. You gave me a tongue to remember and praise You, yet it uttered what melted the innermost beings of those among Your chosen ones who are near to You and burned the hearts of the sincere among the inhabitants of Your holy courts. You gave me sight to behold Your works and contemplate Your signs and the manifestations of Your handiwork, yet I cast aside Your will and did what caused the sincere among Your creatures and the detached among Your servants to lament. You gave me hearing with which to hear Your remembrance and praise and what You sent down from the heaven of Your generosity and the atmosphere of Your will. Alas, alas! I abandoned Your command, ordered Your servants to revile Your trusted ones and Your loved ones, and acted before the throne of Your justice in a way that caused the sighs of those who affirm Your unity and the sincere among the people of Your kingdom to rise. I do not know, my God, which act of my rebellion to recount before the waves of the ocean of Your generosity, or which of my errors to speak of before the effulgent lights of the suns of Your gifts and favors.

8

اسألک فى هذا الحین بأسرار کتابک و ما کان مکنوناً فی علمک و باللّآلئ المستورة فی اصداف عمّان رحمتک ان تجعلنی من الّذین ذکرتهم فی کتابک و وصفتهم فی الواحک هل قدّرت لی یا الهی بعد هذا الحزن من سرور و بعد هذا القبض من بسط و بعد هذا العسر من یسر فآه آه قد جعلت المنابر لذکرک و ارتفاع کلمتک و اظهار امرک و انّی ارتقیت الیها لاعلآء نقض عهدک و القیت علی العباد ما ناح به اهل سرادق عظمتک و سکّان مدائن علمک کم من اوقات انزلت فیها مائدة بیانک من سمآء عطائک و انّی کفرت بها و کم من احیان دعوتنی فیها الی فرات رحمتک و انّی اعرضت عنه بما اتّبعت النّفس و الهوی وعزّتک لم ادر من ایّ ذنب استغفرک و اتوب الیک و من ایّ ظلم ارجع الی بساط جودک و ساحة کرمک قد بلغت جریراتی و خطیئاتی مقاماً عجز المحصون عن احصائها و المحرّرون عن تحریرها اسألک یا مبدّل الظّلمة بالنّور و مظهر الأسرار فی الطّور ایّدنی فی کلّ الأحوال علی التّوکّل علیک و تفویض الأمور الیک ثمّ اجعلنی یا الهی راضیاً بما رقم من قلم قضائک و یراعة تقدیرک انّک انت المقتدر علی ما تشآء و فی قبضتک زمام من فی السّموات و الأرضین لا اله الّا انت العلیم الحکیم

Asʾaluka fī hādhā al-ḥīn bi-asrāri kitābika wa-mā kāna maknūnan fī ʿilmika wa-bi-l-laʾāliʾi al-mastūrati fī aṣdāfi ʿummāni raḥmatika an tajʿalanī mina alladhīna dhakartahum fī kitābika wa-waṣaftahum fī alwāḥik. Hal qaddarta lī yā Ilāhī baʿda hādhā al-ḥuzni min surūr wa-baʿda hādhā al-qabḍi min basṭ wa-baʿda hādhā al-ʿusri min yusr? Fa-āh āh, qad jaʿalta al-manābira li-dhikrika wa-irtifāʿi kalimatika wa-iẓhāri amrika wa-innī irtaqaytu ilayhā li-iʿlāʾi naqḍi ʿahdika wa-alqaytu ʿalā al-ʿibādi mā nāḥa bihi ahlu surādiqi ʿaẓamatika wa-sukkānu madāʾini ʿilmik. Kam min awqātin anzalta fīhā māʾidata bayānika min samāʾi ʿaṭāʾika wa-innī kafartu bihā wa-kam min aḥyānin daʿawtanī fīhā ilā furāti raḥmatika wa-innī aʿraḍtu ʿanhu bi-mā ittabaʿtu al-nafsa wa-l-hawā. Wa-ʿizzatika lam adri min ayyi dhanbin astaghfiruka wa-atūbu ilayka wa-min ayyi ẓulmin arjiʿu ilā bisāṭi jūdika wa-sāḥati karamik. Qad balaghat jarīrātī wa-khaṭīʾātī maqāman ʿajaza al-muḥṣūna ʿan iḥṣāʾihā wa-l-muḥarrirūna ʿan taḥrīrihā. Asʾaluka yā Mubaddila al-ẓulmati bi-l-nūr wa-Muẓhira al-asrāri fī al-Ṭūr, ayyidnī fī kulli al-aḥwāli ʿalā al-tawakkuli ʿalayka wa-tafwīḍi al-umūri ilayk. Thumma ijʿalnī yā Ilāhī rāḍiyan bi-mā ruqima min qalami qaḍāʾika wa-yarāʿati taqdīrik. Innaka anta al-Muqtadiru ʿalā mā tashāʾ wa-fī qabḍatika zimāmu man fī al-samāwāti wa-l-araḍīn. Lā ilāha illā anta al-ʿAlīm al-Ḥakīm.

I ask You at this moment, by the mysteries of Your Book, by what lies hidden in Your knowledge, and by the pearls concealed in the shells of the ocean of Your mercy, to make me one of those whom You have mentioned in Your Book and described in Your Tablets. Have You ordained for me, my God, any joy after this sorrow, any relief after this anguish, any ease after this hardship? Alas, alas! You established pulpits for Your remembrance, the exaltation of Your Word, and the proclamation of Your Cause, yet I ascended them to promote the breaking of Your covenant and delivered to Your servants what caused the people of the pavilion of Your grandeur and the inhabitants of the cities of Your knowledge to lament. How often You sent down the feast of Your utterance from the heaven of Your bounty, while I rejected it! How often You summoned me to the sweet waters of Your mercy, while I turned away from them through following self and desire! By Your glory, I do not know for which sin to seek Your forgiveness and turn to You in repentance, or from which injustice to return to the court of Your generosity and the precincts of Your bounty. My wrongdoings and sins have reached such a degree that those who count are unable to number them, and those who write are unable to record them. I ask You, O You who replace darkness with light and reveal mysteries on the Mount, to strengthen me in every circumstance to trust in You and entrust all affairs to You. Then make me, my God, content with what has been inscribed by the pen of Your decree and the reed of Your ordaining. You indeed have power to do whatever You will, and in Your grasp are the reins of all who are in the heavens and the earth. There is no God but You, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.

9

یا شیخ اعلم انّ مفتریات العباد و اعراضهم و اعتراضهم لا تضرّ من تمسّک بحبل العنایة و تشبّث بأذیال رحمة مالک البریّة لعمر اللّه انّ البهآء ما نطق عن الهوی قد انطقه الّذی انطق الأشیآء بذکره و ثنائه لا اله الّا هو الفرد الواحد المقتدر المختار

Yā Shaykh, iʿlam anna muftarayāti al-ʿibādi wa-iʿrāḍahum wa-iʿtirāḍahum lā taḍurru man tamassaka bi-ḥabli al-ʿināyati wa-tashabbatha bi-adhyāli raḥmati Māliki al-bariyyah. La-ʿamru Allāh, inna al-Bahāʾa mā naṭaqa ʿan al-hawā. Qad anṭaqahu alladhī anṭaqa al-ashyāʾa bi-dhikrihi wa-thanāʾih. Lā ilāha illā huwa al-Fard al-Wāḥid al-Muqtadir al-Mukhtār.

O Shaykh, know that people’s slanders, their turning away, and their opposition cannot harm one who holds fast to the cord of providence and clings to the hem of the mercy of the Lord of creation. By the life of God, Bahá has not spoken from desire. He has been made to speak by the One who caused all things to voice His remembrance and praise. There is no God but Him, the Unique, the One, the All-Powerful, the Unconstrained.

10

صاحبان ابصار حدیده و آذان واعیه و قلوب منیره و صدور منشرحه صدق را از کذب بشناسند و تمیز دهند این مناجات را که از لسان مظلوم جاری شده قرائت نمائید و بقلب فارغ و سمع طاهر مقدّس در آن تفکّر فرمائید شاید نفحات انقطاع را بیابید و بر خود و عباد رحم کنید

Ṣāḥibān-i abṣār-i ḥadīde va ādhān-i vāʿiye va qulūb-i munīre va ṣudūr-i munshariḥe ṣidq rā az kidhb bishināsand va tamyīz dihand. Īn munājāt rā kih az lisān-i Maẓlūm jārī shudih qirāʾat namāyīd va bi-qalb-i fārigh va samʿ-i ṭāhir-i muqaddas dar ān tafakkur farmāyīd. Shāyad nafaḥāt-i inqiṭāʿ rā biyābīd va bar khud va ʿibād raḥm kunīd.

Those with keen sight, attentive ears, radiant hearts, and open breasts recognize and distinguish truth from falsehood. Read this prayer that has flowed from the tongue of the Wronged One, and reflect on it with an unburdened heart and a pure, sanctified hearing. Perhaps you may perceive the breezes of detachment and have mercy on yourselves and on God’s servants.

11

الها معبودا مقصودا کریما رحیما جانها از تو و اقتدارها در قبضهٔ قدرت تو هر که را بلند کنی از ملک بگذرد و بمقام و رفعناه مقاماً علیّاً رسد و هر که را بیندازی از خاک پستتر بلکه هیچ از او بهتر پروردگارا با تباه‌کاری و گناهکاری و عدم پرهیزکاری مقعد صدق میطلبیم و لقاء اولیائت را میجوئیم امر امر تو و حکم آن تو و عالم قدرت زیر فرمان تو هر چه کنی عدل صرفست بل فضل محض یک تجلّی از تجلّیات اسم رحمانت رسم عصیان را از جهان براندازد و محو نماید و یک نسیم از نسائم یوم ظهورت عالم را بخلعت تازه مزیّن نماید ای توانا ناتوانان را توانائی بخش و مردگان را زندگی عطا فرما شاید ترا بیابند و بدریای آگاهیت راه یابند و بر امرت مستقیم مانند اگر از لغات مختلفهٔ عالم عرف ثنای تو متضوّع شود همه محبوب جان و مقصود روان چه تازی چه پارسی اگر از آن محروم ماند قابل ذکر نه چه الفاظ چه معانی ای پروردگار از تو میطلبم کل را راه نمائی و هدایت فرمائی توئی قادر و توانا و عالم و بینا

Ilāhā, maʿbūdā, maqṣūdā, karīmā, raḥīmā! Jānhā az to va eqtedārhā dar qabḍe-ye qodrat-e to. Har ke rā boland konī az malak bogẕarad va be-maqām-e «wa rafaʿnāhu maqāman ʿaliyyan» rasad, va har ke rā biyandāzī az khāk pasttar balke hīch az ū behtar. Parvardegārā, bā tabāhkārī va gonāhkārī va ʿadam-e parhīzkārī maqʿad-e ṣedq mīṭalabīm va leqā-ye owlīyāʾat rā mījūʾīm. Amr amr-e to va ḥokm ān-e to va ʿālam-e qodrat zīr-e farmān-e to. Har che konī ʿadl-e ṣerf ast bal faḍl-e maḥḍ. Yek tajallī az tajallīyāt-e esm-e Raḥmānat rasm-e ʿeṣyān rā az jahān barandāzad va maḥv namāyad va yek nasīm az nasāʾem-e yowm-e ẓohūrat ʿālam rā be-khelʿat-e tāze mozayyan namāyad. Ey tavānā, nātavānān rā tavānāʾī bakhsh va mordegān rā zendegī ʿaṭā farmā, shāyad to rā biyāband va be-daryā-ye āgāhīyat rāh yāband va bar amrat mostaqīm mānand. Agar az loghāt-e mokhtalefe-ye ʿālam ʿarf-e thanā-ye to motaḍavveʿ shavad hame maḥbūb-e jān va maqṣūd-e ravān, che tāzī che pārsī. Agar az ān maḥrūm mānad qābel-e dhekr na, che alfāẓ che maʿānī. Ey Parvardegār, az to mīṭalabam koll rā rāh namāʾī va hedāyat farmāʾī. Toʾī qāder va tavānā va ʿālem va bīnā.

O God, O Adored One, O Desired One, O Generous One, O Merciful One! Souls come from You, and all power lies within the grasp of Your might. Whoever You exalt rises above the angels and attains the station of “We raised him to a lofty station,” and whoever You cast down is lower than dust; indeed, nothingness is better than him. O Lord, despite our wrongdoing, sinfulness, and lack of piety, we seek a seat of truth and long to meet Your chosen ones. The command is Yours, the judgment is Yours, and the realm of power is subject to Your command. Whatever You do is pure justice—indeed, sheer grace. A single revelation of Your name, the All-Merciful, would efface and obliterate every trace of rebellion from the world, and a single breeze from the breezes of the day of Your revelation would adorn the world with a new robe. O Mighty One, grant strength to the powerless and bestow life upon the dead, so that they may find You, gain access to the ocean of Your knowledge, and remain steadfast in Your Cause. If the fragrance of Your praise diffuses from the various languages of the world, all are beloved of the soul and desired by the spirit, whether Arabic or Persian. If they are deprived of it, neither words nor meanings are worthy of mention. O Lord, I ask You to show everyone the way and guide them. You are the Powerful, the Mighty, the Knowing, the Seeing.

12

نسأل اللّه ان یؤیّدک علی العدل و الانصاف و یعرّفک ما کان مستوراً عن العیون و الأبصار انّه هو العزیز المختار استدعا آنکه در آنچه ظاهر شده تفکّر نمایند و بعدل و انصاف تکلّم فرمایند شاید تجلّیات انوار آفتاب صدق و صفا پرتو افکند و از تاریکی نادانی نجات بخشد و عالم را بنور دانائی روشن فرماید این مظلوم مدارس نرفته مباحث ندیده لعمری انّی ما اظهرت نفسی بل اللّه اظهرنی کیف اراد در لوح حضرت سلطان ایّده اللّه تبارک و تعالى این کلمات از لسان مظلوم جاری

Nasʾalu Allāha an yuʾayyidaka ʿalā al-ʿadli wa-l-inṣāfi wa yuʿarrifaka mā kāna mastūran ʿan al-ʿuyūni wa-l-abṣār. Innahu huwa al-ʿAzīzu al-Mukhtār. Estedʿā ānke dar ānche ẓāher shode tafakkor namāyand va be-ʿadl va enṣāf takallom farmāyand, shāyad tajallīyāt-e anvār-e āftāb-e ṣedq va ṣafā partow afkanad va az tārīkī-ye nādānī najāt bakhshad va ʿālam rā be-nūr-e dānāʾī rowshan farmāyad. Īn Maẓlūm madāres narafte, mabāḥeth nadīde. La-ʿamrī innī mā aẓhartu nafsī bal Allāhu aẓharanī kayfa arād. Dar lowḥ-e Ḥaḍrat-e Solṭān, ayyadahu Allāhu tabāraka wa taʿālā, īn kalemāt az lesān-e Maẓlūm jārī:

We ask God to assist you in justice and fairness and to acquaint you with what has been concealed from eyes and sight. He is indeed the Almighty, the Unconstrained. The request is that you reflect on what has appeared and speak with justice and fairness, so that the radiance of the sun of truthfulness and purity may shine forth, deliver people from the darkness of ignorance, and illumine the world with the light of knowledge. This Wronged One has attended no schools and witnessed no scholarly debates. By My life, I did not reveal Myself; rather, God revealed Me as He willed. In the Tablet to His Majesty the Shah—may God, blessed and exalted, assist him—these words flowed from the tongue of the Wronged One:

13

یا سلطان انّی کنت کأحد من العباد و راقداً على المهاد مرّت علیّ نسائم السّبحان و علّمنی علم ما کان لیس هذا من عندی بل من لدن عزیز علیم و امرنی بالنّدآء بین الأرض و السّمآء بذلک ورد علیّ ما ذرفت به دموع العارفین ما قرأت ما عند النّاس من العلوم و ما دخلت المدارس فاسأل المدینة الّتی کنت فیها لتوقن بأنّی لست من الکاذبین هذه ورقة حرّکتها اریاح مشیّة ربّک العزیز الحمید هل لها استقرار عند هبوب اریاح عاصفات لا ومالک الأسمآء و الصّفات بل تحرّکها کیف ترید لیس للعدم وجود تلقآء القدم قد جآء امره المبرم و انطقنی بذکره بین العالمین انّی لم اکن الّا کالمیّت تلقآء امره قلّبتنی ید ارادة ربّک الرّحمن الرّحیم

Yā sulṭān, innī kuntu ka-aḥadin min al-ʿibādi wa rāqidan ʿalā al-mihād. Marrat ʿalayya nasāʾimu al-Subḥāni wa ʿallamanī ʿilma mā kān. Laysa hādhā min ʿindī bal min ladun ʿAzīzin ʿAlīm. Wa amaranī bi-l-nidāʾi bayna al-arḍi wa-l-samāʾ. Bi-dhālika warada ʿalayya mā dharafat bihi dumūʿu al-ʿārifīn. Mā qaraʾtu mā ʿinda al-nāsi min al-ʿulūmi wa mā dakhaltu al-madārisa fa-sʾal al-madīnata allatī kuntu fīhā li-tūqina bi-annī lastu min al-kādhibīn. Hādhihi waraqatun ḥarrakathā aryāḥu mashīʾati rabbika al-ʿAzīzi al-Ḥamīd. Hal lahā istiqrārun ʿinda hubūbi aryāḥin ʿāṣifāt? Lā wa Māliki al-asmāʾi wa-l-ṣifāt! Bal tuḥarrikuhā kayfa turīd. Laysa li-l-ʿadami wujūdun tilqāʾa al-qidam. Qad jāʾa amruhu al-mubramu wa anṭaqanī bi-dhikrihi bayna al-ʿālamīn. Innī lam akun illā ka-l-mayyiti tilqāʾa amrihi. Qallabatnī yadu irādati rabbika al-Raḥmāni al-Raḥīm.

“O King, I was like any other servant, asleep upon My couch. The breezes of the All-Glorious passed over Me and taught Me the knowledge of all that has been. This is not from Me, but from One who is Almighty, All-Knowing. He commanded Me to raise My call between earth and heaven. Because of this, there befell Me what has caused the tears of those who know to flow. I have not read the learning current among people, nor have I entered the schools. Ask the city in which I lived, so that you may be certain that I am not among those who lie. This is a leaf stirred by the winds of the will of your Lord, the Almighty, the Praiseworthy. Can it remain still when tempestuous winds blow? No, by the Master of names and attributes! Rather, they move it as they wish. Nothingness has no existence before the Eternal. His irrevocable command has come and caused Me to speak His remembrance among all peoples. Before His command I was only as one dead. The hand of the will of your Lord, the All-Merciful, the Merciful, turned Me about.”

14

حال بهتر آنکه آن جناب خود را بماء انقطاع که از معین قلم اعلی جاری شده طاهر نمایند و لوجه اللّه در آنچه از قبل و بعد ظاهر شده و یا نازل گشته تفکّر کنند و بعد بحکمت و بیان در اخماد نار ضغینه و بغضا که در قلوب احزاب عالم مکنونست بقدر مقدور ساعى و جاهد شوند مقصود از ارسال رسل و انزال کتب معرفة اللّه و الفت و اتّحاد عباد بوده حال ملاحظه میشود شریعت الهی را سبب و علّت بغضا و عناد نموده‌اند زهی حسرت و ندامت که اکثری به ما عندهم متمسّک و مشغول و از ما عند اللّه غافل و محجوب

Ḥāl behtar ānke ān janāb khod rā be-māʾ-e enqeṭāʿ ke az maʿīn-e Qalam-e Aʿlā jārī shode ṭāher namāyand va li-wajhi Allāh dar ānche az qabl va baʿd ẓāher shode va yā nāzel gashte tafakkor konand va baʿd be-ḥekmat va bayān dar ekhmād-e nār-e ḍaghīne va baghḍā ke dar qolūb-e aḥzāb-e ʿālam maknūn ast be-qadr-e maqdūr sāʿī va jāhed shavand. Maqṣūd az ersāl-e rosol va enzāl-e kotob maʿrefat-e Allāh va olfat va etteḥād-e ʿebād būde. Ḥāl molāḥeẓe mīshavad sharīʿat-e elāhī rā sabab va ʿellat-e baghḍā va ʿenād namūde-and. Zehī ḥasrat va nadāmat ke aktharī be-mā ʿindahom motamassek va mashghūl va az mā ʿinda Allāh ghāfel va maḥjūb.

It would now be best for you to purify yourself with the water of detachment that has flowed from the wellspring of the Most Exalted Pen and, for the sake of God, reflect on whatever has appeared or been revealed before and since. Then, through wisdom and utterance, strive to the extent of your ability to extinguish the fire of rancor and hatred concealed in the hearts of the peoples of the world. The purpose of sending the Messengers and revealing the Books has been the knowledge of God and fellowship and unity among His servants. Yet now we see that they have made the divine law a cause of hatred and hostility. What sorrow and regret that most people cling to and occupy themselves with what they possess, heedless of, and veiled from, what is with God.

15

قل الهی الهی زیّن رأسی باکلیل العدل و هیکلی بطراز الانصاف انّک انت مالک المواهب و الألطاف

Qul: Ilāhī Ilāhī, zayyin raʾsī bi-iklīli al-ʿadli wa haykalī bi-ṭirāzi al-inṣāf. Innaka anta Māliku al-mawāhibi wa-l-alṭāf.

Say: “My God, my God, adorn my head with the crown of justice and my body with the ornament of fairness. You are indeed the Master of gifts and favors.”

16

عدل و انصاف دو حارسند از برای حفظ عباد و از این دو کلمات محکمهٔ مبارکه که علّت صلاح عالم و حفظ امم است ظاهر گردد

ʿAdl va enṣāf do ḥāresand az barā-ye ḥefẓ-e ʿebād va az īn do kalemāt-e moḥkame-ye mobārake ke ʿellat-e ṣalāḥ-e ʿālam va ḥefẓ-e omam ast ẓāher gardad.

Justice and fairness are two guardians for the protection of the people, and from these two emerge firm and blessed words that bring about the well-being of the world and the preservation of nations.

17

در یکی از الواح از قلم مظلوم این کلمات جاری حقّ جلّ جلاله از برای ظهور جواهر معانی از معدن انسانی آمده یعنی مشارق امر و مخازن لآلی علم او چه که انّه تعالی غیب مکنون مستور عن الأنظار انظر ما انزله الرّحمن فی الفرقان لا تدرکه الأبصار و هو یدرک الأبصار و هو اللّطیف الخبیر

Dar yekī az alvāḥ az Qalam-e Maẓlūm īn kalemāt jārī: Ḥaqq jalla jalāluhu az barā-ye ẓohūr-e javāher-e maʿānī az maʿdan-e ensānī āmade, yaʿnī mashāreq-e amr va makhāzen-e laʾālī-ye ʿelm-e ū, che ke innahu taʿālā ghaybun maknūnun mastūrun ʿan al-anẓār. Unẓur mā anzalahu al-Raḥmānu fī al-Furqān: Lā tudrikuhu al-abṣāru wa huwa yudriku al-abṣāra wa huwa al-Laṭīfu al-Khabīr.

In one of the Tablets these words flowed from the Pen of the Wronged One: “God, exalted be His glory, has come to bring forth the gems of meaning from the mine of humanity—that is, the dawning places of His Cause and the treasuries of the pearls of His knowledge—for He, exalted is He, is an unseen mystery, concealed and hidden from sight. Consider what the All-Merciful has revealed in the Qur’an: ‘Eyes do not perceive Him, but He perceives all eyes, and He is the Subtle, the All-Aware.’”

18

الیوم دین اللّه و مذهب اللّه آنکه مذاهب مختلفه و سبل متعدّده را سبب و علّت بغضا ننمایند این اصول و قوانین و راههای محکم متین از مطلع واحد ظاهر و از مشرق واحد مشرق و این اختلافات نظر بمصالح وقت و زمان و قرون و اعصار بوده

Al-yowm dīn-e Allāh va madhhab-e Allāh ānke madhāheb-e mokhtalefe va sobol-e motaʿaddede rā sabab va ʿellat-e baghḍā nanamāyand. Īn oṣūl va qavānīn va rāhhā-ye moḥkam-e matīn az maṭlaʿ-e vāḥed ẓāher va az mashreq-e vāḥed moshreq va īn ekhtelāfāt naẓar be-maṣāleḥ-e vaqt va zamān va qorūn va aʿṣār būde.

Today the religion of God and the faith of God require that the diverse religions and various paths not be made a cause of hatred. These principles, laws, and firm, well-established paths have appeared from a single source and shone from a single dawning place. Their differences have been due to the needs of the times, centuries, and ages.

19

ای اهل بها کمر همّت را محکم نمائید که شاید جدال و نزاع مذهبی از بین اهل عالم مرتفع شود و محو گردد حبّاً للّه و لعباده بر این امر عظیم خطیر قیام نمائید ضغینه و بغضای مذهبی ناریست عالم‌سوز و اطفاء آن بسیار صعب مگر ید قدرت الهی ناس را از این بلاء عقیم نجات بخشد در محاربهٔ واقعهٔ بین دولتین ملاحظه نمائید طرفین از مال و جان گذشتند چه مقدار قریه‌ها کأن لم یکن ملاحظه شد

Ey ahl-e Bahā, kamar-e hemmat rā moḥkam namāʾīd ke shāyad jedāl va nezāʿ-e madhhabī az beyn-e ahl-e ʿālam mortafeʿ shavad va maḥv gardad. Ḥubban li-llāhi wa li-ʿibādihi bar īn amr-e ʿaẓīm-e khaṭīr qīyām namāʾīd. Ḍaghīne va baghḍā-ye madhhabī nārīst ʿālamsūz va eṭfā-ye ān besyār ṣaʿb, magar yad-e qodrat-e elāhī nās rā az īn balā-ye ʿaqīm najāt bakhshad. Dar moḥārebe-ye vāqeʿe-ye beyn-e dowlateyn molāḥeẓe namāʾīd. Ṭarafeyn az māl va jān goẕashtand. Che meqdār qaryehā ka-an lam yakun molāḥeẓe shod.

O people of Bahá, gird yourselves with determination, so that religious contention and strife may be removed from among the people of the world and effaced. Out of love for God and His servants, arise to undertake this great and momentous task. Religious rancor and hatred are a world-consuming fire, and extinguishing it is exceedingly difficult, unless the hand of divine power delivers people from this devastating affliction. Consider the war that took place between the two states. Both sides sacrificed possessions and lives. How many villages were seen reduced to nothing!

20

مشکوة بیان را این کلمه بمثابهٔ مصباح است ای اهل عالم همه بار یک دارید و برگ یک شاخسار بکمال محبّت و اتّحاد و مودّت و اتّفاق سلوک نمائید قسم بآفتاب حقیقت نور اتّفاق آفاق را روشن و منوّر سازد حقّ آگاه گواه این گفتار بوده و هست

Meshkāt-e bayān rā īn kaleme be-mathābe-ye meṣbāḥ ast: Ey ahl-e ʿālam, hame bār-e yek dārīd va barg-e yek shākhsār. Be-kamāl-e maḥabbat va etteḥād va mavaddat va ettefāq solūk namāʾīd. Qasam be-Āftāb-e Ḥaqīqat, nūr-e ettefāq āfāq rā rowshan va monavvar sāzad. Ḥaqq-e āgāh gavāh-e īn goftār būde va hast.

This utterance is like a lamp in the niche of speech: “O people of the world, you are all the fruit of one tree and the leaves of one branch. Conduct yourselves with perfect love, unity, affection, and concord. By the Sun of Truth, the light of concord will brighten and illumine the world. The all-knowing God has been, and remains, witness to these words.”

21

جهد نمائید تا باین مقام بلند اعلی که مقام صیانت و حفظ عالم انسانیست فائز شوید این قصد سلطان مقاصد و این امل ملیک آمال ولکن تا افق آفتاب عدل از سحاب تیرهٔ ظلم فارغ نشود ظهور این مقام مشکل بنظر میآید و سحاب تیره مظاهر ظنون و اوهامند یعنی علمای ایران گاهی بلسان شریعت و هنگامی بلسان حقیقت و طریقت نطق نمودیم و مقصد اقصی و غایت قصوی ظهور این مقام بلند اعلى بوده و کفی باللّه شهیداً

Jahd namāʾīd tā be-īn maqām-e boland-e aʿlā ke maqām-e ṣīyānat va ḥefẓ-e ʿālam-e ensānīst fāʾez shavīd. Īn qaṣd solṭān-e maqāṣed va īn amal malīk-e āmāl. Va lāken tā ofoq-e āftāb-e ʿadl az saḥāb-e tīre-ye ẓolm fāregh nashavad ẓohūr-e īn maqām moshkel be-naẓar mīāyad va saḥāb-e tīre maẓāher-e ẓonūn va owhāmand, yaʿnī ʿolamā-ye Īrān. Gāhī be-lesān-e sharīʿat va hengāmī be-lesān-e ḥaqīqat va ṭarīqat noṭq namūdīm va maqṣad-e aqṣā va ghāyat-e qoṣvā ẓohūr-e īn maqām-e boland-e aʿlā būde. Wa kafā bi-llāhi shahīdan.

Strive to attain this lofty and most exalted station, the station of safeguarding and preserving the human world. This purpose is the sovereign of all purposes, and this hope the king of all hopes. Yet until the horizon of the sun of justice is freed from the dark clouds of oppression, the realization of this station appears difficult. These dark clouds are the embodiments of conjectures and vain imaginings—that is, the religious scholars of Iran. At times We have spoken in the language of religious law, and at others in the language of mystical truth and the spiritual path. Our ultimate purpose and highest aim have been the realization of this lofty and most exalted station. God is sufficient as a witness.

22

ای اهل بها با جمیع اهل عالم بروح و ریحان معاشرت نمائید اگر نزد شما کلمه‌ئی و یا جوهریست که دون شما از آن محروم بلسان محبّت و شفقت القا نمائید و بنمائید اگر قبول شد و اثر نمود مقصد حاصل والّا او را باو گذارید و در بارهٔ او دعا نمائید نه جفا لسان شفقت جذّاب قلوبست و مائدهٔ روح و بمثابهٔ معانی است از برای الفاظ و مانند افق است از برای اشراق آفتاب حکمت و دانائی

Ey ahl-e Bahā, bā jamīʿ-e ahl-e ʿālam be-rūḥ va rayḥān moʿāsherat namāʾīd. Agar nazd-e shomā kalemeʾī va yā jowharīst ke dūn-e shomā az ān maḥrūm, be-lesān-e maḥabbat va shafaqat elqā namāʾīd va benamāʾīd. Agar qabūl shod va athar namūd maqṣad ḥāṣel, va ellā ū rā be-ū goẕārīd va dar bāre-ye ū doʿā namāʾīd na jafā. Lesān-e shafaqat jadhdhāb-e qolūb ast va māʾede-ye rūḥ va be-mathābe-ye maʿānī ast az barā-ye alfāẓ va mānand-e ofoq ast az barā-ye eshrāq-e āftāb-e ḥekmat va dānāʾī.

O people of Bahá, associate with all the people of the world in joy and fellowship. If you possess a word or a gem of which others are deprived, impart it and make it known in the language of love and compassion. If it is accepted and takes effect, the purpose is achieved; otherwise, leave the person to himself and pray for him, rather than mistreat him. The language of compassion attracts hearts and is nourishment for the spirit. It is like meaning to words and like the horizon for the shining of the sun of wisdom and knowledge.

23

مقصود از علما در این موارد که ذکر شده نفوسی هستند که خود را در ظاهر بلباس علم میآرایند و در باطن از آن محروم در ذکر این مقام در لوح حضرت سلطان چند فقره از فقرات کلمات مکنونه که باسم صحیفهٔ فاطمیّه صلوات اللّه علیها از قلم ابهی ظاهر ذکر میشود

Maqṣūd az ʿolamā dar īn mavāred ke dhekr shode nofūsī hastand ke khod rā dar ẓāher be-lebās-e ʿelm mīārāyand va dar bāṭen az ān maḥrūm. Dar dhekr-e īn maqām dar lowḥ-e Ḥaḍrat-e Solṭān chand faqre az faqarāt-e Kalemāt-e Maknūne ke be-esm-e Ṣaḥīfe-ye Fāṭemīyye, ṣalawātu Allāhi ʿalayhā, az Qalam-e Abhā ẓāher, dhekr mīshavad.

By religious scholars in the instances mentioned here are meant those who outwardly adorn themselves with the garb of learning but are inwardly deprived of it. In discussing this subject in the Tablet to His Majesty the Shah, several passages are cited from the Hidden Words, which appeared from the Most Glorious Pen under the title of the Scroll of Fátimih, may God’s blessings rest upon her.

24

ای بیوفایان چرا در ظاهر دعوی شبانی کنید و در باطن ذئب اغنام من شده‌اید مثل شما مثل ستارهٔ قبل از صبح است که در ظاهر درّی و روشن است و در باطن سبب اضلال و هلاکت کاروانهای مدینه و دیار منست

Ey bīvafāyān, cherā dar ẓāher daʿvī-ye shabānī konīd va dar bāṭen dheʾb-e aghnām-e man shode-īd? Mathal-e shomā mathal-e setāre-ye qabl az ṣobḥ ast ke dar ẓāher dorrī va rowshan ast va dar bāṭen sabab-e eḍlāl va halākat-e kārvānhā-ye madīne va dīyār-e man ast.

“O faithless ones, why do you outwardly claim to be shepherds, while inwardly you have become wolves preying on My sheep? You are like the star before dawn, which appears radiant and bright, but in reality leads the caravans of My city and lands astray and to destruction.”

25

و همچنین میفرماید ای بظاهر آراسته و بباطن کاسته مثل تو مثل آب تلخ صافیست که کمال لطافت و صفا از آن در ظاهر مشاهده شود و چون بدست صرّاف ذائقهٔ احدیّه افتد قطره‌ئی از آن را قبول نفرماید تجلّی آفتاب در تراب و مرآت هر دو موجود ولکن از فرقدان تا ارض فرق دان بلکه فرق بی‌منتهى در میان

Va hamchenīn mīfarmāyad: Ey be-ẓāher ārāste va be-bāṭen kāste, mathal-e to mathal-e āb-e talkh-e ṣāfīst ke kamāl-e leṭāfat va ṣafā az ān dar ẓāher moshāhede shavad va chon be-dast-e ṣarrāf-e dhāʾeqe-ye aḥadīyye oftad qaṭreʾī az ān rā qabūl nafarmāyad. Tajallī-ye āftāb dar torāb va merʾāt har do mowjūd, va lāken az Farqadān tā arḍ farq dān, balke farq-e bīmontahā dar mīyān.

And He also says: “O you who are outwardly adorned but inwardly deficient, you are like clear but bitter water, which outwardly appears perfectly delicate and pure, yet when tested by the divine Assayer’s taste, not a drop of it is accepted. The sun’s radiance is present in both dust and mirror, but know that the difference between them is as great as that between the two Pole Stars and the earth—indeed, the difference is infinite.”

26

و همچنین میفرماید ای پسر دنیا بسا سحرگاهان تجلّی عنایت من از مشرق لامکان بمکان تو آمد و ترا در بستر راحت بغیر مشغول دید و چون برق روحانی بمقرّ عزّ نورانی رجوع نمود و در مکامن قرب نزد جنود قدس اظهار نداشتم و خجلت ترا نپسندیدم

Va hamchenīn mīfarmāyad: Ey pesar-e donyā, basā saḥargāhān tajallī-ye ʿenāyat-e man az mashreq-e lāmakān be-makān-e to āmad va to rā dar bestar-e rāḥat be-ghayr mashghūl dīd va chon barq-e rūḥānī be-maqarr-e ʿezz-e nūrānī rojūʿ namūd va dar makāmen-e qorb nazd-e jonūd-e qods eẓhār nadāshtam va khejlat-e to rā napasandīdam.

And He also says: “O son of the world, many a dawn the revelation of My loving-kindness came from the dawning place of the Placeless to your dwelling, found you on your bed of ease occupied with another, and returned like a spiritual flash of lightning to its seat of radiant glory. In the retreats of nearness, before the hosts of holiness, I did not disclose it, nor did I wish for your shame.”

27

و همچنین میفرماید ای مدّعی دوستی من در سحرگاهان نسیم عنایت من بر تو مرور نمود و ترا در فراش غفلت خفته یافت و بر حال تو گریست و بازگشت

Va hamchenīn mīfarmāyad: Ey moddaʿī-ye dūstī-ye man, dar saḥargāhān nasīm-e ʿenāyat-e man bar to morūr namūd va to rā dar ferāsh-e ghaflat khofte yāft va bar ḥāl-e to gerīst va bāzgasht.

And He also says: “O you who claim to love Me, at dawn the breeze of My loving-kindness passed over you and found you asleep upon the bed of heedlessness. It wept over your condition and returned.”

28

امّا علمائی که فی‌الحقیقه بطراز علم و اخلاق مزیّنند ایشان بمثابهٔ رأسند از برای هیکل عالم و مانند بصرند از برای امم لازال هدایت عباد بآن نفوس مقدّسه بوده و هست نسأل اللّه ان یوفّقهم علی ما یحبّ و یرضى انّه هو مولی الوری و ربّ الآخرة و الأولی

Ammā ʿolamāʾī ke fī-l-ḥaqīqe be-ṭerāz-e ʿelm va akhlāq mozayyanand, īshān be-mathābe-ye raʾsand az barā-ye haykal-e ʿālam va mānand-e baṣarand az barā-ye omam. Lāzāl hedāyat-e ʿebād be-ān nofūs-e moqaddase būde va hast. Nasʾalu Allāha an yuwaffiqahum ʿalā mā yuḥibbu wa yarḍā. Innahu huwa Mawlā al-warā wa Rabbu al-ākhirati wa-l-ūlā.

But those scholars who are truly adorned with learning and good character are like the head to the body of the world and like eyes to the nations. The guidance of the people has always depended, and continues to depend, upon those sanctified souls. We ask God to enable them to do what He loves and approves. He is indeed the Master of creation and the Lord of the next world and this one.

29

یا شیخ انّا سمعنا انّ جنابک اعرضت عنّا و اعترضت علینا حیث امرت النّاس بسبّی و افتیت علی سفک دمآء العباد للّه درّ من قال طوعاً لقاض اتی فی حکمه عجباً افتی بسفک دمی فی الحلّ و الحرم براستی میگویم آنچه در سبیل الهی وارد شود محبوب جانست و مقصود روان سمّ مهلک در سبیلش شهدیست فائق و عذابش عذبیست لائق در لوح حضرت سلطان ذکر شده ونفسه الحقّ لا اجزع من البلایا فی سبیله و لا من الرّزایا فی حبّه قد جعل اللّه البلآء غادیة لهذه الدّسکرة الخضرآء و ذبالة لمصباحه الّذی به اشرقت الأرض و السّمآء

Yā Shaykh, innā samiʿnā anna janābaka aʿraḍta ʿannā wa-iʿtaraḍta ʿalaynā ḥaythu amarta al-nāsa bi-sabbī wa-aftayta ʿalā safki dimāʾi al-ʿibād. Li-llāhi darru man qāla: Ṭawʿan li-qāḍin atā fī ḥukmihi ʿajaban, aftā bi-safki damī fī al-ḥilli wa-al-ḥaram. Be-rāstī mīgūyam ānche dar sabīl-e ilāhī vāred shavad maḥbūb-e jān ast va maqṣūd-e ravān. Samm-e mohlik dar sabīlash shahdīst fāʾiq va ʿadhābash ʿadhbīst lāʾiq. Dar lawḥ-e Ḥaḍrat-e Sulṭān dhekr shode: Wa-nafsihi al-Ḥaqq, lā ajzaʿu min al-balāyā fī sabīlihi wa-lā min al-razāyā fī ḥubbihi. Qad jaʿala Allāhu al-balāʾa ghādiyatan li-hādhihi al-daskara al-khaḍrāʾ wa-dhubālatan li-miṣbāḥihi alladhī bihi ashraqat al-arḍu wa-al-samāʾ.

O Shaykh, We have heard that you have turned away from Us and opposed Us, commanding people to revile Me and issuing a ruling for the shedding of the servants’ blood. God bless the one who said: “Willing obedience to a judge whose judgment is a wonder: he has decreed that my blood be shed both outside the sanctuary and within it.” Truly I say, whatever befalls one in the path of God is beloved of the soul and the heart’s desire. Deadly poison in His path is surpassing honey, and His torment a fitting sweetness. In the Tablet to His Majesty the Shah it is stated: “By His own Self, the Truth! I do not bewail afflictions in His path or calamities endured for His love. God has made affliction a morning rain for this verdant field and a wick for His lamp, through which earth and heaven have been illumined.”

30

اقبل بقلبک الی شطر کعبة اللّه المهیمن القیّوم ثمّ ارفع یدیک باستقامة ترتفع بها ایادی الممکنات الی سمآء فضل اللّه ربّ العالمین ثمّ وجّه الیه بتوجّه تتوجّه به الکائنات الی افقه المشرق المنیر و قل ای ربّ ترانی مقبلاً الی سمآء جودک و بحر عطائک و معرضاً عن دونک اسألک بتجلّیات نیّر ظهورک فی الطّور و باشراقات شمس فضلک من افق اسمک الغفور ان تغفر لی و ارحمنی ثمّ اکتب لی من قلمک الأعلی ما یرفعنی باسمک فی ناسوت الانشآء ای ربّ وفّقنی علی التّوجّه الیک و اصغآء ندآء اولیائک الّذین ما اضعفتهم قوّة العالم و ما منعتهم سطوة الأمم اقبلوا و قالوا اللّه ربّنا و ربّ من فی السّموات و الأرضین

Aqbil bi-qalbika ilā shaṭri Kaʿbati Allāhi al-Muhaymini al-Qayyūm, thumma irfaʿ yadayka bi-istiqāmatin tartafiʿu bihā ayādī al-mumkināt ilā samāʾi faḍli Allāhi rabbi al-ʿālamīn. Thumma wajjih ilayhi bi-tawajjuhin tatawajjahu bihi al-kāʾināt ilā ufuqihi al-mushriqi al-munīr, wa-qul: Ay rabb, tarānī muqbilan ilā samāʾi jūdika wa-baḥri ʿaṭāʾika wa-muʿriḍan ʿan dūnika. Asʾaluka bi-tajalliyāti nayyiri ẓuhūrika fī al-Ṭūr wa-bi-ishrāqāti shamsi faḍlika min ufuqi ismika al-Ghafūr an taghfira lī wa-irḥamnī, thumma uktub lī min qalamika al-aʿlā mā yarfaʿunī bi-ismika fī nāsūti al-inshāʾ. Ay rabb, waffiqnī ʿalā al-tawajjuhi ilayka wa-iṣghāʾi nidāʾi awliyāʾika alladhīna mā aḍʿafathum quwwatu al-ʿālam wa-mā manaʿathum saṭwatu al-umam. Aqbalū wa-qālū: Allāhu rabbunā wa-rabbu man fī al-samāwāti wa-al-araḍīn.

Turn your heart toward the Kaaba of God, the All-Protecting, the Self-Subsisting. Then raise your hands with such steadfastness that the hands of all created things may be raised through it toward the heaven of the grace of God, the Lord of the worlds. Then turn toward Him with such devotion that all beings may thereby turn toward His radiant, luminous horizon, and say: “My Lord, You see me turning toward the heaven of Your generosity and the ocean of Your bounty, and turning away from all besides You. I ask You, by the splendors of the Daystar of Your revelation upon the Mount and by the rays of the sun of Your grace shining from the horizon of Your name, the Ever-Forgiving, to forgive me and have mercy on me. Then ordain for me, through Your Most Exalted Pen, what will exalt me through Your name in the earthly realm of creation. My Lord, enable me to turn toward You and to hear the call of Your loved ones, whom the power of the world has not weakened nor the might of the nations restrained. They turned toward You and said: ‘God is our Lord and the Lord of all who are in the heavens and on earth.’”

31

یا شیخ براستی میگویم ختم رحیق مختوم باسم قیّوم برداشته شد خود را محروم منما این مظلوم لوجه اللّه میگوید تو هم لوجه اللّه در آنچه نازل شده و ظاهر گشته تفکّر نما شاید از فیوضات فیّاض حقیقی در این یوم مبارک نصیب برداری و محروم نمانی لیس هذا علی اللّه بعزیز آدم خاکی از کلمهٔ الهی عرشی شد و صیّاد ماهی دارای حکمت ربّانی گشت حضرت ابوذر راعی غنم بود سیّد امم شد

Yā Shaykh, be-rāstī mīgūyam khatm-e raḥīq-e makhtūm be-ism-e Qayyūm bardāshte shod. Khod rā maḥrūm manamā. Īn maẓlūm li-wajhi Allāh mīgūyad, to ham li-wajhi Allāh dar ānche nāzel shode va ẓāher gashte tafakkor namā, shāyad az foyūḍāt-e Fayyāḍ-e Ḥaqīqī dar īn yawm-e mobārak naṣīb bardārī va maḥrūm namānī. Laysa hādhā ʿalā Allāhi bi-ʿazīz. Ādam-e khākī az kalame-ye ilāhī ʿarshī shod va ṣayyād-e māhī dārā-ye ḥekmat-e rabbānī gasht. Ḥaḍrat-e Abū Dharr rāʿī-ye ghanam būd, sayyed-e omam shod.

O Shaykh, truly I say, the seal of the sealed wine has been removed in the name of the Self-Subsisting. Do not deprive yourself. This Wronged One speaks for the sake of God; you too, for the sake of God, reflect on what has been sent down and made manifest, so that you may receive a share of the outpourings of the true Bestower of grace on this blessed Day and not remain deprived. This is not difficult for God. Through the Word of God, earthly Adam became heavenly, and a fisherman became endowed with divine wisdom. His Honor Abū Dharr was a shepherd of sheep; he became a leader of nations.

32

یا شیخ امروز روز علوم و فنون ظاهره نبوده و نیست چه که ملاحظه شد نفسی که بیک کلمه از آن علوم آگاه نه بر کرسیّ عقیان در صدر مجلس عرفان مستوی و صاحب علوم و دارای فنون محروم مقصود از این علوم علومىیست که از لفظ ابتدا شود و بلفظ منتهی گردد ولکن علومی که اثر و ثمر از آن ظاهر و سبب راحت و آسایش عباد است عنداللّه مقبول بوده و هست لو تسمع ندائی تدع ما عندک و تتوجّه الى مقام ماج فیه بحر الحکمة و البیان و هاج عرف عنایة ربّک الرّحمن

Yā Shaykh, emrūz rūz-e ʿolūm va fonūn-e ẓāhere nabūde va nīst, che ke molāḥeẓe shod nafsī ke be-yek kalame az ān ʿolūm āgāh na, bar korsī-ye ʿeqyān dar ṣadr-e majles-e ʿerfān mostavī va ṣāḥeb-e ʿolūm va dārā-ye fonūn maḥrūm. Maqṣūd az īn ʿolūm ʿolūmīst ke az lafẓ ebtedā shavad va be-lafẓ montahī gardad, va-līkan ʿolūmī ke athar va thamar az ān ẓāher va sabab-e rāḥat va āsāyesh-e ʿebād ast ʿinda Allāh maqbūl būde va hast. Law tasmaʿ nidāʾī tadaʿ mā ʿindaka wa-tatawajjahu ilā maqāmin māja fīhi baḥru al-ḥikmati wa-al-bayān wa-hāja ʿarfu ʿināyati rabbika al-Raḥmān.

O Shaykh, this day has not been, and is not, the day of outward learning and arts, for it has been seen that a person unacquainted with a single word of such learning is seated upon a throne of pure gold at the head of the gathering of spiritual knowledge, while one possessed of learning and versed in the arts remains deprived. By this learning is meant learning that begins with words and ends with words. But sciences that yield results and bear fruit, and bring comfort and well-being to the servants of God, have always been and remain acceptable to God. If you hear My call, you will abandon what you possess and turn toward a station where the ocean of wisdom and utterance surges and the fragrance of the loving care of your Lord, the All-Merciful, wafts.

33

در این مقام بنظر آمد فی‌الجمله از امور گذشته ذکر شود شاید سبب ظهور عدل و انصاف گردد این مظلوم در ایّامی که حضرت سلطان ایّده اللّه ربّه الرّحمن عزم توجّه به اصفهان نموده اذن حاصل کرده قصد زیارت بقاع مقدّسهٔ منوّرهٔ ائمّه صلوات اللّه علیهم نموده و بعد از رجوع نظر بگرمی هواء دارالخلافة و شدّت آن به لواسان رفتیم و بعد از توجّه حکایت حضرت سلطان ایّده اللّه تبارک و تعالی واقع و در آن ایّام امور منقلب و نار غضب مشتعل جمعی را اخذ نمودند از جمله این مظلوم را لعمر اللّه ابداً داخل آن امر منکر نبودیم و در مجالس تحقیق هم عدم تقصیر ثابت مع‌ذلک ما را اخذ نمودند و از نیاوران که در آن ایّام مقرّ سلطنت بوده سر برهنه و پای برهنه پیاده با زنجیر بسجن طهران بردند چه که یک ظالمی سواره همراه کلاه از سر برداشت و بسرعت تمام با جمعى از میرغضبان و فرّاشان ما را بردند و چهار شهر در مقامی که شبه و مثل نداشت مقرّ معیّن نمودند امّا سجن که محلّ مظلوم و مظلومان بوده فى‌الحقیقه دخمهٔ تنگ تاریک از آن افضل بوده و چون وارد حبس شدیم بعد از ورود ما را داخل دالانی ظلمانی نمودند از آنجا از سه پلّهٔ سراشیب گذشتیم و بمقرّی که معیّن نموده بودند رسیدیم امّا محل تاریک و معاشر قریب صد و پنجاه نفس از سارقین اموال و قاتلین نفوس و قاطعین طرق بوده مع این جمعیّت محل منفذ نداشت جز طریقی که وارد شدیم اقلام از وصفش عاجز و روائح منتنه‌اش خارج از بیان و آن جمع اکثری بى لباس و فراش اللّه یعلم ما ورد علینا فى ذاک المقام الأنتن الأظلم

Dar īn maqām be-naẓar āmad fī al-jomle az omūr-e godhashte dhekr shavad, shāyad sabab-e ẓohūr-e ʿadl va enṣāf gardad. Īn maẓlūm dar ayyāmī ke Ḥaḍrat-e Sulṭān, ayyadahu Allāhu rabbuhu al-Raḥmān, ʿazm-e tavajjoh be Eṣfahān namūde, edhn ḥāṣel karde qaṣd-e ziyārat-e beqāʿ-e moqaddase-ye monavvare-ye aʾemme, ṣalawātu Allāhi ʿalayhim, namūde, va baʿd az rojūʿ naẓar be-garmī-ye havā-ye Dār al-Khelāfe va sheddat-e ān be Lavāsān raftīm. Va baʿd az tavajjoh ḥekāyat-e Ḥaḍrat-e Sulṭān, ayyadahu Allāhu tabāraka wa-taʿālā, vāqeʿ va dar ān ayyām omūr monqaleb va nār-e ghaḍab moshtaʿel. Jamʿī rā akhdh namūdand, az jomle īn maẓlūm rā. La-ʿamru Allāh, abadan dākhel-e ān amr-e monkar nabūdīm va dar majāles-e taḥqīq ham ʿadam-e taqṣīr thābet. Maʿa dhālek mā rā akhdh namūdand va az Niyāvarān ke dar ān ayyām maqarr-e salṭanat būde, sar-berehne va pā-berehne piyāde bā zanjīr be-sejn-e Ṭehrān bordand, che ke yek ẓālemī savāre hamrāh kolāh az sar bardāsht va be-sorʿat-e tamām bā jamʿī az mīrghaḍabān va farrāshān mā rā bordand va chahār shahr dar maqāmī ke shabah va methl nadāsht maqarr moʿayyan namūdand. Ammā sejn ke maḥall-e maẓlūm va maẓlūmān būde, fī al-ḥaqīqe dakhme-ye tang-e tārīk az ān afḍal būde, va chūn vāred-e ḥabs shodīm baʿd az vorūd mā rā dākhel-e dālānī ẓolmānī namūdand. Az ānjā az se pelle-ye sarāshīb godhashtīm va be-maqarrī ke moʿayyan namūde būdand resīdīm. Ammā maḥall tārīk va moʿāsher qarīb-e ṣad va panjāh nafs az sāreqīn-e amvāl va qātelīn-e nofūs va qāṭeʿīn-e ṭoroq būde. Maʿ-e īn jamʿiyyat maḥall manfadh nadāsht joz ṭarīqī ke vāred shodīm. Aqlām az vaṣfash ʿājez va ravāʾeḥ-e montene-ash khārej az bayān, va ān jamʿ aktharī bī lebās va ferāsh. Allāhu yaʿlamu mā warada ʿalaynā fī dhāka al-maqāmi al-antan al-aẓlam.

At this point it seemed fitting to mention briefly some past events, in the hope that this might bring forth justice and fairness. In the days when His Majesty the Shah—may God, his Lord, the All-Merciful, assist him—had resolved to travel to Isfahan, this Wronged One obtained permission and set out to visit the sacred, luminous shrines of the Imams, may God’s blessings be upon them. After returning, because of the intense heat in the capital, We went to Lavasan. After Our departure, the incident involving His Majesty the Shah—may God, blessed and exalted be He, assist him—occurred. In those days affairs were thrown into turmoil and the fire of anger blazed. A number of people were arrested, among them this Wronged One. By the life of God, We had no involvement whatever in that reprehensible affair, and Our innocence was also established in the investigative proceedings. Nevertheless, they arrested Us and took Us in chains from Niyavaran, then the seat of the royal court, to the prison in Tehran, bareheaded and barefoot, on foot. For a mounted oppressor accompanying Us snatched the hat from Our head, and with a band of executioners and attendants they hurried Us along at full speed. For four months they assigned Us quarters in a place without parallel or likeness. As for the prison that housed this Wronged One and others who had been wronged, a narrow, dark tomb would in truth have been preferable to it. When We entered the prison, they led Us into a dark corridor. From there We descended three steps and reached the quarters they had assigned Us. The place was dark, and Our companions were some hundred and fifty people: thieves, murderers, and highway robbers. Despite this crowd, the place had no opening except the passage by which We had entered. Pens are powerless to describe it, and its foul odors are beyond expression. Most of those people had neither clothing nor bedding. God knows what befell Us in that most foul-smelling, most dark place.

34

و در ایّام و لیالی در سجن مذکور در اعمال و احوال و حرکات حزب بابی تفکّر مینمودیم که مع علوّ و سموّ و ادراک آن حزب آیا چه شده که از ایشان چنین عملی ظاهر یعنى جسارت و حرکت آن حزب نسبت بذات شاهانه و بعد این مظلوم اراده نمود که بعد از خروج از سجن بتمام همّت در تهذیب آن نفوس قیام نماید

Va dar ayyām va layālī dar sejn-e madhkūr dar aʿmāl va aḥvāl va ḥarakāt-e ḥezb-e Bābī tafakkor mīnamūdīm ke maʿ-e ʿolovv va somovv va edrāk-e ān ḥezb āyā che shode ke az īshān chonīn ʿamalī ẓāher, yaʿnī jasārat va ḥarakat-e ān ḥezb nesbat be-dhāt-e shāhāne. Va baʿd īn maẓlūm erāde namūd ke baʿd az khorūj az sejn be-tamām-e hemmat dar tahdhīb-e ān nofūs qiyām namāyad.

During the days and nights in that prison, We reflected on the deeds, circumstances, and conduct of the Bábí community: despite that community’s loftiness, nobility, and understanding, what had happened that such an act should have issued from them—namely, that community’s audacious action against the person of the Shah? This Wronged One then resolved, upon leaving prison, to arise with all His strength to refine the character of those souls.

35

و در شبی از شبها در عالم رؤیا از جمیع جهات این کلمهٔ علیا اصغا شد انّا ننصرک بک و بقلمک لا تحزن عمّا ورد علیک و لا تخف انّک من الآمنین سوف یبعث اللّه کنوز الأرض و هم رجال ینصرونک بک و باسمک الّذی به احیا اللّه افئدة العارفین

Va dar shabī az shabhā dar ʿālam-e roʾyā az jamīʿ-e jahāt īn kalame-ye ʿolyā eṣghā shod: Innā nanṣuruka bika wa-bi-qalamika. Lā taḥzan ʿammā warada ʿalayka wa-lā takhaf, innaka min al-āminīn. Sawfa yabʿathu Allāhu kunūza al-arḍ wa-hum rijālun yanṣurūnaka bika wa-bi-ismika alladhī bihi aḥyā Allāhu afʾidata al-ʿārifīn.

One night, in a dream, these exalted words were heard from every direction: “We will indeed make You victorious through Yourself and through Your Pen. Do not grieve over what has befallen You, and do not fear: You are among those who are secure. God will raise up the treasures of the earth: men who will aid You through Yourself and through Your name, by which God has brought the hearts of those who recognize Him to life.”

36

و چون مظلوم از سجن خارج حسب الأمر حضرت پادشاه حرسه اللّه تعالى مع غلام دولت علیّهٔ ایران و دولت بهیّهٔ روس به عراق عرب توجّه نمودیم و بعد از ورود باعانت الهی و فضل و رحمت ربّانی آیات بمثل غیث هاطل نازل و باطراف ارض ارسال شد و جمیع عباد را مخصوص این حزب را بمواعظ حکیمانه و نصایح مشفقانه نصیحت نمودیم و از فساد و نزاع و جدال و محاربه منع کردیم تا آنکه از فضل الهی غفلت و نادانی ببر و دانائی بدل گشت و سلاح باصلاح

Va chūn maẓlūm az sejn khārej, ḥasb al-amr-e Ḥaḍrat-e Pādshāh, ḥarasahu Allāhu taʿālā, maʿ-e gholām-e Dawlat-e ʿAliyye-ye Īrān va Dawlat-e Bahiyye-ye Rūs be ʿErāq-e ʿArab tavajjoh namūdīm. Va baʿd az vorūd be-eʿānat-e ilāhī va faḍl va raḥmat-e rabbānī āyāt be-methl-e ghayth-e hāṭel nāzel va be-aṭrāf-e arḍ ersāl shod, va jamīʿ-e ʿebād rā makhṣūṣ īn ḥezb rā be-mavāʿeẓ-e ḥakīmāne va naṣāyeḥ-e moshfeqāne naṣīḥat namūdīm va az fasād va nezāʿ va jedāl va moḥārebe manʿ kardīm, tā ānke az faḍl-e ilāhī ghaflat va nādānī be-berr va dānāʾī badal gasht va selāḥ be-eṣlāḥ.

When this Wronged One left prison, at the command of His Majesty the Shah—may God, exalted be He, protect him—We set out for Arab Iraq, accompanied by an attendant of the exalted government of Iran and of the illustrious government of Russia. After Our arrival, through divine assistance and the grace and mercy of the Lord, verses were sent down like pouring rain and dispatched to the regions of the earth. We counseled all the servants of God, and especially this community, with wise exhortations and compassionate advice, and forbade corruption, strife, contention, and warfare, until, through God’s grace, heedlessness and ignorance were changed into righteousness and understanding, and weapons into reform.

37

و در ایّام توقّف در سجن ارض طاء اگرچه نوم از زحمت سلاسل و روائح منتنه قلیل بود ولکن بعضى از اوقات که دست میداد احساس میشد از جهت اعلای رأس چیزى بر صدر میریخت بمثابهٔ رودخانهٔ عظیمى که از قلّهٔ جبل باذخ رفیعی بر ارض بریزد و بآن جهت از جمیع اعضا آثار نار ظاهر و در آن حین لسان قرائت مینمود آنچه را که بر اصغاء آن احدى قادر نه

Va dar ayyām-e tavaqqof dar sejn-e Arḍ-e Ṭāʾ agarche nawm az zaḥmat-e salāsel va ravāʾeḥ-e montene qalīl būd, va-līkan baʿḍī az awqāt ke dast mīdād eḥsās mīshod az jehat-e aʿlā-ye raʾs chīzī bar ṣadr mīrīkht, be-mathābe-ye rūdkhāne-ye ʿaẓīmī ke az qolle-ye jabal-e bādhekh-e rafīʿī bar arḍ berīzad. Va be-ān jehat az jamīʿ-e aʿḍā āthār-e nār ẓāher va dar ān ḥīn lesān qerāʾat mīnamūd ānche rā ke bar eṣghā-ye ān aḥadī qāder na.

During Our confinement in the prison of the Land of Ṭā, although sleep was scarce because of the torment of the chains and the foul odors, on those occasions when it did come, it felt as though something poured from the crown of Our head onto Our breast, like a mighty river descending to the earth from the summit of a lofty, towering mountain. As a result, every limb showed signs of fire, and at that moment Our tongue recited what no one could bear to hear.

38

و بعضی از بیانات که در الواح مخصوص این حزب نازل ذکر میشود تا بیقین مبین کل بدانند که این مظلوم عمل نموده آنچه را که نزد عقلا و مظاهر عدل و انصاف محبوب و مقبول بوده

Va baʿḍī az bayānāt ke dar alvāḥ makhṣūṣ-e īn ḥezb nāzel dhekr mīshavad tā be-yaqīn-e mobīn koll bedānand ke īn maẓlūm ʿamal namūde ānche rā ke nazd-e ʿoqalā va maẓāher-e ʿadl va enṣāf maḥbūb va maqbūl būde.

Some of the utterances revealed in Tablets addressed specifically to this community are quoted here, so that all may know with clear certainty that this Wronged One has acted in ways beloved and acceptable to people of understanding and to those who embody justice and fairness.

39

یا اولیآء اللّه فى بلاده و احبّائه فى دیاره یوصیکم المظلوم بالأمانة و الدّیانة طوبی لمدینة فازت بأنوارهما بهما یرتفع مقام الانسان و یفتح باب الاطمینان على من فى الامکان طوبی لمن تمسّک بهما و عرف شأنهما و ویل لمن انکر مقامهما

Yā awliyāʾa Allāhi fī bilādihi wa-aḥibbāʾahu fī diyārihi, yūṣīkumu al-Maẓlūmu bi-al-amānati wa-al-diyāna. Ṭūbā li-madīnatin fāzat bi-anwārihimā. Bihimā yartafiʿu maqāmu al-insān wa-yuftaḥu bābu al-iṭmiʾnān ʿalā man fī al-imkān. Ṭūbā li-man tamassaka bihimā wa-ʿarafa shaʾnahumā, wa-waylun li-man ankara maqāmahumā.

O friends of God in His lands and His loved ones in His realms! The Wronged One exhorts you to trustworthiness and piety. Blessed is the city that has attained their light. Through them the station of the human being is exalted and the door of assurance is opened to all in the contingent world. Blessed is the one who holds fast to them and recognizes their worth, and woe to the one who denies their station.

40

و در مقام دیگر این کلمات نازل انّا نأمر عباد اللّه و امائه بالعصمة و التّقوى لیقومنّ من رقد الهوی و یتوجّهنّ الى اللّه فاطر الأرض و السّمآء کذلک امرنا العباد حینما اشرق نیّر الآفاق من جهة العراق لیس ضرّی سجنی و بلائی و ما ورد علیّ من طغاة العباد بل عمل الّذین ینسبون انفسهم الی نفسی و یرتکبون ما ینوح به قلبی و قلمی انّ الّذین یفسدون فى الأرض و یتصرّفون فى اموال النّاس و یدخلون البیوت من غیر اذن صاحبها انّى بریء منهم الّا ان یتوبوا و یرجعوا الى اللّه الغفور الرّحیم

Va dar maqām-e dīgar īn kalemāt nāzel: Innā naʾmuru ʿibāda Allāhi wa-imāʾahu bi-al-ʿiṣmati wa-al-taqwā. Li-yaqūmanna min raqdi al-hawā wa-yatawajjahanna ilā Allāhi fāṭiri al-arḍi wa-al-samāʾ. Kadhālika amarnā al-ʿibāda ḥīnamā ashraqa nayyiru al-āfāq min jihati al-ʿIrāq. Laysa ḍurrī sijnī wa-balāʾī wa-mā warada ʿalayya min ṭughāti al-ʿibād, bal ʿamalu alladhīna yansubūna anfusahum ilā nafsī wa-yartakibūna mā yanūḥu bihi qalbī wa-qalamī. Inna alladhīna yufsidūna fī al-arḍ wa-yataṣarrafūna fī amwāli al-nās wa-yadkhulūna al-buyūta min ghayri idhni ṣāḥibihā, innī barīʾun minhum illā an yatūbū wa-yarjiʿū ilā Allāhi al-Ghafūri al-Raḥīm.

Elsewhere these words were revealed: “We command the servants and handmaidens of God to be chaste and God-fearing. Let them arise from the slumber of desire and turn toward God, the Creator of earth and heaven. Thus did We command the servants when the Daystar of the horizons shone from the direction of Iraq. What harms Me is not My imprisonment, My affliction, or what has been inflicted on Me by the tyrants among the people, but rather the deeds of those who ascribe themselves to Me and commit what causes My heart and My Pen to lament. Those who spread corruption on earth, take possession of people’s property, and enter houses without their owners’ permission—I disavow them unless they repent and return to God, the Ever-Forgiving, the Merciful.”

41

و در مقام دیگر یا ملأ الأرض سارعوا الى مرضاة اللّه و جاهدوا حقّ الجهاد فی اظهار امره المبرم المتین قد قدّرنا الجهاد فی سبیل اللّه بجنود الحکمة و البیان و بالأخلاق و الأعمال کذلک قضی الأمر من لدن قویّ قدیر لیس الفخر لمن یفسد فى الأرض بعد اصلاحها اتّقوا اللّه یا قوم و لا تکونوا من الظّالمین

Va dar maqām-e dīgar: Yā malaʾa al-arḍ, sāriʿū ilā marḍāti Allāh wa-jāhidū ḥaqqa al-jihād fī iẓhāri amrihi al-mubrami al-matīn. Qad qaddarnā al-jihāda fī sabīli Allāhi bi-junūdi al-ḥikmati wa-al-bayān wa-bi-al-akhlāqi wa-al-aʿmāl. Kadhālika quḍiya al-amru min ladun qawiyyin qadīr. Laysa al-fakhru li-man yufsidu fī al-arḍi baʿda iṣlāḥihā. Ittaqū Allāha yā qawm wa-lā takūnū min al-ẓālimīn.

And elsewhere: “O peoples of the earth! Hasten toward the good pleasure of God, and strive with all your strength to manifest His irrevocable and firmly established Cause. We have ordained that striving in the path of God be undertaken with the hosts of wisdom and utterance, and with good character and deeds. Thus has the decree been issued by One who is Strong and All-Powerful. There is no glory for one who spreads corruption on earth after it has been set right. Fear God, O people, and do not be among the wrongdoers.”

42

و در مقام دیگر لا تسبّوا احداً بینکم قد جئنا لاتّحاد من علی الأرض و اتّفاقهم یشهد بذلک ما ظهر من بحر بیانی بین العباد ولکنّ القوم اکثرهم فى بعد مبین ان یسبّکم احد او یمسّکم ضرّ فى سبیل اللّه اصبروا و توکّلوا علی السّامع البصیر انّه یشهد و یری و یعمل ما اراد بسلطان من عنده انّه هو المقتدر القدیر قد منعتم عن النّزاع و الجدال فی کتاب اللّه العزیز العظیم تمسّکوا بما تنتفع به انفسکم و اهل العالم کذلک یأمرکم مالک القدم الظّاهر بالاسم الأعظم انّه هو الآمر الحکیم

Va dar maqām-e dīgar: Lā tasubbū aḥadan baynakum. Qad jiʾnā li-ittiḥādi man ʿalā al-arḍi wa-ittifāqihim. Yashhadu bi-dhālika mā ẓahara min baḥri bayānī bayna al-ʿibād, wa-lākinna al-qawma aktharuhum fī buʿdin mubīn. In yasubbkum aḥadun aw yamasskum ḍurrun fī sabīli Allāh, iṣbirū wa-tawakkalū ʿalā al-Sāmiʿi al-Baṣīr. Innahu yashhadu wa-yarā wa-yaʿmalu mā arāda bi-sulṭānin min ʿindihi. Innahu huwa al-Muqtadiru al-Qadīr. Qad muniʿtum ʿan al-nizāʿi wa-al-jidāli fī kitābi Allāhi al-ʿAzīzi al-ʿAẓīm. Tamassakū bi-mā tanta fiʿu bihi anfusukum wa-ahlu al-ʿālam. Kadhālika yaʾmurukum Māliku al-Qidam al-ẓāhiru bi-al-ismi al-Aʿẓam. Innahu huwa al-Āmiru al-Ḥakīm.

And elsewhere: “Do not revile anyone among you. We have come to bring unity and concord to all who dwell on earth. What has appeared among the servants from the ocean of My utterance bears witness to this, yet most of the people remain manifestly far away. If anyone reviles you, or harm touches you in the path of God, be patient and place your trust in the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing. He indeed witnesses and sees, and does what He wills through an authority of His own. He is indeed the All-Powerful, the Almighty. You have been forbidden to engage in strife and contention in the Book of God, the Mighty, the Great. Hold fast to what benefits yourselves and the people of the world. Thus commands you the Lord of Eternity, manifest through the Most Great Name. He is indeed the Ordainer, the All-Wise.”

43

و در مقام دیگر ایّاکم ان تسفکوا الدّمآء اخرجوا سیف اللّسان عن غمد البیان لأنّ به تفتح مدائن القلوب انّا رفعنا حکم القتل عن بینکم انّ الرّحمة سبقت الممکنات ان کنتم تعلمون

Va dar maqām-i dīgar: Iyyākum an tasfikū al-dimāʾ. Akhrijū sayf al-lisān ʿan ghimd al-bayān li-anna bihi tuftaḥu madāʾin al-qulūb. Innā rafaʿnā ḥukm al-qatl ʿan baynikum. Inna al-raḥmata sabaqat al-mumkināt in kuntum taʿlamūn.

And elsewhere: “Beware of shedding blood. Draw the sword of the tongue from the sheath of utterance, for through it the cities of hearts are conquered. We have abolished the decree of killing among you. Mercy has indeed preceded all created things, if you only knew.”

44

و در مقام دیگر یا قوم لا تفسدوا فی الأرض و لا تسفکوا الدّمآء و لا تأکلوا اموال النّاس بالباطل و لا تتّبعوا کلّ ناعق رجیم

Va dar maqām-i dīgar: Yā qawm, lā tufsidū fī al-arḍ wa-lā tasfikū al-dimāʾ wa-lā taʾkulū amwāl al-nās bi-l-bāṭil wa-lā tattabiʿū kulla nāʿiq rajīm.

And elsewhere: “O people! Do not spread corruption on earth, do not shed blood, do not wrongfully consume the property of others, and do not follow every outcast who raises a clamor.”

45

و در مقام دیگر آفتاب بیان الهی را غروب اخذ ننماید و افول از پی درنیاید امروز این کلمهٔ علیا از سدرهٔ منتهى اصغا شد انّى لمن احبّنی و اخذ اوامری و نبذ ما نهی عنه فى کتابی

Va dar maqām-i dīgar: Āftāb-i bayān-i ilāhī rā ghurūb akhdh nanamāyad va ufūl az pay darnayāyad. Imrūz īn kalimiy-i ʿulyā az Sidriy-i Muntahā iṣghā shud: Innī li-man aḥabbanī wa-akhadha awāmirī wa-nabadha mā nuhiya ʿanhu fī kitābī.

And elsewhere: “The sun of divine utterance will never set, nor will its decline follow. Today this exalted utterance was heard from the Lote Tree beyond which there is no passing: ‘I belong to whoever loves Me, holds fast to My commandments, and casts aside what has been forbidden in My Book.’”

46

و در مقام دیگر امروز روز ذکر و ثنا و روز خدمتست خود را محروم منمائید شمائید حروفات کلمات و کلمات کتاب و شما نهالهائی هستید که از دست عنایت در ارض رحمت کشته شده‌اید و از امطار کرم نموّ نموده‌اید شما را از عاصفات شرک و قاصفات کفر حفظ فرمود و بایادی شفقت تربیت نمود حال وقت اثمار و اوراقست و اثمار سدرهٔ انسانی اعمال طیّبه و اخلاق مرضیّه بوده و هست این اثمار را از غافلین منع منمائید اگر پذیرفتند مقصود حاصل و حیات ظاهر والّا ذروهم فى خوضهم یلعبون یا حزب اللّه جهد نمائید شاید قلوب احزاب مختلفهٔ عالم بآب بردباری و شفقت شما از ضغینه و بغضا پاک و پاکیزه شود و قابل و لائق تجلّیات آفتاب حقیقت گردد

Va dar maqām-i dīgar: Imrūz rūz-i dhikr va thanā va rūz-i khidmat ast. Khud rā maḥrūm manamāyīd. Shumāyīd ḥurūfāt-i kalimāt va kalimāt-i kitāb va shumā nihālhāʾī hastīd ke az dast-i ʿināyat dar arḍ-i raḥmat keshte shude-īd va az amṭār-i karam numuv namūde-īd. Shumā rā az ʿāṣifāt-i shirk va qāṣifāt-i kufr ḥifẓ farmūd va bi-ayādī-yi shafaqat tarbiyat namūd. Ḥāl vaqt-i ithmār va awrāq ast va ithmār-i sidriy-i insānī aʿmāl-i ṭayyibe va akhlāq-i marḍiyye būde va hast. Īn ithmār rā az ghāfilīn manʿ manamāyīd. Agar padhīruftand maqṣūd ḥāṣil va ḥayāt ẓāhir va-illā dharhum fī khawḍihim yalʿabūn. Yā ḥizb Allāh, jahd namāyīd shāyad qulūb-i aḥzāb-i mukhtalifiy-i ʿālam bi-āb-i burdbārī va shafaqat-i shumā az ḍaghīne va baghḍā pāk va pākīze shavad va qābil va lāyiq-i tajalliyāt-i āftāb-i ḥaqīqat gardad.

And elsewhere: “Today is the day of remembrance and praise, and the day of service. Do not deprive yourselves. You are the letters of the words and the words of the Book, and you are saplings planted by the hand of loving care in the soil of mercy, which have grown through the rains of bounty. He protected you from the tempests of associating partners with God and the shattering winds of unbelief, and nurtured you with the hands of compassion. Now is the time for fruit and leaves, and the fruits of the human tree have always been, and remain, good deeds and pleasing qualities. Do not withhold these fruits from the heedless. If they accept them, the purpose is achieved and life is made manifest; otherwise, leave them to amuse themselves in their idle talk. O people of God! Strive, so that the hearts of the diverse peoples of the world may, through the water of your forbearance and compassion, be cleansed and purified of malice and hatred, and become fit and worthy to receive the splendors of the Sun of Truth.”

47

در اشراق چهارم از اشراقات ذکر نمودیم از برای هر امری ناصری لازم و جنود منصوره در این ظهور اعمال و اخلاق پسندیده است و قائد و سردار این جنود تقوی اللّه بوده اوست دارای کل و حاکم بر کل

Dar Ishrāq-i chahārum az Ishrāqāt dhikr namūdīm: Az barāy-i har amrī nāṣirī lāzim va junūd-i manṣūre dar īn ẓuhūr aʿmāl va akhlāq-i pasandīde ast va qāʾid va sardār-i īn junūd taqvā-yi Allāh būde. Ūst dārā-yi kull va ḥākim bar kull.

In the fourth Ishráq of the Ishráqát We stated: “Every cause requires a helper, and the victorious hosts in this Revelation are commendable deeds and qualities. The leader and commander of these hosts is the fear of God. It is the sovereign of all and rules over all.”

48

در تجلّی سوّم از کتاب تجلّیات ذکر نمودیم سبب علوّ وجود و سموّ آن علوم و فنون و صنائع است علم بمنزلهٔ جناحست از برای وجود و مرقاتست از برای صعود تحصیلش بر کل لازم ولکن علومی که اهل ارض از آن منتفع شوند نه علومی که از حرف ابتدا شود و بحرف منتهی گردد صاحبان علوم و صنائع را حقّ عظیم است بر اهل عالم یشهد بذلک امّ البیان فى هذا المقام المبین

Dar Tajallī-yi sivvum az Kitāb-i Tajalliyāt dhikr namūdīm: Sabab-i ʿuluvv-i vujūd va sumuvv-i ān ʿulūm va funūn va ṣanāyiʿ ast. ʿIlm bi-manziliy-i janāḥ ast az barāy-i vujūd va mirqāt ast az barāy-i ṣuʿūd. Taḥṣīlash bar kull lāzim va-lākin ʿulūmī ke ahl-i arḍ az ān muntafiʿ shavand na ʿulūmī ke az ḥarf ibtidā shavad va bi-ḥarf muntahī gardad. Ṣāḥibān-i ʿulūm va ṣanāyiʿ rā ḥaqq-i ʿaẓīm ast bar ahl-i ʿālam. Yashhadu bi-dhālika Umm al-Bayān fī hādhā al-maqām al-mubīn.

In the third Tajallí of the Book of Tajallíyát We stated: “The sciences, arts, and crafts are the means by which existence is exalted and elevated. Knowledge is like wings for existence and a ladder for ascent. Its acquisition is incumbent upon everyone, but it must be knowledge from which the people of the earth benefit, not knowledge that begins with words and ends with words. Those versed in the sciences and crafts have a great claim upon the people of the world. To this the Mother of Utterance bears witness in this manifest station.”

49

فی‌الحقیقه کنز حقیقی از برای انسان علم اوست و اوست علّت عزّت و نعمت و فرح و نشاط و بهجت و انبساط طوبی لمن تمسّک به و ویل للغافلین

Fī al-ḥaqīqe kanz-i ḥaqīqī az barāy-i insān ʿilm-i ūst va ūst ʿillat-i ʿizzat va niʿmat va faraḥ va nishāṭ va bahjat va inbisāṭ. Ṭūbā li-man tamassaka bihi wa-wayl li-l-ghāfilīn.

In truth, a human being’s real treasure is knowledge. It is the source of honor and prosperity, joy and delight, gladness and cheer. Blessed is whoever holds fast to it, and woe to the heedless.

50

آن جناب باید در جمیع احوال عباد را بآنچه سبب ظهور اخلاق روحانیّه و اعمال طیّبه است دعوت فرمایند تا کل آگاه شوند بآنچه که سبب ارتفاع وجود است و بهمّت کامل قصد مقام اعلى و ذروهٔ علیا نمایند و آنچه سبب اوّل است از برای تربیت خلق خشیة اللّه بوده طوبی للفائزین

Ān janāb bāyad dar jamīʿ-i aḥvāl ʿibād rā bi-ānche sabab-i ẓuhūr-i akhlāq-i rūḥāniyye va aʿmāl-i ṭayyibe ast daʿvat farmāyand tā kull āgāh shavand bi-ānche ke sabab-i irtifāʿ-i vujūd ast va bi-himmat-i kāmil qaṣd-i maqām-i aʿlā va dhurviy-i ʿulyā namāyand va ānche sabab-i avval ast az barāy-i tarbiyat-i khalq khashyat-i Allāh būde. Ṭūbā li-l-fāʾizīn.

You should, in all circumstances, summon the servants to whatever brings forth spiritual qualities and good deeds, so that all may become aware of what exalts human existence and, with full resolve, seek the most exalted station and the loftiest summit. The foremost means of educating humanity has been the fear of God. Blessed are those who attain it.

51
