کلمهٔ اولی که در ورق اوّل فردوس از قلم ابهی مذکور و مسطور اینست براستی میگویم حفظ مبین و حصن متین از برای عموم اهل عالم خشیة اللّه بوده اوست سبب اکبر از برای حفظ بشر و علّت کبری از برای صیانت وری بلی در وجود آیتی موجود و آن انسان را از آنچه شایسته و لائق نیست منع مینماید و حراست میفرماید و نام آن را حیا گذارده‌اند ولکن این فقره محدود است بمعدودی کل دارای این مقام نبوده و نیستند باید سلاطین ایّام و علمای انام به دین تمسّک نمایند چه که اوست علّت ظهور خشیة اللّه فیما سواه

Kalimiy-i ūlā ke dar varaq-i avval-i Firdaws az qalam-i Abhā madhkūr va masṭūr īn ast: Bi-rāstī mīgūyam ḥifẓ-i mubīn va ḥiṣn-i matīn az barāy-i ʿumūm-i ahl-i ʿālam khashyat-i Allāh būde. Ūst sabab-i akbar az barāy-i ḥifẓ-i bashar va ʿillat-i kubrā az barāy-i ṣiyānat-i varā. Balī dar vujūd āyatī mawjūd va ān insān rā az ānche shāyiste va lāyiq nīst manʿ mīnamāyad va ḥirāsat mīfarmāyad va nām-i ān rā ḥayā gudhāshte-and va-lākin īn faqare maḥdūd ast bi-maʿdūdī. Kull dārā-yi īn maqām nabūde va nīstand. Bāyad salāṭīn-i ayyām va ʿulamā-yi anām bi-dīn tamassuk namāyand che ke ūst ʿillat-i ẓuhūr-i khashyat-i Allāh fīmā sivāh.

The first word set down and inscribed by the Most Glorious Pen on the first leaf of Paradise is this: “Truly I say, the sure protection and strong fortress for all the people of the world is the fear of God. It is the greatest means of protecting humanity and the supreme cause of safeguarding humankind. There is indeed a sign within human beings that restrains and guards them from what is unseemly and unworthy, and it has been named a sense of shame. Yet this is confined to a few; not everyone has possessed or possesses this station. The rulers of the age and the learned among the people must hold fast to religion, for it is the means by which the fear of God appears in all besides Him.”

52

کلمهٔ ثانی که در ورق ثانی از فردوس ذکر نمودیم اینست قلم بیان در این حین مظاهر قدرت و مشارق اقتدار یعنی حضرات ملوک و سلاطین ایّدهم اللّه را نصیحت مینماید و به دین و تمسّک بآن وصیّت میکند اوست سبب بزرگ از برای نظم جهان و اطمینان من فی الامکان سستی ارکان دین سبب قوّت جهّال و جرئت و جسارت شده براستى میگویم آنچه از مقام بلند دین کاست بر غفلت اشرار افزود و نتیجه بالأخره هرج و مرج است اسمعوا یا اولی الأبصار ثمّ اعتبروا یا اولی الأنظار

Kalimiy-i thānī ke dar varaq-i thānī az Firdaws dhikr namūdīm īn ast: Qalam-i bayān dar īn ḥīn maẓāhir-i qudrat va mashāriq-i iqtidār yaʿnī ḥaḍarāt-i mulūk va salāṭīn, ayyadahum Allāh, rā naṣīḥat mīnamāyad va bi-dīn va tamassuk bi-ān vaṣiyyat mīkunad. Ūst sabab-i buzurg az barāy-i naẓm-i jahān va iṭmīnān-i man fī al-imkān. Sustī-yi arkān-i dīn sabab-i quvvat-i juhhāl va jurʾat va jisārat shude. Bi-rāstī mīgūyam ānche az maqām-i buland-i dīn kāst bar ghaflat-i ashrār afzūd va natīje bi-l-ākhare harj va marj ast. Ismaʿū yā ulī al-abṣār thumma iʿtabirū yā ulī al-anẓār.

The second word We mentioned on the second leaf of Paradise is this: “At this moment the Pen of Utterance counsels the manifestations of power and the dawning places of authority—that is, the kings and sovereigns, may God aid them—and exhorts them to uphold religion and hold fast to it. It is the great means of establishing order in the world and tranquility among all who dwell in it. The weakening of the pillars of religion has strengthened the ignorant and made them bold and insolent. Truly I say, whatever has diminished the lofty station of religion has increased the heedlessness of the wicked, and the eventual outcome is chaos and confusion. Listen, O people of insight, and take heed, O people of discernment.”

53

امید آنکه آن جناب در آنچه ذکر شد باذن واعیه اصغا فرمایند شاید عباد را از ما عندهم به ما عند اللّه آگاه نمایند از حقّ میطلبیم نور انصاف و آفتاب عدل را از سحاب تیرهٔ غفلت نجات بخشد و ظاهر فرماید هیچ نوری بنور عدل معادله نمینماید آنست سبب نظم عالم و راحت امم

Umīd ānke ān janāb dar ānche dhikr shud bi-udhun-i vāʿiye iṣghā farmāyand shāyad ʿibād rā az mā ʿindahum bi-mā ʿinda Allāh āgāh namāyand. Az Ḥaqq mīṭalabīm nūr-i inṣāf va āftāb-i ʿadl rā az saḥāb-i tīriy-i ghaflat najāt bakhshad va ẓāhir farmāyad. Hīch nūrī bi-nūr-i ʿadl muʿādile namīnamāyad. Ān ast sabab-i naẓm-i ʿālam va rāḥat-i umam.

It is hoped that you will listen with an attentive ear to what has been stated, so that you may turn the servants’ awareness from what they possess to what is with God. We ask God to free the light of fairness and the sun of justice from the dark clouds of heedlessness and make them manifest. No light can equal the light of justice. It is the means of establishing order in the world and bringing tranquility to the nations.

54

در صحیفهٔ بیان این کلمهٔ علیا مسطور و مرقوم بگو ای دوستان جهد نمائید شاید مصیباتی که فی سبیل اللّه بر مظلوم و شما وارد شده بین ناس ضایع نشود بذیل عفّت تمسّک نمائید و همچنین بحبل امانت و دیانت صلاح عالم را ملاحظه نمائید نه هوای نفس را یا حزب المظلوم شمائید رعاة عالم اغنام را از ذئب نفس و هوی مقدّس دارید و بطراز تقوی اللّه مزیّن نمائید اینست حکم محکم که از قلم قدم در این حین جاری شده لعمر اللّه سیف الأخلاق و الآداب احدّ من سیوف الحدید انّ الفطرة فی هذا الحین تنادی و تقول یا قوم قد اتی الیوم و اظهرنی ربّی بنور کسفت عند اشراقه شموس البیان اتّقوا الرّحمن و لا تکونوا من الغافلین

Dar Ṣaḥīfiy-i Bayān īn kalimiy-i ʿulyā masṭūr va marqūm: Bigū ay dūstān jahd namāyīd shāyad muṣībatī ke fī sabīl-i Allāh bar Maẓlūm va shumā vārid shude bayn-i nās ḍāyiʿ nashavad. Bi-dhayl-i ʿiffat tamassuk namāyīd va hamchunīn bi-ḥabl-i amānat va diyānat. Ṣalāḥ-i ʿālam rā mulāḥiẓe namāyīd na havā-yi nafs rā. Yā ḥizb al-Maẓlūm, shumāyīd ruʿāt-i ʿālam. Aghnām rā az dhiʾb-i nafs va havā muqaddas dārīd va bi-ṭirāz-i taqvā-yi Allāh muzayyan namāyīd. Īn ast ḥukm-i muḥkam ke az qalam-i qidam dar īn ḥīn jārī shude. La-ʿamr Allāh, sayf al-akhlāq wa-l-ādāb aḥaddu min suyūf al-ḥadīd. Inna al-fiṭrata fī hādhā al-ḥīn tunādī wa-taqūl: Yā qawm, qad atā al-yawm wa-aẓharanī rabbī bi-nūr kusifat ʿinda ishrāqihi shumūs al-bayān. Ittaqū al-Raḥmān wa-lā takūnū min al-ghāfilīn.

In the Scroll of Utterance this exalted word is written and inscribed: “Say: O friends! Strive, so that the afflictions that have befallen the Wronged One and you in the path of God may not be wasted among the people. Hold fast to the hem of chastity, and likewise to the cord of trustworthiness and piety. Consider the welfare of the world, not your own selfish desires. O people of the Wronged One! You are the shepherds of the world. Keep the sheep safe from the wolf of self and desire, and adorn them with the ornament of the fear of God. This is the firm decree that has flowed at this moment from the Pen of Eternity. By the life of God! The sword of good character and conduct is sharper than swords of iron. Human nature is at this moment calling out and saying: ‘O people! The Day has come, and my Lord has made me manifest with a light whose dawning has eclipsed the suns of utterance. Fear the All-Merciful, and do not be among the heedless.’”

55

کلمهٔ سوّم که در ورق سوّم فردوس ذکر نمودیم اینست یا ابن الانسان لو تکون ناظراً الی الفضل ضع ما ینفعک و خذ ما ینتفع به العباد و ان تکن ناظراً الى العدل اختر لدونک ما تختاره لنفسک انّ الانسان مرّةً یرفعه الخضوع الی سمآء العزّة و الاقتدار و اخری ینزله الغرور الی مقام الذّلّة و الانکسار یوم عظیم است و ندا بزرگ در لوحی از الواح این کلمهٔ علیا را ذکر نمودیم اگر عالم روح بتمامه بقوّهٔ سامعه تبدیل شود میتوان گفت لائق اصغاء این ندا است که از افق اعلی مرتفع والّا این آذانهای آلوده بقصص کاذبه لائق نبوده و نیست طوبی للسّامعین و ویل للغافلین

Kalimiy-i sivvum ke dar varaq-i sivvum-i Firdaws dhikr namūdīm īn ast: Yā ibn al-insān, law takūnu nāẓiran ilā al-faḍl ḍaʿ mā yanfaʿuka wa-khudh mā yantafiʿu bihi al-ʿibād wa-in takun nāẓiran ilā al-ʿadl ikhtar li-dūnika mā takhtāruhu li-nafsik. Inna al-insāna marratan yarfaʿuhu al-khuḍūʿ ilā samāʾ al-ʿizza wa-l-iqtidār wa-ukhrā yunziluhu al-ghurūr ilā maqām al-dhilla wa-l-inkisār. Yawm ʿaẓīm ast va nidā buzurg. Dar lawḥī az alvāḥ īn kalimiy-i ʿulyā rā dhikr namūdīm: Agar ʿālam-i rūḥ bi-tamāmihi bi-quvviy-i sāmiʿe tabdīl shavad mītavān guft lāyiq-i iṣghā-yi īn nidā ast ke az ufuq-i aʿlā murtafiʿ va-illā īn ādhānhā-yi ālūde bi-qiṣaṣ-i kādhibe lāyiq nabūde va nīst. Ṭūbā li-l-sāmiʿīn wa-wayl li-l-ghāfilīn.

The third word We mentioned on the third leaf of Paradise is this: “O son of man! If you look to grace, set aside what benefits you and take up what benefits the servants; and if you look to justice, choose for others what you choose for yourself. At one time, humility raises a human being to the heaven of glory and power; at another, pride brings one down to the station of abasement and humiliation.” The Day is momentous, and the call is mighty. In one of the Tablets We stated this exalted word: “If the entire world of the spirit were transformed into the faculty of hearing, it could be said to be worthy of hearing this call that has risen from the Most Exalted Horizon. Otherwise, these ears, defiled by false tales, have never been and are not worthy of it. Blessed are those who listen, and woe to the heedless.”

56

از حقّ جلّ جلاله سائل و آمل که مشارق ثروت و اقتدار و مطالع عزّت و اختیار یعنی ملوک ارض ایّدهم اللّه را بر صلح اکبر تأیید فرماید اینست سبب اعظم از برای راحت امم سلاطین آفاق وفّقهم اللّه باید باتّفاق باین امر که سبب اعظم است از برای حفظ عالم تمسّک فرمایند امید آنکه قیام نمایند بر آنچه سبب آسایش عباد است باید مجلس بزرگی ترتیب دهند و حضرات ملوک و یا وزرا در آن مجلس حاضر شوند و حکم اتّحاد و اتّفاق را جاری فرمایند و از سلاح باصلاح توجّه کنند و اگر سلطانی بر سلطانی برخیزد سلاطین دیگر بر منع او قیام نمایند در این صورت عساکر و آلات و ادوات حرب لازم نه الّا علی قدر مقدور لحفظ بلادهم و اگر باین خیر اعظم فائز شوند اهل مملکت کل براحت و مسرّت بامور خود مشغول گردند و نوحه و ندبهٔ اکثری از عباد ساکن شود نسأل اللّه ان یؤیّدهم على ما یحبّ و یرضی انّه هو ربّ العرش و الثّری و مالک الآخرة و الأولی احسن و اولی آنکه در آن مجلس خود سلاطین عظام حاضر شوند و حکم فرمایند و هر یک از سلاطین که بر این امر و اجرای آن قیام فرماید او سیّد سلاطین است عند اللّه طوبی له و نعیماً له

Az Ḥaqq, jalla jalāluhu, sāʾil va āmil ke mashāriq-i tharvat va iqtidār va maṭāliʿ-i ʿizzat va ikhtiyār yaʿnī mulūk-i arḍ, ayyadahum Allāh, rā bar ṣulḥ-i akbar taʾyīd farmāyad. Īn ast sabab-i aʿẓam az barāy-i rāḥat-i umam. Salāṭīn-i āfāq, waffaqahum Allāh, bāyad bi-ittifāq bi-īn amr ke sabab-i aʿẓam ast az barāy-i ḥifẓ-i ʿālam tamassuk farmāyand. Umīd ānke qiyām namāyand bar ānche sabab-i āsāyish-i ʿibād ast. Bāyad majlis-i buzurgī tartīb dihand va ḥaḍarāt-i mulūk va yā vuzarā dar ān majlis ḥāḍir shavand va ḥukm-i ittiḥād va ittifāq rā jārī farmāyand va az silāḥ bi-iṣlāḥ tavajjuh kunand va agar sulṭānī bar sulṭānī barkhīzad salāṭīn-i dīgar bar manʿ-i ū qiyām namāyand. Dar īn ṣūrat ʿasākir va ālāt va adavāt-i ḥarb lāzim na illā ʿalā qadr maqdūr li-ḥifẓ bilādihim va agar bi-īn khayr-i aʿẓam fāʾiz shavand ahl-i mamlakat kull bi-rāḥat va masarrat bi-umūr-i khud mashghūl gardand va nawḥe va nudbiy-i aktharī az ʿibād sākin shavad. Nasʾalu Allāh an yuʾayyidahum ʿalā mā yuḥibbu wa-yarḍā innahu huwa rabb al-ʿarsh wa-l-tharā wa-mālik al-ākhira wa-l-ūlā. Aḥsan va awlā ānke dar ān majlis khud-i salāṭīn-i ʿiẓām ḥāḍir shavand va ḥukm farmāyand va har yak az salāṭīn ke bar īn amr va ijrā-yi ān qiyām farmāyad ū sayyid-i salāṭīn ast ʿinda Allāh. Ṭūbā lahu wa-naʿīman lahu.

We ask and hope that God, exalted be His glory, will aid the dawning places of wealth and power and the sources of honor and authority—that is, the kings of the earth, may God aid them—to establish the Most Great Peace. This is the greatest means of bringing tranquility to the nations. The sovereigns of the world, may God grant them success, must jointly uphold this cause, which is the greatest means of protecting the world. It is hoped that they will arise to do what brings ease to the servants. They must convene a great assembly, and the kings or their ministers must attend it, enforce unity and concord, and turn from arms to reconciliation. If one sovereign rises against another, the other sovereigns must arise to restrain him. In that case, armies and the instruments and equipment of war would be unnecessary, except for a limited measure to protect their countries. If they attain this greatest good, all the people of the realm will pursue their affairs in comfort and happiness, and the lamentation and mourning of most of the servants will be stilled. We ask God to aid them in what He loves and approves. He is indeed the Lord of the throne and the earth, and the Master of the next world and this one. It would be better and more fitting for the great sovereigns themselves to attend that assembly and issue its decrees. Whichever sovereign arises to undertake this cause and carry it out is, in God’s sight, the foremost of sovereigns. Blessed is he, and bliss be his.

57

در این اراضی هر هنگام نوبت عسکریّه میشود از هر جهتی فزع اکبر ظاهر و هر یک از دول در هر سنه بر عساکر میافزاید چه که وزرای حرب در این فقره حریصند و به هل من مزید ناطق از قرار مذکور دولت ایران ایّدها اللّه هم اراده نموده‌اند بر عسکر بیفزایند نزد مظلوم حال صدهزار عسکر منظّم مرتّب کفایت مینماید امید آنکه آن حضرت بر نور عدل بیفزایند لعمر اللّه عدل جندیست قویّ اوست در مقام اوّل و رتبهٔ اولی فاتح افئده و قلوب و اوست مبیّن اسرار وجود و دارای رایت محبّت و جود

Dar īn arāḍī har hangām nawbat-i ʿaskariyye mīshavad az har jihatī fazaʿ-i akbar ẓāhir va har yak az duval dar har sane bar ʿasākir mīafzāyad che ke vuzarā-yi ḥarb dar īn faqare ḥarīṣand va bi-hal min mazīd nāṭiq. Az qarār-i madhkūr dawlat-i Īrān, ayyadahā Allāh, ham irāde namūde-and bar ʿaskar biyafzāyand. Nazd-i Maẓlūm ḥāl ṣad hazār ʿaskar-i munaẓẓam-i murattab kifāyat mīnamāyad. Umīd ānke ān ḥaḍrat bar nūr-i ʿadl biyafzāyand. La-ʿamr Allāh, ʿadl jundī-st qavī. Ūst dar maqām-i avval va rutbiy-i ūlā fātiḥ-i afʾide va qulūb va ūst mubayyin-i asrār-i vujūd va dārā-yi rāyat-i maḥabbat va jūd.

In these lands, whenever the time for military conscription comes, the greatest alarm appears on every side. Each state increases its forces every year, for the ministers of war are eager in this matter and keep saying, “Is there more?” According to reports, the government of Iran, may God aid it, also intends to increase its army. In the view of the Wronged One, one hundred thousand well-organized and disciplined troops would suffice at present. It is hoped that His Majesty will increase the light of justice. By the life of God! Justice is a mighty host. It is, first and foremost, the conqueror of hearts and souls; it reveals the mysteries of existence and bears the banner of love and generosity.

58

و در خزائن علوم الهی علمی موجود که عمل بآن خوف را زائل مینماید ولکن على قدر مقدور و آن ترتیبی است که باید از ایّام طفولیّت بآن عمل شود بسیار فرق مینماید و آنچه از آن بکاهد بر جرئت میافزاید اگر ارادهٔ الهی مدد فرماید شرح مبسوطى در آنچه ذکر شد از قلم بیان جاری میگردد و شاید در مراتب علوم و فنون هم ظاهر شود آنچه که سبب تجدید عالم و امم گردد و همچنین کلمه‌ئی در صحیفهٔ حمرا از قلم اعلی مرقوم و مسطور و آن کلمه قوّت مکنونهٔ در عباد را بتمامها ظاهر فرماید بلکه مثل آن بر آن بیفزایدنسأل اللّه تبارک و تعالی ان یؤیّد عباده علی ما یحبّ و یرضی

Va dar khazāʾen-e ʿolūm-e elāhī ʿelmī mawjūd ke ʿamal be ān khawf rā zāʾel mīnamāyad valāken ʿalā qadr-e maqdūr va ān tartībī ast ke bāyad az ayyām-e ṭofūliyyat be ān ʿamal shavad besyār farq mīnamāyad va ānche az ān bekāhad bar jorʾat mīafzāyad agar erāde-ye elāhī madad farmāyad sharḥ-e mabsūṭī dar ānche dhekr shod az qalam-e bayān jārī mīg ardad va shāyad dar marāteb-e ʿolūm va fonūn ham ẓāher shavad ānche ke sabab-e tajdīd-e ʿālam va omam gardad va hamchenīn kalameʾī dar ṣaḥīfe-ye ḥamrā az qalam-e aʿlā marqūm va masṭūr va ān kalame qovvat-e maknūne-ye dar ʿebād rā be tamāmhā ẓāher farmāyad balke methl-e ān bar ān bīafzāyad. Nasʾalu Allāha tabāraka wa-taʿālā an yuʾayyida ʿibādahu ʿalā mā yuḥibbu wa-yarḍā.

And in the treasuries of divine knowledge there is a knowledge whose application dispels fear, though only to the extent possible. It is a method that must be practiced from childhood. It makes a great difference, and whatever it diminishes of fear it adds to courage. If the divine will lends its aid, a detailed explanation of what has been mentioned will flow from the pen of utterance. Perhaps there will also appear, in the various branches of the sciences and arts, that which will bring about the renewal of the world and its nations. Likewise, a word has been inscribed and recorded by the Most Exalted Pen in the Crimson Scroll. That word will reveal in their entirety the powers latent in human beings; indeed, it will add as much again to them. We ask God, blessed and exalted be He, to aid His servants in what He loves and approves.

59

این ایّام از جمیع جهات اعدا ظاهر و نار بغضا مشتعل ای اهل ارض لعمری و عمرکم این مظلوم خیال ریاست نداشته و ندارد و مقصود رفع آنچه سبب اختلاف احزاب عالم و تفریق امم است بوده و هست تا کل فارغ و آزاد شوند و بخود پردازند استدعا آنکه دوستان این ذیل را بغبار اکاذیب نیالایند و بذکر خوارق عادات که نزد ایشان است از شأن و مقام و تقدیس و تنزیه نکاهند

Īn ayyām az jamīʿ-e jehāt aʿdā ẓāher va nār-e baghḍā moshtaʿel ey ahl-e arḍ la-ʿamrī wa-ʿamrikum īn maẓlūm khayāl-e reyāsat nadāshte va nadārad va maqṣūd rafʿ-e ānche sabab-e ekhtelāf-e aḥzāb-e ʿālam va tafrīq-e omam ast būde va hast tā koll fāregh va āzād shavand va be khod pardāzand estedʿā ānke dūstān īn dheyl rā be ghobār-e akādhīb nayālāyand va be dhekr-e khavāreq-e ʿādāt ke nazd-e īshān ast az shaʾn va maqām va taqdīs va tanzīh nakāhand.

These days enemies have appeared on every side, and the fire of hatred is ablaze. People of the earth! By my life and yours, this Wronged One has never entertained, nor does he now entertain, any ambition for leadership. His purpose has been and remains to remove whatever causes discord among the peoples of the world and division among its nations, so that all may be free and at ease and attend to their own affairs. The friends are asked not to soil this hem with the dust of falsehoods, or to diminish his dignity, station, sanctity, and purity by recounting the miracles they ascribe to him.

60

سبحان‌اللّه امروز روزیست که عقلا از این مظلوم اخذ رأی نمایند و از حقّ بطلبند آنچه را که سبب عزّت و آسایش است ولکن کل برعکس بر اطفاء این نور ساطع لمیع جاهد و ساعی و هر نفسی در صدد آنست که تقصیری ثابت نماید و یا ایرادی وارد آورد امر بمقامی رسیده که از جمیع اطوار این مظلوم اظهار نموده‌اند آنچه را که ذکر آن شایسته نیست یکی از دوستان از نفسی از نفوس مجتمعه در مدینهٔ کبیره ذکر نموده که گفته در هر سنه مبلغ پنجاه‌هزار تومان از وطن به عکّا میرود و بکمال افسوس این فقره را ذکر نمود معلوم نشد محاسب که بوده و دفتردار که

S obḥān Allāh emrūz rūzīst ke ʿoqalā az īn maẓlūm akhdh-e raʾy namāyand va az Ḥaqq beṭalaband ānche rā ke sabab-e ʿezzat va āsāyesh ast valāken koll barʿaks bar eṭfāʾ-e īn nūr-e sāṭeʿ-e lamīʿ jāhed va sāʿī va har nafsī dar ṣadad-e ānast ke taqṣīrī thābet namāyad va yā īrādī vāred āvarad amr be maqāmī resīde ke az jamīʿ-e aṭvār-e īn maẓlūm eẓhār namūdeand ānche rā ke dhekr-e ān shāyeste nīst yekī az dūstān az nafsī az nofūs-e mojtameʿe dar madīne-ye kabīre dhekr namūde ke gofte dar har sane mablagh-e panjāh-hezār tūmān az vaṭan be ʿAkkā mīravad va be kamāl-e afsūs īn faqare rā dhekr namūd maʿlūm nashod moḥāseb ke būde va daftardār ke.

Glory be to God! This is the day when the wise should seek the counsel of this Wronged One and ask God for what brings honor and well-being. Yet all, on the contrary, are striving and laboring to extinguish this radiant, shining light, and everyone seeks to establish some fault or raise some objection. Matters have reached the point where they have said things about every aspect of this Wronged One’s conduct that are unworthy of mention. One of the friends reported that a person among those gathered in the Great City had said that every year a sum of fifty thousand tumans goes from the homeland to Acre. He mentioned this with the deepest regret. It is not known who the accountant was, or who the bookkeeper.

61

باری این مظلوم در جمیع آنچه وارد آورده‌اند و گفته‌اند صابر و صامت چه که اراده آنکه از عنایت حقّ جلّ جلاله و رحمت مسبوقه حکم جدال و نزاع و سفک دماء را از عالم بقوّهٔ بیان محو نمائیم در جمیع احوال در آنچه گفته‌اند بصبر جمیل تمسّک جسته‌ایم و بحقّ گذارده‌ایم ولکن در جواب این فقره ذکر نمودیم اگر فی‌الحقیقه در آنچه ذکر نموده صادقست باید مالک وجود و سلطان غیب و شهود را شکر نماید که نفسی را از ایران مبعوث فرموده که در سجن من غیر ناصر و معین ایران را تصرّف فرموده و یک مالیات هر سنه از آن اخذ میفرماید این مقام ستایش است نه نکوهش لو یکون من المنصفین و اگر نفسی اراده نماید بر امور این مظلوم واقف شود جواب اینست که در بعضی از لیالی و ایّام اسرای عالم و مظلومهای امم بی‌قوت شب را بروز آورده‌اند و روز را بشب این اذکار را دوست نداشته و نداریم و از گوینده هم شکایت ننموده و نمینمائیم در این سجن شخص معزّزی چندی از سنگ‌تراشی کسب معاش مینمود و در بعضى از اوقات هم بعضی بطعام اللّه مرزوق یعنى جوع نسأل اللّه تبارک و تعالی ان یؤیّد الکلّ علی العدل و الانصاف و یوفّقهم علی الانابة و الرّجوع انّه هو السّامع المجیب

Bārī īn maẓlūm dar jamīʿ-e ānche vāred āvardeand va gofteand ṣāber va ṣāmet che ke erāde ānke az ʿenāyat-e Ḥaqq jalla jalāluhu va raḥmat-e masbūqe ḥokm-e jedāl va nezāʿ va safk-e demā rā az ʿālam be qovve-ye bayān maḥv namāyīm dar jamīʿ-e aḥvāl dar ānche gofteand be ṣabr-e jamīl tamassok josteʾīm va be Ḥaqq godhāshteʾīm valāken dar javāb-e īn faqare dhekr namūdīm agar fī’l-ḥaqīqe dar ānche dhekr namūde ṣādeq ast bāyad Mālek-e vojūd va Solṭān-e ghayb va shohūd rā shokr namāyad ke nafsī rā az Īrān mabʿūth farmūde ke dar sejn min ghayr-e nāṣer va moʿīn Īrān rā taṣarrof farmūde va yek māliyāt har sane az ān akhdh mīfarmāyad īn maqām-e setāyesh ast na nekūhesh law yakūnu mina al-munṣifīn va agar nafsī erāde namāyad bar omūr-e īn maẓlūm vāqef shavad javāb īnast ke dar baʿḍī az layālī va ayyām osarā-ye ʿālam va maẓlūmhā-ye omam bī-qūt shab rā be rūz āvardeand va rūz rā be shab īn adhkār rā dūst nadāshte va nadārīm va az gūyande ham shekāyat nanamūde va namīnamāyīm dar īn sejn shakhṣ-e moʿazzazī chandī az sang-tarāshī kasb-e maʿāsh mīnamūd va dar baʿḍī az awqāt ham baʿḍī be ṭaʿām-e Allāh marzūq yaʿnī jūʿ. Nasʾalu Allāha tabāraka wa-taʿālā an yuʾayyida al-kulla ʿalā al-ʿadli wa-l-inṣāfi wa-yuwaffiqahum ʿalā al-inābati wa-l-rujūʿi innahu huwa al-Sāmiʿu al-Mujīb.

In short, this Wronged One has remained patient and silent in the face of everything they have inflicted and said, for our intention is, through the grace of God, exalted be His glory, and His all-preceding mercy, to efface from the world the rule of contention, conflict, and bloodshed through the power of utterance. In all circumstances, faced with what they have said, we have held fast to gracious patience and left the matter to God. In reply to this statement, however, we said: If he is indeed truthful in what he has stated, he should thank the Lord of existence and Sovereign of the unseen and the seen for having raised up a person from Iran who, while in prison, without helper or supporter, has taken possession of Iran and collects a tax from it every year. This calls for praise, not blame, if he is fair-minded. And if anyone wishes to learn about the affairs of this Wronged One, the answer is that on some nights and days the captives of the world and the wronged ones among the nations have passed from night to morning and from day to night without food. We have never liked, nor do we now like, mentioning such things, and we have neither complained nor do we complain of the person who made that statement. In this prison, an honored person earned his livelihood for a time by cutting stone, and at times some have been sustained by the food of God—that is, hunger. We ask God, blessed and exalted be He, to aid everyone in justice and fairness and enable them to turn to Him and return. He is indeed the All-Hearing, the Responsive.

62

سبحانّک اللّهمّ یا الهی تری ما ورد علی المظلوم من الّذین ما عاشرونی و قاموا علی ضرّی و مسکنتی بحیث عجزت الأقلام عن ذکره و الألسن عن بیانه و الألواح عن حمله تسمع حنین قلبی و ضجیج کینونتی و ما ورد علی امنائک فی بلادک و اصفیائک فی مملکتک من الّذین نقضوا عهدک و میثاقک ای ربّ اسألک بضجیج العشّاق فی الآفاق و بحنینهم فی بعدهم عن ساحة قربک و بالدّمآء الّتی سفکت فی حبّک و بالأکباد الّتی ذابت فی سبیلک ان تحفظ اولیائک من ظلم الّذین غفلوا من اسرار اسمک المختار ای ربّ ایّدهم بقدرتک الّتی غلبت الأشیآء و وفّقهم علی الصّبر و الاصطبار انّک انت المقتدر العزیز الوهّاب لا اله الّا انت الکریم الفیّاض

Subḥānaka Allāhumma yā ilāhī tarā mā warada ʿalā al-Maẓlūmi mina alladhīna mā ʿāsharūnī wa-qāmū ʿalā ḍurrī wa-maskanatī bi-ḥaythu ʿajazati al-aqlāmu ʿan dhikrihi wa-l-alsunu ʿan bayānihi wa-l-alwāḥu ʿan ḥamlihi tasmaʿu ḥanīna qalbī wa-ḍajīja kaynūnatī wa-mā warada ʿalā umanāʾika fī bilādika wa-aṣfiyāʾika fī mamlakatika mina alladhīna naqaḍū ʿahdaka wa-mīthāqaka ay rabbi asʾaluka bi-ḍajīji al-ʿushshāqi fī al-āfāqi wa-bi-ḥanīnihim fī buʿdihim ʿan sāḥati qurbika wa-bi-l-dimāʾi allatī sufikat fī ḥubbika wa-bi-l-akbādi allatī dhābat fī sabīlika an taḥfaẓa awliyāʾaka min ẓulmi alladhīna ghafalū min asrāri ismika al-Mukhtār ay rabbi ayyidhum bi-qudratika allatī ghalabati al-ashyāʾa wa-waffiqhum ʿalā al-ṣabri wa-l-iṣṭibāri innaka anta al-Muqtadiru al-ʿAzīzu al-Wahhāb lā ilāha illā anta al-Karīmu al-Fayyāḍ.

Glory be to You, O God, my God! You see what has befallen the Wronged One at the hands of those who have never associated with me and have risen to harm and abase me, to such a degree that pens are powerless to record it, tongues to describe it, and tablets to bear it. You hear the lament of my heart and the cry of my being, and what has befallen Your trusted ones in Your lands and Your chosen ones in Your realm at the hands of those who have broken Your covenant and pledge. My Lord, I ask You by the cries of Your lovers throughout the world, by their lamentation in their remoteness from the court of Your presence, by the blood shed for love of You, and by the hearts consumed in Your path, to protect Your loved ones from the oppression of those who are heedless of the mysteries of Your name, the All-Choosing. My Lord, strengthen them through Your power, which has prevailed over all things, and enable them to be patient and steadfast. You are indeed the All-Powerful, the Almighty, the Ever-Bestowing. There is no God but You, the Generous, the Bountiful.

63

این ایّام بعضی از عدل و انصاف گذشته‌اند و با سیف ضغینه و سنان بغضا هجوم نموده‌اند و حال آنکه شأن منصفین آنکه مردود عالم و مطرود امم را اعانت نمایند و ببر و تقوی تمسّک جویند اکثری الی حین ندانسته‌اند که ارادهٔ این مظلوم چیست و بچه جهت حمل بلایای لاتحصی نموده باری لسان قلب به یا لیت قومی یعلمون ناطق و مظلوم منقطعاً عن الکلّ باین کلمهٔ علیا متکلّم قد احاطت الأمواج سفینة اللّه المهیمن القیّوم انّک یا ملّاح لا تضطرب عن الأریاح انّ فالق الأصباح معک فى هذه الظّلمة الّتی بها اضطربت افئدة العباد الّا من شآء اللّه العزیز المختار

Īn ayyām baʿḍī az ʿadl va enṣāf godhashteand va bā seyf-e ḍaghīne va senān-e baghḍā hojūm namūdeand va ḥāl ānke shaʾn-e monṣefīn ānke mardūd-e ʿālam va maṭrūd-e omam rā eʿānat namāyand va be berr va taqvā tamassok jūyand aktharī elā ḥīn nadānesteand ke erāde-ye īn maẓlūm chīst va be che jehat ḥaml-e balāyā-ye lā-toḥṣā namūde bārī lesān-e qalb be yā layta qawmī yaʿlamūn nāṭeq va maẓlūm munqaṭiʿan ʿani al-kull be īn kalame-ye ʿolyā motakallem qad aḥāṭati al-amwāju safīnata Allāhi al-Muhaymini al-Qayyūm innaka yā mallāḥu lā taḍṭarib ʿani al-aryāḥi inna Fāliqa al-Aṣbāḥi maʿaka fī hādhihi al-ẓulmati allatī bihā iḍṭarabat afʾidatu al-ʿibādi illā man shāʾa Allāhu al-ʿAzīzu al-Mukhtār.

These days some have abandoned justice and fairness and have attacked with the sword of malice and the spear of hatred, although it befits the fair-minded to assist one rejected by the world and cast out by its nations, and to hold fast to righteousness and piety. Most have not yet understood what this Wronged One intends or why he has borne countless afflictions. In short, the tongue of the heart speaks the words, “If only my people knew!” And the Wronged One, detached from all, utters these exalted words: “The waves have surrounded the ship of God, the All-Protecting, the Self-Subsisting. Mariner, do not be alarmed by the winds! The One who causes the dawn to break is with you in this darkness, which has troubled the hearts of all people except those whom God, the Almighty, the All-Choosing, has willed to spare.”

64

یا شیخ قسم بآفتاب حقیقت که از افق سماء سجن مشرق و لائح این مظلوم جز اصلاح قصدی نداشته یشهد بذلک کلّ عارف بصیر و کلّ عالم خبیر و فی حین البلایا کان متمسّکاً بحبل الصّبر و الاصطبار و راضیاً بما ورد علیه من الأعدآء و هو یقول یا الهی ترکت ارادتی لارادتک و مشیّتی لظهور مشیّتک وعزّتک لا ارید نفسی و بقائها الّا للقیام علی خدمة امرک و لا احبّ وجودی الّا للفدآء فی سبیلک ای ربّ تری و تعلم انّ الّذین اردنا منهم العدل و الانصاف قاموا علینا بالظّلم و الاعتساف فی الظّاهر کانوا معی و فی الباطن نصروا اعدائی الّذین قاموا علی هتک حرمتی الهی الهی اشهد انّک خلقت عبادک لنصرة امرک و اعلآء کلمتک و هم نصروا اعدائک اسألک بأمرک الّذی احاط بالوجود و باسمک الّذی به سخّرت الغیب و الشّهود ان تزیّن اهل الأرض بنور عدلک و نوّر قلوبهم بضیآء معرفتک ای ربّ انا عبدک و ابن عبدک اشهد بوحدانیّتک و فردانیّتک و بتقدیس ذاتک و تنزیه کینونتک ای ربّ تری امنائک بین ایادی الخائنین من خلقک و المفترین من بریّتک و تعلم ما ورد علینا من الّذین انت اعلم بهم منّا قد ارتکبوا ما انشقّ به ستر المقرّبین من خلقک اسألک ان تؤیّدهم علی القیام علی ما فات عنهم فی ایّام مشرق وحیک و مطلع الهامک انّک انت المقتدر على ما تشآء و فی قبضتک زمام من فی السّموات و الأرضین قد ارتفع ندآء الفطرة و حنینها و تنادی بأعلی النّدآء و تقول یا قوم تاللّه انّی فزت بمظهری و منزلی هذا یوم فیه ابتسم الطّور بمکلّمه و کرمل بمنزلها و السّدرة بمعلّمها اتّقوا اللّه و لا تکونوا من المنکرین لا تحرموا انفسکم عمّا ظهر بالفضل خذوا کوثر البقآء باسم ربّکم مالک الأسمآء ثمّ اشربوا منه بذکره العزیز البدیع

Yā Sheykh qasam be āftāb-e ḥaqīqat ke az ofoq-e samā-ye sejn moshreq va lāʾeḥ īn maẓlūm joz eṣlāḥ qaṣdī nadāshte yashhadu bi-dhālika kullu ʿārifin baṣīrin wa-kullu ʿālimin khabīrin wa-fī ḥīni al-balāyā kāna mutamassikan bi-ḥabli al-ṣabri wa-l-iṣṭibāri wa-rāḍiyan bi-mā warada ʿalayhi mina al-aʿdāʾi wa-huwa yaqūlu yā ilāhī taraktu irādatī li-irādatika wa-mashīʾatī li-ẓuhūri mashīʾatika wa-ʿizzatika lā urīdu nafsī wa-baqāʾahā illā li-l-qiyāmi ʿalā khidmati amrika wa-lā uḥibbu wujūdī illā li-l-fidāʾi fī sabīlika ay rabbi tarā wa-taʿlamu anna alladhīna aradnā minhumu al-ʿadla wa-l-inṣāfa qāmū ʿalaynā bi-l-ẓulmi wa-l-iʿtisāfi fī al-ẓāhiri kānū maʿī wa-fī al-bāṭini naṣarū aʿdāʾī alladhīna qāmū ʿalā hatki ḥurmatī ilāhī ilāhī ashhadu annaka khalaqta ʿibādaka li-nuṣrati amrika wa-iʿlāʾi kalimatika wa-hum naṣarū aʿdāʾaka asʾaluka bi-amrika alladhī aḥāṭa bi-l-wujūdi wa-bi-ismika alladhī bihi sakhkharta al-ghayba wa-l-shuhūda an tuzayyina ahla al-arḍi bi-nūri ʿadlika wa-nawwir qulūbahum bi-ḍiyāʾi maʿrifatika ay rabbi anā ʿabduka wa-ibnu ʿabdika ashhadu bi-waḥdāniyyatika wa-fardāniyyatika wa-bi-taqdīsi dhātika wa-tanzīhi kaynūnatika ay rabbi tarā umanāʾaka bayna ayādī al-khāʾinīna min khalqika wa-l-muftarīna min bariyyatika wa-taʿlamu mā warada ʿalaynā mina alladhīna anta aʿlamu bihim minnā qad irtakabū mā inshaqqa bihi sitru al-muqarrabīna min khalqika asʾaluka an tuʾayyidahum ʿalā al-qiyāmi ʿalā mā fāta ʿanhum fī ayyāmi mashriqi waḥyika wa-maṭlaʿi ilhāmika innaka anta al-Muqtadiru ʿalā mā tashāʾu wa-fī qabḍatika zimāmu man fī al-samāwāti wa-l-araḍīn qad irtafaʿa nidāʾu al-fiṭrati wa-ḥanīnuhā wa-tunādī bi-aʿlā al-nidāʾi wa-taqūlu yā qawmi ta-Allāhi innī fuztu bi-maẓharī wa-munzilī hādhā yawmun fīhi ibtasama al-Ṭūru bi-mukallimihi wa-Karmilu bi-munzilihā wa-l-Sidratu bi-muʿallimihā ittaqū Allāha wa-lā takūnū mina al-munkirīn lā taḥrimū anfusakum ʿammā ẓahara bi-l-faḍli khudhū Kawthara al-Baqāʾi bi-ismi rabbikum Māliki al-Asmāʾi thumma ishrabū minhu bi-dhikrihi al-ʿAzīzi al-Badīʿ.

Shaykh! By the Sun of Truth that rises and shines from the horizon of the heaven of this prison, this Wronged One has had no purpose but reform. Every discerning knower and every well-informed scholar bears witness to this. In times of affliction he held fast to the cord of patience and steadfastness and was content with what befell him at the hands of his enemies. He says: “My God, I have relinquished my will for Your will, and my desire for the manifestation of Your desire. By Your might, I desire my life and its continuance only to arise in service to Your Cause, and I cherish my existence only to sacrifice it in Your path. My Lord, You see and know that those from whom we sought justice and fairness have risen against us with oppression and tyranny. Outwardly they were with me, but inwardly they aided my enemies, who arose to violate my honor. My God, my God! I bear witness that You created Your servants to aid Your Cause and exalt Your Word, yet they have aided Your enemies. I ask You, by Your Cause, which has encompassed existence, and by Your name, through which You have subdued the unseen and the seen, to adorn the people of the earth with the light of Your justice, and illumine their hearts with the radiance of Your knowledge. My Lord, I am Your servant and the son of Your servant. I bear witness to Your oneness and uniqueness, to the holiness of Your essence and the transcendence of Your being. My Lord, You see Your trusted ones in the hands of the treacherous among Your creatures and the slanderers among Your people. You know what has befallen us at the hands of those whom You know better than we do. They have committed what has torn the veil of those among Your creatures who are near to You. I ask You to aid them to arise and make good what they have missed in the days of the Dawning Place of Your revelation and the Dayspring of Your inspiration. You indeed have power over whatever You will, and in Your grasp are the reins of all who are in the heavens and the earth. The call of innate nature and its lament have risen, and it cries at the top of its voice, saying: ‘People! By God, I have attained the presence of the One who manifests me and sends me down. This is the day when the Mount has smiled at the One who converses with it, Carmel at the One who descends upon it, and the Lote Tree at its Teacher. Fear God and do not be among those who deny. Do not deprive yourselves of what has appeared through grace. Take the Kawthar of everlasting life in the name of your Lord, the Lord of Names, and drink from it in remembrance of Him, the Almighty, the Incomparable.’”

65

در جمیع احوال عباد را بمعروف امر نمودیم و از منکر نهی مالک وجود شاهد و گواه که این مظلوم از حقّ برای خلق طلبیده آنچه را که سبب الفت و اتّحاد و مودّت و اتّفاقست لعمر اللّه این مظلوم قادر بر ستر نبوده انّه اظهر ما اراد و هو المقتدر المختار

Dar jamīʿ-e aḥvāl ʿebād rā be maʿrūf amr namūdīm va az monkar nahy Mālek-e vojūd shāhed va govāh ke īn maẓlūm az Ḥaqq barā-ye khalq ṭalabīde ānche rā ke sabab-e olfat va etteḥād va mavaddat va ettefāq ast la-ʿamru Allāh īn maẓlūm qāder bar satr nabūde innahu aẓhara mā arāda wa-huwa al-Muqtadiru al-Mukhtār.

In all circumstances we have enjoined people to do good and forbidden them to do evil. The Lord of existence bears witness that this Wronged One has asked God, on behalf of humanity, for what fosters fellowship, unity, affection, and concord. By the life of God, this Wronged One has been unable to conceal it. He has manifested what He willed, and He is the All-Powerful, the All-Choosing.

66

این کلمات عالیات که در لوح حضرت سلطان نازل بعضی از آن را مکرّر ذکر مینمائیم تا آن جناب بیقین مبین بدانند که آنچه ذکر شده من عند اللّه بوده یا سلطان انّی کنت کأحد من العباد و راقداً على المهاد مرّت علیّ نسائم السّبحان و علّمنی علم ما کان لیس هذا من عندی بل من لدن عزیز علیم و امرنی بالنّدآء بین الأرض و السّمآء بذلک ورد علیّ ما ذرفت به دموع العارفین ما قرأت ما عند النّاس من العلوم و ما دخلت المدارس فاسأل المدینة الّتی کنت فیها لتوقن بأنّی لست من الکاذبین هذه ورقة حرّکتها اریاح مشیّة ربّک العزیز الحمید هل لها استقرار عند هبوب اریاح عاصفات لا ومالک الأسمآء و الصّفات بل تحرّکها کیف ترید لیس للعدم وجود تلقآء القدم قد جآء امره المبرم و انطقنی بذکره بین العالمین انّی لم اکن الّا کالمیّت تلقآء امره قلّبتنی ید ارادة ربّک الرّحمن الرّحیم هل یقدر احد ان یتکلّم من تلقآء نفسه بما یعترض به علیه العباد من کلّ وضیع و شریف لا والّذی علّم القلم اسرار القدم الّا من کان مؤیّداً من لدن مقتدر قدیر

Īn kalemāt-e ʿāliyāt ke dar lawḥ-e Ḥażrat-e Solṭān nāzel baʿḍī az ān rā mokarrar dhekr mīnamāyīm tā ān janāb be yaqīn-e mobīn bedānand ke ānche dhekr shode min ʿindi Allāh būde yā sulṭānu innī kuntu ka-aḥadin mina al-ʿibādi wa-rāqidan ʿalā al-mihādi marrat ʿalayya nasāʾimu al-Subḥāni wa-ʿallamanī ʿilma mā kāna laysa hādhā min ʿindī bal min ladun ʿAzīzin ʿAlīmin wa-amaranī bi-l-nidāʾi bayna al-arḍi wa-l-samāʾi bi-dhālika warada ʿalayya mā dharafat bihi dumūʿu al-ʿārifīn mā qaraʾtu mā ʿinda al-nāsi mina al-ʿulūmi wa-mā dakhaltu al-madārisa fa-sʾali al-madīnata allatī kuntu fīhā li-tūqina bi-annī lastu mina al-kādhibīn hādhihi waraqatun ḥarrakathā aryāḥu mashīʾati rabbika al-ʿAzīzi al-Ḥamīd hal lahā istiqrārun ʿinda hubūbi aryāḥin ʿāṣifātin lā wa-Māliki al-Asmāʾi wa-l-Ṣifāti bal tuḥarrikuhā kayfa turīdu laysa li-l-ʿadami wujūdun tilqāʾa al-Qidami qad jāʾa amruhu al-mubramu wa-anṭaqanī bi-dhikrihi bayna al-ʿālamīn innī lam akun illā ka-l-mayyiti tilqāʾa amrihi qallabatnī yadu irādati rabbika al-Raḥmāni al-Raḥīm hal yaqdiru aḥadun an yatakallama min tilqāʾi nafsihi bi-mā yuʿtaraḍu bihi ʿalayhi al-ʿibādu min kulli waḍīʿin wa-sharīfin lā wa-alladhī ʿallama al-Qalama asrāra al-Qidami illā man kāna muʾayyadan min ladun Muqtadirin Qadīr.

We repeat some of these exalted words revealed in the Tablet to His Majesty the Shah, so that you may know with clear certainty that what has been stated came from God: “King! I was like any other person, asleep upon my couch. The breezes of the All-Glorious passed over me and taught me the knowledge of all that has been. This is not from me, but from One who is Almighty, All-Knowing. He commanded me to raise my call between earth and heaven. Because of this, there befell me what has caused the tears of those who recognize Him to flow. I have not studied the sciences current among the people, nor have I entered their schools. Ask the city in which I lived, so that you may be certain that I am not one of those who lie. This is a leaf stirred by the winds of the will of your Lord, the Almighty, the Praiseworthy. Can it remain still when tempestuous winds blow? No, by the Lord of Names and Attributes! Rather, they move it as they will. Nonexistence has no existence before the Eternal. His irrevocable command has come and caused me to speak His praise among the peoples of the world. Before His command I was as one dead; the hand of the will of your Lord, the All-Merciful, the Compassionate, turned me about. Can anyone speak of his own accord words for which all people, both lowly and exalted, assail him? No, by the One who taught the Pen the mysteries of eternity—unless he is aided by One who is All-Powerful, All-Capable.”

67

یا سلطان انظر بطرف العدل الی المظلوم ثمّ احکم بالحقّ فیما ورد علیه انّ اللّه قد جعلک ظلّه بین العباد و آیة قدرته لمن فی البلاد احکم بیننا و بین الّذین ظلمونا من دون بیّنة و لا کتاب منیر انّ الّذین حولک یحبّونک لأنفسهم و الغلام یحبّک لنفسک و ما اراد الّا ان یقرّبک الی مقرّ الفضل و یقلّبک الی یمین العدل و کان ربّک علی ما اقول شهیداً

Yā sulṭān, unẓur bi-ṭarfi al-ʿadl ilā al-maẓlūm, thumma uḥkum bi-l-ḥaqq fīmā warada ʿalayh. Inna Allāh qad jaʿalaka ẓillahu bayna al-ʿibād wa-āyata qudratihi li-man fī al-bilād. Uḥkum baynanā wa-bayna alladhīna ẓalamūnā min dūni bayyinatin wa-lā kitābin munīr. Inna alladhīna ḥawlaka yuḥibbūnaka li-anfusihim wa-l-ghulām yuḥibbuka li-nafsika, wa-mā arāda illā an yuqarribaka ilā maqarri al-faḍl wa-yuqallibaka ilā yamīni al-ʿadl. Wa-kāna rabbuka ʿalā mā aqūlu shahīdan.

“King! Look upon this Wronged One with the eye of justice, then judge truthfully what has befallen him. God has made you His shadow among His servants and a sign of His power to those who inhabit the lands. Judge between us and those who have wronged us without proof or an illuminating Book. Those around you love you for their own sake, while this Youth loves you for your own sake. He has wished only to draw you near to the seat of grace and turn you toward the right hand of justice. Your Lord is witness to what I say.”

68

یا سلطان لو تسمع صریر القلم الأعلی و هدیر ورقآء البقآء علی افنان سدرة المنتهی فی ذکر اللّه موجد الأسمآء و خالق الأرض و السّمآء لیبلّغک الی مقام لا تری فى الوجود الّا تجلّی حضرة المعبود و تری الملک احقر شیء عندک تضعه لمن اراد و تتوجّه الی افق کان بأنوار الوجه مضیئاً و لا تحمل ثقل الملک ابداً الّا لنصرة ربّک العلیّ الأعلی اذاً یصلّی علیک الملأ الأعلی حبّذا هذا المقام الأسنی لو ترتقی الیه بسلطان کان باسم اللّه معروفا

Yā sulṭān, law tasmaʿ ṣarīra al-qalami al-aʿlā wa-hadīra warqāʾi al-baqāʾ ʿalā afnāni sidrati al-muntahā fī dhikri Allāh mūjidi al-asmāʾ wa-khāliqi al-arḍ wa-l-samāʾ, la-yuballighuka ilā maqāmin lā tarā fī al-wujūd illā tajalliya ḥaḍrati al-maʿbūd, wa-tarā al-mulka aḥqara shayʾin ʿindaka taḍaʿuhu li-man arāda wa-tatawajjahu ilā ufuqin kāna bi-anwāri al-wajhi muḍīʾan. Wa-lā taḥmilu thiqla al-mulki abadan illā li-nuṣrati rabbika al-ʿaliyy al-aʿlā. Idhan yuṣallī ʿalayka al-malaʾ al-aʿlā. Ḥabbadhā hādhā al-maqāmu al-asnā law tartaqī ilayhi bi-sulṭānin kāna bi-smi Allāh maʿrūfan.

“King! If you were to hear the sound of the Most Exalted Pen and the cooing of the Dove of Eternity upon the branches of the Lote Tree of the Utmost Boundary, as they remember God, the Maker of names and Creator of earth and heaven, it would bring you to a station where you would see nothing in existence but the revelation of the One who is worshipped. You would regard sovereignty as the most insignificant thing, relinquishing it to whoever desired it and turning toward a horizon radiant with the lights of His face. You would never bear the burden of sovereignty except to aid your Lord, the Exalted, the Most High. Then the Concourse on high would bless you. How excellent is this most sublime station, if you would ascend to it through a sovereignty known by the name of God!”

69

آن جناب یا غیر گفته سورهٔ توحید را ترجمه نمایند تا نزد کل معلوم و مبرهن گردد که حقّ لم‌یلد و لم‌یولد است و بابیها بربوبیّت و الوهیّت قائلند

Ān janāb yā ghayr guftih sūrih-yi Tawḥīd rā tarjumih namāyand tā nazd-i kull maʿlūm va mubarhan gardad kih Ḥaqq lam yalid wa-lam yūlad ast va Bābīhā bi-rubūbiyyat va ulūhiyyat qāʾiland.

You, or someone else, have said that the Surah of Divine Unity should be translated so that it may become clear and evident to everyone that God “neither begets nor is begotten,” whereas the Bábís profess lordship and divinity.

70

یا شیخ این مقام مقام فنای از نفس و بقآء باللّه است و این کلمه اگر ذکر شود مدلّ بر نیستى بحت باتّ است این مقام لا املک لنفسى نفعاً و لا ضرّاً و لا حیوةً و لا نشورا است

Yā Shaykh, īn maqām maqām-i fanā-yi az nafs va baqāʾ bi-Allāh ast va īn kalimih agar dhikr shavad mudill bar nīstī-yi baḥt-i bātt ast. Īn maqām lā amliku li-nafsī nafʿan wa-lā ḍarran wa-lā ḥayātan wa-lā nushūran ast.

Shaykh! This station is that of dying to self and abiding in God, and if this word is mentioned, it denotes sheer and utter nothingness. This is the station of “I have no power to bring myself benefit or harm, life or resurrection.”

71

یا شیخ علمای عصر در تجلّیات سدرهٔ بیان لابن عمران در طور عرفان چه میگویند آن حضرت کلمه را از سدره اصغا نمود و قبول فرمود ولکن اکثری از ادراک این مقام محروم چه که به ما عندهم مشغولند و از ما عند اللّه غافل سیّد فندرسک در این مقام خوب گفته این سخن را درنیابد هیچ فهم ظاهری گر ابونصرستی و ور بوعلی سیناستی آیا در این فقره که خاتم انبیا روح ما سواه فداه فرموده چه میگویند میفرماید سترون ربّکم کما ترون البدر فى لیلة اربعة عشر و حضرت امیر علیه السّلام در خطبهٔ طتنجیّه میفرماید فتوقّعوا ظهور مکلّم موسی من الشّجرة علی الطّور و همچنین حسین بن علی علیه السّلام میفرماید أ یکون لغیرک من الظّهور ما لیس لک حتّی یکون هو المظهر لک عمیت عین لا تراک

Yā Shaykh, ʿulamā-yi ʿaṣr dar tajalliyāt-i sidrih-yi bayān li-ibn ʿImrān dar Ṭūr-i ʿirfān chih mīgūyand? Ān Ḥaḍrat kalimih rā az sidrih iṣghā namūd va qabūl farmūd, va-lākin aktharī az idrāk-i īn maqām maḥrūm, chih kih bih mā ʿindahum mashghūland va az mā ʿinda Allāh ghāfil. Sayyid Findirisk dar īn maqām khūb guftih: Īn sukhan rā dar nayābad hīch fahm-i ẓāhirī, gar Abū Naṣrastī va var Bū ʿAlī Sīnāstī. Āyā dar īn fiqrih kih Khātam-i Anbiyā, rūḥ-i mā sivāh fidāh, farmūdih chih mīgūyand? Mīfarmāyad: Sa-tarawna rabbakum kamā tarawna al-badra fī laylati arbaʿata ʿashar. Va Ḥaḍrat-i Amīr, ʿalayhi al-salām, dar khuṭbih-yi Ṭatanjiyyih mīfarmāyad: Fa-tawaqqaʿū ẓuhūra mukallimi Mūsā min al-shajarati ʿalā al-Ṭūr. Va hamchunīn Ḥusayn ibn ʿAlī, ʿalayhi al-salām, mīfarmāyad: A-yakūnu li-ghayrika min al-ẓuhūri mā laysa laka ḥattā yakūna huwa al-muẓhira laka? ʿAmiyat ʿaynun lā tarāk.

Shaykh! What do the scholars of this age say about the revelations of the Lote Tree of Utterance to the son of ʿImrán on the Mount of recognition? He heard the Word from the Tree and accepted it. Yet most are deprived of understanding this station, for they are occupied with what they themselves possess and heedless of what is with God. Sayyid Findirisk has spoken well on this subject: “No outward understanding can grasp these words, even if you are Abú Naṣr or Abú ʿAlí Síná.” What do they say about this passage uttered by the Seal of the Prophets—may the soul of all else be sacrificed for him? He says: “You will see your Lord as you see the full moon on the fourteenth night.” And the Commander of the Faithful, peace be upon him, says in the Ṭatanjiyyih sermon: “Await, then, the appearance of the One who spoke to Moses from the Tree upon the Mount.” Likewise, Ḥusayn son of ʿAlí, peace be upon him, says: “Can anyone other than You possess a manifestation that You do not possess, so that he should be the one to make You manifest? Blind is the eye that does not see You.”

72

امثال این اذکار از بیانات اولیا صلوات اللّه علیهم مذکور و مشهور و در کتب معتبره موجود طوبی لمن ینظر و یتکلّم بالصّدق الخالص نعیم از برای نفسی که خود را بمدد کوثر بیان مقصود عالمیان از ظنون و اوهام طاهر نمود و سبحات جلال را باسم غنیّ متعال شقّ کرد و از عالم و عالمیان گذشت و قصد سجن اعظم نمود

Amthāl-i īn adhkār az bayānāt-i awliyā, ṣalawāt Allāh ʿalayhim, madhkūr va mashhūr va dar kutub-i muʿtabarih mawjūd. Ṭūbā li-man yanẓuru wa-yatakallamu bi-l-ṣidqi al-khāliṣ. Naʿīm az barā-yi nafsī kih khud rā bi-madad-i kawthar-i bayān-i Maqṣūd-i ʿālamiyān az ẓunūn va awhām ṭāhir namūd va subuḥāt-i jalāl rā bi-ism-i Ghaniyy-i Mutaʿāl shaqq kard va az ʿālam va ʿālamiyān gudhasht va qaṣd-i Sijn-i Aʿẓam namūd.

Such sayings from the utterances of the holy ones, God’s blessings be upon them, are well known and widely cited, and are found in authoritative books. Blessed is the one who examines and speaks with unalloyed truthfulness. Bliss awaits the soul who, through the heavenly stream of the utterance of the Desire of all peoples, has purified himself of conjectures and vain imaginings, torn through the veils of glory in the name of the All-Sufficing, the Most Exalted, passed beyond the world and its peoples, and set out for the Most Great Prison.

73

یا شیخ نفحات وحی از دونش ممتاز و بیان الهی مابین کتب بمثابهٔ آفتاب مشرق و لائح طوبى لمن وجد و عرف و قال لک الحمد یا مقصود العالم و لک الشّکر یا محبوب افئدة المخلصین

Yā Shaykh, nafaḥāt-i vaḥy az dūnash mumtāz va bayān-i ilāhī mābayn-i kutub bi-mathābih-yi āftāb mushriq va lāʾiḥ. Ṭūbā li-man wajada wa-ʿarafa wa-qāla: Laka al-ḥamdu yā Maqṣūd al-ʿālam wa-laka al-shukru yā Maḥbūb afʾidati al-mukhliṣīn.

Shaykh! The fragrances of revelation are distinct from all else, and divine utterance shines resplendent among books like the sun. Blessed is the one who has found and recognized it and said: “Praise be to You, Desire of the world, and thanks be to You, Beloved of the hearts of the sincere!”

74

مقصود از ذکر الوهیّت و ربوبیّت را عباد ملتفت نشده‌اند چه اگر بیابند از مقام خود قیام کنند و بکلمهٔ تبنا الی اللّه ناطق گردند حضرت خاتم روح ما سواه فداه میفرماید لنا مع اللّه حالات نحن فیها هو و هو نحن و هو هو و نحن نحن

Maqṣūd az dhikr-i ulūhiyyat va rubūbiyyat rā ʿibād multafit nashudih-and, chih agar biyāband az maqām-i khud qiyām kunand va bi-kalimih-yi tubnā ilā Allāh nāṭiq gardand. Ḥaḍrat-i Khātam, rūḥ-i mā sivāh fidāh, mīfarmāyad: Lanā maʿa Allāhi ḥālātun naḥnu fīhā huwa wa-huwa naḥnu wa-huwa huwa wa-naḥnu naḥnu.

People have not understood what is meant by the mention of divinity and lordship. If they understood, they would rise from their places and utter the words, “We have turned in repentance to God.” The Seal of the Prophets—may the soul of all else be sacrificed for him—says: “We have states with God in which we are He and He is we, yet He is He and we are we.”

75

از این مقام هم گذشته چرا مقامات دیگر را که از قلم ابهی نازل ذکر ننموده‌اند لسان مظلوم در اکثری از ایّام و لیالی باین کلمات عالیات ناطق الهی الهی اشهد بوحدانیّتک و فردانیّتک و بأنّک انت اللّه لا اله الّا انت لم تزل کنت مقدّساً عن ذکر دونک و ثنآء غیرک و لا تزال تکون بمثل ما قد کنت من قبل و من بعد اسألک یا مالک القدم بالاسم الأعظم و بتجلّیات نیّر ظهورک فی طور البیان و بأمواج بحر علمک فی الامکان ان تؤیّدنی علی ما یقرّبنی الیک و یقطعنی عن دونک وعزّتک یا اله الکائنات و مقصود الممکنات احبّ ان اضع وجهی على کلّ بقعة من بقاع ارضک لعلّه یتشرّف بمقام تشرّف بقدوم اولیائک

Az īn maqām ham gudhashtih, chirā maqāmāt-i dīgar rā kih az Qalam-i Abhā nāzil dhikr nanamūdih-and? Lisān-i Maẓlūm dar aktharī az ayyām va layālī bi-īn kalimāt-i ʿāliyāt nāṭiq: Ilāhī ilāhī, ashhadu bi-waḥdāniyyatika wa-fardāniyyatika wa-bi-annaka anta Allāhu lā ilāha illā anta. Lam tazal kunta muqaddasan ʿan dhikri dūnika wa-thanāʾi ghayrika wa-lā tazālu takūnu bi-mithli mā qad kunta min qablu wa-min baʿd. Asʾaluka yā Mālik al-qidam bi-l-ismi al-aʿẓam wa-bi-tajalliyāti nayyiri ẓuhūrika fī Ṭūri al-bayān wa-bi-amwāji baḥri ʿilmika fī al-imkān an tuʾayyidanī ʿalā mā yuqarribunī ilayka wa-yaqṭaʿunī ʿan dūnika. Wa-ʿizzatika yā Ilāh al-kāʾināt wa-Maqṣūd al-mumkināt, uḥibbu an aḍaʿa wajhī ʿalā kulli buqʿatin min biqāʿi arḍika laʿallahu yatasharrafu bi-maqāmin tasharrafa bi-qudūmi awliyāʾika.

Even setting this station aside, why have they not mentioned the other stations revealed by the All-Glorious Pen? On most days and nights the tongue of this Wronged One utters these exalted words: “My God, my God! I bear witness to Your oneness and singleness, and that You are God; there is no God but You. You have always been sanctified beyond the mention of anyone besides You and the praise of anyone other than You, and You will forever remain as You have been, before and hereafter. I ask You, Lord of eternity, by the Most Great Name, by the radiance of the Sun of Your Revelation upon the Mount of Utterance, and by the waves of the ocean of Your knowledge throughout contingent existence, to assist me in what will draw me near to You and detach me from all besides You. By Your might, God of all beings and Desire of all created things! I long to lay my face upon every spot of Your earth, that it may perhaps be honored by a place honored by the footsteps of Your holy ones.”

76

لعمر اللّه اوهام عباد را از افق ایقان محروم نموده و ظنون از رحیق مختوم منع کرده براستی میگویم و لوجه اللّه میگویم این عبد و این مظلوم شرم دارد خود را به هستی و وجود نسبت دهد تا چه رسد بمقامات فوق آن انسان بصیر هر هنگام بر ارض مشی مینماید خود را خجل مشاهده میکند چه که بیقین مبین میداند که علّت نعمت و ثروت و عزّت و علوّ و سموّ و اقتدار او باذن اللّه ارضی است که تحت جمیع اقدام عالم است و نفسی که باین مقام آگاه شد البتّه از نخوت و کبر و غرور مقدّس و مبرّا است آنچه گفته شد من عند اللّه بوده انّه شهد و یشهد و هو العلیم الخبیر

La-ʿamru Allāh, awhām ʿibād rā az ufuq-i īqān maḥrūm namūdih va ẓunūn az raḥīq-i makhtūm manʿ kardih. Bi-rāstī mīgūyam va li-wajhi Allāh mīgūyam, īn ʿabd va īn Maẓlūm sharm dārad khud rā bih hastī va vujūd nisbat dihad tā chih rasad bi-maqāmāt-i fawq-i ān. Insān-i baṣīr har hangām bar arḍ mashy mīnamāyad khud rā khajil mushāhidih mīkunad, chih kih bi-yaqīn-i mubīn mīdānad kih ʿillat-i niʿmat va tharvat va ʿizzat va ʿuluvv va sumuvv va iqtidār-i ū bi-idhn Allāh arḍī ast kih taḥt-i jamīʿ-i aqdām-i ʿālam ast. Va nafsī kih bi-īn maqām āgāh shud al-battih az nikhvat va kibr va ghurūr muqaddas va mubarrā ast. Ānchih guftih shud min ʿindi Allāh būdih. Innahu shahida wa-yashhadu wa-huwa al-ʿAlīm al-Khabīr.

By the life of God! Vain imaginings have deprived people of the horizon of certitude, and conjectures have kept them from the sealed wine. I speak truthfully, and I speak for the sake of God: this servant, this Wronged One, is ashamed to attribute being and existence to himself, let alone stations beyond them. Whenever an insightful person walks upon the earth, he finds himself abashed, for he knows with clear certainty that, by God’s leave, the source of his well-being, wealth, honor, elevation, distinction, and power is the earth beneath the feet of all the world. A soul who becomes aware of this station is assuredly sanctified and freed from arrogance, pride, and conceit. What has been said has come from God. He has borne and continues to bear witness, and He is the All-Knowing, the All-Informed.

77

از حقّ آذان واعیه و ابصار حدیده و صدور منشرحه و قلوب مقبله مسئلت نمائید شاید عباد مقصود را بیابند و بشطر دوست توجّه نمایند بلایائی بر این مظلوم وارد شد که شبه آن را عیون مشاهده نکرده و در اظهار امر بهیچوجه توقّف ننمود و بحضرات ملوک و سلاطین ایّدهم اللّه تعالى القا نمود آنچه را که سبب آسایش و اتّحاد و اتّفاق و عمار عالم و راحت امم است از جمله دو کلمه از ناپلیون ثالث اصغا شد و آن سبب شد که در ادرنه لوحی باو ارسال نمودیم جواب نفرمودند و بعد از ورود در سجن اعظم از وزیر ایشان نامه و دستخطّی رسید اوّل آن بخطّ عجمی و آخر آن را بخطّ خودشان مرقوم داشته بودند و اظهار عنایت فرموده بودند و مذکور داشتند که نامه را حسب الخواهش رساندم و الی حین جوابى نفرموده‌اند ولکن بوزیر مختار خودمان در علیّه و قونسلوس آن اراضی سفارش نمودیم هر مطلبی باشد اظهار فرمائید اجرا میگردد

Az Ḥaqq ādhān-i vāʿiyih va abṣār-i ḥadīdih va ṣudūr-i munshariḥih va qulūb-i muqbilih masʾalat namāyīd, shāyad ʿibād maqṣūd rā biyāband va bi-shaṭr-i Dūst tavajjuh namāyand. Balāyāʾī bar īn Maẓlūm vārid shud kih shibh-i ān rā ʿuyūn mushāhidih nakardih va dar iẓhār-i Amr bi-hīch vajh tavaqquf nanamūd va bi-ḥaḍarāt-i mulūk va salāṭīn, ayyadahum Allāhu taʿālā, ilqā namūd ānchih rā kih sabab-i āsāyish va ittiḥād va ittifāq va ʿimār-i ʿālam va rāḥat-i umam ast. Az jumlih du kalimih az Nāpliyūn-i Thālith iṣghā shud va ān sabab shud kih dar Adirnih lawḥī bi-ū irsāl namūdīm. Javāb nafarmūdand va baʿd az vurūd dar Sijn-i Aʿẓam az vazīr-i īshān nāmih va dastkhaṭṭī rasīd. Avval-i ān bi-khaṭṭ-i ʿajamī va ākhir-i ān rā bi-khaṭṭ-i khudishān marqūm dāshtih būdand va iẓhār-i ʿināyat farmūdih būdand va madhkūr dāshtand kih nāmih rā ḥasb al-khvāhish rasāndam va ilā ḥīn javābī nafarmūdih-and, va-lākin bi-vazīr-i mukhtār-i khudimān dar ʿAliyyih va qunsulus-i ān arāḍī sifārish namūdīm har maṭlabī bāshad iẓhār farmāʾīd ijrā mīgardad.

Ask God for attentive ears, keen eyes, receptive breasts, and hearts turned toward Him, so that people may perhaps grasp the purpose and turn toward the Friend. Afflictions unlike anything eyes have witnessed befell this Wronged One, yet he never hesitated to proclaim the Cause. He conveyed to their majesties the kings and sovereigns—may God, exalted be He, assist them—what would bring about the peace, unity, concord, and prosperity of the world and the well-being of its peoples. Among other things, two statements by Napoleon III were heard, and these prompted us to send him a Tablet from Adrianople. He did not reply. After our arrival in the Most Great Prison, a letter with a handwritten note arrived from his minister. Its first part was written in Persian script and its final part in his own hand. He expressed his kindness and stated: “As requested, I delivered the letter, and thus far he has given no reply. We have, however, instructed our minister plenipotentiary in the capital and our consul in those regions that whatever request you may have, you should make it known, and it will be carried out.”

78

از این بیان ایشان معلوم شد مقصود این عبد را اصلاح امور ظاهره دانسته‌اند لذا آیاتی باسم ایشان در سورهٔ هیکل نازل بعضی از آن ذکر میشود تا آن جناب بدانند که امر این مظلوم للّه و من عند اللّه بوده

Az īn bayān-i īshān maʿlūm shud maqṣūd-i īn ʿabd rā iṣlāḥ-i umūr-i ẓāhirih dānistih-and. Lidhā āyātī bi-ism-i īshān dar Sūrih-yi Haykal nāzil. Baʿḍī az ān dhikr mīshavad tā ān janāb bidānand kih Amr-i īn Maẓlūm li-Allāh va min ʿindi Allāh būdih.

From this statement of his, it became clear that he had understood this servant’s purpose to be the improvement of outward circumstances. Therefore, verses addressed to him were revealed in the Surah of the Temple. Some of them are quoted here so that you may know that the Cause of this Wronged One has been for God and from God.

79

یا ملک باریس نبّئ القسّیس ان لا یدقّ النّواقیس تاللّه الحقّ قد ظهر النّاقوس الأفخم علی هیکل الاسم الأعظم و تدقّه اصابع مشیّة ربّک العلیّ الأعلی فی جبروت البقآء باسمه الأبهی کذلک نزّلت آیات ربّک الکبری تارةً اخری لتقوم علی ذکر اللّه فاطر الأرض و السّمآء فی هذه الأیّام الّتی فیها ناحت قبائل الأرض کلّها و تزلزلت ارکان البلاد و غشّت العباد غبرة الالحاد الّا من شآء ربّک العلیم الحکیم قل قد اتی المختار فی ظلل الأنوار لیحیی الأکوان من نفحات اسمه الرّحمن و یتّحد العالم و یجتمعوا على هذه المائدة الّتی نزلت من السّمآء ایّاکم ان تکفروا بنعمة اللّه بعد انزالها هذا خیر لکم ممّا عندکم لأنّه سیفنی و ما عند اللّه یبقی انّه هو الحاکم علی ما یرید قد هبّت نسمات الغفران من شطر ربّکم الرّحمن من اقبل الیها طهّرته عن العصیان و عن کلّ دآء و سقم طوبی لمن اقبل الیها و ویل للمعرضین

Yā malik Bārīs, nabbiʾ al-qissīs an lā yaduqqa al-nawāqīs. Ta-Allāhi al-Ḥaqq, qad ẓahara al-nāqūsu al-afkham ʿalā haykali al-ismi al-aʿẓam wa-taduqquhu aṣābiʿu mashīʾati rabbika al-ʿaliyy al-aʿlā fī jabarūti al-baqāʾ bi-smihi al-Abhā. Kadhālika nuzzilat āyātu rabbika al-kubrā tāratan ukhrā li-taqūma ʿalā dhikri Allāh fāṭiri al-arḍ wa-l-samāʾ fī hādhihi al-ayyāmi allatī fīhā nāḥat qabāʾilu al-arḍi kulluhā wa-tazalzalat arkānu al-bilād wa-ghashshat al-ʿibāda ghubratu al-ilḥād illā man shāʾa rabbuka al-ʿAlīm al-Ḥakīm. Qul qad atā al-Mukhtār fī ẓulali al-anwār li-yuḥyiya al-akwāna min nafaḥāti ismihi al-Raḥmān wa-yattaḥida al-ʿālam wa-yajtamiʿū ʿalā hādhihi al-māʾidati allatī nazalat min al-samāʾ. Iyyākum an takfurū bi-niʿmati Allāh baʿda inzālihā. Hādhā khayrun lakum mimmā ʿindakum li-annahu sa-yafnā wa-mā ʿinda Allāhi yabqā. Innahu huwa al-ḥākimu ʿalā mā yurīd. Qad habbat nasamātu al-ghufrān min shaṭri rabbikum al-Raḥmān. Man aqbala ilayhā ṭahharathu ʿan al-ʿiṣyān wa-ʿan kulli dāʾin wa-saqam. Ṭūbā li-man aqbala ilayhā wa-waylun li-l-muʿriḍīn.

“King of Paris! Tell the priest to ring the bells no longer. By God, the True One! The most majestic Bell has appeared in the temple of the Most Great Name, and the fingers of the will of your Lord, the Exalted, the Most High, ring it in the dominion of eternity in His All-Glorious name. Thus have the most great verses of your Lord been sent down once again, so that you may arise to remember God, the Creator of earth and heaven, in these days when all the tribes of the earth have lamented, the foundations of the countries have been shaken, and the dust of unbelief has enveloped His servants, except those whom your Lord, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise, has willed to spare. Say: The Chosen One has come beneath canopies of light to quicken all beings with the fragrances of His name, the All-Merciful, so that the world may be united and all may gather around this table sent down from heaven. Beware of denying God’s bounty after it has been sent down. This is better for you than what you possess, for that will perish, while what is with God will endure. He, indeed, ordains whatever He wills. The breezes of forgiveness have blown from the direction of your Lord, the All-Merciful. Whoever turns toward them will be purified by them from disobedience and from every disease and ailment. Blessed is the one who turns toward them, and woe to those who turn away!”

80

لو تتوجّه بسمع الفطرة الی الأشیآء تسمع منها قد اتی القدیم ذو المجد العظیم یسبّح کلّ شىء بحمد ربّه منهم من عرف اللّه و یذکر و منهم من یذکر و لا یعرف کذلک احصینا الأمر فی لوح مبین

Law tatawajjahu bi-samʿi al-fiṭrati ilā al-ashyāʾ tasmaʿu minhā: Qad atā al-Qadīm dhū al-majdi al-ʿaẓīm. Yusabbiḥu kullu shayʾin bi-ḥamdi rabbih. Minhum man ʿarafa Allāha wa-yadhkur wa-minhum man yadhkuru wa-lā yaʿrif. Kadhālika aḥṣaynā al-amra fī lawḥin mubīn.

“If you turn toward all things with the ear of your innate nature, you will hear them say: ‘The Ancient One, possessed of great glory, has come.’ Everything glorifies its Lord with praise. Among them are those who have recognized God and remember Him, and those who remember Him without recognizing Him. Thus have we set forth the matter in a clear Tablet.”

81

یا ملک اسمع النّدآء من هذه النّار المشتعلة من هذه الشّجرة الخضرآء فی هذا الطّور المرتفع علی البقعة المقدّسة البیضآء خلف قلزم البقآء انّه لا اله الّا انا الغفور الرّحیم قد ارسلنا من ایّدناه بروح القدس لیخبرکم بهذا النّور الّذی اشرق من افق مشیّة ربّکم العلیّ الأبهی و ظهرت فی الغرب آثاره توجّهوا الیه فی هذا الیوم الّذى جعله اللّه غرّة الأیّام و فیه تجلّی الرّحمن علی من فی السّموات و الأرضین قم علی خدمة اللّه و نصرة امره انّه یؤیّدک بجنود الغیب و الشّهادة و یجعلک سلطاناً علی ما تطلع الشّمس علیه انّ ربّک هو المقتدر القدیر

Yā malik, ismaʿ al-nidāʾ min hādhihi al-nāri al-mushtaʿilati min hādhihi al-shajarati al-khaḍrāʾ fī hādhā al-Ṭūri al-murtafiʿ ʿalā al-buqʿati al-muqaddasati al-bayḍāʾ khalfa qulzumi al-baqāʾ: Innahu lā ilāha illā anā al-Ghafūr al-Raḥīm. Qad arsalnā man ayyadnāhu bi-rūḥi al-qudus li-yukhbirakum bi-hādhā al-nūri alladhī ashraqa min ufuqi mashīʾati rabbikum al-ʿaliyy al-Abhā wa-ẓaharat fī al-gharbi āthāruh. Tawajj ahū ilayhi fī hādhā al-yawmi alladhī jaʿalahu Allāhu ghurrata al-ayyām wa-fīhi tajallā al-Raḥmān ʿalā man fī al-samāwāti wa-l-arḍīn. Qum ʿalā khidmati Allāh wa-nuṣrati amrih. Innahu yuʾayyiduka bi-junūdi al-ghaybi wa-l-shahādah wa-yajʿaluka sulṭānan ʿalā mā taṭluʿu al-shamsu ʿalayh. Inna rabbaka huwa al-Muqtadir al-Qadīr.

“King! Listen to the call from this Fire blazing in this verdant Tree upon this lofty Mount, on the holy, snow-white Spot beyond the ocean of eternity: ‘There is no God but Me, the Ever-Forgiving, the Merciful.’ We sent the one whom We strengthened with the Holy Spirit to tell you of this Light, which has shone from the horizon of the will of your Lord, the Exalted, the All-Glorious, and whose signs have appeared in the West. Turn toward Him on this Day, which God has made the crown of days, and on which the All-Merciful has revealed Himself to all who are in the heavens and on earth. Arise to serve God and aid His Cause. He will support you with the hosts of the unseen and the seen, and make you sovereign over all upon which the sun rises. Your Lord is indeed the All-Powerful, the Almighty.”

82

قد فاحت نفحات الرّحمن فی الامکان طوبی لمن وجد عرفها و اقبل الیها بقلب سلیم زیّن هیکلک بطراز اسمی و لسانک بذکری و قلبک بحبّی العزیز المنیع ما اردنا لک الّا ما هو خیر لک ممّا عندک و من خزائن الأرض کلّها انّ ربّک هو العلیم الخبیر قم بین العباد باسمی و قل یا ملأ الأرض اقبلوا الی من اقبل الیکم انّه لوجه اللّه بینکم و حجّته فیکم و دلیله لکم قد جآءکم بآیات عجز عنها العالمون انّ شجرة الطّور تنطق فی صدر العالم و روح القدس ینادی بین الأمم قد اتی المقصود بسلطان مبین

Qad fāḥat nafaḥātu al-Raḥmān fī al-imkān. Ṭūbā li-man wajada ʿarfahā wa-aqbala ilayhā bi-qalbin salīm. Zayyin haykalaka bi-ṭirāzi ismī wa-lisānaka bi-dhikrī wa-qalbaka bi-ḥubbī al-ʿazīz al-manīʿ. Mā aradnā laka illā mā huwa khayrun laka mimmā ʿindaka wa-min khazāʾini al-arḍi kullihā. Inna rabbaka huwa al-ʿalīm al-khabīr. Qum bayna al-ʿibādi bi-ismī wa-qul yā malaʾa al-arḍi aqbilū ilā man aqbala ilaykum. Innahu la-wajhu Allāhi baynakum wa-ḥujjatuhu fīkum wa-dalīluhu lakum. Qad jāʾakum bi-āyātin ʿajaza ʿanhā al-ʿālamūn. Inna shajarata al-Ṭūr tanṭiqu fī ṣadri al-ʿālam wa-rūḥu al-qudus yunādī bayna al-umam: qad atā al-maqṣūdu bi-sulṭānin mubīn.

The breezes of the All-Merciful have wafted through creation. Blessed is whoever has caught their fragrance and turned toward them with a pure heart. Adorn your person with the ornament of My name, your tongue with My remembrance, and your heart with My mighty, unassailable love. We have desired for you only what is better for you than all you possess and all the treasures of the earth. Your Lord is indeed the All-Knowing, the All-Aware. Arise among the people in My name and say: “People of the earth! Turn toward Him who has turned toward you. He is indeed the face of God among you, His proof in your midst, and His guide for you. He has come to you with signs that the peoples of the world are powerless to match. The Tree of Sinai speaks in the heart of the world, and the Holy Spirit calls out among the nations: ‘The Desired One has come with manifest authority.’”

83

یا ملک قد سقطت انجم سمآء العلم الّذین یستدلّون بما عندهم لاثبات امری و یذکرون اللّه باسمی فلمّا جئتهم بمجدی اعرضوا عنّی الا انّهم من السّاقطین هذا ما اخبرکم به الرّوح اذ اتی بالحقّ و اعترض علیه علمآء الیهود الی ان ارتکبوا ما ناح به روح القدس و ذرفت دموع المقرّبین

Yā malik, qad saqaṭat anjumu samāʾi al-ʿilm alladhīna yastadillūna bi-mā ʿindahum li-ithbāti amrī wa-yadhkurūna Allāha bi-ismī. Fa-lammā jiʾtuhum bi-majdī aʿraḍū ʿannī. Alā innahum mina al-sāqiṭīn. Hādhā mā akhbarakum bihi al-rūḥ idh atā bi-al-ḥaqq wa-iʿtaraḍa ʿalayhi ʿulamāʾu al-yahūd ilā an irtakabū mā nāḥa bihi rūḥu al-qudus wa-dharafat dumūʿu al-muqarrabīn.

King! The stars of the heaven of knowledge have fallen—those who draw on what they possess to establish the truth of My Cause and who remember God in My name. Yet when I came to them in My glory, they turned away from Me. They are indeed among the fallen. This is what the Spirit foretold to you when He came with the truth and the Jewish scholars opposed Him, until they committed what caused the Holy Spirit to lament and the tears of those brought near to God to flow.

84

قل یا ملأ الرّهبان لا تعتکفوا فی الکنائس و المعابد اخرجوا باذنی ثمّ اشتغلوا بما تنتفع به انفسکم و انفس العباد کذلک یأمرکم مالک یوم الدّین اعتکفوا فی حصن حبّی هذا حقّ الاعتکاف لو کنتم من العارفین من جاور البیت انّه کالمیّت ینبغی للانسان ان یظهر منه ما ینتفع به العباد و الّذی لیس له ثمر ینبغی للنّار کذلک یعظکم ربّکم انّه هو العزیز الکریم تزوّجوا لیقوم بعدکم احد مقامکم انّا منعناکم عن الخیانة لا عمّا تظهر به الأمانة أ اخذتم اصول انفسکم و نبذتم اصول اللّه ورائکم اتّقوا اللّه و لا تکونوا من الجاهلین لو لا الانسان من یذکرنی فی ارضی و کیف تظهر صفاتی و اسمائی تفکّروا و لا تکونوا من الّذین احتجبوا و کانوا من الرّاقدین انّ الّذى ما تزوّج انّه ما وجد مقرّاً لیسکن فیه او یضع رأسه علیه بما اکتسبت ایدی الخائنین لیس تقدیس نفسه بما عرفتم و عندکم من الأوهام بل بما عندنا اسألوا لتعرفوا مقامه الّذی کان مقدّساً عن ظنون من علی الأرض کلّها طوبی للعارفین

Qul yā malaʾa al-ruhbān, lā taʿtakifū fī al-kanāʾisi wa-al-maʿābid. Ukhrujū bi-idhnī thumma ishtag hilū bi-mā tanta fiʿu bihi anfusukum wa-anfusu al-ʿibād. Kadhālika yaʾmurukum māliku yawmi al-dīn. Iʿtakifū fī ḥiṣni ḥubbī. Hādhā ḥaqqu al-iʿtikāf law kuntum mina al-ʿārifīn. Man jāwara al-bayta innahu ka-al-mayyit. Yanbaghī li-al-insāni an yaẓhara minhu mā yantafiʿu bihi al-ʿibād wa-alladhī laysa lahu thamarun yanbaghī li-al-nār. Kadhālika yaʿiẓukum rabbukum innahu huwa al-ʿazīz al-karīm. Tazawwajū li-yaqūma baʿdakum aḥadun maqāmakum. Innā manaʿnākum ʿani al-khiyānati lā ʿammā taẓharu bihi al-amānah. A-akhadhtum uṣūla anfusikum wa-nabadhtum uṣūla Allāhi warāʾakum? Ittaqū Allāha wa-lā takūnū mina al-jāhilīn. Law lā al-insānu man yadhkurunī fī arḍī wa-kayfa taẓharu ṣifātī wa-asmāʾī? Tafakkarū wa-lā takūnū mina alladhīna iḥtajabū wa-kānū mina al-rāqidīn. Inna alladhī mā tazawwaja innahu mā wajada maqarran li-yaskuna fīhi aw yaḍaʿa raʾsahu ʿalayhi bi-mā iktasabat aydī al-khāʾinīn. Laysa taqdīsu nafsihi bi-mā ʿaraftum wa-ʿindakum mina al-awhām bal bi-mā ʿindanā. Isʾalū li-taʿrifū maqāmahu alladhī kāna muqaddasan ʿan ẓunūni man ʿalā al-arḍi kullihā. Ṭūbā li-al-ʿārifīn.

Say: “Monks! Do not seclude yourselves in churches and temples. Come out with My permission, then occupy yourselves with what benefits you and other people. Thus the Master of the Day of Judgment commands you. Seclude yourselves in the stronghold of My love. This is true seclusion, if you would understand. Whoever remains secluded in the house is like the dead. A human being should bring forth what benefits others, and whatever bears no fruit is fit for the fire. Thus your Lord admonishes you. He is indeed the Almighty, the All-Bountiful. Marry, so that someone may take your place after you. We have forbidden you treachery, not that through which faithfulness is manifested. Have you adopted principles of your own and cast the principles of God behind you? Fear God and do not be among the ignorant. Were it not for humanity, who would remember Me on My earth, and how would My attributes and names be manifested? Reflect, and do not be among those who are veiled and lie asleep. He who did not marry found no place to dwell or to lay His head, because of what the hands of the treacherous had done. The sanctity of His person does not consist in what you have understood and the vain imaginings you entertain, but in what is with Us. Ask, so that you may recognize His station, which is sanctified above the conjectures of all who dwell on earth. Blessed are those who understand.”

85

یا ملک انّا سمعنا منک کلمة تکلّمت بها اذ سألک ملک الرّوس عمّا قضی من حکم الغزآء انّ ربّک هو العلیم الخبیر قلت کنت راقداً فی المهاد ایقظنی ندآء العباد الّذین ظلموا الی ان غرقوا فی البحر الأسود کذلک سمعنا و ربّک علی ما اقول شهید نشهد انّک ما ایقظک النّدآء بل الهوی لأنّا بلوناک وجدناک فی معزل اعرف لحن القول و کن من المتفرّسین انّا ما نحبّ ان نرجع الیک کلمة سوء حفظاً للمقام الّذى اعطیناک فی الحیوة الظّاهرة انّا اخترنا الأدب و جعلناه سجیّة المقرّبین انّه ثوب یوافق النّفوس من کلّ صغیر و کبیر طوبی لمن جعله طراز هیکله ویل لمن جعل محروماً من هذا الفضل العظیم لو کنت صاحب الکلمة ما نبذت کتاب اللّه ورآء ظهرک اذ ارسل الیک من لدن عزیز حکیم انّا بلوناک به ما وجدناک على ما ادّعیت قم و تدارک ما فات عنک سوف تفنی الدّنیا و ما عندک و یبقی الملک للّه ربّک و ربّ آبائک الأوّلین لا ینبغی لک ان تقتصر الأمور علی ما یهوی هواک اتّق زفرات المظلوم احفظه من سهام الظّالمین

Yā malik, innā samiʿnā minka kalimatan takallamta bihā idh saʾalaka maliku al-Rūs ʿammā quḍiya min ḥukmi al-ghazāʾ. Inna rabbaka huwa al-ʿalīm al-khabīr. Qulta kuntu rāqidan fī al-mihād ayqaẓanī nidāʾu al-ʿibādi alladhīna ẓulimū ilā an ghariqū fī al-baḥri al-aswad. Kadhālika samiʿnā wa-rabbuka ʿalā mā aqūlu shahīd. Nashhadu annaka mā ayqaẓaka al-nidāʾ bal al-hawā li-annā balawnāka wajadnāka fī maʿzil. Iʿrif laḥna al-qawli wa-kun mina al-mutafarrisīn. Innā mā nuḥibbu an nurjiʿa ilayka kalimata sūʾin ḥifẓan li-al-maqāmi alladhī aʿṭaynāka fī al-ḥayāti al-ẓāhirah. Innā ikhtarnā al-adaba wa-jaʿalnāhu sajiyyata al-muqarrabīn. Innahu thawbun yuwāfiqu al-nufūsa min kulli ṣaghīrin wa-kabīr. Ṭūbā li-man jaʿalahu ṭirāza haykalihi. Waylun li-man juʿila maḥrūman min hādhā al-faḍli al-ʿaẓīm. Law kunta ṣāḥiba al-kalimati mā nabadhta kitāba Allāhi warāʾa ẓahrika idh ursila ilayka min ladun ʿazīzin ḥakīm. Innā balawnāka bihi mā wajadnāka ʿalā mā iddaʿayta. Qum wa-tadārak mā fāta ʿanka. Sawfa tafnā al-dunyā wa-mā ʿindaka wa-yabqā al-mulku li-Allāhi rabbika wa-rabbi ābāʾika al-awwalīn. Lā yanbaghī laka an taqtaṣira al-umūra ʿalā mā yahwā hawāka. Ittaq zafarāti al-maẓlūm. Iḥfaẓhu min sihāmi al-ẓālimīn.

King! We heard words you spoke when the king of Russia asked you about the decision to go to war. Your Lord is indeed the All-Knowing, the All-Aware. You said: “I was asleep on my couch when I was awakened by the cry of the people who were wronged until they drowned in the Black Sea.” Thus We heard, and your Lord is witness to what I say. We testify that it was not the cry that awakened you, but desire, for We tested you and found you aloof. Discern the meaning of these words and be among those who perceive. We do not wish to return an evil word to you, out of regard for the station We have given you in this outward life. We have chosen courtesy and made it the disposition of those brought near to Us. It is a garment that befits every soul, great and small. Blessed is whoever makes it the adornment of his person. Woe to whoever is deprived of this great bounty. Had you been true to your words, you would not have cast the Book of God behind your back when it was sent to you by One who is Almighty, All-Wise. We tested you through it and did not find you to be as you claimed. Arise and make amends for what you have missed. The world and all you possess will pass away, and sovereignty will remain with God, your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers. You should not confine affairs to what your own desire craves. Beware the sighs of the Wronged One. Protect Him from the arrows of the oppressors.

86

بما فعلت تختلف الأمور فی مملکتک و یخرج الملک من کفّک جزآء عملک اذاً تجد نفسک فی خسران مبین و تأخذ الزّلازل کلّ القبائل هناک الّا بأن تقوم علی نصرة هذا الأمر و تتّبع الرّوح فی هذا السّبیل المستقیم أ عزّک غرّک لعمری انّه لا یدوم و سوف یزول الّا بأن تتمسّک بهذا الحبل المتین قد نری الذّلّة تسعی ورائک و انت من الغافلین ینبغی لک اذا سمعت النّدآء من شطر الکبریآء تدع ما عندک و تقول لبّیک یا اله من فی السّموات و الأرضین

Bi-mā faʿalta takhtalifu al-umūru fī mamlakatika wa-yakhruju al-mulku min kaffika jazāʾa ʿamalika. Idhan tajidu nafsaka fī khusrānin mubīn. Wa-taʾkhudhu al-zalāzilu kulla al-qabāʾili hunāka illā bi-an taqūma ʿalā nuṣrati hādhā al-amri wa-tattabiʿa al-rūḥa fī hādhā al-sabīli al-mustaqīm. A-ʿizzuka gharraka? La-ʿamrī innahu lā yadūmu wa-sawfa yazūlu illā bi-an tatamassaka bi-hādhā al-ḥabli al-matīn. Qad narā al-dhillata tasʿā warāʾaka wa-anta mina al-ghāfilīn. Yanbaghī laka idhā samiʿta al-nidāʾa min shaṭri al-kibriyāʾ tadaʿa mā ʿindaka wa-taqūla labbayka yā ilāha man fī al-samāwāti wa-al-arḍīn.

Because of what you have done, affairs in your kingdom will fall into disorder, and sovereignty will pass from your grasp in requital for your actions. Then you will find yourself in manifest loss. Tremors will seize all the peoples there unless you arise to support this Cause and follow the Spirit on this straight path. Has your might deluded you? By My life, it will not endure and will soon vanish unless you hold fast to this strong cord. We see humiliation pursuing you while you remain heedless. When you hear the call from the realm of majesty, you should abandon what you possess and say: “Here I am, O God of all who are in the heavens and on earth!”

87

یا ملک قد کنّا بأمّ العراق الی ان حمّ الفراق توجّهنا الی ملک الاسلام بأمره فلمّا اتیناه ورد علینا من اولی النّفاق ما لا یتمّ بالأوراق بذلک ناح سکّان الفردوس و اهل حظائر القدس ولکنّ القوم فی حجاب غلیظ

Yā malik, qad kunnā bi-ummi al-ʿIrāq ilā an ḥumma al-firāq. Tawajjahnā ilā maliki al-Islām bi-amrihi. Fa-lammā ataynāhu warada ʿalaynā min ulī al-nifāqi mā lā yatimmu bi-al-awrāq. Bi-dhālika nāḥa sukkānu al-firdawsi wa-ahlu ḥaẓāʾiri al-quds wa-lākinna al-qawma fī ḥijābin ghalīẓ.

King! We were in the capital of Iraq until the time of separation was decreed. We journeyed to the king of Islam at his command. When We reached him, those given to hypocrisy inflicted on Us what no pages could fully recount. At this the inhabitants of Paradise and the people of the holy courts lamented, but the people remain behind a thick veil.

88

الی ان قلنا قد اشتدّ علینا الأمر فی کلّ یوم بل فی کلّ ساعة الی ان اخرجونا من السّجن و ادخلونا فی السّجن الأعظم بظلم مبین اذا قیل بأیّ جرم حبسوا قالوا انّهم ارادوا ان یجدّدوا الدّین لو کان القدیم هو المختار عندکم لم ترکتم ما شرع فی التّوریة و الانجیل بیّنوا یا قوم لعمری لیس لکم الیوم من محیص ان کان هذا جرمی قد سبقنی فی ذلک محمّد رسول اللّه و من قبله الرّوح و من قبله الکلیم و ان کان ذنبی اعلآء کلمة اللّه و اظهار امره فأنا اوّل المذنبین لا ابدّل هذا الذّنب بملکوت ملک السّموات و الأرضین

Ilā an qulnā qad ishtadda ʿalaynā al-amru fī kulli yawmin bal fī kulli sāʿatin ilā an akhrajūnā mina al-sijni wa-adkhalūnā fī al-sijni al-aʿẓami bi-ẓulmin mubīn. Idhā qīla bi-ayyi jurmin ḥubisū qālū innahum arādū an yujaddidū al-dīn. Law kāna al-qadīmu huwa al-mukhtāra ʿindakum lima taraktum mā shuriʿa fī al-tawrāti wa-al-injīl? Bayyinū yā qawm. La-ʿamrī laysa lakumu al-yawma min maḥīṣ. In kāna hādhā jurmī qad sabaqanī fī dhālika Muḥammadun rasūlu Allāh wa-man qablihi al-rūḥ wa-man qablihi al-kalīm. Wa-in kāna dhanbī iʿlāʾa kalimati Allāhi wa-iẓhāra amrihi fa-anā awwalu al-mudhnibīn. Lā ubaddilu hādhā al-dhanba bi-malakūti mulki al-samāwāti wa-al-arḍīn.

Further on We said: “Our plight grew more severe every day, indeed every hour, until they took Us out of the prison and cast Us into the Most Great Prison with manifest injustice. When asked, ‘For what crime were they imprisoned?’ they said, ‘They sought to renew religion.’ If you prefer what is old, why have you abandoned what was ordained in the Torah and the Gospel? Explain yourselves, people! By My life, today you have no escape. If this is My crime, then Muhammad, the Messenger of God, committed it before Me, and before Him the Spirit, and before Him the One who spoke with God. And if My sin is to exalt the word of God and manifest His Cause, then I am the first of sinners. I would not exchange this sin for sovereignty over the kingdom of the heavens and the earth.”

89

الی ان قلنا کلّما ازداد البلآء زاد البهآء فی حبّ اللّه و امره بحیث ما منعنی ما ورد علیّ من جنود الغافلین لو یستروننی فی اطباق التّراب یجدوننی راکباً علی السّحاب و داعیاً الی اللّه المقتدر القدیر انّی فدیت بنفسی فی سبیل اللّه و اشتاق البلایا فی حبّه و رضائه یشهد بذلک ما انا فیه من البلایا الّتی ما حملها احد من العالمین و ینطق کلّ شعر من شعراتی بما نطق شجر الطّور و کلّ عرق من عروقی یدعو اللّه و یقول یا لیت قطعت فى سبیلک لحیوة العالم و اتّحاد من فیه کذلک قضی الأمر من لدن علیم خبیر

Ilā an qulnā kullamā izdāda al-balāʾu zāda al-Bahāʾu fī ḥubbi Allāhi wa-amrihi bi-ḥaythu mā manaʿanī mā warada ʿalayya min junūdi al-ghāfilīn. Law yasturūnanī fī aṭbāqi al-turābi yajidūnanī rākiban ʿalā al-saḥābi wa-dāʿiyan ilā Allāhi al-muqtadiri al-qadīr. Innī fadaytu bi-nafsī fī sabīli Allāhi wa-ashtāqu al-balāyā fī ḥubbihi wa-riḍāʾihi. Yashhadu bi-dhālika mā anā fīhi mina al-balāyā allatī mā ḥamalahā aḥadun mina al-ʿālamīn. Wa-yanṭiqu kullu shaʿrin min shaʿarātī bi-mā naṭaqa shajaru al-Ṭūr wa-kullu ʿirqin min ʿurūqī yadʿū Allāha wa-yaqūlu yā layta quṭiʿtu fī sabīlika li-ḥayāti al-ʿālami wa-ittiḥādi man fīhi. Kadhālika quḍiya al-amru min ladun ʿalīmin khabīr.

Further on We said: “The greater the affliction, the greater Bahāʾ’s love for God and His Cause, so that nothing inflicted on Me by the hosts of the heedless has held Me back. Were they to bury Me beneath layers of earth, they would find Me riding upon the clouds and calling people to God, the All-Powerful, the Almighty. I have sacrificed Myself in the path of God and long for afflictions out of love for Him and to attain His good pleasure. To this bear witness the afflictions I suffer, which no one in all the world has borne. Every hair of Mine speaks what the Tree of Sinai spoke, and every vein of Mine calls upon God and says: ‘If only I could be severed in Your path, that the world might live and all within it be united!’ Thus has the matter been decreed by One who is All-Knowing, All-Aware.”

90

و اعلم انّ الرّعیّة امانات اللّه بینکم احفظوهم کما تحفظون انفسکم ایّاکم ان تجعلوا الذّئاب رعاة الأغنام و ان یمنعکم الغرور و الاستکبار عن التّوجّه الى الفقرآء و المساکین اطلع من افق الانقطاع باسمی ثمّ اقبل الی الملکوت بأمر ربّک المقتدر القدیر

Wa-iʿlam anna al-raʿiyyata amānātu Allāhi baynakum. Iḥfaẓūhum kamā taḥfaẓūna anfusakum. Iyyākum an tajʿalū al-dhiʾāba ruʿāta al-aghnāmi wa-an yamnaʿakumu al-ghurūru wa-al-istikbāru ʿani al-tawajjuhi ilā al-fuqarāʾi wa-al-masākīn. Iṭlaʿ min ufuqi al-inqiṭāʿi bi-ismī thumma aqbil ilā al-malakūti bi-amri rabbika al-muqtadiri al-qadīr.

Know that your subjects are God’s trusts among you. Protect them as you protect yourselves. Beware of making wolves the shepherds of the sheep, and of allowing conceit and arrogance to keep you from attending to the poor and needy.
