Rise above the horizon of detachment in My name, then turn toward the Kingdom at the command of your Lord, the All-Powerful, the Almighty.

91

الی ان قلنا زیّن جسد الملک بطراز اسمی و قم علی تبلیغ امری هذا خیر لک ممّا عندک و یرفع اللّه به اسمک بین الملوک انّه علی کلّ شیء قدیر امش بین النّاس باسم اللّه و سلطانه لتظهر منک آثاره بین العالمین

Ilā an qulnā zayyin jasada al-mulki bi-ṭirāzi ismī wa-qum ʿalā tablīghi amrī. Hādhā khayrun laka mimmā ʿindaka wa-yarfaʿu Allāhu bihi ismaka bayna al-mulūk. Innahu ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr. Imshi bayna al-nāsi bi-ismi Allāhi wa-sulṭānihi li-taẓhara minka āthāruhu bayna al-ʿālamīn.

Further on We said: “Adorn the body of sovereignty with the ornament of My name and arise to proclaim My Cause. This is better for you than all you possess, and through it God will exalt your name among kings. He has power over all things. Walk among the people in the name of God and by His authority, so that His signs may appear through you among the peoples of the world.”

92

الی ان قلنا قل یا قوم هل ینبغی لکم ان تنسبوا انفسکم الى الرّحمن و ترتکبوا ما ارتکبه الشّیطان لا وجمال السّبحان لو کنتم من العارفین قدّسوا قلوبکم عن حبّ الدّنیا و السنکم عن الافترآء و ارکانکم عمّا یمنعکم عن التّقرّب الی اللّه العزیز الحمید قل الدّنیا هی اعراضکم عن مطلع الوحی و اقبالکم الی ما لا ینفعکم و ما منعکم الیوم عن شطر اللّه انّه اصل الدّنیا اجتنبوها و تقرّبوا الی المنظر الأکبر هذا المقرّ المشرق المنیر یا قوم لا تسفکوا الدّمآء و لا تحکموا علی نفس الّا بالحقّ کذلک امرتم من لدن علیم خبیر انّ الّذین یفسدون فی الأرض بعد اصلاحها اولئک جاوزوا ما حدّد فی الکتاب فبئس مثوی المعتدین

Ilā an qulnā qul yā qawm, hal yanbaghī lakum an tansubū anfusakum ilā al-Raḥmāni wa-tartakibū mā irtakabahu al-shayṭān? Lā wa-jamāli al-subḥān law kuntum mina al-ʿārifīn. Qaddisū qulūbakum ʿan ḥubbi al-dunyā wa-alsinatakum ʿani al-iftirāʾi wa-arkānakum ʿammā yamnaʿukum ʿani al-taqarrubi ilā Allāhi al-ʿazīzi al-ḥamīd. Qul al-dunyā hiya iʿrāḍukum ʿan maṭlaʿi al-waḥyi wa-iqbālukum ilā mā lā yanfaʿukum. Wa-mā manaʿakumu al-yawma ʿan shaṭri Allāhi innahu aṣlu al-dunyā. Ijtanibūhā wa-taqarrabū ilā al-manẓari al-akbari hādhā al-maqarri al-mushriqi al-munīr. Yā qawm, lā tasfikū al-dimāʾa wa-lā taḥkumū ʿalā nafsin illā bi-al-ḥaqq. Kadhālika umirtum min ladun ʿalīmin khabīr. Inna alladhīna yufsidūna fī al-arḍi baʿda iṣlāḥihā ulāʾika jāwazū mā ḥuddida fī al-kitāb. Fa-biʾsa mathwā al-muʿtadīn.

Further on We said: “Say: ‘People! Is it fitting for you to claim allegiance to the All-Merciful while committing what Satan has committed? No, by the beauty of the All-Glorious, if you would understand! Purify your hearts of love for the world, your tongues of slander, and your limbs of whatever prevents you from drawing near to God, the Almighty, the Praiseworthy. Say: The world is your turning away from the Dawning-Place of revelation and turning toward what does not benefit you. Whatever keeps you today from turning toward God is the very essence of worldliness. Shun it and draw near to the Most Great Vision, this radiant, luminous abode. People! Do not shed blood, and do not pass judgment on anyone except with justice. Thus have you been commanded by One who is All-Knowing, All-Aware. Those who spread corruption on earth after it has been set right have overstepped the bounds prescribed in the Book. Miserable indeed is the abode of the transgressors.’”

93

الی ان قلنا لا تخونوا فی اموال النّاس کونوا امنآء فی الأرض و لا تحرموا الفقرآء عمّا اتاکم اللّه من فضله انّه یعطیکم ضعف ما عندکم انّه هو المعطى الکریم یا اهل البهآء سخّروا مدائن القلوب بسیوف الحکمة و البیان انّ الّذین یجادلون بأهوآء انفسهم اولئک فی حجاب مبین قل سیف الحکمة احرّ من الصّیف و احدّ من سیف الحدید لو کنتم من العارفین اخرجوه باسمی و سلطانی ثمّ افتحوا به مدائن افئدة الّذین اعتکفوا فی حصن الهوی کذلک یأمرکم قلم الأبهی اذ کان جالساً تحت سیوف الغافلین ان اطّلعتم على خطیئة استروها لیستر اللّه عنکم انّه هو السّتّار ذو الفضل العظیم یا ملأ الأغنیآء ان رأیتم فقیراً لا تستکبروا علیه تفکّروا فیما خلقتم منه قد خلق کلّ من مآء مهین

Ilā an qulnā lā takhūnū fī amwāli al-nās. Kūnū umanāʾa fī al-arḍi wa-lā taḥrimū al-fuqarāʾa ʿammā ātākumu Allāhu min faḍlihi. Innahu yuʿṭīkum ḍiʿfa mā ʿindakum. Innahu huwa al-muʿṭī al-karīm. Yā ahla al-Bahāʾ, sakhkhirū madāʾina al-qulūbi bi-suyūfi al-ḥikmati wa-al-bayān. Inna alladhīna yujādilūna bi-ahwāʾi anfusihim ulāʾika fī ḥijābin mubīn. Qul sayfu al-ḥikmati aḥarru mina al-ṣayfi wa-aḥaddu min sayfi al-ḥadīd law kuntum mina al-ʿārifīn. Akhrijūhu bi-ismī wa-sulṭānī thumma iftaḥū bihi madāʾina afʾidati alladhīna iʿtakafū fī ḥiṣni al-hawā. Kadhālika yaʾmurukum qalamu al-Abhā idh kāna jālisan taḥta suyūfi al-ghāfilīn. In iṭṭalaʿtum ʿalā khaṭīʾatin usturūhā li-yastura Allāhu ʿankum. Innahu huwa al-sattāru dhū al-faḍli al-ʿaẓīm. Yā malaʾa al-aghniyāʾ, in raʾaytum faqīran lā tastakbirū ʿalayhi. Tafakkarū fīmā khuliqtum minhu. Qad khuliqa kullun min māʾin mahīn.

Further on We said: “Do not act dishonestly with the property of others. Be trustworthy on earth, and do not deprive the poor of what God has given you from His bounty. He will give you twice what you possess. He is indeed the Giver, the All-Bountiful. People of Bahāʾ! Conquer the cities of hearts with the swords of wisdom and utterance. Those who dispute according to their own desires are indeed behind a manifest veil. Say: The sword of wisdom is hotter than summer and sharper than a sword of steel, if you would understand. Draw it in My name and by My authority, then conquer with it the cities of the hearts of those who have secluded themselves in the stronghold of desire. Thus the Pen of the All-Glorious commands you as He sits beneath the swords of the heedless. If you become aware of a sin, conceal it, so that God may conceal yours. He is indeed the Concealer, possessed of immense bounty. You who are rich! If you see a poor person, do not treat him arrogantly. Reflect on what you were created from. Everyone was created from a lowly fluid.”

94

الی ان قلنا انظروا العالم کهیکل انسان اعترته الأمراض و برئه منوط باتّحاد من فیه اجتمعوا على ما شرّعناه لکم و لا تتّبعوا سبل المختلفین تفکّر فی الدّنیا و شأن اهلها انّ الّذى خلق العالم لنفسه قد حبس فی اخرب الدّیار بما اکتسبت ایدی الغافلین و من افق السّجن یدعو النّاس الى فجر اللّه العلیّ العظیم هل تفرح بما عندک من الزّخارف بعد اذ تعلم انّها ستفنی او تسترّ بما تحکم علی شبر من الأرض بعد اذ کلّها لم تکن عند اهل البهآء الّا کسواد عین نملة میّتة دعها لأهلها ثمّ اقبل الى مقصود العالمین این اهل الغرور و قصورهم انظر فی قبورهم لتعتبر بما جعلناها عبرة للنّاظرین لو تأخذک نفحات الوحی لتفرّ من الملک مقبلاً الی الملکوت و تنفق ما عندک للتّقرّب الی هذا المنظر الکریم

Ilā an qulnā: Unẓurū al-ʿālama ka-haykali insānin iʿtarat-hu al-amrāḍu wa-burʾuhu manūṭun bi-ittiḥādi man fīhi. Ijtamiʿū ʿalā mā sharaʿnāhu lakum wa-lā tattabiʿū subula al-mukhtalifīn. Tafakkar fī al-dunyā wa-shaʾni ahlihā. Inna alladhī khalaqa al-ʿālama li-nafsihi qad ḥubisa fī akhrabi al-diyāri bi-mā iktasabat aydī al-ghāfilīn, wa-min ufuqi al-sijni yadʿū al-nāsa ilā fajri Allāhi al-ʿAliyyi al-ʿAẓīm. Hal tafraḥu bi-mā ʿindaka mina al-zakhārifi baʿda idh taʿlamu annahā satafnā, aw tastarru bi-mā taḥkumu ʿalā shibrin mina al-arḍi baʿda idh kulluhā lam takun ʿinda ahli al-Bahāʾi illā ka-sawādi ʿayni namlatin mayyitah? Daʿhā li-ahlihā thumma aqbil ilā maqṣūdi al-ʿālamīn. Ayna ahlu al-ghurūri wa-quṣūruhum? Unẓur fī qubūrihim li-taʿtabira bi-mā jaʿalnāhā ʿibratan li-l-nāẓirīn. Law taʾkhudhuka nafaḥātu al-waḥyi la-tafirru mina al-mulki muqbilan ilā al-malakūti wa-tunfiqu mā ʿindaka li-l-taqarrubi ilā hādhā al-manẓari al-karīm.

Further on We said: “Regard the world as a human body afflicted with diseases, whose recovery depends on the unity of those within it. Unite around what We have prescribed for you, and do not follow the paths of those who differ. Reflect on the world and the condition of its people. He who created the world for Himself has been imprisoned in the most desolate of lands because of what the hands of the heedless have done. From the horizon of the prison He calls the people to the dawn of God, the Most High, the Most Great. Do you rejoice in the ornaments you possess, knowing that they will perish, or delight in ruling over a span of earth, when all of it is, to the people of Bahāʾ, no more than the black of a dead ant’s eye? Leave it to its people, and turn toward the One desired by all the worlds. Where are the arrogant and their palaces? Look at their graves and take heed, for We have made them a lesson for those who look. If the breezes of revelation were to seize you, you would flee from earthly dominion toward the Kingdom and spend all you possess to draw near to this gracious Countenance.”

95

و امر نمودیم یکى از ملأ حضرت روح این لوح را ارسال دارد و او ذکر نمود لوح و ترجمهٔ آن را ارسال داشتم العلم عند اللّه العزیز العلّام

Va amr namūdīm yekī az malaʾ-i Ḥaḍrat-i Rūḥ īn lawḥ rā irsāl dārad va ū dhikr namūd: Lawḥ va tarjumeh-yi ān rā irsāl dāshtam. Al-ʿilmu ʿinda Allāhi al-ʿAzīzi al-ʿAllām.

We instructed one of the clergy of His Holiness the Spirit to send this Tablet, and he stated: “I have sent the Tablet and its translation.” Knowledge rests with God, the Almighty, the All-Knowing.

96

و یکى از اجزاء هیکل لوح حضرت امپراطور روس ایّده اللّه تبارک و تعالی است

Va yekī az ajzā-yi haykal lawḥ-i ḥaḍrat-i impirāṭūr-i Rūs, ayyadahu Allāhu tabāraka wa-taʿālā, ast.

One of the constituent parts of this body is the Tablet to His Majesty the Emperor of Russia—may God, blessed and exalted be He, assist him.

97

یا ملک الرّوس اسمع ندآء اللّه الملک القدّوس و اقبل الى الفردوس المقرّ الّذی فیه استقرّ من سمّی بالأسمآء الحسنی بین الملإ الأعلی و فی ملکوت الانشآء باسم اللّه البهیّ الأبهی ایّاک ان یحجبک شیء عن التّوجّه الی ربّک الرّحمن الرّحیم انّا سمعنا ما نادیت به مولاک فی نجواک لذا هاج عرف عنایتی و ماج بحر رحمتی اجبناک بالحقّ انّ ربّک هو العلیم الحکیم قد نصرنی احد سفرائِک اذ کنت فی سجن الطّآء تحت السّلاسل و الأغلال بذلک کتب اللّه لک مقاماً لم یحط به علم احد الّا هو ایّاک ان تبدّل هذا المقام العظیم

Yā malika al-Rūs, ismaʿ nidāʾa Allāhi al-Maliki al-Quddūsi wa-aqbil ilā al-firdawsi al-maqarri alladhī fīhi istaqarra man summiya bi-l-asmāʾi al-ḥusnā bayna al-malaʾi al-aʿlā wa-fī malakūti al-inshāʾi bi-smi Allāhi al-Bahiyyi al-Abhā. Iyyāka an yaḥjubaka shayʾun ʿani al-tawajjuhi ilā rabbika al-Raḥmāni al-Raḥīm. Innā samiʿnā mā nādayta bihi mawlāka fī najwāka, li-dhā hāja ʿarfu ʿināyatī wa-māja baḥru raḥmatī. Ajabnāka bi-l-ḥaqqi, inna rabbaka huwa al-ʿAlīmu al-Ḥakīm. Qad naṣaranī aḥadu sufarāʾika idh kuntu fī sijni al-Ṭāʾi taḥta al-salāsili wa-l-aghlāl. Bi-dhālika kataba Allāhu laka maqāman lam yuḥiṭ bihi ʿilmu aḥadin illā huwa. Iyyāka an tubaddila hādhā al-maqāma al-ʿaẓīm.

“King of Russia! Hear the call of God, the King, the Most Holy, and turn toward Paradise, the dwelling where He abides who is called by the most beautiful names among the heavenly concourse, and in the kingdom of creation by the name of God, the All-Glorious, the Most Glorious. Beware lest anything keep you from turning toward your Lord, the All-Merciful, the Merciful. We heard what you called out to your Master in your secret prayer; therefore the fragrance of My loving care stirred and the ocean of My mercy surged. We answered you in truth. Your Lord is indeed the All-Knowing, the All-Wise. One of your ambassadors came to My aid when I was in the prison of Ṭāʾ, bound in chains and fetters. For this, God has ordained for you a station that no one’s knowledge encompasses except His own. Beware lest you exchange this great station for another.”

98

الی ان قلنا قد اتی الأب و الابن فی الواد المقدّس یقول لبّیک اللّهمّ لبّیک و الطّور یطوف حول البیت و الشّجر ینادی بأعلى النّدآء قد اتی الوهّاب راکباً علی السّحاب طوبی لمن تقرّب الیه ویل للمبعدین

Ilā an qulnā: Qad atā al-Abu wa-l-Ibnu fī al-wādi al-muqaddasi yaqūlu: Labbayka Allāhumma labbayk. Wa-l-Ṭūru yaṭūfu ḥawla al-Bayti wa-l-shajaru yunādī bi-aʿlā al-nidāʾi: Qad atā al-Wahhābu rākiban ʿalā al-saḥāb. Ṭūbā li-man taqarraba ilayhi, waylun li-l-mubʿadīn.

Further on We said: “The Father has come, and the Son in the holy valley says: ‘Here I am, O God, here I am!’ Sinai circles around the House, and the Tree calls out at the top of its voice: ‘The All-Bountiful has come, riding upon the clouds!’ Blessed is whoever draws near to Him; woe to those who remain far away!”

99

قم بین النّاس بهذا الأمر المبرم ثمّ ادع الأمم الی اللّه العزیز العظیم لا تکن من الّذین کانوا ان یدعوا اللّه باسم من الأسمآء فلمّا اتی المسمّى کفروا به و اعرضوا عنه الی ان افتوا علیه بظلم مبین انظر ثمّ اذکر الأیّام الّتی فیها اتی الرّوح و حکم علیه هیرودس قد نصر اللّه الرّوح بجنود الغیب و حفظه بالحقّ و ارسله الی ارض اخری وعداً من عنده انّه هو الحاکم علی ما یرید انّ ربّک یحفظ من یشآء لو یکون فى قطب البحر او فی فم الثّعبان او تحت سیوف الظّالمین

Qum bayna al-nāsi bi-hādhā al-amri al-mubrami thumma udʿu al-umama ilā Allāhi al-ʿAzīzi al-ʿAẓīm. Lā takun mina alladhīna kānū an yadʿū Allāha bi-smin mina al-asmāʾi fa-lammā atā al-musammā kafarū bihi wa-aʿraḍū ʿanhu ilā an aftaw ʿalayhi bi-ẓulmin mubīn. Unẓur thumma udhkur al-ayyāma allatī fīhā atā al-Rūḥu wa-ḥakama ʿalayhi Hīrūdus. Qad naṣara Allāhu al-Rūḥa bi-junūdi al-ghaybi wa-ḥafiẓahu bi-l-ḥaqqi wa-arsalahu ilā arḍin ukhrā waʿdan min ʿindihi. Innahu huwa al-ḥākimu ʿalā mā yurīd. Inna rabbaka yaḥfaẓu man yashāʾu law yakūnu fī quṭbi al-baḥri aw fī fami al-thuʿbāni aw taḥta suyūfi al-ẓālimīn.

“Rise among the people with this irrevocable Cause, then summon the nations to God, the Almighty, the Most Great. Do not be among those who called upon God by one of His names, but when the One bearing that name came, disbelieved in Him and turned away from Him, until they pronounced judgment against Him with manifest injustice. Consider and recall the days when the Spirit came and Herod passed judgment against Him. God aided the Spirit with the hosts of the unseen, protected Him in truth, and sent Him to another land, in fulfillment of a promise from Him. He indeed decrees whatever He wills. Your Lord protects whomever He wills, even in the midst of the sea, in the serpent’s mouth, or beneath the swords of the unjust.”

100

الی ان قلنا اسمع ندائی مرّة اخری من شطر سجنی لیخبرک بما ورد علی جمالی من مظاهر جلالی و تعرف صبری بعد قدرتی و اصطباری بعد اقتداری وعمری لو تعرف ما نزّل من قلمی و تطّلع علی خزائن امری و لآلئ اسراری فی بحور اسمائی و اواعی کلماتی لتفدی بنفسک فی سبیل اللّه شوقاً الی ملکوته العزیز المنیع اعلم جسمی تحت سیوف الأعدآء و جسدی فی بلآء لا یحصی ولکنّ الرّوح فی بشارة لا یعادلها فرح العالمین

Ilā an qulnā: Ismaʿ nidāʾī marratan ukhrā min shaṭri sijnī li-yukhbiraka bi-mā warada ʿalā jamālī min maẓāhiri jalālī wa-taʿrifa ṣabrī baʿda qudratī wa-iṣṭibārī baʿda iqtidārī. Wa-ʿamrī, law taʿrifu mā nuzzila min qalamī wa-taṭṭaliʿu ʿalā khazāʾini amrī wa-laʾāliʾi asrārī fī buḥūri asmāʾī wa-awāʿī kalimātī la-tafdī bi-nafsika fī sabīli Allāhi shawqan ilā malakūtihi al-ʿAzīzi al-Manīʿ. Iʿlam, jismī taḥta suyūfi al-aʿdāʾi wa-jasadī fī balāʾin lā yuḥṣā, wa-lākinna al-rūḥa fī bishāratin lā yuʿādiluhā faraḥu al-ʿālamīn.

Further on We said: “Hear My call once more from the direction of My prison, that it may tell you what has befallen My Beauty at the hands of the manifestations of My majesty, and that you may know My patience despite My power and My forbearance despite My might. By My life! If you knew what has been sent down from My Pen and became acquainted with the treasuries of My Cause and the pearls of My mysteries in the oceans of My names and the vessels of My words, you would sacrifice your life in the path of God out of longing for His mighty, inaccessible Kingdom. Know that My body is beneath the swords of enemies and My flesh suffers countless afflictions, yet My spirit is filled with a gladness that the joy of all the worlds cannot equal.”

101

و همچنین بعضی از آیات لوح حضرت ملکه ایّدها اللّه تبارک و تعالی ذکر میشود مقصود آنکه شاید نفحات وحی آن جناب را اخذ نماید و لوجه اللّه بر خدمت امر قیام کنند و آنچه از الواح حضرات ملوک وفّقهم اللّه نرسیده برسانند این امر عظیم است این خدمت عظیم در آن ارض علمای اعلام بسیارند از جمله حضرات سادات که در بزرگی و شأن معروفند با ایشان مشورت نمائید و آنچه از قلم اعلی جاری شده بنمائید شاید بر اصلاح عالم و تهذیب نفوس امم مؤیّد شوند و ضغینه و بغضای مکنونهٔ مخزونهٔ در افئده را بکوثر نصایح الهی ساکن نمایند این توفیق را از حقّ میطلبیم و لیس هذا علیه بعزیز

Va hamchunīn baʿḍī az āyāt-i lawḥ-i ḥaḍrat-i malakeh, ayyadahā Allāhu tabāraka wa-taʿālā, dhikr mī-shavad. Maqṣūd ān-ke shāyad nafaḥāt-i vaḥy ān janāb rā akhdh namāyad va li-vajhi Allāh bar khidmat-i amr qiyām kunand va ānchih az alvāḥ-i ḥaḍarāt-i mulūk, waffaqahumu Allāh, narasīdeh birasānand. Īn amr ʿaẓīm ast, īn khidmat ʿaẓīm. Dar ān arḍ ʿulamā-yi aʿlām bisyārand, az jumleh ḥaḍarāt-i sādāt keh dar buzurgī va shaʾn maʿrūfand. Bā īshān mashvarat namāyīd va ānchih az qalam-i aʿlā jārī shudeh binamāyīd. Shāyad bar iṣlāḥ-i ʿālam va tahdhīb-i nufūs-i umam muʾayyad shavand va ḍaghīneh va baghḍā-yi maknūneh-yi makhzūneh dar afʾideh rā bi-kawthar-i naṣāyiḥ-i ilāhī sākin namāyand. Īn tawfīq rā az Ḥaqq mī-ṭalabīm, wa-laysa hādhā ʿalayhi bi-ʿazīz.

Likewise, some of the verses of the Tablet to Her Majesty the Queen—may God, blessed and exalted be He, assist her—are cited. The purpose is that the breezes of revelation may perhaps seize you, and that you may arise to serve the Cause for God’s sake and deliver whichever of the Tablets to Their Majesties the kings—may God grant them success—have not reached them. This is a great undertaking, a great service. In that land there are many distinguished scholars, among them the honored sayyids, who are renowned for their greatness and standing. Consult with them and show them what has flowed from the Most Exalted Pen. Perhaps they may be assisted in reforming the world and refining the souls of the nations, and may quell the rancor and hatred concealed and stored in hearts with the life-giving waters of divine counsels. We ask God to grant this success, and this is not difficult for Him.

102

یا ایّتها الملکة فی لندن اسمعی ندآء ربّک مالک البریّة من السّدرة الالهیّة انّه لا اله الّا انا العزیز الحکیم ضعی ما علی الأرض و زیّنی رأس الملک باکلیل ذکر ربّک الجلیل انّه قد اتی فی العالم بمجده الأعظم و کمل ما ذکر فی الانجیل قد تشرّف برّ الشّام بقدوم ربّه مالک الأنام و اخذ سکر خمر الوصال شطر الجنوب و الشّمال طوبی لمن وجد عرف الرّحمن و اقبل الی مشرق الجمال فی هذا الفجر المنیر قد اهتزّ المسجد الأقصی من نسمات ربّه الأبهی و البطحآء من ندآء اللّه العلیّ الأعلی و کلّ حصاة منها تسبّح الرّبّ بهذا الاسم العظیم

Yā ayyatuhā al-malikatu fī Landan, ismaʿī nidāʾa rabbiki Māliki al-bariyyati mina al-sidrati al-ilāhiyyah: Innahu lā ilāha illā anā al-ʿAzīzu al-Ḥakīm. Ḍaʿī mā ʿalā al-arḍi wa-zayyinī raʾsa al-mulki bi-iklīli dhikri rabbiki al-Jalīl. Innahu qad atā fī al-ʿālami bi-majdihi al-aʿẓami wa-kamula mā dhukira fī al-Injīl. Qad tasharrafa barru al-Shāmi bi-qudūmi rabbihi Māliki al-anāmi wa-akhadha sukru khamri al-wiṣāli shaṭra al-janūbi wa-l-shamāl. Ṭūbā li-man wajada ʿarfa al-Raḥmāni wa-aqbala ilā mashriqi al-jamāli fī hādhā al-fajri al-munīr. Qad ihtazza al-Masjidu al-Aqṣā min nasamāti rabbihi al-Abhā wa-l-Baṭḥāʾu min nidāʾi Allāhi al-ʿAliyyi al-Aʿlā, wa-kullu ḥaṣātin minhā tusabbiḥu al-Rabba bi-hādhā al-ismi al-ʿaẓīm.

“Queen in London! Hear the call of your Lord, the Sovereign of creation, from the divine Lote-Tree: ‘There is no God but Me, the Almighty, the All-Wise.’ Set aside what is on earth, and adorn the head of sovereignty with the crown of remembrance of your Lord, the All-Glorious. He has come into the world in His most great glory, and what was recorded in the Gospel has been fulfilled. The land of Syria has been honored by the arrival of its Lord, the Sovereign of humankind, and the intoxication of the wine of reunion has seized the regions of the south and the north. Blessed is whoever has perceived the fragrance of the All-Merciful and turned toward the Dawning-Place of Beauty in this radiant dawn. The Aqṣā Mosque has stirred at the breezes of its Lord, the Most Glorious, and Baṭḥāʾ at the call of God, the Most High, the Most Exalted; every pebble within it glorifies the Lord through this great Name.”

103

الی ان قلنا انّا نذکرک لوجه اللّه و نحبّ ان یعلو اسمک بذکر ربّک خالق الأرض و السّمآء انّه علی ما اقول شهید قد بلغنا انّک منعت بیع الغلمان و الامآء هذا ما حکم به اللّه فی هذا الظّهور البدیع قد کتب اللّه لک جزآء ذلک انّه موفّی اجور المحسنات و المحسنین ان تتّبعی ما ارسل الیک من لدن علیم خبیر انّ الّذی اعرض و استکبر بعدما جآءته البیّنات من لدن منزل الآیات لیحبط اللّه عمله انّه علی کلّ شیء قدیر انّ الأعمال تقبل بعد الاقبال من اعرض عن الحقّ انّه من احجب الخلق کذلک قدّر من لدن عزیز قدیر

Ilā an qulnā: Innā nadhkuruki li-wajhi Allāhi wa-nuḥibbu an yaʿluwa ismuki bi-dhikri rabbiki Khāliqi al-arḍi wa-l-samāʾ. Innahu ʿalā mā aqūlu shahīd. Qad balaghanā annaki manaʿti bayʿa al-ghilmāni wa-l-imāʾ. Hādhā mā ḥakama bihi Allāhu fī hādhā al-ẓuhūri al-badīʿ. Qad kataba Allāhu laki jazāʾa dhālika, innahu muwaffī ujūri al-muḥsināti wa-l-muḥsinīn, in tattabiʿī mā ursila ilayki min ladun ʿAlīmin Khabīr. Inna alladhī aʿraḍa wa-istakbara baʿdamā jāʾat-hu al-bayyinātu min ladun Munzili al-āyāti la-yuḥbiṭu Allāhu ʿamalahu. Innahu ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr. Inna al-aʿmāla tuqbalu baʿda al-iqbāl. Man aʿraḍa ʿani al-Ḥaqqi innahu min aḥjabi al-khalq. Kadhālika quddira min ladun ʿAzīzin Qadīr.

Further on We said: “We make mention of you for God’s sake and desire that your name be exalted through remembrance of your Lord, the Creator of earth and heaven. He is witness to what I say. We have learned that you have forbidden the sale of male and female slaves. This is what God has decreed in this wondrous Revelation. God has ordained a reward for you for this—He indeed pays in full the rewards of women and men who do good—if you follow what has been sent to you by One who is All-Knowing, All-Aware. Whoever turns away and acts arrogantly after the clear proofs have come to him from the One who sends down the verses, God will assuredly bring his deeds to nothing. He has power over all things. Deeds are accepted after one has turned toward Him. Whoever turns away from the True One is among the most veiled of His creatures. Thus has it been decreed by One who is Almighty, All-Powerful.”

104

و سمعنا انّک اودعت زمام المشاورة بأیادی الجمهور نعم ما عملت لأنّ بها تستحکم اصول ابنیة الأمور و تطمئنّ قلوب من فی ظلّک من کلّ وضیع و شریف ولکن ینبغی لهم ان یکونوا امنآء بین العباد و یرون انفسهم وکلآء لمن علی الأرض کلّها هذا ما وعظوا به فی اللّوح من لدن مدبّر حکیم و اذا توجّه احد الی المجمع یحوّل طرفه الی الأفق الأعلی و یقول یا الهی اسألک باسمک الأبهی ان تؤیّدنی علی ما تصلح به امور عبادک و تعمر به بلادک انّک انت علی کلّ شیء قدیر طوبی لمن یدخل المجمع لوجه اللّه و یحکم بین النّاس بالعدل الخالص الا انّه من الفائزین

Wa-samiʿnā annaki awdaʿti zimāma al-mushāwarati bi-ayādī al-jumhūr. Niʿma mā ʿamilti li-anna bihā tastaḥkimu uṣūlu abniyati al-umūri wa-taṭmaʾinnu qulūbu man fī ẓilliki min kulli waḍīʿin wa-sharīf. Wa-lākin yanbaghī lahum an yakūnū umanāʾa bayna al-ʿibādi wa-yarawna anfusahum wukalāʾa li-man ʿalā al-arḍi kullihā. Hādhā mā wuʿiẓū bihi fī al-lawḥi min ladun Mudabbirin Ḥakīm. Wa-idhā tawajjaha aḥadun ilā al-majmaʿi yuḥawwilu ṭarfahu ilā al-ufuqi al-aʿlā wa-yaqūlu: Yā ilāhī, asʾaluka bi-smika al-Abhā an tuʾayyidanī ʿalā mā taṣluḥu bihi umūru ʿibādika wa-taʿmuru bihi bilāduka. Innaka anta ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr. Ṭūbā li-man yadkhulu al-majmaʿa li-wajhi Allāhi wa-yaḥkumu bayna al-nāsi bi-l-ʿadli al-khāliṣ. Alā innahu mina al-fāʾizīn.

“We have also heard that you have entrusted the reins of consultation to the people. Well have you done, for through it the foundations of the structure of affairs are strengthened and the hearts of all who live under your protection, both lowly and noble, are reassured. Yet they should be trustworthy among the people and regard themselves as representatives of all who dwell on earth. This is the counsel given to them in the Tablet by One who is the All-Wise Ordainer. When anyone goes to the assembly, he should turn his gaze toward the Most Exalted Horizon and say: ‘My God! I ask You by Your Most Glorious Name to assist me in whatever will set right the affairs of Your servants and make Your lands flourish. You indeed have power over all things.’ Blessed is whoever enters the assembly for God’s sake and judges between people with pure justice. He is indeed among those who attain success.”

105

یا اصحاب المجالس هناک و فی دیار اخری تدبّروا و تکلّموا فیما یصلح به العالم و حاله لو کنتم من المتوسّمین انظروا العالم کهیکل انسان انّه خلق صحیحاً کاملاً اعترته الأمراض بالأسباب المختلفة المتغایرة و ما طابت نفسه یوماً بل اشتدّ مرضه بما وقع تحت تصرّف المتطبّبین الّذین رکبوا مطیّة الهوی و کانوا من الهائمین الّا من شآء اللّه ربّ العالمین و ان طاب عضو من اعضائه فی عصر من الأعصار بطبیب حاذق بقیت اعضآء اخری فیما کان کذلک ینبّئکم العلیم الخبیر و الیوم نراه تحت ایادی الّذین اخذهم سکر خمر الغرور بحیث لا یعرفون خیر انفسهم فکیف هذا الأمر الأوعر الخطیر

Yā aṣḥāba al-majālisi hunāka wa-fī diyārin ukhrā, tadabbarū wa-takallamū fī-mā yaṣluḥu bihi al-ʿālamu wa-ḥāluhu law kuntum mina al-mutawassimīn. Unẓurū al-ʿālama ka-haykali insānin, innahu khuliqa ṣaḥīḥan kāmilan, iʿtarat-hu al-amrāḍu bi-l-asbābi al-mukhtalifati al-mutaghāyirah. Wa-mā ṭābat nafsuhu yawman, bal ishtadda maraḍuhu bi-mā waqaʿa taḥta taṣarrufi al-mutaṭabbibīna alladhīna rakibū maṭiyyata al-hawā wa-kānū mina al-hāʾimīn, illā man shāʾa Allāhu Rabbu al-ʿālamīn. Wa-in ṭāba ʿuḍwun min aʿḍāʾihi fī ʿaṣrin mina al-aʿṣāri bi-ṭabībin ḥādhiqin baqiyat aʿḍāʾun ukhrā fī-mā kān. Kadhālika yunabbiʾukumu al-ʿAlīmu al-Khabīr. Wa-l-yawma narāhu taḥta ayādī alladhīna akhadhahum sukru khamri al-ghurūri bi-ḥaythu lā yaʿrifūna khayra anfusihim, fa-kayfa hādhā al-amru al-awʿaru al-khaṭīr?

“Members of assemblies there and in other lands! Deliberate and speak about what will improve the world and its condition, if you are discerning. Regard the world as a human body: it was created sound and whole, but diseases have afflicted it through various and differing causes. Not for a day has it recovered; rather, its illness has grown worse because it has fallen under the control of would-be physicians who have mounted the steed of desire and wandered astray, except for those whom God, the Lord of the worlds, wills otherwise. Even if a skilled physician has healed one of its limbs in some age, other limbs have remained as they were. Thus the All-Knowing, the All-Aware informs you. Today We see it in the hands of those so intoxicated with the wine of pride that they do not know their own good—how much less this most difficult and momentous matter!”

106

الی ان قلنا و ما جعله اللّه الدّریاق الأعظم و السّبب الأتمّ لصحّته هو اتّحاد من علی الأرض علی امر واحد و شریعة واحدة هذا لا یمکن ابداً الّا بطبیب حاذق کامل مؤیّد لعمری هذا هو الحقّ و ما بعده الّا الضّلال المبین کلّما اتی ذاک السّبب الأعظم و اشرق ذاک النّور من مشرق القدم منعه المتطبّبون و صاروا سحاباً بینه و بین العالم لذا ما طاب مرضه و بقی فی سقمه الی الحین انّهم لم یقدروا على حفظه و صحّته و الّذى کان مظهر القدرة بین البریّة منع عمّا اراد بما اکتسبت ایدی المتطبّبین

Ilā an qulnā: Wa-mā jaʿalahu Allāhu al-diryāqa al-aʿẓama wa-l-sababa al-atamma li-ṣiḥḥatihi huwa ittiḥādu man ʿalā al-arḍi ʿalā amrin wāḥidin wa-sharīʿatin wāḥidah. Hādhā lā yumkinu abadan illā bi-ṭabībin ḥādhiqin kāmilin muʾayyad. La-ʿamrī, hādhā huwa al-ḥaqqu wa-mā baʿdahu illā al-ḍalālu al-mubīn. Kullamā atā dhāka al-sababu al-aʿẓamu wa-ashraqa dhāka al-nūru min mashriqi al-qidami manaʿahu al-mutaṭabbibūna wa-ṣārū saḥāban baynahu wa-bayna al-ʿālam. Li-dhā mā ṭāba maraḍuhu wa-baqiya fī saqamihi ilā al-ḥīn. Innahum lam yaqdirū ʿalā ḥifẓihi wa-ṣiḥḥatihi, wa-alladhī kāna maẓhara al-qudrati bayna al-bariyyati muniʿa ʿammā arāda bi-mā iktasabat aydī al-mutaṭabbibīn.

Further on We said: “What God has made the supreme remedy and the most complete means of its recovery is the union of all who dwell on earth in one Cause and one law. This can never be achieved except through a skilled, perfect, divinely assisted Physician. By My life! This is the truth, and beyond it there is nothing but manifest error. Whenever that supreme means has appeared and that Light has shone from the Dawning-Place of eternity, the would-be physicians have obstructed Him and become clouds between Him and the world. Thus its illness has not been cured, and it has remained sick to this day. They have been unable to preserve it and restore its health, while He who was the manifestation of power among creation was prevented from accomplishing His purpose by what the hands of the would-be physicians had done.”

107

انظروا فی هذه الأیّام الّتی اتی جمال القدم بالاسم الأعظم لحیوة العالم و اتّحادهم انّهم قاموا علیه بأسیاف شاحذة و ارتکبوا ما فزع به الرّوح الأمین الی ان جعلوه مسجوناً فی اخرب البلاد و انقطعت عن ذیله ایادی المقبلین اذا قیل لهم اتی مصلح العالم قالوا قد تحقّق انّه من المفسدین مع انّهم ما عاشروه و یرون انّه ما حفظ نفسه فی اقلّ من حین کان فی کلّ الأحیان بین ایادی اهل الطّغیان مرّةً حبسوه و طوراً اخرجوه و تارةً اداروا به البلاد کذلک حکموا علینا و اللّه بما اقول علیم

Unẓurū fī hādhihi al-ayyāmi allatī atā Jamālu al-Qidami bi-l-ismi al-aʿẓami li-ḥayāti al-ʿālami wa-ittiḥādihim. Innahum qāmū ʿalayhi bi-asyāfin shāḥidhatin wa-irtakabū mā faziʿa bihi al-Rūḥu al-Amīnu ilā an jaʿalūhu masjūnan fī akhrabi al-bilādi wa-inqaṭaʿat ʿan dhaylihi ayādī al-muqbilīn. Idhā qīla lahum atā muṣliḥu al-ʿālami qālū qad taḥaqqaqa annahu mina al-mufsidīn, maʿa annahum mā ʿāsharūhu wa-yarawna annahu mā ḥafiẓa nafsahu fī aqalla min ḥīn. Kāna fī kulli al-aḥyāni bayna ayādī ahli al-ṭughyān. Marratan ḥabasūhu wa-ṭawran akhrajūhu wa-tāratan adārū bihi al-bilād. Kadhālika ḥakamū ʿalaynā wa-Allāhu bi-mā aqūlu ʿalīm.

“Consider these days, in which the Ancient Beauty has come with the Most Great Name to give life to the world and unite its people. They have risen against Him with sharpened swords and committed what has filled the Faithful Spirit with dread, until they imprisoned Him in the most desolate of lands and cut off the hands of those who turn toward Him from the hem of His robe. When they are told, ‘The Reformer of the world has come,’ they say, ‘It has been established that He is among those who spread corruption,’ although they have not associated with Him and see that He has not protected Himself for even the briefest moment. He has always been in the hands of the tyrannical. At one time they imprisoned Him, at another they expelled Him, and at yet another they drove Him from land to land. Thus have they passed judgment upon Us, and God knows what I say.”

108

این نسبت فساد همان نسبت فسادیست که از قبل فراعنه بحضرت کلیم اللّه داده‌اند اقرأ ما انزله الرّحمن فی الفرقان قوله تبارک و تعالی و لقد ارسلنا موسی بآیاتنا و سلطان مبین الی فرعون و هامان و قارون فقالوا ساحر کذّاب فلمّا جآءهم بالحقّ من عندنا قالوا اقتلوا ابنآء الّذین آمنوا معه و استحیوا نسائهم و ما کید الکافرین الّا فی ضلال و قال فرعون ذرونی اقتل موسى و لیدع ربّه انّی اخاف ان یبدّل دینکم او ان یظهر فی الأرض الفساد و قال موسی انّی عذت بربّی و ربّکم من کلّ متکبّر لا یؤمن بیوم الحساب

Īn nisbat-i fasād hamān nisbat-i fasādīst ki az qabl farāʿina bi-Ḥaḍrat-i Kalīm Allāh dāda-and. Iqraʾ mā anzalahu al-Raḥmān fī al-Furqān, qawluhu tabāraka wa-taʿālā: Wa-laqad arsalnā Mūsā bi-āyātinā wa-sulṭānin mubīn ilā Firʿawn wa-Hāmān wa-Qārūn fa-qālū sāḥirun kadhdhāb. Fa-lammā jāʾahum bi-al-ḥaqq min ʿindinā qālū uqtulū abnāʾ alladhīna āmanū maʿahu wa-istaḥyū nisāʾahum wa-mā kaydu al-kāfirīn illā fī ḍalāl. Wa-qāla Firʿawn dharūnī aqtul Mūsā wa-l-yadʿu rabbahu innī akhāfu an yubaddila dīnakum aw an yuẓhira fī al-arḍ al-fasād. Wa-qāla Mūsā innī ʿudhtu bi-rabbī wa-rabbikum min kulli mutakabbirin lā yuʾminu bi-yawm al-ḥisāb.

This charge of spreading corruption is the very charge that the Pharaohs of old leveled against Moses, who spoke with God. Read what the All-Merciful revealed in the Qur’an. These are His words, blessed and exalted is He: “We sent Moses with Our signs and a clear authority to Pharaoh, Haman, and Korah, but they said, ‘A sorcerer, a liar!’ When he brought them the truth from Us, they said, ‘Kill the sons of those who believe with him, and spare their women.’ Yet the scheming of the unbelievers leads only astray. Pharaoh said, ‘Let me kill Moses, and let him call upon his Lord. I fear that he will change your religion or cause corruption to appear in the land.’ Moses said, ‘I seek refuge in my Lord and your Lord from every arrogant person who does not believe in the Day of Reckoning.’”

109

لازال مصلح عالم را مفسد دانسته‌اند و گفته‌اند آنچه را که کل شنیده‌اند هر هنگام نیّر ظهور از افق سماء ارادهٔ الهی اشراق نمود جمعی بانکار و برخی باعراض و حزبی بمفتریات تمسّک جستند و عباد را از شریعهٔ عنایت مالک ایجاد محروم ساختند چنانچه حال نفوسی‌که این مظلوم را ندیده‌اند و معاشرت نکرده‌اند گفته و میگویند آنچه را که آن جناب شنیده و میشنوند بگوئید ای قوم امروز آفتاب بیان از افق سماء فضل مشرق و نور ظهور مکلّم طور امام ادیان ساطع و لامع صدر و قلب و سمع و بصر را بکوثر بیان رحمن مقدّس و مطهّر سازید و بعد توجّه نمائید لعمر اللّه از جمیع اشیاء نداء قد اتی الحقّ اصغا کنید طوبی للمنصفین و هنیئاً للمقبلین

Lā-zāl muṣliḥ-i ʿālam rā mufsid dānista-and va gufta-and ānchi rā ki kull shinīda-and. Har hangām nayyir-i ẓuhūr az ufuq-i samā-yi irāda-yi ilāhī ishrāq nimūd, jamʿī bi-inkār va barkhī bi-iʿrāḍ va ḥizbī bi-muftarayāt tamassuk justand va ʿibād rā az sharīʿa-yi ʿināyat-i Mālik-i ījād maḥrūm sākhtand. Chinānchi ḥāl nufūsī ki īn maẓlūm rā nadīda-and va muʿāsharat nakarda-and gufta va mīgūyand ānchi rā ki ān janāb shinīda va mīshinavand. Bigūʾīd ay qawm imrūz āftāb-i bayān az ufuq-i samā-yi faḍl mushriq va nūr-i ẓuhūr-i Mukallim-i Ṭūr imām-i adyān sāṭiʿ va lāmiʿ. Ṣadr va qalb va samʿ va baṣar rā bi-kawthar-i bayān-i Raḥmān muqaddas va muṭahhar sāzīd va baʿd tavajjuh namāʾīd. La-ʿamru Allāh az jamīʿ-i ashyā nidā-yi qad atā al-Ḥaqq iṣghā kunīd. Ṭūbā li-al-munṣifīn wa-hanīʾan li-al-muqbilīn.

They have always regarded the Reformer of the world as a corrupter, and have said what everyone has heard. Whenever the Luminary of Revelation shone from the horizon of the heaven of the divine will, some resorted to denial, others to rejection, and still others to slander, depriving God’s servants of the stream of grace of the Lord of creation. So it is now: people who have neither seen this Wronged One nor associated with Him have said, and continue to say, the things that you have heard and continue to hear. Say: People! Today the sun of utterance shines from the horizon of the heaven of grace, and the light of the revelation of Him who spoke on Sinai shines and gleams before the religions. Sanctify and purify your breasts, hearts, hearing, and sight with the heavenly waters of the All-Merciful’s utterance, and then turn toward Him. By the life of God, you will hear from all things the call, “The Truth has come!” Blessed are the fair-minded, and joy to those who turn toward Him.

110

از جمله نسبت بسدرهٔ مبارکه گفته‌اند آنچه را که هر عالم بصیری و هر عارف خبیری بر کذبش گواهى دهد البتّه آن جناب آیاتی که در بارهٔ حضرت کلیم نازل شده ملاحظه و قرائت نموده‌اند قوله تبارک و تعالی قال أ لم نربّک فینا ولیداً و لبثت فینا من عمرک سنین و فعلت فعلتک الّتی فعلت و انت من الکافرین قال فعلتها اذاً و انا من الضّالّین ففررت منکم لمّا خفتکم فوهب لی ربّی حکماً و جعلنی من المرسلین و در مقام دیگر قوله تبارک و تعالی و دخل المدینة علی حین غفلة من اهلها فوجد فیها رجلین یقتتلان هذا من شیعته و هذا من عدوّه فاستغاثه الّذی من شیعته علی الّذی من عدوّه فوکزه موسی فقضی علیه قال هذا من عمل الشّیطان انّه عدوّ مضلّ مبین قال ربّ انّی ظلمت نفسی فاغفر لی فغفر له انّه هو الغفور الرّحیم قال ربّ بما انعمت علیّ فلن اکون ظهیراً للمجرمین فأصبح فی المدینة خائفاً یترقّب فاذا الّذی استنصره بالأمس یستصرخه قال له موسى انّک لغویّ مبین فلمّا ان اراد ان یبطش بالّذی هو عدوّ لهما قال یا موسی أ ترید ان تقتلنی کما قتلت نفساً بالأمس ان ترید الّا ان تکون جبّاراً فی الأرض و ما ترید ان تکون من المصلحین حال سمع و بصر مقدّس و مطهّر لازم که بعدل و انصاف تمسّک نماید حضرت کلیم هم بظلم و گمراهی اقرار نموده و همچنین بخوف و فرار و عصیان و طلب مغفرت از حقّ جلّ جلاله کرده و بآن فائز گشت

Az jumla nisbat bi-Sidra-yi mubāraka gufta-and ānchi rā ki har ʿālim-i baṣīrī va har ʿārif-i khabīrī bar kidhibash gavāhī dihad. Albatta ān janāb āyātī ki dar bāra-yi Ḥaḍrat-i Kalīm nāzil shuda mulāḥaẓa va qirāʾat nimūda-and. Qawluhu tabāraka wa-taʿālā: Qāla a-lam nurabbika fīnā walīdan wa-labithta fīnā min ʿumrika sinīn. Wa-faʿalta faʿlataka allatī faʿalta wa-anta min al-kāfirīn. Qāla faʿaltuhā idhan wa-anā min al-ḍāllīn. Fa-farartu minkum lammā khiftukum fa-wahaba lī rabbī ḥukman wa-jaʿalanī min al-mursalīn. Va dar maqām-i dīgar qawluhu tabāraka wa-taʿālā: Wa-dakhala al-madīnata ʿalā ḥīni ghaflatin min ahlihā fa-wajada fīhā rajulayni yaqtatilān hādhā min shīʿatihi wa-hādhā min ʿaduwwihi fa-istaghāthahu alladhī min shīʿatihi ʿalā alladhī min ʿaduwwihi fa-wakazahu Mūsā fa-qaḍā ʿalayhi qāla hādhā min ʿamali al-shayṭān innahu ʿaduwwun muḍillun mubīn. Qāla rabbi innī ẓalamtu nafsī fa-ighfir lī fa-ghafara lahu innahu huwa al-Ghafūr al-Raḥīm. Qāla rabbi bi-mā anʿamta ʿalayya fa-lan akūna ẓahīran li-al-mujrimīn. Fa-aṣbaḥa fī al-madīnati khāʾifan yataraqqabu fa-idhā alladhī istanṣarahu bi-al-amsi yastaṣrikhuhu qāla lahu Mūsā innaka la-ghawiyyun mubīn. Fa-lammā an arāda an yabṭisha bi-alladhī huwa ʿaduwwun lahumā qāla yā Mūsā a-turīdu an taqtulanī kamā qatalta nafsan bi-al-amsi in turīdu illā an takūna jabbāran fī al-arḍ wa-mā turīdu an takūna min al-muṣliḥīn. Ḥāl samʿ va baṣar-i muqaddas va muṭahhar lāzim ki bi-ʿadl va inṣāf tamassuk namāyad. Ḥaḍrat-i Kalīm ham bi-ẓulm va gumrāhī iqrār nimūda va hamchunīn bi-khawf va firār va ʿiṣyān va ṭalab-i maghfirat az Ḥaqq jalla jalāluhu karda va bi-ān fāʾiz gasht.

Among other things, they have said of the blessed Tree what every discerning scholar and every well-informed knower would attest to be false. You have surely examined and read the verses revealed concerning Moses, who spoke with God. These are His words, blessed and exalted is He: “He said, ‘Did we not raise you among us as a child, and did you not spend years of your life among us? And you committed that deed of yours, and you were one of the ungrateful.’ He said, ‘I did it then, when I was among those who had gone astray. So I fled from you when I feared you; then my Lord granted me wisdom and made me one of the messengers.’” And elsewhere these are His words, blessed and exalted is He: “He entered the city at a time when its people were unaware, and found two men fighting there, one of his own people and the other of his enemies. The one of his own people appealed to him for help against the one of his enemies. Moses struck him with his fist and killed him. He said, ‘This is the work of Satan. He is indeed an enemy who clearly leads astray.’ He said, ‘My Lord, I have wronged myself, so forgive me.’ And He forgave him. He is indeed the Ever-Forgiving, the Merciful. He said, ‘My Lord, because of the favor You have shown me, I will never be a supporter of the guilty.’ The next morning he was in the city, fearful and watchful, when the man who had sought his help the day before cried out to him for help again. Moses said to him, ‘You are clearly in error.’ Then, when he was about to seize the man who was an enemy to them both, he said, ‘Moses! Do you intend to kill me as you killed someone yesterday? You only want to be a tyrant in the land; you do not want to be one of those who set things right.’” Now sanctified and purified hearing and sight are needed, that one may hold fast to justice and fairness. Moses himself acknowledged wrongdoing and error, as well as fear, flight, and disobedience, and sought forgiveness from God, exalted is His glory, and received it.

111

یا شیخ حقّ جلّ جلاله هر حین بمظاهر نفسش ظاهر با علم یفعل ما یشآء و یحکم ما یرید آمده لیس لأحد ان یقول لم و بم و من قال انّه اعرض عن اللّه ربّ الأرباب در ایّام ظهور این امور ظاهر و موجود چنانچه در بارهٔ این مظلوم هم گفته‌اند آنچه را که مقرّبین و مخلصین بر کذبش گواهی داده و میدهند لعمر اللّه این ذیل مقدّس بوده و هست اگرچه حال جمعی اراده نموده‌اند آن را بمفتریات کذبهٔ نالائقه بیالایند ولکنّ اللّه یعلم و هم لا یعلمون نفسی که بقدرت و قوّت الهی مقابل جمیع احزاب عالم قیام نمود و کل را بافق اعلی دعوت فرمود او را انکار نموده‌اند و نفوسی که لازال خلف استار و احجاب ساکن و بحفظ خود مشغول بآن نفوس تمسّک جسته‌اند حال هم جمعی بکذب و افترا مشغول قصدی جز ادخال شبهات در افئده و قلوب نداشته و ندارند هر نفسی از مدینهٔ کبیره باین ارض توجّه مینماید فوراً بسیّالهٔ برقیّه خبر میدهند که وجهی سرقت نموده و به عکّا رفته شخصی عالم و کامل و فاضل در آخر عمر بارض مقدّسه توجّه نموده و مقصودش اعتکاف بوده در بارهٔ او نوشته‌اند آنچه را که زفرات مخلصین و مقرّبین مرتفع

Yā Shaykh, Ḥaqq jalla jalāluhu har ḥīn bi-maẓāhir-i nafsash ẓāhir, bā ʿalam-i yafʿalu mā yashāʾ va yaḥkumu mā yurīd āmada. Laysa li-aḥadin an yaqūla lima wa-bima wa-man qāla innahu aʿraḍa ʿan Allāh Rabb al-arbāb. Dar ayyām-i ẓuhūr īn umūr ẓāhir va mawjūd, chinānchi dar bāra-yi īn maẓlūm ham gufta-and ānchi rā ki muqarrabīn va mukhliṣīn bar kidhibash gavāhī dāda va mīdihand. La-ʿamru Allāh īn dhayl muqaddas būda va hast agarchi ḥāl jamʿī irāda nimūda-and ān rā bi-muftarayāt-i kadhiba-yi nālāʾiqa biyālāyand, wa-lākinna Allāha yaʿlamu wa-hum lā yaʿlamūn. Nafsī ki bi-qudrat va quvvat-i ilāhī muqābil-i jamīʿ-i aḥzāb-i ʿālam qiyām nimūd va kull rā bi-Ufuq-i Aʿlā daʿvat farmūd ū rā inkār nimūda-and va nufūsī ki lā-zāl khalf-i astār va aḥjāb sākin va bi-ḥifẓ-i khud mashghūl bi-ān nufūs tamassuk justa-and. Ḥāl ham jamʿī bi-kidhb va iftirā mashghūl qaṣdī juz idkhāl-i shubahāt dar afʾida va qulūb nadāshta va nadārand. Har nafsī az madīna-yi kabīra bi-īn arḍ tavajjuh mīnamāyad fawran bi-sayyāla-yi barqiyya khabar mīdihand ki vajhī sirqat nimūda va bi-ʿAkkā rafta. Shakhṣī ʿālim va kāmil va fāḍil dar ākhir-i ʿumr bi-Arḍ-i Muqaddasa tavajjuh nimūda va maqṣūdash iʿtikāf būda dar bāra-yi ū nivishta-and ānchi rā ki zafarāt-i mukhliṣīn va muqarrabīn murtafiʿ.

Shaykh! God, exalted is His glory, has at every time appeared through the Manifestations of His own Self, coming with the banner of “He does whatever He wills” and “He ordains whatever He desires.” No one has the right to say “Why?” or “For what reason?” Whoever says this has turned away from God, the Lord of lords. Such things appear and occur in the days of Revelation, just as they have said of this Wronged One things whose falsehood those who are near to God and sincere in devotion have attested and continue to attest. By the life of God! This robe has always been, and remains, undefiled, although some now intend to stain it with unseemly, lying slanders. But God knows, and they do not know. They have denied the One who, through divine might and power, stood against all the factions of the world and summoned everyone to the Most Exalted Horizon, and have clung instead to people who have always dwelt behind curtains and veils, occupied with protecting themselves. Even now some are busy with lies and slander; their sole intention has been, and remains, to sow doubts in hearts and minds. Whenever anyone sets out from the Great City toward this land, they immediately send word by telegraph that he has stolen money and gone to Acre. A learned, accomplished, and erudite man came to the Holy Land at the end of his life, intending to live in seclusion. They wrote things about him that have raised the sighs of the sincere and those who are near to God.

112

این مظلوم را مرحوم مغفور حضرت مشیرالدّوله میرزا حسین خان غفر اللّه له شناخته بود و البتّه نزد اولیای دولت تفصیل ورود این مظلوم را در آستانه و اقوال و اعمالش را ذکر فرموده یوم ورود میهمان‌دار دولت حاضر و ما را بمحلّی که مأمور بود برده فی‌الحقیقه کمال محبّت و عنایت از جانب دولت نسبت باین مظلومان ظاهر و مشهود یوم دیگر شاهزاده شجاع‌الدّوله و میرزا صفا بنیابت مرحوم مغفور مشیرالدّوله وزیر مختار تشریف آوردند و همچنین بعضی از وزرای دولت علیّه از جمله مرحوم کمال پاشا و بعضى دیگر و این مظلوم متوکّلاً علی اللّه من غیر ذکر حاجت و مطلبی چهار شهر در آن ارض بوده و اعمالش نزد کل معلوم و مشهود لا ینکرها الّا کلّ مبغض کذّاب من عرف اللّه لم یعرف دونه دوست نداشته و نداریم امثال این امور را ذکر نمائیم

Īn maẓlūm rā marḥūm-i maghfūr Ḥaḍrat-i Mushīr al-Dawla Mīrzā Ḥusayn Khān, ghafara Allāhu lahu, shinākhta būd va albatta nazd-i awliyā-yi dawlat tafṣīl-i vurūd-i īn maẓlūm rā dar Āstāna va aqvāl va aʿmālash rā dhikr farmūda. Yawm-i vurūd mihmān-dār-i dawlat ḥāḍir va mā rā bi-maḥallī ki maʾmūr būd burda. Fī-al-ḥaqīqa kamāl-i maḥabbat va ʿināyat az jānib-i dawlat nisbat bi-īn maẓlūmān ẓāhir va mashhūd. Yawm-i dīgar Shāhzāda Shujāʿ al-Dawla va Mīrzā Ṣafā bi-niyābat-i marḥūm-i maghfūr Mushīr al-Dawla vazīr-i mukhtār tashrīf āvardand va hamchunīn baʿḍī az vuzarā-yi Dawlat-i ʿAliyya az jumla marḥūm Kamāl Pāshā va baʿḍī dīgar. Va īn maẓlūm mutawakkilan ʿalā Allāh min ghayr-i dhikr-i ḥājat va maṭlabī chahār shahr dar ān arḍ būda va aʿmālash nazd-i kull maʿlūm va mashhūd. Lā yunkiruhā illā kullu mubghiḍin kadhdhāb. Man ʿarafa Allāha lam yaʿrif dūnahu. Dūst nadāshta va nadārīm amthāl-i īn umūr rā dhikr namāʾīm.

The late Mushir al-Dawlih, Mirza Husayn Khan, may God forgive him, knew this Wronged One, and surely related to the authorities of the state the details of this Wronged One’s arrival in Constantinople, and His words and deeds. On the day of Our arrival, the government’s host was present and took Us to the place to which he had been directed. Indeed, the utmost kindness and consideration on the government’s part toward these wronged ones were plain and evident. The next day Prince Shuja al-Dawlih and Mirza Safa came on behalf of the late Mushir al-Dawlih, the minister plenipotentiary, as did some ministers of the Ottoman government, including the late Kamal Pasha and certain others. This Wronged One remained in that land for four months, trusting in God, without mentioning any need or request, and His deeds were known and evident to all. None deny them except malicious liars. Whoever has known God has known no one besides Him. We have never wished, nor do We now wish, to mention such matters.

113

بعضی از بزرگان ایران هر هنگام وارد آن مدینه شده‌اند درب خانه‌ها لأجل شهریّه و انعام کمال جدّ و جهد را مبذول داشته‌اند و این مظلوم اگر سبب اعزاز نبوده علّت ذلّت هم نشده و این عمل حضرت مرحوم مغفور اعلی اللّه مقامه نظر بدوستی این مظلوم نبوده بلکه نظر بمقتضیات حکمت و خدمتی که سرّاً در نظر داشته‌اند بوده شهادت میدهم که در خدمت دولت امین بوده بشأنی که خیانت را در عرصه‌اش راهی و مقامی نبوده و سبب ورود این مظلومان در سجن اعظم هم او بوده ولکن چون در عمل خود صادق بود لائق ذکر خیر است این مظلوم لازال همّش و قصدش ارتفاع و ارتقاء دولت و ملّت بوده نه ارتفاع مقام خود حال جمعی جمعی را جمع نموده‌اند و بر هتک حرمت این مظلوم قیام کرده‌اند ولکنّ المظلوم یسأل اللّه تبارک و تعالی ان یؤیّدهم على الرّجوع و یوفّقهم علی تدارک ما فات عنهم و الانابة لدی باب عطائه انّه هو الغفور الرّحیم

Baʿḍī az buzurgān-i Īrān har hangām vārid-i ān madīna shuda-and darb-i khāna-hā li-ajl-i shahriyya va inʿām kamāl-i jidd va jahd rā mabdhūl dāshta-and va īn maẓlūm agar sabab-i iʿzāz nabūda ʿillat-i dhillat ham nashuda. Va īn ʿamal-i Ḥaḍrat-i marḥūm-i maghfūr, aʿlā Allāhu maqāmahu, naẓar bi-dūstī-yi īn maẓlūm nabūda balki naẓar bi-muqtaḍayāt-i ḥikmat va khidmatī ki sirran dar naẓar dāshta-and būda. Shahādat mīdiham ki dar khidmat-i dawlat amīn būda bi-shaʾnī ki khiyānat rā dar ʿarṣa-ash rāhī va maqāmī nabūda va sabab-i vurūd-i īn maẓlūmān dar Sijn-i Aʿẓam ham ū būda va lākin chūn dar ʿamal-i khud ṣādiq būd lāyiq-i dhikr-i khayr ast. Īn maẓlūm lā-zāl hammash va qaṣdash irtifāʿ va irtiqā-yi dawlat va millat būda na irtifāʿ-i maqām-i khud. Ḥāl jamʿī jamʿī rā jamʿ nimūda-and va bar hatk-i ḥurmat-i īn maẓlūm qiyām karda-and. Wa-lākinna al-Maẓlūm yasʾalu Allāha tabāraka wa-taʿālā an yuʾayyidahum ʿalā al-rujūʿ wa-yuwaffiqahum ʿalā tadāruki mā fāta ʿanhum wa-al-inābati ladā bābi ʿaṭāʾihi innahu huwa al-Ghafūr al-Raḥīm.

Whenever some of the notables of Iran have entered that city, they have made every effort at people’s doors to obtain stipends and gifts. This Wronged One, if He has not brought honor, has at least not brought humiliation. This action of that departed gentleman, may God exalt his station, was not prompted by friendship for this Wronged One, but by considerations of prudence and a service he privately had in mind. I testify that he was trustworthy in the service of the state, to such a degree that treachery had neither access to nor a place in his conduct. He was also the cause of these wronged ones entering the Most Great Prison; nevertheless, because he was sincere in what he did, he deserves to be remembered favorably. This Wronged One’s concern and purpose have always been the advancement and progress of the government and the people, not the elevation of His own station. Now some have gathered others around them and arisen to dishonor this Wronged One. Yet the Wronged One asks God, blessed and exalted is He, to help them return, enable them to make up for what they have missed, and turn in repentance to the door of His bounty. He is indeed the Ever-Forgiving, the Merciful.

114

یا شیخ انّ قلمی ینوح لنفسی و اللّوح یبکی بما ورد علیّ من الّذی حفظناه فی سنین متوالیات و کان ان یخدم امام وجهی فی اللّیالی و الأیّام الی ان اغواه احد خدّامی الّذی سمّی بسیّد محمّد یشهد بذلک عباد موقنون الّذین هاجروا معی من الزّورآء الی ان وردنا فی هذا السّجن العظیم و ورد منهما علیّ ما صاح به کلّ عالم و ناح به کلّ عارف و ذرفت دموع المنصفین

Yā Shaykh, inna qalamī yanūḥu li-nafsī wa-al-Lawḥ yabkī bi-mā warada ʿalayya min alladhī ḥafiẓnāhu fī sinīna mutawāliyāt wa-kāna an yakhduma imāma wajhī fī al-layālī wa-al-ayyām ilā an aghwāhu aḥadu khuddāmī alladhī summiya bi-Sayyid Muḥammad. Yashhadu bi-dhālika ʿibādun mūqinūn alladhīna hājarū maʿī min al-Zawrāʾ ilā an waradnā fī hādhā al-sijn al-ʿaẓīm. Wa-warada minhumā ʿalayya mā ṣāḥa bihi kullu ʿālim wa-nāḥa bihi kullu ʿārif wa-dharafat dumūʿu al-munṣifīn.

Shaykh! My Pen laments for Me, and the Tablet weeps over what I have suffered at the hands of one whom We protected for successive years, who served in My presence night and day, until one of My attendants, named Siyyid Muhammad, led him astray. The servants endowed with certitude who migrated with Me from Baghdad until We arrived in this mighty prison bear witness to this. From these two I suffered what made every learned person cry out, every knower lament, and the tears of the fair-minded flow.

115

نسأل اللّه ان یؤیّد الغافلین علی العدل و الانصاف و یعرّفهم ما غفلوا عنه انّه هو الفضّال الکریم ای ربّ لا تمنع عبادک عن باب فضلک و لا تطردهم عن بساط قربک ایّدهم علی کشف سبحات الجلال و خرق حجبات الأوهام و الآمال انّک انت الغنیّ المتعال لا اله الّا انت العزیز الفضّال

Nasʾalu Allāha an yuʾayyida al-ghāfilīn ʿalā al-ʿadl wa-al-inṣāf wa-yuʿarrifahum mā ghafalū ʿanhu innahu huwa al-Faḍḍāl al-Karīm. Ay rabb, lā tamnaʿ ʿibādaka ʿan bābi faḍlika wa-lā taṭrudhum ʿan bisāṭi qurbika. Ayyidhum ʿalā kashfi subuḥāti al-jalāl wa-kharqi ḥujubāti al-awhām wa-al-āmāl. Innaka anta al-Ghanī al-Mutaʿāl. Lā ilāha illā anta al-ʿAzīz al-Faḍḍāl.

We ask God to assist the heedless to act with justice and fairness, and to make known to them what they have overlooked. He is indeed the Most Bountiful, the Generous. My Lord! Do not bar Your servants from the door of Your grace, nor drive them from the court of Your presence. Help them to remove the veils of glory and tear through the veils of imaginings and desires. You are indeed the Self-Sufficient, the Most Exalted. There is no God but You, the Almighty, the Most Bountiful.

116

قسم بآفتاب برهان که از افق سماء ایقان اشراق نموده این مظلوم در لیالی و ایّام بتهذیب نفوس مشغول تا آنکه نور دانائی بر تاریکی نادانی غلبه نمود

Qasam bi-āftāb-i burhān ki az ufuq-i samā-yi īqān ishrāq nimūda īn maẓlūm dar layālī va ayyām bi-tahdhīb-i nufūs mashghūl tā ānki nūr-i dānāʾī bar tārīkī-yi nādānī ghalaba nimūd.

I swear by the sun of proof that has shone from the horizon of the heaven of certitude: this Wronged One has been occupied night and day with refining souls, until the light of knowledge overcame the darkness of ignorance.

117

یا شیخ مکرّر ذکر شده و میشود چهل سنه بعنایت الهی و ارادهٔ قویّهٔ نافذهٔ ربّانی حضرت سلطان ایّده اللّه را نصرت نمودیم نصرتی که نزد مظاهر عدل و انصاف ثابت و محقّق است و لا ینکرها الّا کلّ معتد اثیم و کلّ مبغض مریب عجب آنکه وزراء دولت و امناء ملّت الی حین باین خدمت ظاهر مبین ملتفت نشده‌اند و یا شده‌اند نظر بحکمت ذکر نفرموده‌اند قبل از اربعین هر سنه مابین عباد مجادله و محاربه ظاهر و قائم و بعد بجنود حکمت و بیان و نصیحت و عرفان کل بحبل متین صبر و ذیل منیر اصطبار تمسّک جستند و تشبّث نمودند بشأنی که آنچه بر این حزب مظلوم وارد شد تحمّل کردند و بحقّ گذاشتند مع آنکه در مازندران و رشت جمع کثیری را ببدترین عذاب معذّب نمودند از جمله حضرت حاجی نصیر که فی‌الحقیقه نوری بود مشرق از افق سماء تسلیم بعد از شهادت چشم او را کندند و دماغش را بریدند و ظلم بمقامی رسید که اهل ممالک خارجه گریستند و نوحه نمودند و در باطن از برای عیال و صغار بعضی در اطراف ممالک اعانت نمودند

Yā Shaykh, mukarrar dhikr shuda va mīshavad chihil sana bi-ʿināyat-i ilāhī va irāda-yi qaviyya-yi nāfidha-yi rabbānī Ḥaḍrat-i Sulṭān ayyadahu Allāh rā nuṣrat nimūdīm nuṣratī ki nazd-i maẓāhir-i ʿadl va inṣāf thābit va muḥaqqaq ast, wa-lā yunkiruhā illā kullu muʿtadin athīm wa-kullu mubghiḍin murīb. ʿAjab ānki vuzarā-yi dawlat va umanā-yi millat ilā ḥīn bi-īn khidmat-i ẓāhir-i mubīn multafit nashuda-and va yā shuda-and naẓar bi-ḥikmat dhikr nafarmūda-and. Qabl az arbaʿīn har sana mābayn-i ʿibād mujādala va muḥāraba ẓāhir va qāʾim va baʿd bi-junūd-i ḥikmat va bayān va naṣīḥat va ʿirfān kull bi-ḥabl-i matīn-i ṣabr va dhayl-i munīr-i iṣṭibār tamassuk justand va tashabbuth nimūdand bi-shaʾnī ki ānchi bar īn ḥizb-i maẓlūm vārid shud taḥammul kardand va bi-Ḥaqq gudhāshtand. Maʿa ānki dar Māzandarān va Rasht jamʿ-i kathīrī rā bi-badtarīn ʿadhāb muʿadhdhab nimūdand az jumla Ḥaḍrat-i Ḥājī Naṣīr ki fī-al-ḥaqīqa nūrī būd mushriq az ufuq-i samā-yi taslīm. Baʿd az shahādat chashm-i ū rā kandand va damāghash rā burīdand va ẓulm bi-maqāmī rasīd ki ahl-i mamālik-i khārija girīstand va nawḥa nimūdand va dar bāṭin az barā-yi ʿiyāl va ṣighār baʿḍī dar aṭrāf-i mamālik iʿānat nimūdand.

Shaykh! It has repeatedly been stated, and is stated again, that for forty years, through divine grace and the mighty, all-pervading will of God, We have aided His Majesty the sovereign, may God assist him—an aid established and confirmed in the eyes of those who embody justice and fairness. None deny it except sinful aggressors and malicious doubters. It is astonishing that the ministers of the state and the trustees of the people have not yet recognized this clear and evident service, or, if they have, have refrained from mentioning it out of prudence. Before these forty years, strife and warfare arose among the people every year. Afterward, through the forces of wisdom, utterance, counsel, and spiritual knowledge, all took hold of the strong cord of patience and clung to the luminous robe of forbearance, to such a degree that they endured whatever befell this wronged community and left it to God. This was so even though in Mazandaran and Rasht many were subjected to the worst tortures, among them Haji Nasir, who was truly a light shining from the horizon of the heaven of submission. After his martyrdom they gouged out his eye and cut off his nose. The cruelty reached such a degree that people in foreign countries wept and lamented, and some in various countries secretly provided assistance for the families and young children.

118

یا شیخ قلم حیا میکند از ذکر آنچه واقع شده و در ارض صاد نار ظلم مشتعل بشأنی که هر منصفی نوحه نمود لعمرک از مدائن علم و معرفت نحیب بکا مرتفع بقسمی که اکباد اهل بر و تقوی محترق نورین نیّرین حسنین در آن ارض رایگان جان فدا نمودند دولت و ثروت و عزّت ایشان را منع ننمود اللّه یعلم ما ورد علیهما و القوم اکثرهم لا یعلمون

Yā Shaykh, qalam ḥayā mīkunad az dhikr-i ānchih vāqiʿ shudih va dar arḍ-i Ṣād nār-i ẓulm mushtaʿil bi-shaʾnī kih har munṣifī nawḥih nimūd. La-ʿamruka, az madāʾin-i ʿilm va maʿrifat naḥīb-i bukā murtafiʿ bi-qismī kih akbād-i ahl-i birr va taqvā muḥtariq. Nūrayn-i nayyirayn-i Ḥasanayn dar ān arḍ rāygān jān fidā nimūdand. Dawlat va tharvat va ʿizzat īshān rā manʿ nanimūd. Allāhu yaʿlamu mā warada ʿalayhimā wa-l-qawmu aktharuhum lā yaʿlamūn.

Shaykh! The Pen is ashamed to recount what has happened. In the land of Sad, the fire of oppression blazed so fiercely that every fair-minded person lamented. By your life! From the cities of knowledge and understanding arose such cries of weeping that the hearts of the righteous and devout were consumed. The two radiant lights, the two Hasans, freely sacrificed their lives in that land. Position, wealth, and honor did not hold them back. God knows what befell them, but most of the people do not know.

119

و قبل از ایشان جناب کاظم و من معه و در آخر حضرت اشرف کل شربت شهادت را بکمال شوق و اشتیاق نوشیدند و برفیق اعلی شتافتند و همچنین در عهد سردار عزیز خان جناب عارف باللّه میرزا مصطفی و من معه را اخذ نمودند و برفیق اعلی و افق ابهی فرستادند باری در هر بلدی آثار ظلم ظاهر و مشهود ظلمی که شبه و مثل نداشته مع‌ذلک نفسی بر دفاع قیام ننمود در حضرت بدیع که حامل لوح حضرت سلطان بوده تفکّر نما که چگونه جان داد آن فارس مضمار انقطاع اکلیل ثمین حیات را نثار دوست یکتا نمود

Va qabl az īshān Jināb-i Kāẓim va man maʿahu va dar ākhir Ḥaḍrat-i Ashraf, kull sharbat-i shahādat rā bi-kamāl-i shawq va ishtiyāq nūshīdand va bi-Rafīq-i Aʿlā shitāftand. Va hamchunīn dar ʿahd-i Sardār ʿAzīz Khān Jināb-i ʿārif bi-llāh Mīrzā Muṣṭafā va man maʿahu rā akhdh nimūdand va bi-Rafīq-i Aʿlā va Ufuq-i Abhā firistādand. Bārī dar har baladī āthār-i ẓulm ẓāhir va mashhūd, ẓulmī kih shibh va mithl nadāshtih. Maʿa-dhālik nafsī bar difāʿ qiyām nanimūd. Dar Ḥaḍrat-i Badīʿ kih ḥāmil-i lawḥ-i Ḥaḍrat-i Sulṭān būdih tafakkur namā kih chigūnih jān dād. Ān fāris-i miḍmār-i inqiṭāʿ iklīl-i thamīn-i ḥayāt rā nithār-i Dūst-i Yiktā nimūd.

Before them, Kazim and his companions, and lastly Ashraf, all drank the cup of martyrdom with the utmost eagerness and longing, and hastened to the Most Exalted Companion. Likewise, during the tenure of Sardar Aziz Khan, they seized Mirza Mustafa, who knew God, and his companions, and sent them to the Most Exalted Companion and the All-Glorious Horizon. In short, in every city the signs of oppression were clear and evident—oppression without parallel or equal. Yet not a soul rose to defend himself. Consider Badi, who carried the Tablet to His Majesty the sovereign: how he gave his life! That horseman in the arena of detachment offered the precious crown of life to the one Beloved.

120

یا شیخ اگر این امور انکار شود کدام امر لائق اقرار است بیّن لوجه اللّه و لا تکن من الصّامتین حضرت نجفعلی را اخذ نمودند و با کمال جذب و شوق قصد مقام شهادت نمود و باین کلمه ناطق ما بها و خون‌بها را یافتیم این بگفت و جان داد در اشراق و تجلّی نیّر انقطاع که از شطر اعلای قلب ملّا علیجان اشراق نمود نظر نمائید نفحات کلمهٔ علیا و اقتدار قلم اعلی بشأنی جذبش کرد که میدان شهادت و ایوان عشرت نزدش یکسان بل الأولی اولی در جناب ابابصیر و سیّد اشرف زنجانی تفکّر نمائید امّ اشرف را حاضر نمودند که ابنش را نصیحت نماید ترغیب نمود الی ان فاز بالشّهادة الکبری

Yā Shaykh, agar īn umūr inkār shavad kudām amr lāyiq-i iqrār ast? Bayyin li-wajhi Allāh wa-lā takun mina al-ṣāmitīn. Ḥaḍrat-i NajafʿAlī rā akhdh nimūdand va bā kamāl-i jadhb va shawq qaṣd-i maqām-i shahādat nimūd va bi-īn kalimih nāṭiq: mā bahā va khūn-bahā rā yāftīm. Īn biguft va jān dād. Dar ishrāq va tajallī-yi nayyir-i inqiṭāʿ kih az shaṭr-i aʿlā-yi qalb-i Mullā ʿAlījān ishrāq nimūd naẓar namāyīd. Nafaḥāt-i kalimih-yi ʿulyā va iqtidār-i Qalam-i Aʿlā bi-shaʾnī jadhbash kard kih maydān-i shahādat va ayvān-i ʿishrat nazdash yiksān, bal al-ūlā awlā. Dar Jināb-i Abā Baṣīr va Sayyid Ashraf-i Zanjānī tafakkur namāyīd. Umm-i Ashraf rā ḥāḍir nimūdand kih ibnash rā naṣīḥat namāyad. Targhīb nimūd ilā an fāza bi-l-shahādati al-kubrā.

Shaykh! If these things are denied, what is worthy of acknowledgment? Speak plainly for the sake of God, and do not be among the silent. They seized Najaf-Ali, and with the utmost rapture and eagerness he set out for the place of martyrdom, uttering these words: “We have found Baha and the price of our blood.” He said this and gave his life. Consider the radiance and splendor of the sun of detachment that shone from the loftiest reaches of Mulla Ali-Jan’s heart. The breezes of the Most Exalted Word and the power of the Most Exalted Pen so enraptured him that the field of martyrdom and the hall of pleasure were alike to him—indeed, the former was preferable. Reflect on Aba Basir and Sayyid Ashraf of Zanjan. They brought Ashraf’s mother to counsel her son. She encouraged him until he attained the supreme martyrdom.

121

یا شیخ این حزب از خلیج اسماء گذشته‌اند و بر شاطی بحر انقطاع خرگاه برافراشته‌اند ایشان صد‌هزار جان رایگان نثار نمایند و به ما اراده الأعدآء تکلّم ننمایند بارادة اللّه متمسّکند و از ما عند القوم فارغ و آزاد سر دادند و کلمهٔ نالائقه نگفتند تفکّر نمائید گویا از بحر انقطاع نوشیده‌اند زندگی دنیا ایشان را از شهادت در سبیل الهی منع ننمود

Yā Shaykh, īn ḥizb az khalīj-i asmāʾ gudhashtih-and va bar shāṭī-yi baḥr-i inqiṭāʿ khargāh bar-afrāshtih-and. Īshān ṣad-hazār jān rāygān nithār namāyand va bi-mā arāda al-aʿdāʾ takallum nanamāyand. Bi-irādati Allāh mutamassikand va az mā ʿinda al-qawm fārigh va āzād. Sar dādand va kalimih-yi nālāyiqih naguftand. Tafakkur namāyīd. Gūyā az baḥr-i inqiṭāʿ nūshīdih-and. Zindigī-yi dunyā īshān rā az shahādat dar sabīl-i ilāhī manʿ nanimūd.

Shaykh! This community has passed beyond the gulf of names and pitched its tent on the shore of the ocean of detachment. They would freely offer a hundred thousand lives rather than speak as their enemies wished. They hold fast to the will of God and are free and detached from what the people possess. They gave their heads but uttered no unworthy word. Reflect: it is as though they have drunk from the ocean of detachment. The life of this world did not hold them back from martyrdom in the path of God.

122

در مازندران جمع کثیری از عباد اللّه را تمام نمودند حاکم بمفتریات جمعی را تاراج کرد از جمله ذکر نمود حضرات اسلحه جمع کرده‌اند و بعد از تفحّص ملاحظه شد یک لولهٔ تفنگ من غیر اسباب بوده سبحان‌اللّه این حزب بسلاح محتاج نه چه که کمر همّت لأجل اصلاح عالم بسته‌اند جندشان اعمال طیّبه سلاحشان اخلاق مرضیّه و سردارشان تقوی اللّه طوبی لمن انصف لعمر اللّه این حزب از صبر و سکون و تسلیم و رضا مظاهر عدل شده‌اند و در اصطبار بمقامی رسیده‌اند که کشته شده‌اند و نکشته‌اند مع آنکه بر مظلومهای ارض وارد شد آنچه که تاریخ عالم شبه آن را ذکر ننموده و چشم امم مثلش را ندیده آیا سبب آنکه این بلایای عظیمه را قبول نموده‌اند و در دفع آن دست درنیاورده‌اند چه بوده و علّت تسلیم و سکون چه سبب منع قلم اعلی در صباح و مساء و اخذ زمام امور بقدرت و قوّت مولی الوری

Dar Māzandarān jamʿ-i kathīrī az ʿibād-i Allāh rā tamām nimūdand. Ḥākim bi-muftarayāt jamʿī rā tārāj kard. Az jumlih dhikr nimūd ḥaḍarāt asliḥih jamʿ kardih-and, va baʿd az tafaḥḥuṣ mulāḥiẓih shud yik lūlih-yi tufang min ghayri asbāb būdih. Subḥāna Allāh, īn ḥizb bi-silāḥ muḥtāj nah, chih kih kamar-i himmat li-ajli iṣlāḥ-i ʿālam bastih-and. Jundishān aʿmāl-i ṭayyibih, silāḥishān akhlāq-i marḍīyyih va sardārishān taqvā Allāh. Ṭūbā li-man anṣafa. La-ʿamru Allāh, īn ḥizb az ṣabr va sukūn va taslīm va riḍā maẓāhir-i ʿadl shudih-and va dar iṣṭibār bi-maqāmī rasīdih-and kih kushtih shudih-and va nakushtih-and. Maʿa ānkih bar maẓlūmhā-yi arḍ vārid shud ānchih kih tārīkh-i ʿālam shibh-i ān rā dhikr nanimūdih va chashm-i umam mithlash rā nadīdih. Āyā sabab-i ānkih īn balāyā-yi ʿaẓīmih rā qabūl nimūdih-and va dar dafʿ-i ān dast dar-nayāvardih-and chih būdih va ʿillat-i taslīm va sukūn chih? Sabab, manʿ-i Qalam-i Aʿlā dar ṣabāḥ va masāʾ va akhdh-i zimām-i umūr bi-qudrat va quvvat-i Mawlā al-Varā.

In Mazandaran they put to death a great many of God’s servants. The governor plundered a number of them on the strength of false accusations. Among other things, he stated that these people had gathered weapons, but after a search it was found that there was only a single gun barrel without its fittings. Glory be to God! This community has no need of weapons, for they have resolved to reform the world. Their armies are good deeds, their weapons commendable conduct, and their commander the fear of God. Blessed is the one who judges fairly! By the life of God! Through patience, calm, submission, and contentment, this community has become an embodiment of justice. They have reached such a degree of patient endurance that they have been killed but have not killed, even though these wronged ones of the earth have suffered what the history of the world has never recorded and the eyes of the nations have never seen. Why have they accepted these tremendous afflictions and raised no hand to ward them off? What accounts for their submission and calm? The reason is the prohibition issued by the Most Exalted Pen morning and evening, and the reins of affairs being held through the power and might of the Lord of all people.

123

در ابا‌بدیع تفکّر نمائید آن مظلوم را اخذ نمودند و بسب و لعن این مظلوم امر کردند ولکن بعنایت الهی و رحمت ربّانی شهادت اختیار نمود و بآن فائز گشت ان تعدّوا الشّهدآء فی سبیل اللّه لا تحصوهم در حضرت سیّد اسمعیل علیه سلام اللّه و عنایته نظر نمائید که قبل از فجر باب بیت را با عمامهٔ خود جاروب نمود و بعد در کنار شط مقبلاً الی البیت بدست خود جان نثار نمود

Dar Abā-Badīʿ tafakkur namāyīd. Ān maẓlūm rā akhdh nimūdand va bi-sabb va laʿn-i īn Maẓlūm amr kardand, va lākin bi-ʿināyat-i ilāhī va raḥmat-i rabbānī shahādat ikhtiyār nimūd va bi-ān fāʾiz gasht. In taʿuddū al-shuhadāʾa fī sabīli Allāh lā tuḥṣūhum. Dar Ḥaḍrat-i Sayyid Ismaʿīl ʿalayhi salāmu Allāh wa-ʿināyatuhu naẓar namāyīd kih qabl az fajr bāb-i bayt rā bā ʿamāmih-yi khud jārūb nimūd va baʿd dar kinār-i shaṭṭ muqbilan ilā al-bayt bi-dast-i khud jān nithār nimūd.

Reflect on Aba-Badi. They seized that wronged man and ordered him to revile and curse this Wronged One. Yet through divine favor and the Lord’s mercy he chose martyrdom and attained it. If you were to count the martyrs in the path of God, you could not number them. Consider Sayyid Ismail, upon whom be God’s peace and favor, who before dawn swept the doorway of the House with his turban, and afterward, on the riverbank, facing the House, offered up his life with his own hand.

124

در نفوذ کلمه نظر نما جمیع این نفوس را اوّل بسب و لعن امر نمودند ولکن هیچکدام ارادهٔ خود را بر ارادة اللّه مقدّم نداشت

Dar nufūdh-i kalimih naẓar namā. Jamīʿ-i īn nufūs rā avval bi-sabb va laʿn amr nimūdand, va lākin hīchkudām irādih-yi khud rā bar irādati Allāh muqaddam nadāsht.

Consider the penetrating power of the Word. All these souls were first ordered to revile and curse, yet not one of them placed his own will before the will of God.

125

یا شیخ از قبل حضرت ذبیح یک نفس بوده و حال این مظلوم ظاهر نمود از برای شما آنچه را که علّت حیرت منصفین است انصف باللّه و قم على خدمة ربّک انّه یجزیک جزآء لا تعادله کنوز الأرض و لا خزائن الملوک و السّلاطین توکّل فی کلّ الأمور علی اللّه و فوّضها الیه انّه یعطیک اجراً کان فی الکتاب عظیماً و در این دوروزهٔ عمر باعمالی مشغول شو که عرف رضا از آن متضوّع گردد و بطراز قبول مزیّن شود حضرت بلال حبشی چون عملش مقبول افتاد سین او از شین عالم سبقت گرفت امروز باید جمیع احزاب بنور اتّحاد و اتّفاق منوّر گردند باری کبر و غرور بعضی از احزاب عالم دانائی را خراب کرده و بیت عدل و داد را ویران نموده

Yā Shaykh, az qabl Ḥaḍrat-i Dhabīḥ yik nafs būdih va ḥāl īn Maẓlūm ẓāhir nimūd az barāy-i shumā ānchih rā kih ʿillat-i ḥayrat-i munṣifīn ast. Inṣaf bi-llāh wa-qum ʿalā khidmati rabbika innahu yajzīka jazāʾan lā tuʿādiluhu kunūzu al-arḍi wa-lā khazāʾinu al-mulūki wa-l-salāṭīn. Tawakkal fī kulli al-umūri ʿalā Allāh wa-fawwiḍhā ilayhi innahu yuʿṭīka ajran kāna fī al-kitābi ʿaẓīman. Va dar īn du-rūzih-yi ʿumr bi-aʿmālī mashghūl shaw kih ʿarf-i riḍā az ān mutaḍavviʿ gardad va bi-ṭirāz-i qabūl muzayyan shavad. Ḥaḍrat-i Bilāl-i Ḥabashī chūn ʿamalash maqbūl uftād sīn-i ū az shīn-i ʿālam sabqat girift. Imrūz bāyad jamīʿ-i aḥzāb bi-nūr-i ittiḥād va ittifāq munavvar gardand. Bārī kibr va ghurūr-i baʿḍī az aḥzāb ʿālam-i dānāʾī rā kharāb kardih va bayt-i ʿadl va dād rā vīrān nimūdih.

Shaykh! In former times the sacrificial victim was but one soul. Now this Wronged One has shown you what astonishes the fair-minded. Be fair, for God’s sake, and arise to serve your Lord. He will reward you with a recompense that neither the treasures of the earth nor the treasuries of kings and sovereigns can equal. In all affairs, place your trust in God and commit them to Him. He will grant you a reward accounted great in the Book. In these few days of life, occupy yourself with deeds that give off the fragrance of His good pleasure and are adorned with the ornament of His acceptance. Because the deeds of Bilal the Ethiopian were accepted, his sin surpassed the shin of the world. Today all communities must be illumined with the light of unity and concord. Yet the pride and arrogance of some communities have laid waste the realm of knowledge and destroyed the house of justice and equity.

126

یا شیخ وارد شد بر این مظلوم آنچه که شبه و مثل نداشته و کل را بکمال تسلیم و رضا لأجل تهذیب نفوس و ارتفاع کلمة اللّه حمل نمودیم در ایّامی که در سجن ارض میم بودیم ما را یک یوم بدست علما دادند دیگر معلومست که چه وارد شد و اگر وقتی آن جناب در انبار حضرت سلطان وارد شوند از نائب و رئیس آن محل بطلبند که آن دو زنجیر را که یکی به قره‌کهر و یکی به سلاسل معروفست بنمایند قسم بنیّر عدل که چهار شهر این مظلوم در یکی از این دو معذّب و مغلول و حزنِی ما یعقوب بثّ اقلّه و کلّ بلآء ایّوب بعض بلیّتی

Yā Shaykh, vārid shud bar īn Maẓlūm ānchih kih shibh va mithl nadāshtih va kull rā bi-kamāl-i taslīm va riḍā li-ajli tahdhīb-i nufūs va irtifāʿ-i kalimati Allāh ḥaml nimūdīm. Dar ayyāmī kih dar sijn-i arḍ-i Mīm būdīm mā rā yik yawm bi-dast-i ʿulamā dādand. Dīgar maʿlūmast kih chih vārid shud. Va agar vaqtī ān jināb dar anbār-i Ḥaḍrat-i Sulṭān vārid shavand az nāʾib va raʾīs-i ān maḥall biṭalaband kih ān du zanjīr rā kih yikī bi-Qarah-Kahr va yikī bi-Salāsil maʿrūfast binamāyand. Qasam bi-Nayyir-i ʿAdl kih chahār shahr īn Maẓlūm dar yikī az īn du muʿadhdhab va maghlūl. Wa-ḥuznī mā Yaʿqūbu baththa aqallahu wa-kullu balāʾi Ayyūba baʿḍu baliyyatī.

Shaykh! This Wronged One has suffered what has no parallel or equal, and We have borne it all with complete submission and contentment, to refine souls and exalt the Word of God. During the days when We were in prison in the land of Mim, they handed Us over to the religious scholars for one day. What then befell Us is plain enough. If you should ever enter His Majesty the sovereign’s storehouse, ask the deputy and the officer in charge there to show you the two chains known as Qarah-Kahr and Salasil. I swear by the Sun of Justice that for four months this Wronged One was tormented and fettered in one of these two. The sorrow Jacob poured out was but the smallest part of My sorrow, and all Job’s afflictions are but part of My affliction.

127

و همچنین در شهادت حاجی محمّد رضا در مدینهٔ عشق تفکّر نمائید ظالمهای عالم بر آن مظلوم وارد آوردند آنچه را که بعضی از ملل خارجه گریستند و نوحه نمودند چه که از قرار مذکور و معلوم سی و دو زخم بر جسد مبارکش وارد مع‌ذلک احدی از امر تجاوز ننمود و دست درنیاورد در هر حال حکم کتاب را بر ارادهٔ خود مقدّم داشتند مع آنکه در آن مدینه جمعی از این حزب بوده و هستند

Va hamchunīn dar shahādat-i Ḥājī Muḥammad Riḍā dar Madīnih-yi ʿIshq tafakkur namāyīd. Ẓālimhā-yi ʿālam bar ān maẓlūm vārid āvardand ānchih rā kih baʿḍī az milal-i khārijih girīstand va nawḥih nimūdand, chih kih az qarār-i madhkūr va maʿlūm sī va du zakhm bar jasad-i mubārakash vārid. Maʿa-dhālik aḥadī az amr tajāvuz nanimūd va dast dar-nayāvard. Dar har ḥāl ḥukm-i kitāb rā bar irādih-yi khud muqaddam dāshtand, maʿa ānkih dar ān madīnih jamʿī az īn ḥizb būdih va hastand.

Reflect also on the martyrdom of Haji Muhammad-Rida in the City of Love. The oppressors of the world inflicted on that wronged man such cruelties that some among the foreign nations wept and lamented, for, according to what has been reported and established, his blessed body received thirty-two wounds. Nevertheless, no one transgressed the command or raised a hand. In every circumstance they placed the injunction of the Book before their own will, although a number of this community lived, and still live, in that city.

128

استدعا آنکه حضرت سلطان ایّده اللّه تبارک و تعالی در این امور بنفسه تفکّر فرمایند و بعدل و انصاف حکم نمایند مع آنکه در اکثری از بلاد ایران در این سنین اخیره این حزب کشته شدند و نکشتند مشاهده میشود بغضای افئدهٔ بعضی زیاده از قبل ظاهر و از سیّد اعمال شفاعت مظلومها از اعدا نزد امرا بوده البتّه بسمع بعضی رسیده که حزب مظلوم در آن مدینه نزد حاکم از قاتلها شفاعت نمودند و تخفیف طلب کردند فاعتبروا یا اولی الأبصار

Istidʿā ānkih Ḥaḍrat-i Sulṭān ayyadahu Allāhu tabāraka wa-taʿālā dar īn umūr bi-nafsih tafakkur farmāyand va bi-ʿadl va inṣāf ḥukm namāyand. Maʿa ānkih dar aktharī az bilād-i Īrān dar īn sinīn-i akhīrih īn ḥizb kushtih shudand va nakushtand, mushāhadih mīshavad baghḍā-yi afʾidih-yi baʿḍī ziyādih az qabl ẓāhir. Va az sayyid-i aʿmāl shafāʿat-i maẓlūmhā az aʿdā nazd-i umarā būdih. Al-battih bi-samʿ-i baʿḍī rasīdih kih ḥizb-i maẓlūm dar ān madīnih nazd-i ḥākim az qātilhā shafāʿat nimūdand va takhfīf ṭalab kardand. Fa-ʿtabirū yā ulī al-abṣār.

It is Our request that His Majesty the sovereign, may God, blessed and exalted, assist him, personally reflect on these matters and judge with justice and fairness. Although in most cities of Iran in recent years this community has been killed and has not killed, the hatred in some hearts is seen to be more evident than before. Among the noblest deeds has been the intercession of the wronged with the authorities on behalf of their enemies. Some have surely heard that in that city the wronged community interceded with the governor for the murderers and asked for their punishment to be reduced. Take heed, then, you who have insight!

129

یا شیخ این آیات محکمات در یکی از الواح از قلم ابهی نازل یا عبد اسمع ندآء المظلوم الّذی حمل الشّدائد و البلایا فی سبیل اللّه مالک الأسمآء الی ان سجن فى ارض الطّآء انّه دعا النّاس الی الجنّة العلیا و هم اخذوه و داروا به فی المدن و الدّیار کم من لیل طار النّوم من عیون احبّائی حبّاً لنفسی و کم من یوم قام علیّ الأحزاب مرّة رأیت نفسی علی اعلی الجبال و اخری فى سجن الطّآء فی السّلاسل و الأغلال لعمر اللّه قد کنت شاکراً ناطقاً ذاکراً متوجّهاً راضیاً خاضعاً خاشعاً فی کلّ الأحوال کذلک مضت ایّامی الی ان انتهت الی هذا السّجن الّذی به تزلزلت الأرض و ناحت السّموات طوبی لعبد نبذ الظّنون اذ اتی المکنون برایات الآیات انّا اخبرنا النّاس بهذا الظّهور الأعظم ولکنّ القوم فی سکر عجاب

Yā Shaykh, īn āyāt-i muḥkamāt dar yikī az alvāḥ az Qalam-i Abhā nāzil: Yā ʿabd, ismaʿ nidāʾa al-Maẓlūmi alladhī ḥamala al-shadāʾida wa-l-balāyā fī sabīli Allāhi Māliki al-asmāʾi ilā an sujina fī arḍi al-Ṭāʾ. Innahu daʿā al-nāsa ilā al-jannati al-ʿulyā wa-hum akhadhūhu wa-dārū bihi fī al-muduni wa-l-diyār. Kam min laylin ṭāra al-nawmu min ʿuyūni aḥibbāʾī ḥubban li-nafsī wa-kam min yawmin qāma ʿalayya al-aḥzāb. Marratan raʾaytu nafsī ʿalā aʿlā al-jibāli wa-ukhrā fī sijni al-Ṭāʾi fī al-salāsili wa-l-aghlāl. La-ʿamru Allāhi qad kuntu shākiran nāṭiqan dhākiran mutawajjihan rāḍiyan khāḍiʿan khāshiʿan fī kulli al-aḥwāl. Kadhālika maḍat ayyāmī ilā an intahat ilā hādhā al-sijni alladhī bihi tazalzalati al-arḍu wa-nāḥati al-samāwāt. Ṭūbā li-ʿabdin nabadha al-ẓunūna idh atā al-Maknūnu bi-rāyāti al-āyāt. Innā akhbarnā al-nāsa bi-hādhā al-ẓuhūri al-aʿẓami wa-lākinna al-qawma fī sukrin ʿujāb.

Shaykh! These decisive verses were revealed by the All-Glorious Pen in one of the Tablets: “Servant! Hear the call of the Wronged One, who bore hardships and afflictions in the path of God, the Lord of Names, until He was imprisoned in the land of Ta. He called the people to the most exalted Paradise, but they seized Him and took Him from city to city and land to land. How many nights sleep fled from the eyes of My loved ones out of love for Me, and how many days the factions rose against Me! At one time I found Myself on the loftiest mountains, at another in the prison of Ta, in chains and fetters. By the life of God! In every circumstance I was thankful, speaking forth, remembering God, turning toward Him, content, submissive, and humble. Thus My days passed until they culminated in this prison, through which the earth trembled and the heavens lamented. Blessed is the servant who cast aside conjectures when the Hidden One came with the banners of His verses. We have informed the people of this Most Great Revelation, but the people are in a strange stupor.”

130

عند ذلک ارتفع النّدآء من شطر الحجاز نادت و قالت طوبی لک یا عکّا بما جعلک اللّه مطلع ندائه الأحلی و مشرق آیاته الکبری و نعیماً لک بما استقرّ علیک کرسیّ العدل و اشرق من افقک نیّر العنایة و الألطاف طوبی لمنصف انصف فی هذا الذّکر الأعظم و ویل لکلّ غافل مرتاب

ʿInda dhālika irtafaʿa al-nidāʾu min shaṭri al-Ḥijāz. Nādat wa-qālat ṭūbā laki yā ʿAkkā bi-mā jaʿalaki Allāhu maṭliʿa nidāʾihi al-aḥlā wa-mashriqa āyātihi al-kubrā wa-naʿīman laki bi-mā istaqarra ʿalayki kursiyyu al-ʿadli wa-ashraqa min ufuqiki nayyiru al-ʿināyati wa-l-alṭāf. Ṭūbā li-munṣifin anṣafa fī hādhā al-dhikri al-aʿẓami wa-waylun li-kulli ghāfilin murtāb.

At that moment a call rose from the direction of the Hijaz. It called out and said: “Blessed are you, Acre, for God has made you the dawning-place of His sweetest call and the dayspring of His greatest signs. Bliss be yours, for the throne of justice has been established upon you, and the sun of favor and loving-kindness has shone from your horizon. Blessed is the fair-minded person who judges equitably concerning this Most Great Remembrance, and woe to every heedless doubter!”

131

و بعد از شهادت بعضی از شهدا لوح برهان از سماء امر مالک ادیان نازل

Va baʿd az shahādat-i baʿḍī az shuhadā Lawḥ-i Burhān az samāʾ-i amr-i Mālik-i Adyān nāzil.

After the martyrdom of some of the martyrs, the Tablet of the Proof was revealed from the heaven of the Cause of the Lord of Religions.

132

هو المقتدر العلیم الحکیم قد احاطت اریاح البغضآء سفینة البطحآء بما اکتسبت ایدی الظّالمین یا ایّها المشهور بالعلم قد افتیت علی الّذین ناح لهم کتب العالم و شهد لهم دفاتر الأدیان کلّها و انّک انت یا ایّها البعید فی حجاب غلیظ تاللّه قد حکمت علی الّذین بهم لاح افق الایمان یشهد بذلک مطالع الوحی و مظاهر امر ربّک الرّحمن الّذین انفقوا ارواحهم و ما عندهم فی سبیله المستقیم قد صاح من ظلمک دین اللّه فیما سواه و انّک تلعب و تکون من الفرحین لیس فی قلبی بغضک و لا بغض احد من العباد انّ العارف یراک و امثالک فی جهل مبین انّک لو اطّلعت علی ما فعلت لألقیت نفسک فی النّار او خرجت من البیت متوجّهاً الی الجبال و نحت الی ان رجعت الی مقام قدّر لک من لدن مقتدر قدیر یا ایّها الموهوم اخرق حجبات الظّنون و الأوهام لتری شمس العلم مشرقة من هذا الأفق المنیر قد قطعت بضعة الرّسول و ظننت انّک نصرت دین اللّه کذلک سوّلت لک نفسک و انت من الغافلین قد احترق من فعلک قلوب الملإ الأعلی و الّذین طافوا حول امر اللّه ربّ العالمین قد ذاب کبد البتول من ظلمک و ناح اهل الفردوس فی مقام کریم

Huwa al-Muqtadir al-ʿAlīm al-Ḥakīm. Qad aḥāṭat aryāḥ al-baghḍāʾ safīnat al-Baṭḥāʾ bi-mā iktasabat aydī al-ẓālimīn. Yā ayyuhā al-mashhūr bi-l-ʿilm, qad aftayta ʿalā alladhīna nāḥa lahum kutub al-ʿālam wa-shahida lahum dafātir al-adyān kullihā, wa-innaka anta yā ayyuhā al-baʿīd fī ḥijāb ghalīẓ. Ta-Allāh, qad ḥakamta ʿalā alladhīna bihim lāḥa ufuq al-īmān. Yashhadu bi-dhālika maṭāliʿ al-waḥy wa-maẓāhir amr rabbika al-Raḥmān alladhīna anfaqū arwāḥahum wa-mā ʿindahum fī sabīlihi al-mustaqīm. Qad ṣāḥa min ẓulmika dīn Allāh fī-mā siwāh, wa-innaka talʿabu wa-takūnu min al-fariḥīn. Laysa fī qalbī bughḍuka wa-lā bughḍ aḥad min al-ʿibād. Inna al-ʿārif yarāka wa-amthālaka fī jahl mubīn. Innaka law iṭṭalaʿta ʿalā mā faʿalta la-alqayta nafsaka fī al-nār aw kharajta min al-bayt mutawajjihan ilā al-jibāl wa-nuḥta ilā an rajaʿta ilā maqām quddira laka min ladun Muqtadir Qadīr. Yā ayyuhā al-mawhūm, ukhruq ḥujubāt al-ẓunūn wa-l-awhām li-tarā shams al-ʿilm mushriqatan min hādhā al-ufuq al-munīr. Qad qaṭaʿta biḍʿat al-Rasūl wa-ẓananta annaka naṣarta dīn Allāh. Kadhālika sawwalat laka nafsuka wa-anta min al-ghāfilīn. Qad iḥtaraqa min fiʿlika qulūb al-malaʾ al-aʿlā wa-alladhīna ṭāfū ḥawla amr Allāh Rabb al-ʿālamīn. Qad dhāba kabid al-Batūl min ẓulmika wa-nāḥa ahl al-Firdaws fī maqām karīm.
