He is the All-Powerful, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise. The winds of hatred have surrounded the Ark of Batha because of what the hands of the oppressors have done. You who are renowned for learning! You have issued a ruling against those for whom the books of the world have lamented and to whom the scriptures of every religion have borne witness. Yet you, distant one, are behind a thick veil. By God, you have passed judgment against those through whom the horizon of faith shone forth. To this bear witness the Daysprings of revelation and the Manifestations of the Cause of your Lord, the All-Merciful, who gave their lives and all they possessed in His straight path. Because of your oppression, the religion of God has cried out amid all else, while you amuse yourself and rejoice. In My heart there is no hatred for you or for any other person. One who truly knows sees you and your like in manifest ignorance. If you realized what you have done, you would cast yourself into the fire, or leave your home and head for the mountains, lamenting until you returned to the station ordained for you by One who is All-Powerful, Almighty. You who are deluded! Tear through the veils of conjecture and illusion, so that you may see the sun of knowledge shining from this luminous horizon. You have cut to pieces the Messenger’s own flesh and imagined that you were helping the religion of God. Thus has your self enticed you, and you are among the heedless. Your deed has set ablaze the hearts of the heavenly Assembly and of those who have circled around the Cause of God, the Lord of the worlds. Your oppression has melted the heart of the Virgin, and the inhabitants of Paradise have lamented in a noble station.

133

انصف باللّه بأیّ برهان استدلّ علمآء الیهود و افتوا به علی الرّوح اذ اتی بالحقّ و بأیّ حجّة انکر الفریسیّون و علمآء الأصنام اذ اتی محمّد رسول اللّه بکتاب حکم بین الحقّ و الباطل بعدل اضآء بنوره ظلمات الأرض و انجذبت قلوب العارفین و انّک استدللت الیوم بما استدلّ به علمآء الجهل فی ذاک العصر یشهد بذلک مالک مصر الفضل فی هذا السّجن العظیم انّک اقتدیت بهم بل سبقتهم فی الظّلم و ظننت انّک نصرت الدّین و دفعت عن شریعة اللّه العلیم الحکیم ونفسه الحقّ ینوح من ظلمک النّاموس الأکبر و تصیح شریعة اللّه الّتی بها سرت نسمات العدل علی من فی السّموات و الأرضین هل ظننت انّک ربحت فیما افتیت لا وسلطان الأسمآء یشهد بخسرانک من عنده علم کلّ شیء فی لوح حفیظ

Anṣif bi-Allāh, bi-ayyi burhān istadalla ʿulamāʾ al-Yahūd wa-aftaw bihi ʿalā al-Rūḥ idh atā bi-l-ḥaqq, wa-bi-ayyi ḥujja ankara al-Farīsiyyūn wa-ʿulamāʾ al-aṣnām idh atā Muḥammad Rasūl Allāh bi-kitāb ḥakama bayna al-ḥaqq wa-l-bāṭil bi-ʿadl aḍāʾa bi-nūrihi ẓulumāt al-arḍ wa-injadhabat qulūb al-ʿārifīn. Wa-innaka istadlalta al-yawm bi-mā istadalla bihi ʿulamāʾ al-jahl fī dhāka al-ʿaṣr. Yashhadu bi-dhālika Mālik miṣr al-faḍl fī hādhā al-sijn al-ʿaẓīm. Innaka iqtadayta bihim bal sabaqtahum fī al-ẓulm wa-ẓananta annaka naṣarta al-dīn wa-dafaʿta ʿan sharīʿat Allāh al-ʿAlīm al-Ḥakīm. Wa-nafsihi al-ḥaqq, yanūḥu min ẓulmika al-nāmūs al-akbar wa-taṣīḥu sharīʿat Allāh allatī bihā sarat nasamāt al-ʿadl ʿalā man fī al-samāwāt wa-l-arḍīn. Hal ẓananta annaka rabiḥta fī-mā aftayta? Lā wa-Sulṭān al-asmāʾ. Yashhadu bi-khusrānika man ʿindahu ʿilm kull shayʾ fī lawḥ ḥafīẓ.

Be fair, by God! What proof did the Jewish scholars invoke when they issued their ruling against the Spirit as He came with the truth? And on what evidence did the Pharisees and the scholars of idols base their denial when Muhammad, the Messenger of God, came with a Book that judged between truth and falsehood with a justice whose light illumined the darkness of the earth and attracted the hearts of those who truly know? Today you have invoked the same arguments that the scholars of ignorance invoked in that age. The Sovereign of the city of grace bears witness to this in this mighty prison. You have followed their example; indeed, you have surpassed them in oppression, imagining that you were helping religion and defending the Law of God, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise. By His own true Self, the Most Great Law laments your oppression, and the Law of God, through which the breezes of justice have wafted over all who are in the heavens and on earth, cries out. Did you imagine that you had gained anything by the ruling you issued? No, by the Sovereign of Names! He who holds the knowledge of all things in a preserving Tablet bears witness to your loss.

134

یا ایّها الغافل انّک ما رأیتنی و ما عاشرت و ما آنست معی فی اقلّ من آن فکیف امرت النّاس بسبّی هل اتّبعت فی ذلک هواک ام مولاک فأت بآیة ان انت من الصّادقین نشهد انّک نبذت شریعة اللّه ورائک و اخذت شریعة نفسک انّه لا یعزب عن علمه من شیء انّه هو الفرد الخبیر یا ایّها الغافل اسمع ما انزله الرّحمن فی الفرقان لا تقولوا لمن القی الیکم السّلام لست مؤمناً کذلک حکم من فی قبضته ملکوت الأمر و الخلق ان انت من السّامعین انّک نبذت حکم اللّه و اخذت حکم نفسک فویل لک یا ایّها الغافل المریب انّک لو تنکرنی بأیّ برهان یثبت ما عندک فأت به یا ایّها المشرک باللّه و المعرض عن سلطانه الّذی احاط العالمین

Yā ayyuhā al-ghāfil, innaka mā raʾaytanī wa-mā ʿāsharta wa-mā ānasta maʿī fī aqall min ān, fa-kayfa amarta al-nās bi-sabbī? Hal ittabaʿta fī dhālika hawāka am Mawlāka? Faʾti bi-āya in anta min al-ṣādiqīn. Nashhadu annaka nabadhta sharīʿat Allāh warāʾaka wa-akhadhta sharīʿat nafsika. Innahu lā yaʿzubu ʿan ʿilmihi min shayʾ. Innahu huwa al-Fard al-Khabīr. Yā ayyuhā al-ghāfil, ismaʿ mā anzalahu al-Raḥmān fī al-Furqān: lā taqūlū li-man alqā ilaykum al-salām lasta muʾminan. Kadhālika ḥakama man fī qabḍatihi malakūt al-amr wa-l-khalq, in anta min al-sāmiʿīn. Innaka nabadhta ḥukm Allāh wa-akhadhta ḥukm nafsika, fa-wayl laka yā ayyuhā al-ghāfil al-murīb. Innaka law tunkirunī bi-ayyi burhān yathbutu mā ʿindaka? Faʾti bihi yā ayyuhā al-mushrik bi-Allāh wa-l-muʿriḍ ʿan sulṭānihi alladhī aḥāṭa al-ʿālamīn.

Heedless one! You have not seen Me, associated with Me, or kept Me company for even a moment. How, then, have you ordered people to revile Me? In this, have you followed your own desire or your Lord? Bring forth a sign, if you are truthful. We testify that you have cast the Law of God behind you and adopted the law of your own self. Nothing escapes His knowledge. He is the Unique, the All-Informed. Heedless one! Listen to what the All-Merciful has revealed in the Qur’an: “Do not say to one who offers you peace, ‘You are not a believer.’” Thus has He in whose grasp lies the kingdom of revelation and creation decreed, if you are among those who listen. You have cast aside God’s judgment and adopted your own. Woe to you, heedless doubter! If you deny Me, by what proof can what you possess be established? Bring it forth, you who associate partners with God and turn away from His sovereignty, which encompasses all worlds.

135

اعلم انّ العالم من اعترف بظهوری و شرب من بحر علمی و طار فی هوآء حبّی و نبذ ما سوائی و اخذ ما نزّل من ملکوت بیانی البدیع انّه بمنزلة البصر للبشر و روح الحیوان لجسد الامکان تعالی الرّحمن الّذی عرّفه و اقامه علی خدمة امره العزیز العظیم یصلّی علیه الملأ الأعلی و اهل سرداق الکبریآء الّذین شربوا رحیقی المختوم باسمی القویّ القدیر انّک ان تک من اهل هذا المقام الأعلی فأت بآیة من لدی اللّه فاطر السّمآء و ان عرفت عجز نفسک خذ اعنّة هواک ثمّ ارجع الی مولاک لعلّ یکفّر عنک سیّئاتک الّتی بها احترقت اوراق السّدرة و صاحت الصّخرة و بکت عیون العارفین بک انشقّ ستر الرّبوبیّة و غرقت السّفینة و عقرت النّاقة و ناح الرّوح فی مقام رفیع أ تعترض علی الّذى اتاک بما عندک و عند اهل العالم من حجج اللّه و آیاته افتح بصرک لتری المظلوم مشرقاً من افق ارادة اللّه الملک الحقّ المبین ثمّ افتح سمع فؤادک لتسمع ما تنطق به السّدرة الّتی ارتفعت بالحقّ من لدی اللّه العزیز الجمیل انّ السّدرة مع ما ورد علیها من ظلمک و اعتساف امثالک تنادی بأعلی النّدآء و تدعو الکلّ الی سدرة المنتهی و الأفق الأعلی طوبی لنفس رأت الآیة الکبری و لأذن سمعت ندائها الأحلی و ویل لکلّ معرض اثیم

Iʿlam anna al-ʿālim man iʿtarafa bi-ẓuhūrī wa-shariba min baḥr ʿilmī wa-ṭāra fī hawāʾ ḥubbī wa-nabadha mā siwāʾī wa-akhadha mā nuzzila min malakūt bayānī al-badīʿ. Innahu bi-manzilat al-baṣar li-l-bashar wa-rūḥ al-ḥayawān li-jasad al-imkān. Taʿālā al-Raḥmān alladhī ʿarrafahu wa-aqāmahu ʿalā khidmat amrihi al-ʿazīz al-ʿaẓīm. Yuṣallī ʿalayhi al-malaʾ al-aʿlā wa-ahl surdāq al-kibriyāʾ alladhīna sharibū raḥīqī al-makhtūm bi-smī al-Qawiyy al-Qadīr. Innaka in taku min ahl hādhā al-maqām al-aʿlā faʾti bi-āya min ladā Allāh Fāṭir al-samāʾ, wa-in ʿarafta ʿajz nafsika khudh aʿinnat hawāka thumma irjaʿ ilā Mawlāka laʿalla yukaffira ʿanka sayyiʾātika allatī bihā iḥtaraqat awrāq al-sidra wa-ṣāḥat al-ṣakhra wa-bakat ʿuyūn al-ʿārifīn. Bika inshaqqa sitr al-rubūbiyya wa-ghariqat al-safīna wa-ʿuqirat al-nāqa wa-nāḥa al-Rūḥ fī maqām rafīʿ. A-taʿtariḍu ʿalā alladhī atāka bi-mā ʿindaka wa-ʿinda ahl al-ʿālam min ḥujaj Allāh wa-āyātihi? Iftaḥ baṣaraka li-tarā al-Maẓlūm mushriqan min ufuq irādat Allāh al-Malik al-Ḥaqq al-Mubīn. Thumma iftaḥ samʿ fuʾādika li-tasmaʿ mā tanṭiqu bihi al-sidra allatī irtafaʿat bi-l-ḥaqq min ladā Allāh al-ʿAzīz al-Jamīl. Inna al-sidra maʿa mā warada ʿalayhā min ẓulmika wa-iʿtisāf amthālika tunādī bi-aʿlā al-nidāʾ wa-tadʿū al-kull ilā Sidrat al-Muntahā wa-l-ufuq al-aʿlā. Ṭūbā li-nafs raʾat al-āya al-kubrā wa-li-udhun samiʿat nidāʾahā al-aḥlā wa-wayl li-kull muʿriḍ athīm.

Know that a truly learned person is one who has acknowledged My revelation, drunk from the ocean of My knowledge, soared in the atmosphere of My love, cast aside everything but Me, and embraced what has been sent down from the kingdom of My wondrous utterance. Such a person is like sight to humanity and the spirit of life to the body of contingent existence. Exalted is the All-Merciful, who has granted him understanding and raised him up to serve His mighty and glorious Cause. The heavenly Assembly and the inhabitants of the pavilion of grandeur, who have drunk My choice wine sealed with My name, the Strong, the Almighty, invoke blessings upon him. If you belong to this most exalted station, bring forth a sign from God, the Creator of heaven. But if you recognize your own powerlessness, rein in your desires and return to your Lord, so that He may atone for your misdeeds, through which the leaves of the Lote-Tree have burned, the Rock has cried out, and the eyes of those who truly know have wept. Because of you, the veil of lordship has been torn, the Ark has sunk, the she-camel has been slaughtered, and the Spirit has lamented in a lofty station. Do you object to Him who has brought you the proofs and signs of God that you and the people of the world possess? Open your eyes, so that you may see the Wronged One shining from the horizon of the will of God, the King, the Truth, the Expounder. Then open the hearing of your heart, so that you may hear what is spoken by the Lote-Tree that has been raised up in truth by God, the Almighty, the Beautiful. Despite the oppression you have inflicted upon it and the tyranny of those like you, the Lote-Tree calls out with the loudest voice, summoning everyone to the Lote-Tree of the Utmost Boundary and the most exalted horizon. Blessed is the soul that has seen the greatest sign, and the ear that has heard its sweetest call; and woe to every sinful one who turns away!

136

یا ایّها المعرض باللّه لو تری السّدرة بعین الانصاف لتری آثار سیوفک فى افنانها و اغصانها و اوراقها بعدما خلقک اللّه لعرفانها و خدمتها تفکّر لعلّ تطّلع بظلمک و تکون من التّائبین أ ظننت انّا نخاف من ظلمک فاعلم ثمّ ایقن انّا فی اوّل یوم فیه ارتفع صریر القلم الأعلی بین الأرض و السّمآء انفقنا ارواحنا و اجسادنا و ابنائنا و اموالنا فی سبیل اللّه العلیّ العظیم و نفتخر بذلک بین اهل الانشآء و الملإ الأعلی یشهد بذلک ما ورد علینا فی هذا الصّراط المستقیم تاللّه قد ذابت الأکباد و صلبت الأجساد و سفکت الدّمآء و الأبصار کانت ناظرة الی افق عنایة ربّها الشّاهد البصیر کلّما زاد البلآء زاد اهل البهآء فی حبّهم قد شهد بصدقهم ما انزله الرّحمن فی الفرقان بقوله فتمنّوا الموت ان کنتم صادقین هل الّذی حفظ نفسه خلف الأحجاب خیر ام الّذی انفقها فی سبیل اللّه انصف و لا تکن فى تیه الکذب من الهائمین قد اخذهم کوثر محبّة الرّحمن علی شأن ما منعتهم مدافع العالم و لا سیوف الأمم عن التّوجّه الى بحر عطآء ربّهم المعطی الکریم

Yā ayyuhā al-muʿriḍ, bi-Allāh, law tarā al-sidra bi-ʿayn al-inṣāf la-tarā āthār suyūfika fī afnānihā wa-aghṣānihā wa-awrāqihā baʿdamā khalaqaka Allāh li-ʿirfānihā wa-khidmatihā. Tafakkar laʿalla taṭṭaliʿu bi-ẓulmika wa-takūnu min al-tāʾibīn. A-ẓananta annā nakhāfu min ẓulmika? Fa-iʿlam thumma ayqin annā fī awwal yawm fīhi irtafaʿa ṣarīr al-Qalam al-Aʿlā bayna al-arḍ wa-l-samāʾ anfaqnā arwāḥanā wa-ajsādanā wa-abnāʾanā wa-amwālanā fī sabīl Allāh al-ʿAliyy al-ʿAẓīm wa-naftakhiru bi-dhālika bayna ahl al-inshāʾ wa-l-malaʾ al-aʿlā. Yashhadu bi-dhālika mā warada ʿalaynā fī hādhā al-ṣirāṭ al-mustaqīm. Ta-Allāh, qad dhābat al-akbād wa-ṣulibat al-ajsād wa-sufikat al-dimāʾ wa-l-abṣār kānat nāẓiratan ilā ufuq ʿināyat rabbihā al-Shāhid al-Baṣīr. Kullamā zāda al-balāʾ zāda ahl al-Bahāʾ fī ḥubbihim. Qad shahida bi-ṣidqihim mā anzalahu al-Raḥmān fī al-Furqān bi-qawlihi: fa-tamannaw al-mawt in kuntum ṣādiqīn. Hal alladhī ḥafiẓa nafsahu khalf al-aḥjāb khayr am alladhī anfaqahā fī sabīl Allāh? Anṣif wa-lā takun fī tīh al-kadhib min al-hāʾimīn. Qad akhadhahum Kawthar maḥabbat al-Raḥmān ʿalā shaʾn mā manaʿathum madāfiʿ al-ʿālam wa-lā suyūf al-umam ʿan al-tawajjuh ilā baḥr ʿaṭāʾ rabbihim al-Muʿṭī al-Karīm.

You who turn away! By God, if you looked at the Lote-Tree with the eye of fairness, you would see the marks of your swords on its boughs, branches, and leaves, even though God created you to recognize and serve it. Reflect, so that you may become aware of your oppression and be among those who repent. Did you imagine that We fear your oppression? Know, then, and be assured that on the very first day when the sound of the Most Exalted Pen rose between earth and heaven, We offered Our lives, Our bodies, Our children, and Our possessions in the path of God, the Most High, the Most Great. In this We take pride before the people of creation and the heavenly Assembly. What has befallen Us on this straight path bears witness to this. By God, hearts have melted, bodies have been crucified, and blood has been shed, while eyes remained fixed on the horizon of the loving care of their Lord, the Witness, the All-Seeing. The greater the affliction, the greater the love of the people of Baha. What the All-Merciful revealed in the Qur’an bears witness to their truthfulness in His words: “Then wish for death, if you are truthful.” Is one who has kept himself safe behind veils better, or one who has offered his life in the path of God? Be fair, and do not be among those who wander in the wilderness of falsehood. The river of the All-Merciful’s love has so enraptured them that neither the cannons of the world nor the swords of the nations have prevented them from turning toward the ocean of the bounty of their Lord, the Bestower, the All-Bountiful.

137

تاللّه ما اعجزنی البلآء و ما اضعفنی اعراض العلمآء نطقت و انطق امام الوجوه قد فتح باب الفضل و اتی مطلع العدل بآیات واضحات و حجج باهرات من لدی اللّه المقتدر القدیر احضر بین یدی الوجه لتسمع اسرار ما سمعه ابن عمران فی طور العرفان کذلک یأمرک مشرق ظهور ربّک الرّحمن من شطر سجنه العظیم

Ta-Allāh, mā aʿjazanī al-balāʾ wa-mā aḍʿafanī iʿrāḍ al-ʿulamāʾ. Naṭaqtu wa-anṭiqu amāma al-wujūh: qad futiḥa bāb al-faḍl wa-atā Maṭlaʿ al-ʿadl bi-āyāt wāḍiḥāt wa-ḥujaj bāhirāt min ladā Allāh al-Muqtadir al-Qadīr. Uḥḍur bayna yaday al-Wajh li-tasmaʿ asrār mā samiʿahu Ibn ʿImrān fī Ṭūr al-ʿirfān. Kadhālika yaʾmuruka Mashriq ẓuhūr rabbika al-Raḥmān min shaṭr sijnihi al-ʿaẓīm.

By God, affliction has not rendered Me powerless, nor has the rejection of the scholars weakened Me. I have spoken, and I speak openly before all: the gate of grace has been opened, and the Dayspring of justice has come with clear signs and resplendent proofs from God, the All-Powerful, the Almighty. Come into the presence of the Countenance, so that you may hear the mysteries of what the son of Imran heard on the Sinai of recognition. Thus does the Dayspring of the revelation of your Lord, the All-Merciful, command you from the direction of His mighty prison.

138

عند ذلک ارتفع ندآء الفطرة مرّة اخری و حنینها و تقول انّ الطّور ینادی و یقول یا ملأ البیان اتّقوا الرّحمن انّی فزت بمکلّمی و اخذ جذب فرحی حصاة الأرض و ترابها و السّدرة تقول یا ملأ البیان انصفوا فیما ظهر بالحقّ قد ظهرت النّار الّتی اظهرها اللّه للکلیم یشهد بذلک کلّ ذی بصر علیم

ʿInda dhālika irtafaʿa nidāʾ al-fiṭra marratan ukhrā wa-ḥanīnuhā wa-taqūlu: inna al-Ṭūr yunādī wa-yaqūlu yā malaʾ al-Bayān, ittaqū al-Raḥmān, innī fuztu bi-Mukallimī wa-akhadha jadhb faraḥī ḥaṣāt al-arḍ wa-turābahā. Wa-l-sidra taqūlu: yā malaʾ al-Bayān, anṣifū fī-mā ẓahara bi-l-ḥaqq. Qad ẓaharat al-nār allatī aẓharahā Allāh li-l-Kalīm. Yashhadu bi-dhālika kull dhī baṣar ʿalīm.

At that moment the call of innate nature and its yearning cry rose once again, and it said: “Sinai calls out and says, ‘People of the Bayan! Fear the All-Merciful. I have attained the presence of Him who speaks to me, and the rapture of my joy has seized the pebbles and dust of the earth.’ And the Lote-Tree says, ‘People of the Bayan! Be fair concerning what has appeared in truth. The fire that God revealed to Him who conversed with Him has appeared. Everyone endowed with sight and knowledge bears witness to this.’”

139

یا شیخ بعضی از شهدای این ظهور ذکر شد و همچنین بعضی از آیات که در ذکر ایشان از ملکوت بیان نازل امید آنکه منقطعاً عن العالم در آنچه ذکر شده تفکّر فرمایند

Yā Shaykh, baʿżī az shohadā-ye īn ẓohūr dhekr shod va hamchenīn baʿżī az āyāt ke dar dhekr-e īshān az malakūt-e bayān nāzel. Omīd ānke munqaṭiʿan ʿan al-ʿālam dar ānche dhekr shode tafakkor farmāyand.

O Shaykh! Some of the martyrs of this revelation have been mentioned, as have some of the verses revealed in their remembrance from the kingdom of utterance. It is hoped that, detached from the world, you will reflect on what has been mentioned.

140

حال در میرزا هادی دولت‌آبادی و صاد اصفهانی در ارض طاء تفکّر لازم اوّل بمجرّد آنکه شنید او را بابی گفته‌اند اضطراب اخذش نمود بشأنی که وقار و سکون مفقود گشت بر منابر ارتقا جست و نطق نمود بکلماتی که سزاوار نبود لازال گلپار‌ه‌های عالم محض حبّ ریاست عمل نموده‌اند آنچه را که سبب و علّت گمراهی عباد گشته آن جناب جمیع را مثل آن نفوس ندانند استقامت و ثبوت و رسوخ و اطمینان و تمکین و وقار شهدای این ظهور ذکر شد تا آن جناب آگاه شوند و مقصود از آنچه بیان شد از الواح ملوک و غیره آنکه آن جناب بیقین مبین بدانند که این مظلوم امر اللّه را ستر ننمود و بآنچه مأمور بود امام وجوه عالم بافصح بیان ذکر نمود و القا فرمود ولکن امثال آن نفوس ضعیفه مثل هادی و غیره امر اللّه را تبدیل نمودند و نظر بزندگانی دوروزهٔ دنیا عمل کردند و گفتند آنچه را که عین عدل گریست و قلم اعلی نوحه نمود مع آنکه از اصل امر بی‌خبر بوده و هستند و این مظلوم لوجه اللّه اظهار نمود

Ḥāl dar Mīrzā Hādī Dowlat-Ābādī va Ṣād-e Eṣfahānī dar arż-e Ṭāʾ tafakkor lāzem. Avval be-mojarrad-e ānke shenīd ū rā Bābī gofte-and eżṭerāb akhdhash namūd be-shaʾnī ke vaqār va sokūn mafqūd gasht. Bar manāber erteqā jost va noṭq namūd be-kalemātī ke sazāvār nabūd. Lāzāl gelpāreh-hā-ye ʿālam maḥż-e ḥobb-e riyāsat ʿamal namūde-and ānche rā ke sabab va ʿellat-e gomrāhī-ye ʿebād gashte. Ān janāb jamīʿ rā methl-e ān nofūs nadānand. Esteqāmat va thobūt va rosūkh va eṭmīnān va tamkīn va vaqār-e shohadā-ye īn ẓohūr dhekr shod tā ān janāb āgāh shavand va maqṣūd az ānche bayān shod az alvāḥ-e molūk va ghayreh ānke ān janāb be-yaqīn-e mobīn bedānand ke īn Maẓlūm Amr Allāh rā satr nanamūd va be-ānche maʾmūr būd amāma al-wujūh-e ʿālam be-afṣaḥ-e bayān dhekr namūd va elqā farmūd. Va-līkan amthāl-e ān nofūs-e żaʿīfeh methl-e Hādī va ghayreh Amr Allāh rā tabdīl namūdand va naẓar be-zendegānī-ye do-rūze-ye donyā ʿamal kardand va goftand ānche rā ke ʿayn-e ʿadl gerīst va Qalam-e Aʿlā nowḥeh namūd, maʿ-e ānke az aṣl-e amr bī-khabar būde va hastand va īn Maẓlūm li-wajh Allāh eẓhār namūd.

Now it is necessary to reflect on Mirza Hadi Dawlat-Abadi and Sad of Isfahan in the land of Ta. The former, as soon as he heard that he had been called a Babi, was seized with such agitation that his dignity and composure vanished. He mounted pulpits and uttered words that were unworthy. The clods of the world have always, solely out of love of leadership, done what has caused people to go astray. You should not consider everyone to be like those souls. The steadfastness, constancy, firmness, assurance, composure, and dignity of the martyrs of this revelation have been mentioned so that you may become aware. The purpose of what has been set forth from the Tablets to the kings and elsewhere is that you may know with clear certainty that this Wronged One did not conceal the Cause of God, but openly declared and proclaimed before the people of the world, in the most eloquent language, what He had been commanded to convey. Yet weak souls such as Hadi and others have altered the Cause of God and, for the sake of this world’s fleeting life, have done and said things that have made the eye of justice weep and the Most Exalted Pen lament, although they have been and remain unaware of the fundamentals of the Cause. This Wronged One has made this known for the sake of God.

141

یا هادی نزد اخوی رفتی و دیدی حال بساحت مظلوم توجّه نما شاید نفحات وحی و فوحات الهام ترا تأیید نماید و بمقصود فائز گرداند هر نفسی الیوم بمشاهدهٔ آثار فائز شود حقّ را از باطل بمثابهٔ شمس از ظلّ تمیز دهد و بمقصود آگاه گردد حقّ شاهد و گواه که آنچه ذکر شده لوجه اللّه بوده که شاید آن جناب سبب هدایت خلق شوند و احزاب عالم را از ظنون و اوهام نجات بخشند سبحان‌اللّه الی حین معرضین و منکرین نمیدانند آنچه نزد مبشّر یعنی نقطه رفته از که بوده العلم عند اللّه ربّ العالمین

Yā Hādī, nazd-e akhavī raftī va dīdī. Ḥāl be-sāḥat-e Maẓlūm tavajjoh namā shāyad nafaḥāt-e vaḥy va fawaḥāt-e elhām to rā taʾyīd namāyad va be-maqṣūd fāʾez gardānad. Har nafsī al-yowm be-moshāhede-ye āthār fāʾez shavad Ḥaqq rā az bāṭel be-mathābe-ye shams az ẓell tamīz dahad va be-maqṣūd āgāh gardad. Ḥaqq shāhed va govāh ke ānche dhekr shode li-wajh Allāh būde ke shāyad ān janāb sabab-e hedāyat-e khalq shavand va aḥzāb-e ʿālam rā az ẓonūn va owhām najāt bakhshand. Subḥān Allāh, elā ḥīn moʿreżīn va monkerīn nemīdānand ānche nazd-e Mobashsher yaʿnī Noqṭeh rafte az ke būde. Al-ʿilm ʿinda Allāh Rabb al-ʿālamīn.

O Hadi! You went to My brother and saw him. Now turn toward the court of the Wronged One, so that the breezes of revelation and the fragrances of inspiration may strengthen you and enable you to attain your goal. Anyone who today attains a view of the writings will distinguish truth from falsehood as the sun is distinguished from shadow, and will become aware of the intended purpose. God bears witness and testifies that what has been mentioned has been for His sake, so that you may become a means of guiding people and may deliver the peoples of the world from conjectures and illusions. Glory be to God! To this day, those who turn away and deny do not know who was responsible for what befell the Herald, that is, the Point. Knowledge rests with God, the Lord of the worlds.

142

یا شیخ همّت کن و بر خدمت امر قیام نما امروز رحیق مختوم امام وجوه ظاهر خذه باسم ربّک ثمّ اشربه بذکره العزیز البدیع این مظلوم در لیالی و ایّام بتألیف قلوب و تهذیب نفوس مشغول امورات واقعه در ایران در سنین اوّلیّه فی‌الحقیقه سبب حزن مقرّبین و مخلصین بوده و در هر سنه قتل و غارت و تاراج و سفک دماء موجود یک سنه در زنجان ظاهر شد آنچه که سبب فزع اکبر بود و همچنین یک سنه در نیریز و سنهٔ دیگر در طبری تا آنکه واقعهٔ ارض طاء واقع و از آن ببعد این مظلوم باعانت حقّ جلّ جلاله این حزب مظلوم را بما ینبغى آگاه نمود کل از ما عندهم و ما عند القوم مقدّس و به ما عند اللّه متشبّث و ناظر

Yā Shaykh, hemmat kon va bar khedmat-e Amr qiyām namā. Emrūz raḥīq-e makhtūm amām-e vojūh ẓāher. Khudhhu bi-smi rabbika thumma ishrabhu bi-dhikrihi al-ʿAzīz al-Badīʿ. Īn Maẓlūm dar layālī va ayyām be-taʾlīf-e qolūb va tahdhīb-e nofūs mashghūl. Omūrāt-e vāqeʿe dar Īrān dar senīn-e avvaliyye fī’l-ḥaqīqe sabab-e ḥozn-e moqarrabīn va mokhleṣīn būde va dar har sane qatl va ghārat va tārāj va safk-e demāʾ mowjūd. Yek sane dar Zanjān ẓāher shod ānche ke sabab-e fazaʿ-e akbar būd va hamchenīn yek sane dar Nayrīz va sane-ye dīgar dar Ṭabarī, tā ānke vāqeʿe-ye arḍ-e Ṭāʾ vāqeʿ va az ān be-baʿd īn Maẓlūm be-eʿānat-e Ḥaqq, jalla jalāluhu, īn ḥezb-e maẓlūm rā bi-mā yanbaghī āgāh nemūd. Koll az mā ʿindahum va mā ʿinda al-qawm moqaddas va be mā ʿinda Allāh motashabbeth va nāẓer.

O Shaykh, exert yourself and arise to serve the Cause. Today the sealed wine is manifest before all eyes. Take it in the name of your Lord, then drink it in remembrance of Him, the Almighty, the Incomparable. This Wronged One is occupied day and night with uniting hearts and refining souls. The events that occurred in Iran in the early years were truly a cause of sorrow to those who are near to God and devoted to Him. Every year there was killing, pillage, plunder, and bloodshed. One year, events occurred in Zanjan that caused the greatest alarm; likewise, one year in Nayriz, and another year in Tabari, until the incident in the land of Ta occurred. From that time onward, this Wronged One, with the assistance of God—exalted be His glory—made this wronged community aware of what was fitting. All have freed themselves from what they and the people possess, and hold fast to and look toward what is with God.

143

حال باید حضرت سلطان حفظه اللّه تعالی بعنایت و شفقت با این حزب رفتار فرمایند و این مظلوم امام کعبهٔ الهی عهد مینماید از این حزب جز صداقت و امانت امری ظاهر نشود که مغایر رأی جهان‌آرای حضرت سلطانی باشد هر ملّتی باید مقام سلطانش را ملاحظه نماید و در آن خاضع باشد و بامرش عامل و بحکمش متمسّک سلاطین مظاهر قدرت و رفعت و عظمت الهی بوده و هستند این مظلوم با احدی مداهنه ننموده کل بر این فقره شاهد و گواهند ولکن ملاحظهٔ شئون سلاطین من عند اللّه بوده و از کلمات انبیا و اولیا واضح و معلوم خدمت حضرت روح علیه السّلام عرض نمودند یا روح اللّه أ یجوز ان تعطی جزیة لقیصر ام لا قال بلی ما لقیصر لقیصر و ما للّه للّه منع نفرمودند و این دو کلمه یکی است نزد متبصّرین چه که ما لقیصر اگر من عند اللّه نبود نهی میفرمودند و همچنین در آیهٔ مبارکهٔ اطیعوا اللّه و اطیعوا الرّسول و اولی الأمر منکم مقصود از این اولو الأمر در مقام اوّل و رتبهٔ اولی ائمّه صلوات اللّه علیهم بوده و هستند ایشانند مظاهر قدرت و مصادر امر و مخازن علم و مطالع حکم الهی و در رتبهٔ ثانی و مقام ثانی ملوک و سلاطین بوده‌اند یعنى ملوکی که بنور عدلشان آفاق عالم منوّر و روشن است امید آنکه از حضرت سلطان نور عدلی اشراق نماید که جمیع احزاب امم را احاطه کند کل باید از حقّ از برایش بطلبند آنچه را که الیوم سزاوار است

Ḥāl bāyad Ḥaḍrat-e Solṭān, ḥafiẓahu Allāhu taʿālā, be-ʿenāyat va shafaqat bā īn ḥezb raftār farmāyand va īn Maẓlūm amām-e Kaʿbe-ye elāhī ʿahd mīnamāyad az īn ḥezb joz ṣedāqat va amānat amrī ẓāher nashavad ke moghāyer-e raʾy-e jahān-ārā-ye Ḥaḍrat-e Solṭānī bāshad. Har mellatī bāyad maqām-e solṭānash rā molāḥeẓe namāyad va dar ān khāḍeʿ bāshad va be-amrash ʿāmel va be-ḥokmash motamassek. Salāṭīn maẓāher-e qodrat va refʿat va ʿaẓamat-e elāhī būde va hastand. Īn Maẓlūm bā aḥadī modāhene nanemūde, koll bar īn faqare shāhed va govāhand, va lāken molāḥeẓe-ye shoʾūn-e salāṭīn min ʿindi Allāh būde va az kalemāt-e anbiyā va owliyā vāḍeḥ va maʿlūm. Khedmat-e Ḥaḍrat-e Rūḥ, ʿalayhi al-salām, ʿarḍ nemūdand: Yā Rūḥa Allāh, a-yajūzu an tuʿṭā jizyatun li-Qayṣar am lā? Qāla: Balā, mā li-Qayṣar li-Qayṣar wa-mā li-llāh li-llāh. Manʿ nafarmūdand va īn do kalame yekī ast nazd-e motabaṣṣerīn, che ke mā li-Qayṣar agar min ʿindi Allāh nabūd nahy mīfarmūdand. Va hamchenīn dar āye-ye mobārake-ye Aṭīʿū Allāha wa-aṭīʿū al-rasūla wa-ulī al-amri minkum, maqṣūd az īn ulū al-amr dar maqām-e avval va rotbe-ye ūlā aʾemme, ṣalawātu Allāhi ʿalayhim, būde va hastand. Īshānand maẓāher-e qodrat va maṣāder-e amr va makhāzen-e ʿelm va maṭāleʿ-e ḥekam-e elāhī va dar rotbe-ye thānī va maqām-e thānī molūk va salāṭīn būde-and, yaʿnī molūkī ke be-nūr-e ʿadles hān āfāq-e ʿālam monavvar va rowshan ast. Omīd ānke az Ḥaḍrat-e Solṭān nūr-e ʿadlī eshrāq namāyad ke jamīʿ-e aḥzāb-e omam rā eḥāṭe konad. Koll bāyad az Ḥaqq az barāyash beṭalaband ānche rā ke al-yawm sazāvār ast.

Now His Majesty the Shah—may God, exalted be He, protect him—should treat this community with kindness and compassion. This Wronged One pledges before the divine Kaaba that nothing but truthfulness and trustworthiness will appear from this community, and nothing contrary to His Majesty’s world-adorning judgment. Every nation should respect the station of its sovereign, submit to it, act according to his command, and adhere to his decree. Kings have been and remain manifestations of divine power, loftiness, and grandeur. This Wronged One has flattered no one; all bear witness and testify to this. Nevertheless, regard for the dignity of kings is ordained by God, as is clear and evident from the words of the Prophets and holy ones. The Spirit—peace be upon Him—was asked, “O Spirit of God, is it permissible to pay tribute to Caesar or not?” He said, “Yes. What belongs to Caesar is Caesar’s, and what belongs to God is God’s.” He did not forbid it. To those with insight, these two statements are one, for if what belonged to Caesar had not been from God, He would have forbidden it. Likewise, in the blessed verse, “Obey God, and obey the Messenger and those among you who hold authority,” those who hold authority have been and remain, in the first instance and foremost rank, the Imams—may God’s blessings rest upon them. They are the manifestations of power, the sources of command, the treasuries of knowledge, and the dawning places of divine wisdom. In the second rank and station, the reference has been to kings and sovereigns—that is, kings whose justice illumines and brightens the horizons of the world. It is hoped that a light of justice will shine from His Majesty the Shah and encompass all the peoples of the nations. Everyone should ask God to grant him what is fitting for this day.

144

الهی الهی و سیّدی و سندی و مقصودی و محبوبی اسألک بالأسرار الّتی کانت مکنونة فی علمک و بالآیات الّتی منها تضوّع عرف عنایتک و بأمواج بحر عطائک و سمآء فضلک و کرمک و بالدّمآء الّتی سفکت فی سبیلک و بالأکباد الّتی ذابت فی حبّک ان تؤیّد حضرة السّلطان بقدرتک و سلطانک لیظهر منه ما یکون باقیاً فی کتبک و صحفک و الواحک ای ربّ خذ یده بید اقتدارک و نوّره بنور معرفتک و زیّنه بطراز اخلاقک انّک انت المقتدر على ما تشآء و فی قبضتک زمام الأشیآء لا اله الّا انت الغفور الکریم

Ilāhī ilāhī wa-sayyidī wa-sanadī wa-maqṣūdī wa-maḥbūbī, asʾaluka bi-l-asrāri allatī kānat maknūnatan fī ʿilmika wa-bi-l-āyāti allatī minhā taḍawwaʿa ʿarfu ʿināyatika wa-bi-amwāji baḥri ʿaṭāʾika wa-samāʾi faḍlika wa-karamika wa-bi-l-dimāʾi allatī sufikat fī sabīlika wa-bi-l-akbādi allatī dhābat fī ḥubbika an tuʾayyida Ḥaḍrata al-Sulṭān bi-qudratika wa-sulṭānika li-yaẓhara minhu mā yakūnu bāqiyan fī kutubika wa-ṣuḥufika wa-alwāḥika. Ay Rabb, khudh yadahu bi-yadi iqtidārika wa-nawwirhu bi-nūri maʿrifatika wa-zayyinhu bi-ṭirāzi akhlāqika. Innaka anta al-Muqtadiru ʿalā mā tashāʾu wa-fī qabḍatika zimāmu al-ashyāʾ. Lā ilāha illā anta al-Ghafūru al-Karīm.

My God, my God, my Lord, my support, my desire, and my beloved! I ask You, by the mysteries concealed in Your knowledge, by the verses from which the fragrance of Your loving care has spread, by the waves of the ocean of Your bounty and the heaven of Your grace and generosity, by the blood shed in Your path, and by the hearts that have melted in love for You, to strengthen His Majesty the Shah through Your power and sovereignty, so that there may appear from him what will endure in Your books, Your scriptures, and Your Tablets. O Lord, take his hand with the hand of Your might, illumine him with the light of Your knowledge, and adorn him with the ornament of Your attributes. You have the power to do whatever You will, and the reins of all things are in Your grasp. There is no God but You, the Ever-Forgiving, the Generous.

145

حضرت بولس قدّیس در رسالهٔ باهل رومیّه نوشته لتخضع کلّ نفس للسّلاطین العالیة فانّه لا سلطان الّا من اللّه و السّلاطین الکائنة انّما رتّبها اللّه فمن یقاوم السّلطان فانّه یعاند ترتیب اللّه الی ان قال لأنّه خادم اللّه المنتقم الّذی ینفذ الغضب علی من یفعل الشّرّ میفرماید ظهور سلاطین و شوکت و اقتدارشان من عند اللّه بوده

Ḥaḍrat-e Būlos-e Qeddīs dar resāle-ye be-ahl-e Rūmiyye neveshte: Li-takhḍaʿ kullu nafsin li-l-salāṭīni al-ʿāliyati fa-innahu lā sulṭāna illā min Allāhi wa-l-salāṭīnu al-kāʾinatu innamā rattabahā Allāhu fa-man yuqāwimu al-sulṭāna fa-innahu yuʿānidu tartība Allāh. Ilā an qāla: Li-annahu khādimu Allāhi al-muntaqimu alladhī yunfidh u al-ghaḍaba ʿalā man yafʿalu al-sharr. Mīfarmāyad ẓohūr-e salāṭīn va showkat va eqtedāreshān min ʿindi Allāh būde.

Saint Paul wrote in his Epistle to the Romans, “Let every soul submit to the higher authorities, for there is no authority except from God, and the existing authorities have been established by God. Whoever resists authority therefore opposes God’s ordering.” He goes on to say, “For he is God’s servant, the avenger who executes wrath upon the evildoer.” He states that the rise of sovereigns, and their majesty and power, are from God.

146

در احادیث قبل هم ذکر شده آنچه که علما دیده و شنیده‌اند نسأل اللّه تبارک و تعالی ان یؤیّدک یا شیخ علی التّمسّک بما نزّل من سمآء عطآء اللّه ربّ العالمین علما باید با حضرت سلطان متّحد شوند و بآنچه سبب حفظ و حراست و نعمت و ثروت عباد است تمسّک نمایند سلطان عادل عنداللّه اقربست از کل یشهد بذلک من ینطق فی السّجن الأعظم اللّه لا اله الّا هو الفرد الواحد المقتدر العلیم الحکیم

Dar aḥādīth-e qabl ham dhekr shode ānche ke ʿolamā dīde va shenīde-and. Nasʾalu Allāha tabāraka wa-taʿālā an yuʾayyidaka yā Shaykh ʿalā al-tamassuki bi-mā nuzzila min samāʾi ʿaṭāʾi Allāhi Rabbi al-ʿālamīn. ʿOlamā bāyad bā Ḥaḍrat-e Solṭān mottaḥed shavand va be-ānche sabab-e ḥefẓ va ḥerāsat va neʿmat va thervat-e ʿebād ast tamassok namāyand. Solṭān-e ʿādel ʿinda Allāh aqrab ast az koll. Yashhadu bi-dhālika man yanṭiqu fī al-Sijni al-Aʿẓam. Allāhu lā ilāha illā huwa al-Fardu al-Wāḥidu al-Muqtadiru al-ʿAlīmu al-Ḥakīm.

The traditions of the past also contain statements that the religious scholars have seen and heard. We ask God, blessed and exalted be He, to help you, O Shaykh, to hold fast to what has been sent down from the heaven of the bounty of God, the Lord of the worlds. The religious scholars should unite with His Majesty the Shah and hold fast to what ensures the protection, security, welfare, and prosperity of the people. A just sovereign is nearer to God than anyone else. He who speaks in the Most Great Prison bears witness to this. God—there is no God but Him, the Unique, the One, the All-Powerful, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.

147

اگر آن جناب یک ساعت لوجه اللّه در اموری که از قبل و بعد ظاهر شده تفکّر فرمایند از ما عنده به ما عند اللّه توجّه نمایند و سبب اعلاء کلمة اللّه گردند آیا از اوّل ابداع الی حین از مشرق ارادهٔ الهی نوری و یا ظهوری اشراق نموده که قبائل ارض او را قبول نموده و امرش را پذیرفته‌اند آن که بوده و اسمش چه از حضرت خاتم روح ما سواه فداه و من قبله حضرت روح الی ان ینتهی الی البدیع الأوّل در احیان ظهور کل مبتلا بوده‌اند بعضی را مجنون گفته‌اند و برخی را کذّاب نامیده‌اند و عمل نموده‌اند آنچه را که قلم حیا میکند از ذکرش لعمر اللّه ورد علیهم ما ناحت به الأشیآء کلّها ولکنّ القوم اکثرهم فی جهل مبین نسأل اللّه ان یؤیّدهم علی الرّجوع الیه و الانابة لدی باب رحمته انّه علی کلّ شیء قدیر

Agar ān janāb yek sāʿat li-wajhi Allāh dar omūrī ke az qabl va baʿd ẓāher shode tafakkor farmāyand, az mā ʿindahu be mā ʿinda Allāh tavajjoh namāyand va sabab-e eʿlā-ye Kalimat Allāh gardand. Āyā az avval-e ebdāʿ ilā ḥīn az mashreq-e erāde-ye elāhī nūrī va yā ẓohūrī eshrāq nemūde ke qabāʾel-e arḍ ū rā qabūl nemūde va amrash rā padhīrofte-and? Ān ke būde va esmash che? Az Ḥaḍrat-e Khātam, rūḥu mā siwāhu fidāhu, va min qablihi Ḥaḍrat-e Rūḥ ilā an yantahiya ilā al-Badīʿ al-Awwal, dar aḥyān-e ẓohūr koll mobtalā būde-and. Baʿḍī rā majnūn gofte-and va barkhī rā kadhdhāb nāmīde-and va ʿamal nemūde-and ānche rā ke qalam ḥayā mīkonad az dhekrash. La-ʿamru Allāh, warada ʿalayhim mā nāḥat bihi al-ashyāʾu kulluhā wa-lākinna al-qawma aktharuhum fī jahlin mubīn. Nasʾalu Allāha an yuʾayyidahum ʿalā al-rujūʿi ilayhi wa-l-inābati ladā bābi raḥmatihi. Innahu ʿalā kulli shayʾin qadīr.

If you were to reflect for one hour, for God’s sake, on the events that have occurred in the past and more recently, you would turn from what you possess toward what is with God and become a means of exalting the Word of God. From the beginning of creation until now, has any light or revelation shone from the dawning place of the divine will whose bearer the peoples of the earth accepted and whose Cause they embraced? Who was he, and what was his name? From the Seal—may the souls of all others be sacrificed for Him—and, before Him, the Spirit, back to the Primal Originator, all suffered affliction at the time of their appearance. Some were called madmen, and others were named liars, and things were done that the pen is ashamed to mention. By the life of God, what befell them caused all things to lament, yet most of the people are in manifest ignorance. We ask God to help them return to Him and turn in repentance at the gate of His mercy. He has power over all things.

148

فی هذا الحین ارتفع صریر قلمی الأعلی و قال وصّ حضرة الشّیخ بما وصّیت به احد اغصانک لعلّ نفحات البیان تجذبه و تقرّبه الی اللّه ربّ العالمین

Fī hādhā al-ḥīn irtafaʿa ṣarīru qalamī al-Aʿlā wa-qāla: Waṣṣi Ḥaḍrata al-Shaykh bi-mā waṣṣayta bihi aḥada Aghṣānika laʿalla nafaḥāti al-bayāni tajdhubuhu wa-tuqarribuhu ilā Allāhi Rabbi al-ʿālamīn.

At this moment the sound of My Most Exalted Pen arose, and it said, “Counsel the honored Shaykh with the counsel You gave to one of Your Branches, so that the breezes of utterance may attract him and draw him near to God, the Lord of the worlds.”

149

کن فی النّعمة منفقاً و فی فقدها شاکرا ً و فی الحقوق امیناً و فی الوجه طلقاً و للفقرآء کنزاً و للأغنیآء ناصحاً و للمنادی مجیباً و فی الوعد وفیّاً و فی الأمور منصفاً و فی الجمع صامتاً و فی القضآء عادلاً و للانسان خاضعاً و فی الظّلمة سراجاً و للمهموم فرجاً و للظّمآن بحراً و للمکروب ملجأً و للمظلوم ناصراً و عضداً و ظهراً و فی الأعمال متّقیاً و للغریب وطناً و للمریض شفآءً و للمستجیر حصناً و للضّریر بصراً و لمن ضلّ صراطاً و لوجه الصّدق جمالاً و لهیکل الأمانة طرازاً و لبیت الأخلاق عرشاً و لجسد العالم روحاً و لجند العدل رایةً و لأفق الخیر نوراً و للأرض الطّیّبة رذاذاً و لبحر العلم فلکاً و لسمآء الکرم شمساً و لرأس الحکمة اکلیلاً و لجبین الدّهر بیاضاً و لشجر الخضوع ثمراً نسأل اللّه ان یحفظک من حرارة الحقد و صبارّة البرد انّه قریب مجیب کذلک نطق لسانی لأحد اغصانی و ذکرناه لأحبّائی الّذین نبذوا الأوهام و اخذوا ما امروا به فی یوم فیه اشرقت شمس الایقان من افق ارادة اللّه ربّ العالمین هذا یوم فیه غرّدت طیر البیان علی الأغصان باسم ربّها الرّحمن طوبی لمن طار بأجنحة الاشتیاق الی اللّه مالک یوم التّلاق

Kun fī al-niʿmati munfiqan wa-fī faqdihā shākiran wa-fī al-ḥuqūqi amīnan wa-fī al-wajhi ṭalqan wa-li-l-fuqarāʾi kanzan wa-li-l-aghniyāʾi nāṣiḥan wa-li-l-munādī mujīban wa-fī al-waʿdi wafiyyan wa-fī al-umūri munṣifan wa-fī al-jamʿi ṣāmitan wa-fī al-qaḍāʾi ʿādilan wa-li-l-insāni khāḍiʿan wa-fī al-ẓulmati sirājan wa-li-l-mahmūmi farajan wa-li-l-ẓamʾāni baḥran wa-li-l-makrūbi maljaʾan wa-li-l-maẓlūmi nāṣiran wa-ʿaḍudan wa-ẓahran wa-fī al-aʿmāli muttaqiyan wa-li-l-gharībi waṭanan wa-li-l-marīḍi shifāʾan wa-li-l-mustajīri ḥiṣnan wa-li-l-ḍarīri baṣaran wa-li-man ḍalla ṣirāṭan wa-li-wajhi al-ṣidqi jamālan wa-li-haykali al-amānati ṭirāzan wa-li-bayti al-akhlāqi ʿarshan wa-li-jasadi al-ʿālami rūḥan wa-li-jundi al-ʿadli rāyatan wa-li-ufuqi al-khayri nūran wa-li-l-arḍi al-ṭayyibati radhādhan wa-li-baḥri al-ʿilmi fulkan wa-li-samāʾi al-karami shamsan wa-li-raʾsi al-ḥikmati iklīlan wa-li-jabīni al-dahri bayāḍan wa-li-shajari al-khuḍūʿi thamaran. Nasʾalu Allāha an yaḥfaẓaka min ḥarārati al-ḥiqdi wa-ṣabbārrati al-bard. Innahu qarībun mujīb. Kadhālika naṭaqa lisānī li-aḥadi Aghṣānī wa-dhakarnāhu li-aḥibbāʾī alladhīna nabadhū al-awhāma wa-akhadhū mā umirū bihi fī yawmin fīhi ashraqat shamsu al-īqāni min ufuqi irādati Allāhi Rabbi al-ʿālamīn. Hādhā yawmun fīhi gharradat ṭayru al-bayāni ʿalā al-Aghṣāni bi-smi rabbihā al-Raḥmān. Ṭūbā li-man ṭāra bi-ajniḥati al-ishtiyāqi ilā Allāhi Māliki yawmi al-talāq.

Be generous in prosperity and thankful when it is absent; trustworthy in respecting others’ rights, cheerful in countenance, a treasure to the poor, a counselor to the rich, responsive to the caller, faithful to your promises, fair in your dealings, silent in gatherings, just in judgment, humble toward others, a lamp in darkness, a relief to the sorrowful, an ocean to the thirsty, a refuge to the distressed, a helper, a support, and a defender to the wronged, upright in your deeds, a home to the stranger, a cure to the sick, a fortress to those seeking shelter, sight to the blind, a path to those who have strayed, beauty to the face of truthfulness, an ornament to the form of trustworthiness, a throne to the house of virtue, a spirit to the body of the world, a banner to the army of justice, a light to the horizon of goodness, gentle rain to fertile soil, a ship upon the ocean of knowledge, a sun in the heaven of generosity, a crown upon the head of wisdom, radiance upon the brow of time, and fruit upon the tree of humility. We ask God to protect you from the heat of malice and the bitter cold. He is near and answers prayers. Thus My tongue spoke to one of My Branches, and We have recounted it for My loved ones who have cast aside vain imaginings and embraced what they were commanded on a day when the sun of certitude shone from the horizon of the will of God, the Lord of the worlds. This is a day when the birds of utterance have sung upon the Branches in the name of their Lord, the All-Merciful. Blessed is the one who has flown on the wings of longing toward God, the Lord of the Day of Meeting.

150

حقّ آگاه و معشر امنا گواه که این مظلوم لازال تحت خطر عظیم بوده و لو لا البلایا فی سبیل اللّه ما لذّ لی بقائی و ما نفعنی حیوتی و لا یخفی علی اهل البصر و النّاظرین الی المنظر الأکبر بأنّی فی اکثر ایّامی کنت کعبد جالس تحت سیف علّق بخیط واحد و لا یدری متی ینزل أ ینزل فی الحین او بعد حین و فی کلّ ذلک نشکر اللّه ربّ العالمین و لسان سرّ در لیالی و ایّام باین مناجات ناطق سبحانک یا الهى لو لا البلایا فی سبیلک من این یظهر مقام عاشقیک و لو لا الرّزایا فی حبّک بأیّ شیء یثبت شأن مشتاقیک وعزّتک انیس محبّیک دموع عیونهم و مؤنس مریدیک زفرات قلوبهم و غذآء قاصدیک قطعات اکبادهم و ما الذّ سمّ الرّدی فی سبیلک و ما اعزّ سهام الأعدآء لاعلآء کلمتک یا الهی و سیّدی اشربنی فی امرک ما اردته و انزل علیّ فی حبّک ما قدّرته وعزّتک لا ارید الّا ما ترید و لا احبّ الّا ما انت تحبّ توکّلت علیک فی کلّ الأحوال انّک انت الغنیّ المتعال اسألک یا الهی ان تظهر لنصرة هذا الظّهور من کان قابلاً لاسمک و سلطانک لیذکرک بین خلقک و یرفع اعلام نصرک فی مملکتک و یزیّنهم بأخلاقک و اوامرک لا اله الّا انت المهیمن القیّوم

Ḥaqq āgāh va maʿshar-e omanā govāh ke īn Maẓlūm lāzāl taḥt-e khaṭar-e ʿaẓīm būde. Wa-law lā al-balāyā fī sabīli Allāhi mā ladhdha lī baqāʾī wa-mā nafaʿanī ḥayātī. Wa-lā yakhfā ʿalā ahli al-baṣari wa-l-nāẓirīna ilā al-Manẓari al-Akbar bi-annī fī akthari ayyāmī kuntu ka-ʿabdin jālisin taḥta sayfin ʿulliqa bi-khayṭin wāḥidin wa-lā yadrī matā yanzilu, a-yanzilu fī al-ḥīni aw baʿda ḥīn. Wa-fī kulli dhālika nashkuru Allāha Rabba al-ʿālamīn. Va lesān-e serr dar layālī va ayyām be-īn monājāt nāṭeq: Subḥānaka yā ilāhī, law lā al-balāyā fī sabīlika min ayna yaẓharu maqāmu ʿāshiqīka wa-law lā al-razāyā fī ḥubbika bi-ayyi shayʾin yathbutu shaʾnu mushtāqīk? Wa-ʿizzatika, anīsu muḥibbīka dumūʿu ʿuyūnihim wa-muʾnisu murīdīka zafarātu qulūbihim wa-ghidhāʾu qāṣidīka qiṭaʿātu akbādihim. Wa-mā aladhdha samma al-radā fī sabīlika wa-mā aʿazza sihāma al-aʿdāʾi li-iʿlāʾi kalimatik. Yā ilāhī wa-sayyidī, ashribnī fī amrika mā aradtahu wa-anzil ʿalayya fī ḥubbika mā qaddartahu. Wa-ʿizzatika, lā urīdu illā mā turīdu wa-lā uḥibbu illā mā anta tuḥibb. Tawakkaltu ʿalayka fī kulli al-aḥwāl. Innaka anta al-Ghaniyyu al-Mutaʿāl. Asʾaluka yā ilāhī an tuẓhira li-nuṣrati hādhā al-ẓuhūri man kāna qābilan li-smika wa-sulṭānika li-yadhkuraka bayna khalqika wa-yarfaʿa aʿlāma naṣrika fī mamlakatika wa-yuzayyinahum bi-akhlāqika wa-awāmirika. Lā ilāha illā anta al-Muhayminu al-Qayyūm.

God knows, and the company of the trustworthy bears witness, that this Wronged One has always been in grave danger. Were it not for afflictions in the path of God, My continued existence would bring Me no pleasure and My life would be of no benefit to Me. It is not hidden from those with insight and those who gaze toward the Most Great Vision that, for most of My days, I have been like a servant seated beneath a sword suspended by a single thread, not knowing when it will fall—whether at once or after a time. Through all this, We thank God, the Lord of the worlds. And day and night My inmost tongue utters this prayer: “Glory be to You, my God! Were it not for afflictions in Your path, how would the station of Your lovers be revealed? Were it not for calamities suffered out of love for You, how would the rank of those who long for You be established? By Your might, the companions of those who love You are the tears of their eyes; the comfort of those devoted to You is the sighing of their hearts; and the food of those who seek You is the fragments of their own hearts. How sweet is the poison of death in Your path, and how precious the arrows of enemies when borne to exalt Your Word! My God and my Lord, give Me to drink in Your Cause whatever You have willed, and send down upon Me, in love for You, whatever You have ordained. By Your might, I desire only what You desire, and love only what You love. In every circumstance I have placed My trust in You. You are the Self-Sufficient, the Most Exalted. I ask You, my God, to raise up in support of this Revelation someone worthy of Your name and Your sovereignty, that he may remember You among Your creatures, raise the banners of Your victory in Your kingdom, and adorn them with Your attributes and Your commandments. There is no God but You, the All-Protecting, the Self-Subsisting.”

151

عند ذلک ارتفع ندآء الفطرة مرّة بعد مرّة نادت و قالت یا ملأ الأرض تاللّه انّی لفطرة اللّه بینکم ایّاکم ان تنکرونی قد اظهرنی اللّه بنور احاط علی من فی السّموات و الأرضین انصفوا یا قوم فی ظهوری و بروزی و اشراقی و لا تکونوا من الظّالمین

ʿInda dhālika irtafaʿa nidāʾu al-fiṭrati marratan baʿda marratin, nādat wa-qālat: Yā malaʾa al-arḍ, ta-Allāhi innī la-fiṭratu Allāhi baynakum, iyyākum an tunkirūnī. Qad aẓharanī Allāhu bi-nūrin aḥāṭa ʿalā man fī al-samāwāti wa-l-araḍīn. Anṣifū yā qawmi fī ẓuhūrī wa-burūzī wa-ishrāqī wa-lā takūnū min al-ẓālimīn.

At that moment the call of the innate nature rose again and again, crying out and saying, “O peoples of the earth! By God, I am God’s innate nature among you. Beware of denying Me. God has made Me manifest with a light that has encompassed all who are in the heavens and the earth. Judge fairly, O people, concerning My manifestation, My emergence, and My radiance, and do not be among the unjust.”

152

یا شیخ انّ المظلوم یسأل اللّه تبارک و تعالی ان یجعلک فاتح باب الانصاف و یظهر بک امره بین العباد انّه هو المقتدر العزیز الوهّاب

Yā Shaykh, inna al-Maẓlūma yasʾalu Allāha tabāraka wa-taʿālā an yajʿalaka fātiḥa bābi al-inṣāfi wa-yuẓhira bika amrahu bayna al-ʿibād. Innahu huwa al-Muqtadiru al-ʿAzīzu al-Wahhāb.

O Shaykh, this Wronged One asks God, blessed and exalted be He, to make you an opener of the gate of fairness and to manifest His Cause through you among His servants. He is the All-Powerful, the Almighty, the Ever-Bestowing.

153

یا شیخ از حقّ بطلب آذان و ابصار و افئدهٔ عالم را مقدّس فرماید و از هوای نفس حفظ نماید چه که غرض مرضیست بزرگ انسان را از عرفان حضرت موجود محروم مینماید و از تجلّیات انوار نیّر ایقان ممنوع میسازد از فضل و رحمت الهی سائل و آمل که این مانع اکبر را از میان بردارد انّه هو القویّ الغالب القدیر

Yā Shaykh, az Ḥaqq beṭalab ādhān va abṣār va afʾede-ye ʿālam rā moqaddas farmāyad va az havā-ye nafs ḥefẓ namāyad, che ke gharaḍ maraḍīst bozorg, ensān rā az ʿerfān-e Ḥażrat-e Mawjūd maḥrūm mīnamāyad va az tajallīyāt-e anvār-e nayyer-e īqān mamnūʿ mīsāzad. Az fażl va raḥmat-e elāhī sāʾel va āmel ke īn māneʿ-e akbar rā az miyān bardārad. Innahu huwa al-Qawī al-Ghālib al-Qadīr.

O Shaykh, ask God to sanctify the ears, eyes, and hearts of the world and protect them from selfish desire, for prejudice is a grave disease: it deprives people of the recognition of the Lord of Being and bars them from the radiance of the light of the sun of certitude. We ask and hope, through divine grace and mercy, that He will remove this greatest obstacle. He is indeed the Strong, the All-Subduing, the All-Powerful.

154

فی هذا الحین ارتفع النّدآء عن یمین البقعة النّورآء اللّه لا اله الّا هو الآمر الحکیم الق علی الشّیخ بقیّة لوح البرهان لیجذبه الی افق ظهور ربّه الرّحمن لعلّه یقوم علی نصرة الأمر بآیات محکمات و براهین عالیات و ینطق بین العباد بما نطق به لسان البرهان الملک للّه ربّ العالمین

Fī hādhā al-ḥīn irtafaʿa al-nidāʾ ʿan yamīn al-buqʿa al-nawrāʾ: Allāh, lā ilāha illā huwa al-Āmir al-Ḥakīm. Alqi ʿalā al-Shaykh baqiyyat Lawḥ al-Burhān li-yajdhibahu ilā ufuq ẓuhūr rabbihi al-Raḥmān, laʿallahu yaqūm ʿalā nuṣrat al-Amr bi-āyāt muḥkamāt wa-barāhīn ʿāliyāt wa-yanṭiq bayna al-ʿibād bi-mā naṭaqa bihi lisān al-burhān: al-mulk li-llāh rabb al-ʿālamīn.

At this moment the call rose from the right side of the luminous Spot: “God—there is no god but Him, the Ordainer, the All-Wise. Recite to the Shaykh the remainder of the Tablet of the Proof, that it may draw him toward the horizon of the revelation of his Lord, the All-Merciful. Perhaps he will arise to champion the Cause with conclusive verses and lofty proofs, and proclaim among the servants what the tongue of proof has proclaimed: ‘Sovereignty belongs to God, the Lord of all worlds.’”

155

اقرأ کتاب الایقان و ما انزله الرّحمن لملک باریس و امثاله لتطّلع بما قضی من قبل و توقن بأنّا ما اردنا الفساد فی الأرض بعد اصلاحها انّما نذکّر العباد خالصاً لوجه اللّه من شآء فلیقبل و من شآء فلیعرض انّ ربّنا الرّحمن لهو الغنیّ الحمید یا معشر الأحزاب هذا یوم لا ینفعکم شیء من الأشیآء و لا اسم من الأسمآء الّا بهذا الاسم الّذى جعله اللّه مظهر امره و مطلع اسمائه الحسنی لمن فی ملکوت الانشآء نعیماً لمن وجد عرف الرّحمن و کان من الرّاسخین و لا یغنیکم الیوم علومکم و فنونکم و لا زخارفکم و عزّکم دعوا الکلّ ورائکم مقبلین الی الکلمة العلیا الّتی بها فصّلت الزّبر و الصّحف و هذا الکتاب المبین یا قوم ضعوا ما الّفتموه من قلم الظّنون و الأوهام تاللّه قد اشرقت شمس العلم من افق الیقین

Iqraʾ Kitāb al-Īqān wa-mā anzalahu al-Raḥmān li-malik Bārīs wa-amthālihi li-taṭṭaliʿa bi-mā quḍiya min qabl wa-tūqina bi-annā mā aradnā al-fasād fī al-arḍ baʿda iṣlāḥihā. Innamā nudhakkir al-ʿibād khāliṣan li-wajh Allāh. Man shāʾa fa-l-yuqbil wa-man shāʾa fa-l-yuʿriḍ. Inna rabbanā al-Raḥmān la-huwa al-Ghanī al-Ḥamīd. Yā maʿshar al-aḥzāb, hādhā yawm lā yanfaʿukum shayʾ min al-ashyāʾ wa-lā ism min al-asmāʾ illā bi-hādhā al-ism alladhī jaʿalahu Allāh maẓhar amrihi wa-maṭlaʿ asmāʾihi al-ḥusnā li-man fī malakūt al-inshāʾ. Naʿīman li-man wajada ʿarf al-Raḥmān wa-kāna min al-rāsikhīn. Wa-lā yughnīkum al-yawm ʿulūmukum wa-funūnukum wa-lā zakhārifukum wa-ʿizzukum. Daʿū al-kull warāʾakum muqbilīn ilā al-kalima al-ʿulyā allatī bihā fuṣṣilat al-zubur wa-l-ṣuḥuf wa-hādhā al-kitāb al-mubīn. Yā qawm, ḍaʿū mā allaftumūhu min qalam al-ẓunūn wa-l-awhām. Ta-llāh, qad ashraqat shams al-ʿilm min ufuq al-yaqīn.

Read the Book of Certitude and what the All-Merciful revealed to the King of Paris and others like him, so that you may learn what was decreed before and be certain that We have not sought to spread corruption on earth after it has been set right. We admonish the servants solely for the sake of God. Let whoever wishes turn toward Him, and whoever wishes turn away. Our Lord, the All-Merciful, is indeed the Self-Sufficient, the Praiseworthy. O assemblage of contending parties, this is a day when nothing whatsoever, and no name among all names, will benefit you except through this Name, which God has made the manifestation of His Cause and the dawning place of His most beautiful names for all in the kingdom of creation. Blessed is the one who has perceived the fragrance of the All-Merciful and remained steadfast. Today neither your learning and arts nor your finery and prestige will avail you. Leave everything behind, turning toward the Most Exalted Word, through which the scriptures, the scrolls, and this clear Book have been set forth in detail. O people, set aside what you have composed with the pen of conjecture and vain imaginings. By God, the sun of knowledge has risen from the horizon of certainty.

156

یا ایّها الغافل ان کنت فی ریب ممّا نحن علیه انّا نشهد بما شهد اللّه قبل خلق السّموات و الأرض انّه لا اله الّا هو العزیز الوهّاب و نشهد انّه کان واحداً فی ذاته و واحداً فی صفاته لم یکن له شبه فی الابداع و لا شریک فی الاختراع قد ارسل الرّسل و انزل الکتب لیبشّروا الخلق الی سوآء الصّراط

Yā ayyuhā al-ghāfil, in kunta fī rayb mimmā naḥnu ʿalayhi, innā nashhadu bi-mā shahida Allāh qabla khalq al-samāwāt wa-l-arḍ: innahu lā ilāha illā huwa al-ʿAzīz al-Wahhāb. Wa-nashhadu annahu kāna wāḥidan fī dhātihi wa-wāḥidan fī ṣifātihi. Lam yakun lahu shibh fī al-ibdāʿ wa-lā sharīk fī al-ikhtirāʿ. Qad arsala al-rusul wa-anzala al-kutub li-yubashshirū al-khalq ilā sawāʾ al-ṣirāṭ.

O heedless one, if you doubt what We profess, We testify to what God testified before the creation of the heavens and the earth: there is no god but Him, the Almighty, the Ever-Bestowing. And We testify that He has ever been one in His essence and one in His attributes. He has no likeness in creation and no partner in bringing things into being. He sent the Messengers and revealed the Books to bring creation glad tidings of the straight path.

157

هل السّلطان اطّلع و غضّ الطّرف عن فعلک ام اخذه الرّعب بما عوت شرذمة من الذّئاب الّذین نبذوا صراط اللّه ورائهم و اخذوا سبیلک من دون بیّنة و لا کتاب انّا سمعنا بأنّ ممالک الایران تزیّنت بطراز العدل فلمّا تفرّسنا وجدناها مطالع الظّلم و مشارق الاعتساف انّا نری العدل تحت مخالب الظّلم نسأل اللّه ان یخلّصه بقوّة من عنده و سلطان من لدنه انّه هو المهیمن على من فی الأرضین و السّموات لیس لأحد ان یعترض علی نفس فیما ورد علی امر اللّه ینبغی لکلّ من توجّه الی الأفق الأعلی ان یتمسّک بحبل الاصطبار و یتوکّل علی اللّه المهیمن المختار یا احبّآء اللّه اشربوا من عین الحکمة و طیروا فی هوا الحکمة و تکلّموا بالحکمة و البیان کذلک یأمرکم ربّکم العزیز العلّام

Hal al-sulṭān iṭṭalaʿa wa-ghaḍḍa al-ṭarf ʿan fiʿlika am akhadhahu al-ruʿb bi-mā ʿawat shirdhima min al-dhiʾāb alladhīna nabadhū ṣirāṭ Allāh warāʾahum wa-akhadhū sabīlaka min dūn bayyina wa-lā kitāb? Innā samiʿnā bi-anna mamālik al-Īrān tazayyanat bi-ṭirāz al-ʿadl, fa-lammā tafarrasnā wajadnāhā maṭāliʿ al-ẓulm wa-mashāriq al-iʿtisāf. Innā narā al-ʿadl taḥta makhālib al-ẓulm. Nasʾal Allāh an yukhalliṣahu bi-quwwa min ʿindihi wa-sulṭān min ladunhu. Innahu huwa al-Muhaymin ʿalā man fī al-arḍīn wa-l-samāwāt. Laysa li-aḥad an yaʿtariḍa ʿalā nafs fī-mā warada ʿalā amr Allāh. Yanbaghī li-kull man tawajjaha ilā al-ufuq al-aʿlā an yatamassaka bi-ḥabl al-iṣṭibār wa-yatawakkala ʿalā Allāh al-Muhaymin al-Mukhtār. Yā aḥibbāʾ Allāh, ishrabū min ʿayn al-ḥikma wa-ṭīrū fī hawā al-ḥikma wa-takallamū bi-l-ḥikma wa-l-bayān. Kadhālika yaʾmurukum rabbukum al-ʿAzīz al-ʿAllām.

Has the sovereign learned of your deed and turned a blind eye to it, or has terror seized him at the howling of a band of wolves who have cast the path of God behind them and followed your way without any evidence or Book? We heard that the realms of Iran were adorned with the ornament of justice, but when We examined them closely, We found them to be the dawning places of oppression and the sources of tyranny. We see justice beneath the claws of oppression. We ask God to deliver it through strength from Him and authority from His presence. He is indeed the Guardian over all who are in the earth and the heavens. No one is entitled to object to any person over what has befallen the Cause of God. Everyone who has turned toward the Most Exalted Horizon should hold fast to the cord of patient endurance and put their trust in God, the Guardian, who acts as He chooses. O loved ones of God, drink from the spring of wisdom, soar in the air of wisdom, and speak with wisdom and eloquence. Thus your Lord, the Almighty, the All-Knowing, commands you.

158

یا غافل لا تطمئنّ بعزّک و اقتدارک مثلک کمثل بقیّة اثر الشّمس علی رؤوس الجبال سوف یدرکها الزّوال من لدی اللّه الغنیّ المتعال قد اخذ عزّک و عزّ امثالک و هذا ما حکم به من عنده امّ الألواح این من حارب اللّه و این من جادل بآیاته و این من اعرض عن سلطانه و این الّذین قتلوا اصفیائه و سفکوا دمآء اولیائه تفکّر لعلّ تجد نفحات اعمالک یا ایّها الجاهل المرتاب بکم ناح الرّسول و صاحت البتول و خربت الدّیار و اخذت الظّلمة کلّ الأقطار یا معشر العلمآء بکم انحطّ شأن الملّة و نکس علم الاسلام و ثلّ عرشه العظیم کلّما اراد ممیّز ان یتمسّک بما یرتفع به شأن الاسلام ارتفعت ضوضائکم بذلک منع عمّا اراد و بقی الملک فی خسران کبیر

Yā ghāfil, lā taṭmaʾinna bi-ʿizzika wa-iqtidārika. Mathaluka ka-mathal baqiyyat athar al-shams ʿalā ruʾūs al-jibāl, sawfa yudrikuhā al-zawāl min ladā Allāh al-Ghanī al-Mutaʿāl. Qad ukhidha ʿizzuka wa-ʿizz amthālika, wa-hādhā mā ḥakama bihi man ʿindahu Umm al-Alwāḥ. Ayna man ḥāraba Allāh, wa-ayna man jādala bi-āyātihi, wa-ayna man aʿraḍa ʿan sulṭānihi, wa-ayna alladhīna qatalū aṣfiyāʾahu wa-safakū dimāʾ awliyāʾihi? Tafakkar laʿalla tajida nafaḥāt aʿmālika, yā ayyuhā al-jāhil al-murtāb. Bikum nāḥa al-Rasūl wa-ṣāḥat al-Batūl wa-kharibat al-diyār wa-akhadhat al-ẓulma kull al-aqṭār. Yā maʿshar al-ʿulamāʾ, bikum inḥaṭṭa shaʾn al-milla wa-nukkisa ʿalam al-Islām wa-thulla ʿarshuhu al-ʿaẓīm. Kullamā arāda mumayyiz an yatamassaka bi-mā yartafiʿu bihi shaʾn al-Islām irtafaʿat ḍawḍāʾukum. Bi-dhālika muniʿa ʿammā arāda wa-baqiya al-mulk fī khusrān kabīr.

O heedless one, do not rest secure in your glory and power. You are like the last trace of sunlight on the mountaintops; it will soon fade away at the bidding of God, the Self-Sufficient, the Most Exalted. Your glory and the glory of those like you have been taken away. This is what He with whom is the Mother of Tablets has decreed. Where is the one who waged war against God? Where is the one who disputed His signs? Where is the one who turned away from His sovereignty? And where are those who killed His chosen ones and shed the blood of His loved ones? Reflect, so that you may perhaps perceive the scent of your deeds, O ignorant and doubting one. Because of you the Messenger lamented, the Chaste One cried out, homes were laid waste, and darkness overtook every region. O assemblage of religious scholars, because of you the standing of the faith has declined, the banner of Islam has been lowered, and its mighty throne has been overthrown. Whenever a discerning person sought to hold fast to something that would exalt the standing of Islam, your clamor arose. Thus he was prevented from carrying out his purpose, and the realm remained in grievous loss.

159

یا قلمی الأعلی اذکر الرّقشآء الّتی بظلمها ناحت الأشیآء و ارتعدت فرائص الأولیآء کذلک یأمرک مالک الأسمآء فی هذا المقام المحمود قد صاحت من ظلمک البتول و تظنّ انّک من آل الرّسول کذلک سوّلت لک نفسک یا ایّها المعرض عن اللّه ربّ ما کان و ما یکون انصفی یا ایّتها الرّقشآء بأیّ جرم لدغت ابنآء الرّسول و نهبت اموالهم أ کفرت بالّذی خلقک بأمره کن فیکون قد فعلت بأبنآء الرّسول ما لا فعلت عاد و ثمود بصالِح و هود و لا الیهود بروح اللّه مالک الوجود أ تنکر آیات ربّک الّتی اذ نزّلت من سمآء الأمر خضعت لها کتب العالم کلّها تفکّر لتطّلع بفعلک یا ایّها الغافل المردود سوف تأخذک نفحات العذاب کما اخذت قوماً قبلک انتظر یا ایّها المشرک باللّه مالک الغیب و الشّهود هذا یوم اخبر به اللّه بلسان رسوله تفکّر لتعرف ما انزله الرّحمن فی الفرقان و فی هذا اللّوح المسطور هذا یوم فیه اتی مشرق الوحی بآیات بیّنات الّتی عجز عن احصائها المحصون هذا یوم فیه وجد کلّ ذی شمّ عرف نسمة الرّحمن فی الامکان و سرع کلّ ذی بصر الی فرات رحمة ربّه مالک الملوک یا ایّها الغافل تاللّه قد رجع حدیث الذّبح و الذّبیح توجّه الی مقرّ الفدآء و ما رجع بما اکتسبت یدک یا ایّها المبغض العنود أ ظننت بالشّهادة ینحطّ شأن الأمر لا والّذى جعله اللّه مهبط الوحی ان انت من الّذین هم یفقهون ویل لک یا ایّها المشرک باللّه و للّذین اتّخذوک اماماً لأنفسهم من دون بیّنة و لا کتاب مشهود کم من ظالم قام علی اطفآء نور اللّه قبلک و کم من فاجر قتل و نهب الی ان ناحت من ظلمه الأفئدة و النّفوس قد غابت شمس العدل بما استوی هیکل الظّلم علی اریکة البغضآء ولکنّ القوم هم لا یشعرون یا جاهل قد قتلت ابنآء الرّسول و نهبت اموالهم قل هل الأموال کفرت باللّه ام مالکها على زعمک انصف یا ایّها الجاهل المحجوب قد اخذت الاعتساف و نبذت الانصاف بذلک ناحت الأشیآء و انت من الغافلین قد قتلت الکبیر و نهبت الصّغیر هل تظنّ انّک تأکل ما جمعته بالظّلم لا ونفسی کذلک یخبرک الخبیر تاللّه لا یغنیک ما عندک و ما جمعته بالاعتساف یشهد بذلک ربّک العلیم قد قمت على اطفآء نور الأمر سوف تنخمد نارک امراً من عنده انّه هو المقتدر القدیر لا تعجزه شؤونات العالم و لا سطوة الأمم یفعل ما یشآء بسلطانه و یحکم ما یرید تفکّر فی النّاقة مع انّها من الحیوان رفعها الرّحمن الی مقام نطق السن العالم بذکرها و ثنائها انّه هو المهیمن علی من فی السّموات و الأرض لا اله الّا هو العزیز العظیم کذلک زیّنّا آفاق سمآء اللّوح بشموس الکلمات نعیماً لمن فاز بها و استضآء بأنوارها و ویل للمعرضین و ویل للمنکرین و ویل للغافلین الحمد للّه ربّ العالمین

Yā qalamī al-aʿlā, udhkur al-Raqshāʾ allatī bi-ẓulmihā nāḥat al-ashyāʾ wa-irtaʿadat farāʾiṣ al-awliyāʾ. Kadhālika yaʾmuruka Mālik al-Asmāʾ fī hādhā al-maqām al-maḥmūd. Qad ṣāḥat min ẓulmika al-Batūl wa-taẓunn annaka min āl al-Rasūl. Kadhālika sawwalat laka nafsuka, yā ayyuhā al-muʿriḍ ʿan Allāh rabb mā kāna wa-mā yakūn. Inṣifī yā ayyatuhā al-Raqshāʾ, bi-ayyi jurm ladaghti abnāʾ al-Rasūl wa-nahabti amwālahum? A-kafarti bi-alladhī khalaqaki bi-amrihi kun fa-yakūn? Qad faʿalti bi-abnāʾ al-Rasūl mā lā faʿalat ʿĀd wa-Thamūd bi-Ṣāliḥ wa-Hūd wa-lā al-Yahūd bi-Rūḥ Allāh Mālik al-Wujūd. A-tunkir āyāt rabbika allatī idh nuzzilat min samāʾ al-amr khaḍaʿat lahā kutub al-ʿālam kulluhā? Tafakkar li-taṭṭaliʿa bi-fiʿlika, yā ayyuhā al-ghāfil al-mardūd. Sawfa taʾkhudhuka nafaḥāt al-ʿadhāb kamā akhadhat qawman qablaka. Intaẓir, yā ayyuhā al-mushrik bi-llāh Mālik al-ghayb wa-l-shuhūd. Hādhā yawm akhbara bihi Allāh bi-lisān rasūlihi. Tafakkar li-taʿrifa mā anzalahu al-Raḥmān fī al-Furqān wa-fī hādhā al-lawḥ al-masṭūr. Hādhā yawm fīhi atā Mashriq al-Waḥy bi-āyāt bayyināt allatī ʿajaza ʿan iḥṣāʾihā al-muḥṣūn. Hādhā yawm fīhi wajada kull dhī shamm ʿarf nasamat al-Raḥmān fī al-imkān wa-saraʿa kull dhī baṣar ilā furāt raḥmat rabbihi Mālik al-Mulūk. Yā ayyuhā al-ghāfil, ta-llāh, qad rajaʿa ḥadīth al-dhabḥ wa-l-dhabīḥ tawajjaha ilā maqarr al-fidāʾ wa-mā rajaʿa bi-mā iktasabat yaduka, yā ayyuhā al-mubghiḍ al-ʿanūd. A-ẓananta bi-l-shahāda yanḥaṭṭ shaʾn al-Amr? Lā wa-alladhī jaʿalahu Allāh mahbiṭ al-waḥy, in anta min alladhīna hum yafqahūn. Wayl laka yā ayyuhā al-mushrik bi-llāh wa-li-alladhīna ittakhadhūka imāman li-anfusihim min dūn bayyina wa-lā kitāb mashhūd. Kam min ẓālim qāma ʿalā iṭfāʾ nūr Allāh qablaka wa-kam min fājir qatala wa-nahaba ilā an nāḥat min ẓulmihi al-afʾida wa-l-nufūs. Qad ghābat shams al-ʿadl bi-mā istawā haykal al-ẓulm ʿalā arīkat al-baghḍāʾ wa-lākinna al-qawm hum lā yashʿurūn. Yā jāhil, qad qatalta abnāʾ al-Rasūl wa-nahabta amwālahum. Qul hal al-amwāl kafarat bi-llāh am mālikuhā ʿalā zaʿmika? Inṣif, yā ayyuhā al-jāhil al-maḥjūb. Qad akhadhta al-iʿtisāf wa-nabadhta al-inṣāf. Bi-dhālika nāḥat al-ashyāʾ wa-anta min al-ghāfilīn. Qad qatalta al-kabīr wa-nahabta al-ṣaghīr. Hal taẓunn annaka taʾkul mā jamaʿtahu bi-l-ẓulm? Lā wa-nafsī, kadhālika yukhbiruka al-Khabīr. Ta-llāh, lā yughnīka mā ʿindaka wa-mā jamaʿtahu bi-l-iʿtisāf. Yashhadu bi-dhālika rabbuka al-ʿAlīm. Qad qumta ʿalā iṭfāʾ nūr al-Amr. Sawfa tankhamid nāruka amran min ʿindihi. Innahu huwa al-Muqtadir al-Qadīr. Lā tuʿjizuhu shuʾūnāt al-ʿālam wa-lā saṭwat al-umam. Yafʿalu mā yashāʾ bi-sulṭānihi wa-yaḥkumu mā yurīd. Tafakkar fī al-nāqa, maʿa annahā min al-ḥayawān rafaʿahā al-Raḥmān ilā maqām naṭaqa alsun al-ʿālam bi-dhikrihā wa-thanāʾihā. Innahu huwa al-Muhaymin ʿalā man fī al-samāwāt wa-l-arḍ. Lā ilāha illā huwa al-ʿAzīz al-ʿAẓīm. Kadhālika zayyannā āfāq samāʾ al-lawḥ bi-shumūs al-kalimāt. Naʿīman li-man fāza bihā wa-istaḍāʾa bi-anwārihā, wa-wayl li-l-muʿriḍīn wa-wayl li-l-munkirīn wa-wayl li-l-ghāfilīn. Al-ḥamd li-llāh rabb al-ʿālamīn.

O My Most Exalted Pen, make mention of the She-Serpent, whose oppression made all things lament and the limbs of the loved ones tremble. Thus the Lord of Names commands you in this praiseworthy station. The Chaste One has cried out at your oppression, yet you imagine that you belong to the family of the Messenger. Thus has your own self deceived you, O you who turn away from God, the Lord of all that has been and all that will be. Be fair, O She-Serpent! For what crime did you bite the sons of the Messenger and plunder their possessions? Have you disbelieved in Him who created you through His command, “Be,” and it is? You have done to the sons of the Messenger what neither ʿAd and Thamud did to Salih and Hud, nor the Jews to the Spirit of God, the Lord of Being. Do you deny the verses of your Lord, before which all the books of the world bowed down when they were sent down from the heaven of His command? Reflect, so that you may understand your deed, O heedless and rejected one. The blasts of punishment will soon seize you, just as they seized a people before you. Wait, O you who associate partners with God, the Lord of the unseen and the seen. This is the day of which God gave tidings through the tongue of His Messenger. Reflect, so that you may recognize what the All-Merciful has revealed in the Quran and in this inscribed Tablet. This is the day when the Dawning Place of Revelation has come with clear verses that those who count have been unable to number. This is the day when everyone endowed with the sense of smell has perceived the fragrance of the breeze of the All-Merciful in the world of being, and everyone endowed with sight has hastened to the sweet waters of the mercy of his Lord, the King of Kings. O heedless one, by God, the story of the sacrifice has returned, and the sacrificial victim has turned toward the place of sacrifice and has not returned, because of what your hands have done, O hateful and obstinate one. Did you imagine that martyrdom would diminish the standing of the Cause? No, by Him whom God has made the recipient of revelation, if you are among those who understand. Woe to you, O you who associate partners with God, and to those who have taken you as their leader without any evidence or attested Book. How many oppressors before you arose to extinguish the light of God, and how many evildoers killed and plundered until hearts and souls lamented at their oppression! The sun of justice has set because the embodiment of oppression has seated itself upon the throne of hatred, but the people do not perceive it. O ignorant one, you have killed the sons of the Messenger and plundered their possessions. Say: Was it the possessions that disbelieved in God, or their owners, as you allege? Be fair, O ignorant and veiled one. You have embraced tyranny and cast fairness aside. Because of this all things have lamented, yet you remain among the heedless. You have killed the elder and plundered the younger. Do you imagine that you will enjoy what you have amassed through oppression? No, by My own Self! Thus the All-Informed tells you. By God, neither what you possess nor what you have amassed through tyranny will avail you. Your Lord, the All-Knowing, bears witness to this. You have arisen to extinguish the light of the Cause. Your own fire will soon be put out by a command from Him. He is indeed the All-Powerful, the Almighty. Neither the affairs of the world nor the might of nations can frustrate Him. Through His sovereignty He does whatever He pleases and decrees whatever He wills. Reflect on the she-camel: although she was an animal, the All-Merciful exalted her to such a station that the tongues of the world have spoken in her remembrance and praise. He is indeed the Guardian over all who are in the heavens and the earth. There is no god but Him, the Almighty, the All-Glorious. Thus We have adorned the horizons of the heaven of this Tablet with the suns of words. Blessed is the one who has attained them and been illumined by their light. Woe to those who turn away, woe to those who deny, and woe to the heedless. Praise be to God, the Lord of all worlds.

160

یا شیخ قد اسمعناک تغرّدات عندلیب الفردوس و اریناک الآثار الّتی انزلها اللّه بأمره المبرم فی السّجن الأعظم لتقرّ بها عینک و تطمئنّ بها نفسک انّه هو الفیّاض الکریم قم بقوّة البرهان علی خدمة امر اللّه ربّک الرّحمن لو تخاف من ایمانک خذ اللّوح ثمّ احفظه فی جیب توکّلک و اذا دخلت موقف الحشر و یسألک اللّه بأیّ حجّة آمنت بهذا الظّهور اخرج اللّوح و قل بهذا الکتاب المبارک العزیز البدیع اذاً ترتفع الیک ایادی الکلّ و یأخذون اللّوح و یضعونه علی عیونهم و یجدون منه عرف بیان اللّه ربّ العالمین لو یعذّبک اللّه بما آمنت بآیاته فی هذا الظّهور فبأیّ حجّة یعذّب الّذین ما آمنوا بمحمّد رسول اللّه و من قبله بعیسی بن مریم و من قبله بالکلیم و من قبله بالخلیل الی ان تنتهی الظّهورات الی البدیع الأوّل الّذی خلق بارادة ربّک القادر المحیط کذلک انزلنا الآیات لأحد قبلک و ذکرناها لک فی هذا الیوم لتعرف و تکون من الموقنین یا ایّها النّاطق بالعلم انّ الأمر اظهر من ان یخفی و ابین من ان یستر انّه کالشّمس فی وسط الزّوال لا ینکرها الّا کلّ مبغض مریب

Yā Shaykh, qad asmaʿnāka tagharrudāt ʿandalīb al-Firdaws wa-araynāka al-āthār allatī anzalahā Allāh bi-amrihi al-mubram fī al-Sijn al-Aʿẓam li-taqarra bihā ʿaynuka wa-taṭmaʾinna bihā nafsuka. Innahu huwa al-Fayyāḍ al-Karīm. Qum bi-quwwat al-burhān ʿalā khidmat amr Allāh rabbika al-Raḥmān. Law takhāf min īmānika, khudh al-lawḥ thumma iḥfaẓhu fī jayb tawakkulika. Wa-idhā dakhalta mawqif al-ḥashr wa-yasʾaluka Allāh bi-ayyi ḥujja āmanta bi-hādhā al-ẓuhūr, akhrij al-lawḥ wa-qul: bi-hādhā al-kitāb al-mubārak al-ʿazīz al-badīʿ. Idhan tartafiʿ ilayka ayādī al-kull wa-yaʾkhudhūn al-lawḥ wa-yaḍaʿūnahu ʿalā ʿuyūnihim wa-yajidūn minhu ʿarf bayān Allāh rabb al-ʿālamīn. Law yuʿadhdhibuka Allāh bi-mā āmanta bi-āyātihi fī hādhā al-ẓuhūr, fa-bi-ayyi ḥujja yuʿadhdhib alladhīna mā āmanū bi-Muḥammad Rasūl Allāh wa-min qablihi bi-ʿĪsā ibn Maryam wa-min qablihi bi-l-Kalīm wa-min qablihi bi-l-Khalīl ilā an tantahiya al-ẓuhūrāt ilā al-badīʿ al-awwal alladhī khuliqa bi-irādat rabbika al-Qādir al-Muḥīṭ? Kadhālika anzalnā al-āyāt li-aḥad qablaka wa-dhakarnāhā laka fī hādhā al-yawm li-taʿrifa wa-takūna min al-mūqinīn. Yā ayyuhā al-nāṭiq bi-l-ʿilm, inna al-Amr aẓhar min an yakhfā wa-abyan min an yustar. Innahu ka-l-shams fī wasaṭ al-zawāl, lā yunkiruhā illā kull mubghiḍ murīb.

O Shaykh, We have let you hear the songs of the Nightingale of Paradise and shown you the writings that God has sent down through His irrevocable command in the Most Great Prison, so that your eyes may be gladdened and your soul reassured by them. He is indeed the All-Bountiful, the Generous. Arise, through the power of proof, to serve the Cause of God, your Lord, the All-Merciful. If you fear the consequences of your faith, take this Tablet and keep it in the fold of your trust in God. When you enter the place of resurrection and God asks you, “On what proof did you believe in this Revelation?” bring out the Tablet and say, “On this blessed, mighty, wondrous Book.” Then the hands of all will reach up toward you, and they will take the Tablet, lay it upon their eyes, and perceive from it the fragrance of the utterance of God, the Lord of all worlds. If God should punish you for believing in His verses in this Revelation, on what grounds would He punish those who did not believe in Muhammad, the Messenger of God, or, before Him, in Jesus, son of Mary, or, before Him, in Him who conversed with God, or, before Him, in the Friend of God, tracing the Revelations back to the first creation brought into being by the will of your Lord, the All-Powerful, the All-Encompassing? Thus We revealed the verses to someone before you, and We have recounted them to you on this day so that you may recognize the truth and be among those who are certain. O you who speak of learning, the Cause is too manifest to be hidden and too clear to be concealed. It is like the sun at high noon; none denies it but one who is hateful and full of doubt.

161

در این حین سزاوار آنکه بحضرت مقصود توجّه نمائیم و باین کلمات عالیات متمسّک شویم الهی الهی سراج امرت را بدهن حکمت برافروختی از اریاح مختلفه حفظش نما سراج از تو زجاج از تو اسباب آسمان و زمین در قبضهٔ قدرت تو امرا را عدل عنایت فرما و علما را انصاف توئی آن مقتدری که بحرکت قلم امر مبرمت را نصرت فرمودی و اولیا را راه نمودی توئی مالک قدرت و ملیک اقتدار لا اله الّا انت العزیز المختار و قل الهی الهی لک الحمد بما سقیتنی من ید عطآء اسمک القیّوم رحیقک المختوم اسألک بأنوار فجر ظهورک و بنفوذ کلمتک العلیا و اقتدار قلمک الأعلی الّذی بحرکته انجذبت حقائق الأشیآء ان توفّق حضرة السّلطان علی نصرة امرک و الاقبال الی افق ظهورک و التّوجّه الی انوار وجهک ای ربّ ایّده علی ما یقرّبه الیک ثمّ انصره بجنود السّموات و الأرض اسألک یا اله الأسمآء و فاطر السّمآء بنور امرک و نار سدرة عنایتک ان تؤیّد حضرته علی اظهار امرک بین خلقک ثمّ افتح علی وجهه ابواب فضلک و رحمتک و عطائک انّک انت المقتدر علی ما تشآء بقولک کن فیکون

Dar īn ḥīn sazāvār ānkih bi-Ḥaḍrat-i Maqṣūd tavajjuh namāyīm va bi-īn kalimāt-i ʿāliyāt mutamassik shavīm: Ilāhī Ilāhī, sirāj-i amrat rā bi-duhn-i ḥikmat bar-afrūkhtī, az aryāḥ-i mukhtalifih ḥifẓash namā. Sirāj az tu, zujāj az tu, asbāb-i āsmān va zamīn dar qabḍiy-i qudrat-i tu. Umarā rā ʿadl ʿināyat farmā va ʿulamā rā inṣāf. Tuʾī ān muqtadirī kih bi-ḥarakat-i qalam amr-i mubramat rā nuṣrat farmūdī va awliyā rā rāh namūdī. Tuʾī mālik-i qudrat va malīk-i iqtidār. Lā ilāha illā anta al-ʿAzīz al-Mukhtār. Wa qul: Ilāhī Ilāhī, laka al-ḥamdu bi-mā saqaytanī min yadi ʿaṭāʾi ismika al-Qayyūm raḥīqaka al-makhtūm. Asʾaluka bi-anwāri fajri ẓuhūrika wa bi-nufūdhi kalimatika al-ʿulyā wa iqtidāri qalamika al-aʿlā alladhī bi-ḥarakatihi injadhabat ḥaqāʾiqu al-ashyāʾ an tuwaffiqa ḥaḍrata al-sulṭān ʿalā nuṣrati amrika wa al-iqbāli ilā ufuqi ẓuhūrika wa al-tawajjuhi ilā anwāri wajhika. Ay Rabb, ayyidhu ʿalā mā yuqarribuhu ilayka thumma unṣurhu bi-junūdi al-samāwāti wa al-arḍ. Asʾaluka yā Ilāha al-asmāʾ wa Fāṭira al-samāʾ bi-nūri amrika wa nāri sidrati ʿināyatika an tuʾayyida ḥaḍratahu ʿalā iẓhāri amrika bayna khalqika thumma iftaḥ ʿalā wajhihi abwāba faḍlika wa raḥmatika wa ʿaṭāʾika. Innaka anta al-muqtadiru ʿalā mā tashāʾ bi-qawlika kun fa-yakūn.

At this moment it is fitting that we turn toward Him who is the Desired One and hold fast to these exalted words: “My God, my God! You have kindled the lamp of Your Cause with the oil of wisdom; protect it from contrary winds. The lamp is Yours, the glass is Yours, and the means of heaven and earth are in the grasp of Your power. Grant justice to rulers and fairness to the learned. You are the All-Powerful who, through the movement of the Pen, has aided Your irrevocable Cause and shown the way to Your loved ones. You are the Possessor of power and the King of might. There is no god but You, the Almighty, the Unconstrained.” And say: “My God, my God! Praise be to You for giving me Your sealed wine to drink from the hand of the bounty of Your name, the Self-Subsisting. I ask You, by the lights of the dawn of Your Revelation, by the potency of Your most exalted Word, and by the might of Your Most Exalted Pen, through whose movement the realities of all things have been enraptured, to enable His Majesty the Sultan to aid Your Cause, turn toward the horizon of Your Revelation, and direct himself toward the lights of Your face. O Lord, assist him in whatever will draw him near to You, and then aid him with the hosts of the heavens and the earth. I ask You, O God of names and Creator of heaven, by the light of Your Cause and the fire of the Lote Tree of Your loving care, to assist His Majesty in making Your Cause manifest among Your creatures. Then open before his face the gates of Your grace, Your mercy, and Your bounty. You indeed have power over whatever You will through Your word, ‘Be,’ and it is.”

162

یا شیخ زمام امور بقوّت الهی و قدرت ربّانی اخذ شده بود اخذ عزیز مقتدر احدی قادر بر فساد و فتنه نبوده حال چون قدر عنایت و الطاف را ندانستند بجزای اعمال خود مبتلا شده و میشوند و مأمورین نظر بحرکت سرّی حبل ممدود از جمیع جهات حزب مخالف را تحریک و تأیید نموده‌اند در مدینهٔ کبیره جمعی را بر مخالفت این مظلوم برانگیختند و امر بمقامی رسیده که نفوس مأموره در آن ارض تمسّک نموده‌اند بآنچه سبب ذلّت دولت و ملّت است یکی از سادات بزرگوار که نزد اکثری از منصفین معروفش معروف و عملش مقبول و تجارتش مشهور و از اجلّهٔ تجّار نزد کل مشهود بسمت بیروت توجّه نمود نظر بدوستی آن جناب باین مظلوم از سیّالهٔ برقیّه بمترجم ایران خبر دادند که سیّد مذکور با آدم خود وجهی از نقد و غیره سرقت کرده‌اند و به عکّا توجّه نموده‌اند و مقصود از این حرکت ذلّت این مظلوم بوده ولکن هیهات که اهل این دیار باین گفتهای نالائقه از صراط مستقیم صدق و راستی منحرف شوند باری از هر جهت هجوم نموده‌اند و طرف مقابل را تأیید مینمایند و این مظلوم از حقّ میطلبد کل را موفّق دارد بر آنچه سزاوار ایّام است و در لیالی و ایّام باین کلمات محکمات ناظر و ناطق الهی الهی اسألک بشمس فضلک و بحر علمک و سمآء عدلک ان تؤیّد المنکرین على الاقرار و المعرضین علی الاقبال و المفترین علی العدل و الانصاف ای ربّ ایّدهم علی الرّجوع الیک و الانابة لدی باب فضلک انّک انت المقتدر علی ما تشآء و فی قبضتک زمام من فی السّموات و الأرضین الحمد للّه ربّ العالمین

Yā Shaykh, zimām-i umūr bi-quvvat-i ilāhī va qudrat-i rabbānī akhdh shudih būd, akhdh-i ʿazīz-i muqtadir. Aḥadī qādir bar fasād va fitnih nabūdih. Ḥāl chūn qadr-i ʿināyat va alṭāf rā nadānistand bi-jazā-yi aʿmāl-i khud mubtalā shudih va mī-shavand va maʾmūrīn naẓar bi-ḥarakat-i sirrī-yi ḥabl-i mamdūd az jamīʿ-i jihāt ḥizb-i mukhālif rā taḥrīk va taʾyīd namūdih-and. Dar Madīniy-i Kabīrih jamʿī rā bar mukhālifat-i īn maẓlūm bar-angīkhtand va amr bi-maqāmī rasīdih kih nufūs-i maʾmūrih dar ān arḍ tamassuk namūdih-and bi-ānchih sabab-i dhillat-i dawlat va millat ast. Yikī az sādāt-i buzurgvār kih nazd-i aktharī az munṣifīn maʿrūfash maʿrūf va ʿamalash maqbūl va tijāratash mashhūr va az ajilliy-i tujjār nazd-i kull mashhūd bi-samt-i Bayrūt tavajjuh namūd. Naẓar bi-dūstī-yi ān jināb bi-īn maẓlūm az sayyāliy-i barqīyih bi-mutarjim-i Īrān khabar dādand kih sayyid-i madhkūr bā ādam-i khud vajhī az naqd va ghayrih sirqat kardih-and va bi-ʿAkkā tavajjuh namūdih-and va maqṣūd az īn ḥarakat dhillat-i īn maẓlūm būdih. Va-līkin hayhāt kih ahl-i īn diyār bi-īn guftihā-yi nālāʾiqih az ṣirāṭ-i mustaqīm-i ṣidq va rāstī munḥarif shavand. Bārī az har jihat hujūm namūdih-and va ṭaraf-i muqābil rā taʾyīd mī-namāyand va īn maẓlūm az Ḥaqq mī-ṭalabad kull rā muvaffaq dārad bar ānchih sazāvār-i ayyām ast va dar layālī va ayyām bi-īn kalimāt-i muḥkamāt nāẓir va nāṭiq: Ilāhī Ilāhī, asʾaluka bi-shamsi faḍlika wa baḥri ʿilmika wa samāʾi ʿadlika an tuʾayyida al-munkirīna ʿalā al-iqrār wa al-muʿriḍīna ʿalā al-iqbāl wa al-muftarīna ʿalā al-ʿadli wa al-inṣāf. Ay Rabb, ayyidhum ʿalā al-rujūʿi ilayka wa al-inābati ladā bābi faḍlika. Innaka anta al-muqtadiru ʿalā mā tashāʾ wa fī qabḍatika zimāmu man fī al-samāwāti wa al-arḍīn. Al-ḥamdu li-llāhi Rabbi al-ʿālamīn.

O Shaykh, the reins of affairs had been seized through divine strength and heavenly power, with the grasp of One who is mighty and all-powerful. No one could stir up corruption or sedition. Now, because they failed to appreciate this loving care and these favors, they have suffered, and continue to suffer, the consequences of their deeds. In view of the secret activity of the outstretched cord, the officials have incited and supported the opposing party on every side. In the Great City they stirred up a group to oppose this Wronged One, and matters have reached the point where the officials in that land have resorted to what brings disgrace upon both state and people. One of the noble descendants of the Prophet, whose benevolence is recognized by most fair-minded people, whose conduct is approved, whose commerce is well known, and whom everyone regards as one of the foremost merchants, set out for Beirut. Because of his friendship with this Wronged One, they sent word by telegraph to the Persian interpreter that the aforementioned sayyid and his servant had stolen a sum in cash and other property and had set out for Acre. The purpose of this action was to disgrace this Wronged One.
