Yet far be it from the people of this region to be turned aside by such unworthy statements from the straight path of truthfulness and integrity. In short, they have attacked from every direction and are supporting the opposing side. This Wronged One asks God to enable everyone to do what befits these days, and night and day He contemplates and utters these firmly established words: “My God, my God! I ask You, by the sun of Your grace, the ocean of Your knowledge, and the heaven of Your justice, to help those who deny to acknowledge, those who turn away to turn toward You, and those who slander to act with justice and fairness. O Lord, assist them to return to You and turn in repentance at the gate of Your grace. You indeed have power over whatever You will, and in Your grasp are the reins of all who are in the heavens and the earth. Praise be to God, the Lord of all worlds.”

163

عنقریب آنچه در افئده و قلوب مستور مشاهده گردد یوم یومیست که حضرت لقمان از برای ابنش ذکر فرموده و ربّ العزّة از آن خبر داده و حبیبش را آگاه نموده بقوله تعالی یا بنیّ انّها ان تک مثقال حبّة من خردل فتکن فی صخرة او فی السّموات او فی الأرض یأت بها اللّه انّ اللّه لطیف خبیر امروز خائنهٔ اعین و خافیهٔ صدور کل امام کرسیّ ظهور ظاهر و هویدا لا یعزب عن علمه من شیء یسمع و یری و هو السّمیع البصیر بسیار عجبست که امین و خائن را از هم فرقی نه

ʿAn-qarīb ānchih dar afʾidih va qulūb mastūr mushāhadih gardad. Yawm yawmīst kih Ḥaḍrat-i Luqmān az barā-yi ibnash dhikr farmūdih va Rabb al-ʿizzat az ān khabar dādih va Ḥabībash rā āgāh namūdih bi-qawlihi taʿālā: Yā bunayya innahā in taku mithqāla ḥabbatin min khardalin fa-takun fī ṣakhratin aw fī al-samāwāti aw fī al-arḍi yaʾti bihā Allāh, inna Allāha laṭīfun khabīr. Imrūz khāʾiniy-i aʿyun va khāfiyiy-i ṣudūr kull imām-i kursī-yi ẓuhūr ẓāhir va huvaydā. Lā yaʿzubu ʿan ʿilmihi min shayʾ, yasmaʿu wa yarā wa huwa al-Samīʿ al-Baṣīr. Bisyār ʿajab ast kih amīn va khāʾin rā az ham farqī nah.

Soon whatever is hidden in hearts and souls will be seen. This is the day of which Luqman spoke to his son, of which the Lord of Glory gave tidings, and of which He informed His Beloved through His exalted words: “O my son, even if it is the weight of a mustard seed, and lies within a rock or in the heavens or the earth, God will bring it forth. God is indeed the Subtle, the All-Informed.” Today the treachery of eyes and the secrets of hearts are all manifest and plain before the throne of Revelation. Nothing escapes His knowledge. He hears and sees, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing. It is most astonishing that no distinction is made between the trustworthy and the treacherous.

164

ایکاش حضرت پادشاه ممالک ایران ادام اللّه سلطانه از قناسل دولت علیّهٔ ایران که در این جهات بوده‌اند استفسار فرمایند تا بر افعال و اعمال این مظلوم آگاه شوند باری جمعی را از اختر و غیره برانگیختند و در انتشار مفتریات مشغول این بسی واضح و معلوم نفسی را که مردود عباد و مطرود بلاد مشاهده نمایند با سیف ضغینه و سهام بغضا احاطه کنند لیس هذا اوّل امر ظهر بالظّلم و لا اوّل قارورة کسرت و لا اوّل ستر هتک فی سبیل اللّه ربّ العالمین و این مظلوم ساکتاً صامتاً در سجن اعظم بخود مشغول و از غیر اللّه منقطع ظلم بمقامی رسیده که اقلام عالم از تحریر آن عاجز و قاصر است

Ay kāsh Ḥaḍrat-i Pādshāh-i mamālik-i Īrān, adāma Allāhu sulṭānahu, az qanāsil-i dawlat-i ʿaliyyih-yi Īrān kih dar īn jihāt būdih-and istifsār farmāyand tā bar afʿāl va aʿmāl-i īn maẓlūm āgāh shavand. Bārī jamʿī rā az Akhtar va ghayrih bar-angīkhtand va dar intishār-i muftariyāt mashghūl. Īn basī vāḍiḥ va maʿlūm, nafsī rā kih mardūd-i ʿibād va maṭrūd-i bilād mushāhadih namāyand bā sayf-i ḍaghīnih va sihām-i baghḍā iḥāṭih kunand. Laysa hādhā awwala amrin ẓahara bi-l-ẓulmi wa lā awwala qārūratin kusirat wa lā awwala sitrin hutika fī sabīli Allāhi Rabbi al-ʿālamīn. Va īn maẓlūm sākitan ṣāmitan dar Sijn-i Aʿẓam bi-khud mashghūl va az ghayr-i Allāh munqaṭiʿ. Ẓulm bi-maqāmī rasīdih kih aqlām-i ʿālam az taḥrīr-i ān ʿājiz va qāṣir ast.

If only His Majesty the sovereign of the realms of Persia—may God perpetuate his sovereignty—would question the consuls of the exalted Persian government who have been in these regions, so that he might learn of the deeds and conduct of this Wronged One. In short, they have stirred up a group from Akhtar and elsewhere, who are busy spreading slanders. It is quite clear and well known that when they see someone rejected by the people and banished from every land, they surround him with the sword of malice and the arrows of hatred. This is not the first matter in which oppression has appeared, nor the first vessel to be broken, nor the first veil to be torn in the path of God, the Lord of all worlds. This Wronged One, silent and still, attends to His own affairs in the Most Great Prison, detached from all but God. Oppression has reached such a degree that the pens of the world are powerless and unable to describe it.

165

در این مقام لازم امری که ظاهر شد ذکر شود شاید عباد بحبل عدل و راستی تمسّک نمایند جناب حاجی شیخ محمّد علی علیه بهآء اللّه الأبدی از تجّار معروف بوده اکثری از اهل مدینهٔ کبیره او را میشناسند در ایاّم اخیره که سفارت ایران در آستانه در سرّ سرّ بتحریک مشغول آن مقبل صادق را پریشان دیده‌اند تا آنکه شبی از شبها خود را در بحر انداخت و از قضا جمعی از عباد حاضر و او را اخذ نمودند و این عمل را هر حزبی تعبیری نمود و ذکری کرد تا آنکه مرّة اخری شبی از شبها در جامعی رفته و خادم آن محل ذکر نمود این شخص شب را احیا داشت و تا صبح بمناجات و دعا و عجز و ابتهال مشغول و بعد ذکرش قطع شد و این عبد توجّه نمود مشاهده شد روح را تسلیم نموده و شیشه‌ئی خالی نزدش دیده شد مشعر بر اینکه سم خورده باری بکمال تحیّر قوم را اطّلاع داد و دو وصیّت‌نامه از او ظاهر شد امّا اوّل مشعر بر اقرار و اعتراف بر وحدانیّت حقّ و تقدیس ذاته تعالی عن الأشباه و الأمثال و تنزیه کینونته عن الأوصاف و الأذکار و الأقوال و الاقرار بظهور الأنبیآء و الأولیآء و الاعتراف بما کان مرقوماً فی کتب اللّه مولی الوری و در ورقهٔ دیگر مناجاتی عرض کرده و در آخر ورقه ذکر نموده این عبد و اولیا متحیّر مانده‌اند چه که در یک مقام قلم اعلی کل را از فساد و نزاع و جدال منع فرموده و در مقامی هم از قلم اعلی این کلمهٔ علیا نازل اگر نفسی سوء قصدی از احدی در حضور مشاهده نماید باید تعرّض نکند و بحقّ گذارد این حکم محکم از یک جهت ظاهر و ثابت و از جهت دیگر مشاهده شد مفترین بکلماتی نطق مینمایند که قوّهٔ بشری از حمل و اصغاء آن عاجز و قاصر است لذا این عبد این ذنب اعظم را اختیار نمود و از بحر کرم الهی و سماء رحمت ربّانی سائل و آملم که جریرات این عبد را از قلم فضل و عطا محو فرماید سیّئات بسیار و خطایا بیشمار ولکن بحبل جودش متمسّکم و بذیل کرمش متشبّث حقّ شاهد و مقرّبان درگاه آگاه که این عبد قادر بر اصغاء مقالات مغلّین نبوده لذا این عمل را ارتکاب نمود لو یعذّبنی انّه هو محمود فی فعله و لو یغفر لی انّه مطاع فی امره

Dar īn maqām lāzim amrī kih ẓāhir shud dhikr shavad shāyad ʿibād bi-ḥabl-i ʿadl va rāstī tamassuk namāyand. Jināb-i Ḥājī Shaykh Muḥammad ʿAlī, ʿalayhi bahāʾu Allāhi al-Abadī, az tujjār-i maʿrūf būdih, aktharī az ahl-i Madīniy-i Kabīrih ū rā mī-shināsand. Dar ayyām-i akhīrih kih sifārat-i Īrān dar Āstānih dar sirr-i sirr bi-taḥrīk mashghūl ān muqbil-i ṣādiq rā parishān dīdih-and tā ānkih shabī az shabhā khud rā dar baḥr andākht va az qaḍā jamʿī az ʿibād ḥāḍir va ū rā akhdh namūdand va īn ʿamal rā har ḥizbī taʿbīrī namūd va dhikrī kard tā ānkih marratan ukhrā shabī az shabhā dar jāmiʿī raftih va khādim-i ān maḥall dhikr namūd: Īn shakhs shab rā iḥyā dāsht va tā ṣubḥ bi-munājāt va duʿā va ʿajz va ibtihāl mashghūl va baʿd dhikrash qaṭʿ shud va īn ʿabd tavajjuh namūd, mushāhadih shud rūḥ rā taslīm namūdih va shīshih-ʾī khālī nazdash dīdih shud mushʿir bar īnkih samm khūrdih. Bārī bi-kamāl-i taḥayyur qawm rā iṭṭilāʿ dād va du vaṣiyyat-nāmih az ū ẓāhir shud. Ammā avval mushʿir bar iqrār va iʿtirāf bar vaḥdāniyyat-i Ḥaqq va taqdīs-i dhātihi taʿālā ʿan al-ashbāhi wa al-amthāl va tanzīh-i kaynūnatihi ʿan al-awṣāfi wa al-adhkāri wa al-aqwāl wa al-iqrāri bi-ẓuhūri al-anbiyāʾi wa al-awliyāʾ wa al-iʿtirāfi bi-mā kāna marqūman fī kutubi Allāhi Mawlā al-warā. Va dar varaqiy-i dīgar munājātī ʿarḍ kardih va dar ākhir-i varaqih dhikr namūdih: Īn ʿabd va awliyā mutaḥayyir māndih-and chih kih dar yik maqām Qalam-i Aʿlā kull rā az fasād va nizāʿ va jidāl manʿ farmūdih va dar maqāmī ham az Qalam-i Aʿlā īn kalimiy-i ʿulyā nāzil: Agar nafsī sūʾ-i qaṣdī az aḥadī dar ḥuḍūr mushāhadih namāyad bāyad taʿarruḍ nakunad va bi-Ḥaqq gudhārad. Īn ḥukm-i muḥkam az yik jihat ẓāhir va thābit va az jihat-i dīgar mushāhadih shud muftarīn bi-kalimātī nuṭq mī-namāyand kih quvviy-i bashar az ḥaml va iṣghā-yi ān ʿājiz va qāṣir ast. Lidhā īn ʿabd īn dhanb-i aʿẓam rā ikhtiyār namūd va az baḥr-i karam-i ilāhī va samā-yi raḥmat-i rabbānī sāʾil va āmilam kih jarīrāt-i īn ʿabd rā az qalam-i faḍl va ʿaṭā maḥv farmāyad. Sayyiʾāt bisyār va khaṭāyā bī-shumār va-līkin bi-ḥabl-i jūdash mutamassikam va bi-dhayl-i karamash mutashabbith. Ḥaqq shāhid va muqarrabān-i dargāh āgāh kih īn ʿabd qādir bar iṣghā-yi maqālāt-i mughillīn nabūdih lidhā īn ʿamal rā irtikāb namūd. Law yuʿadhdhibnī innahu huwa maḥmūdun fī fiʿlihi wa law yaghfir lī innahu muṭāʿun fī amrihi.

At this point it is necessary to recount an event that occurred, so that perhaps the people may hold fast to the cord of justice and truthfulness. Haji Shaykh Muhammad Ali—may the glory of God, the Eternal, rest upon him—was a well-known merchant whom most of the people of the Great City know. In recent days, while the Persian embassy in Constantinople was engaged in the utmost secrecy in stirring up trouble, that sincere believer was seen to be distressed, until one night he threw himself into the sea. As it happened, some people were present and rescued him. Every group interpreted this deed in its own way and spoke of it, until once again, one night, he went into a mosque. The attendant there said: “This man kept vigil through the night and was occupied until morning with communion, prayer, humble supplication, and entreaty. Then his utterances ceased, and this servant went over and saw that he had surrendered his soul. An empty bottle was seen beside him, indicating that he had taken poison.” In short, utterly bewildered, he informed the people, and two wills were found that he had left. The first expressed acknowledgment and confession of the oneness of God, the sanctity of His exalted Essence above likenesses and comparisons, and the transcendence of His Being above descriptions, mentions, and words; it acknowledged the appearance of the Prophets and holy ones and affirmed what was recorded in the Books of God, the Lord of humanity. In the other sheet he had offered a prayer, and at the end of the sheet he had written: “This servant and the loved ones have been left bewildered, for in one passage the Most Exalted Pen has forbidden everyone to engage in corruption, contention, and dispute, and in another this exalted utterance has been revealed by the Most Exalted Pen: ‘If anyone should witness an attempt by someone to do harm in His presence, he must not intervene but must leave the matter to God.’ On the one hand, this firm command is manifest and established; on the other, the slanderers have been seen to utter words that human strength is powerless and unable to bear or hear. This servant has therefore chosen this most grievous sin, and I ask and hope, from the ocean of divine generosity and the heaven of heavenly mercy, that He may efface this servant’s transgressions with the pen of grace and bounty. My evil deeds are many and my sins innumerable, yet I hold fast to the cord of His bounty and cling to the hem of His generosity. God is witness, and those near His threshold know, that this servant was unable to listen to the statements of the malicious, and therefore committed this deed. If He punishes me, He is indeed praiseworthy in His action, and if He forgives me, He is indeed to be obeyed in His command.”

166

حال جناب شیخ در نفوذ کلمه تفکّر نماید شاید از شمال وهم بیمین یقین توجّه کند این مظلوم در امر الهی با احدی مداهنه ننموده و کلمهٔ حقّ را امام وجوه خلق بأعلی النّدآء ذکر کرده من شآء فلیقبل و من شآء فلیعرض ولکن اگر این امور ظاهرهٔ واضحهٔ مشهوده انکار شود چه امری نزد متبصّرین بطراز قبول و اقرار مزیّن گردد انّا نسأل اللّه تبارک و تعالی ان یغفر للمذکور و یبدّل سیّئاته بالحسنات انّه هو المقتدر العزیز الوهّاب

Ḥāl Jināb-i Shaykh dar nufūdh-i kalimih tafakkur namāyad shāyad az shimāl-i vahm bi-yamīn-i yaqīn tavajjuh kunad. Īn maẓlūm dar amr-i ilāhī bā aḥadī mudāhanih nanamūdih va kalimiy-i ḥaqq rā imām-i vujūh-i khalq bi-aʿlā al-nidāʾ dhikr kardih. Man shāʾa fa-l-yuqbil wa man shāʾa fa-l-yuʿriḍ. Va-līkin agar īn umūr-i ẓāhiriy-i vāḍiḥiy-i mashhūdih inkār shavad chih amrī nazd-i mutabaṣṣirīn bi-ṭirāz-i qabūl va iqrār muzayyan gardad? Innā nasʾalu Allāha tabāraka wa taʿālā an yaghfira li-l-madhkūr wa yubaddila sayyiʾātihi bi-l-ḥasanāt. Innahu huwa al-Muqtadir al-ʿAzīz al-Wahhāb.

Let the Shaykh now reflect upon the potency of the Word, so that perhaps he may turn from the left hand of delusion to the right hand of certainty. In the Cause of God this Wronged One has compromised with no one, and has proclaimed the word of truth at the top of His voice before the faces of all people. Let whoever wishes turn toward it, and whoever wishes turn away. But if these manifest, clear, and witnessed events are denied, what matter could be adorned with acceptance and acknowledgment in the eyes of the discerning? We ask God, blessed and exalted, to forgive the aforementioned man and to change his evil deeds into good ones. He is indeed the All-Powerful, the Almighty, the All-Bountiful.

167

اموری در این ظهور ظاهر که از برای مظاهر علم و فضل و مشارق انصاف و عدل جز تصدیق مجالی نه امروز بر شما لازم و واجب که بقوّت ملکوتی قیام نمائی و شبهات احزاب عالم را بقدرت علم محو فرمائی تا کل مقدّس شده قصد بحر اعظم نمایند و به ما اراده اللّه تمسّک جویند

Umūrī dar īn ẓuhūr ẓāhir kih az barā-yi maẓāhir-i ʿilm va faḍl va mashāriq-i inṣāf va ʿadl juz taṣdīq majālī nah. Imrūz bar shumā lāzim va vājib kih bi-quvvat-i malakūtī qiyām namāʾī va shubuhāt-i aḥzāb-i ʿālam rā bi-qudrat-i ʿilm maḥv farmāʾī tā kull muqaddas shudih qaṣd-i Baḥr-i Aʿẓam namāyand va bi-mā arāda Allāh tamassuk jūyand.

Things have appeared in this Revelation that leave those who embody knowledge and learning, and those who are dawning places of fairness and justice, no room for anything but affirmation. Today it is your necessary and binding duty to arise with heavenly strength and, through the power of knowledge, dispel the doubts of the peoples of the world, so that all may be purified, set their course toward the Most Great Ocean, and hold fast to what God has willed.

168

باری هر معرضی بکلمه‌ئی تمسّک نموده و بر حقّ اعتراض کرده سبحان‌اللّه ذکر الوهیّت و ربوبیّت که از اولیا و اصفیا ظاهر شده آن را اسباب اعراض و انکار قرار داده‌اند حضرت صادق فرموده العبودیّة جوهرة کنهها الرّبوبیّة و حضرت امیر در جواب اعرابی که از نفس سؤال نموده فرموده و ثالثها اللّاهوتیّة الملکوتیّة و هی قوّة لاهوتیّة و جوهرة بسیطة حیّة بالذّات الی ان قال علیه السّلام فهی ذات اللّه العلیا و شجرة طوبی و سدرة المنتهی و جنّة المأوی حضرت صادق فرموده اذا قام قائمنا اشرقت الأرض بنور ربّها و همچنین از ابی عبداللّه علیه السّلام حدیث طویلی ذکر شده و از جملهٔ نصوص حدیث مذکور این کلمهٔ علیا است فعند ذلک یهبط الجبّار عزّ و جلّ من الغمام و الملائکة و فی القرآن العظیم هل ینظرون الّا ان یأتیهم اللّه فی ظلل من الغمام و در حدیث مفضّل میفرماید یسند القائم ظهره الی الحرم و یمدّ یده المبارکة فتری بیضآء من غیر سوء و یقول هذه ید اللّه و یمین اللّه و عن اللّه و بأمر اللّه هر نحو این احادیث را معنی نموده‌اند آثار قلم اعلی را هم معنی نمایند حضرت امیر فرموده انا الّذی لا یقع علیه اسم و لا صفة و همچنین فرموده ظاهری امامة و باطنی غیب لا یدرک قال ابو جعفر الطّوسی قلت لأبی عبداللّه انتم الصّراط فی کتاب اللّه و انتم الزّکوة و انتم الحجّ قال یا فلان نحن الصّراط فی کتاب اللّه عزّ و جلّ و نحن الزّکوة و نحن الصّیام و نحن الحجّ و نحن الشّهر الحرام و نحن البلد الحرام و نحن کعبة اللّه و نحن قبلة اللّه و نحن وجه اللّه روی جابر عن ابی جعفر علیه السّلام قال یا جابر علیک بالبیان و المعانی فقال علیه السّلام امّا البیان و هو ان تعرف اللّه سبحانه لیس کمثله شیء فتعبده و لا تشرک به شیئاً و امّا المعانی فنحن معانیه و نحن جنبه و یده و لسانه و امره و حکمه و علمه و حقّه اذا شئنا شآء اللّه و یرید ما نریده ایضاً حضرت امیر علیه السّلام فرمود کیف اعبد ربّاً لم اره و در مقام دیگر میفرماید ما رأیت شیئاً الّا و قد رأیت اللّه قبله او بعده او معه

Bārī har muʿriḍī bi-kalimih-ī tamassuk namūdih va bar Ḥaqq iʿtirāḍ kardih. Subḥāna Allāh! Dhikr-i ulūhiyyat va rubūbiyyat kih az awliyā va aṣfiyā ẓāhir shudih ān rā asbāb-i iʿrāḍ va inkār qarār dādih-and. Ḥaḍrat-i Ṣādiq farmūdih: al-ʿubūdiyyatu jawharatun kunhuhā al-rubūbiyyah. Va Ḥaḍrat-i Amīr dar javāb-i aʿrābī kih az nafs suʾāl namūdih farmūdih: wa-thālithuhā al-lāhūtiyyatu al-malakūtiyyatu wa-hiya quwwatun lāhūtiyyatun wa-jawharatun basīṭatun ḥayyatun bi-al-dhāt. Ilā an qāla ʿalayhi al-salām: fa-hiya dhātu Allāhi al-ʿulyā wa-shajaratu Ṭūbā wa-sidratu al-muntahā wa-jannatu al-maʾwā. Ḥaḍrat-i Ṣādiq farmūdih: idhā qāma qāʾimunā ashraqati al-arḍu bi-nūri rabbihā. Va hamchunīn az Abī ʿAbdillāh ʿalayhi al-salām ḥadīth-i ṭavīlī dhikr shudih va az jumlih-yi nuṣūṣ-i ḥadīth-i madhkūr īn kalimih-yi ʿulyā ast: fa-ʿinda dhālika yahbiṭu al-Jabbāru ʿazza wa-jalla mina al-ghamāmi wa-al-malāʾikah. Wa-fī al-Qurʾāni al-ʿaẓīm: hal yanẓurūna illā an yaʾtiyahumu Allāhu fī ẓulalin mina al-ghamām. Va dar ḥadīth-i Mufaḍḍal mīfarmāyad: yusnidu al-Qāʾimu ẓahrahu ilā al-ḥarami wa-yamuddu yadahu al-mubārakata fa-turā bayḍāʾa min ghayri sūʾin wa-yaqūlu hādhihi yadu Allāhi wa-yamīnu Allāhi wa-ʿan Allāhi wa-bi-amri Allāh. Har naḥv īn aḥādīth rā maʿnī namūdih-and āthār-i Qalam-i Aʿlā rā ham maʿnī namāyand. Ḥaḍrat-i Amīr farmūdih: anā alladhī lā yaqaʿu ʿalayhi ismun wa-lā ṣifah. Va hamchunīn farmūdih: ẓāhirī imāmatun wa-bāṭinī ghaybun lā yudrak. Qāla Abū Jaʿfar al-Ṭūsī: qultu li-Abī ʿAbdillāh antumu al-ṣirāṭu fī kitābi Allāhi wa-antumu al-zakātu wa-antumu al-ḥajj. Qāla yā fulānu naḥnu al-ṣirāṭu fī kitābi Allāhi ʿazza wa-jalla wa-naḥnu al-zakātu wa-naḥnu al-ṣiyāmu wa-naḥnu al-ḥajju wa-naḥnu al-shahru al-ḥarāmu wa-naḥnu al-baladu al-ḥarāmu wa-naḥnu kaʿbatu Allāhi wa-naḥnu qiblatu Allāhi wa-naḥnu wajhu Allāh. Rawā Jābirun ʿan Abī Jaʿfar ʿalayhi al-salām qāla: yā Jābiru ʿalayka bi-al-bayāni wa-al-maʿānī. Fa-qāla ʿalayhi al-salām: ammā al-bayānu wa-huwa an taʿrifa Allāha subḥānahu laysa ka-mithlihi shayʾun fa-taʿbudahu wa-lā tushrika bihi shayʾan wa-ammā al-maʿānī fa-naḥnu maʿānīhi wa-naḥnu janbuhu wa-yaduhu wa-lisānuhu wa-amruhu wa-ḥukmuhu wa-ʿilmuhu wa-ḥaqquhu idhā shiʾnā shāʾa Allāhu wa-yurīdu mā nurīdu. Ayḍan Ḥaḍrat-i Amīr ʿalayhi al-salām farmūd: kayfa aʿbudu rabban lam arahu. Va dar maqām-i dīgar mīfarmāyad: mā raʾaytu shayʾan illā wa-qad raʾaytu Allāha qablahu aw baʿdahu aw maʿahu.

In short, everyone who has turned away has seized upon some word and raised objections against God. Glory be to God! They have made the references to divinity and lordship that have issued from the saints and chosen ones grounds for rejection and denial. His Holiness Ṣādiq has said: “Servitude is a jewel whose essence is lordship.” And His Holiness the Commander, in answer to a Bedouin who had asked about the soul, said: “Its third is the divine, heavenly soul, which is a divine power and a simple substance, living in itself.” He continued, peace be upon him, until he said: “It is the exalted Self of God, the Tree of Ṭūbā, the Lote Tree of the Utmost Boundary, and the Garden of Refuge.” His Holiness Ṣādiq has said: “When our Qāʾim arises, the earth will shine with the light of its Lord.” A lengthy tradition has also been related from Abū ʿAbdillāh, peace be upon him, and among the explicit statements of that tradition is this exalted utterance: “At that moment the All-Compelling, mighty and glorious is He, will descend from the clouds, and the angels.” And in the mighty Qurʾān: “Are they waiting for anything but that God should come to them in the shadows of the clouds?” And in the tradition of Mufaḍḍal he says: “The Qāʾim will lean his back against the Sanctuary and extend his blessed hand, and it will be seen to be white, without blemish. He will say: ‘This is the hand of God, the right hand of God, from God and by the command of God.’” In whatever way they have interpreted these traditions, let them also interpret the writings of the Most Exalted Pen. His Holiness the Commander has said: “I am the one to whom no name or attribute applies.” He has also said: “My outward reality is the Imamate, and my inward reality is an unseen mystery that cannot be apprehended.” Abū Jaʿfar al-Ṭūsī said: “I said to Abū ʿAbdillāh: ‘You are the Path in the Book of God, and you are the alms and you are the pilgrimage.’ He said: ‘O so-and-so! We are the Path in the Book of God, mighty and glorious is He; we are the alms, we are fasting, we are the pilgrimage, we are the sacred month, we are the sacred city, we are the Kaaba of God, we are the Point of Adoration of God, and we are the Face of God.’” Jābir related that Abū Jaʿfar, peace be upon him, said: “O Jābir! Hold fast to the exposition and the meanings.” He then said, peace be upon him: “As for the exposition, it is that you should recognize God, glorified be He—nothing is like Him—and worship Him and associate nothing with Him. As for the meanings, we are His meanings, and we are His side, His hand, His tongue, His command, His judgment, His knowledge, and His truth. When we will, God wills, and He desires what we desire.” His Holiness the Commander, peace be upon him, also said: “How could I worship a Lord whom I have not seen?” And elsewhere he says: “I have seen nothing without seeing God before it, or after it, or with it.”

169

یا شیخ در آنچه ذکر شده تفکّر فرما شاید بقوّت اسم قیّوم از رحیق مختوم بیاشامی و بیابی آنچه را که کل از ادراکش عاجزند کمر همّت را محکم نما و قصد ملکوت اعلی کن شاید در حین تنزیل نفحات وحی و الهام را بیابی و بآن فائز شوی براستی میگویم از برای امر الهی شبه و مثلی نبوده و نیست حجبات اوهام را خرق نما انّه یمدّک و یؤیّدک فضلاً من عنده و هو القویّ الغالب القدیر تا وقت باقی و سدرهٔ مبارکه مابین بریّه بأعلی النّدآء ناطق خود را منع منما توکّل علی اللّه و فوّض امورک الیه ثمّ احضر فى السّجن الأعظم لتسمع ما لا سمعت الآذان شبهه و تری ما لا رأت العیون و الأبصار آیا بعد از این بیان از برای احدی حجّتی باقیست لا ونفس اللّه القائمة علی الأمر براستی میگویم امروز کلمهٔ مبارکهٔ ولکنّه رسول اللّه و خاتم النّبیّین به یوم یقوم النّاس لربّ العالمین منتهی شد اشکر اللّه بهذا الفضل العظیم

Yā Shaykh dar ānchih dhikr shudih tafakkur farmā shāyad bi-quvvat-i ism-i Qayyūm az raḥīq-i makhtūm biyāshāmī va biyābī ānchih rā kih kull az idrākash ʿājizand. Kamar-i himmat rā muḥkam namā va qaṣd-i malakūt-i aʿlā kun shāyad dar ḥīn-i tanzīl nafaḥāt-i vaḥy va ilhām rā biyābī va bi-ān fāʾiz shavī. Bi-rāstī mīgūyam az barā-yi Amr-i Ilāhī shibh va mithlī nabūdih va nīst. Ḥujubāt-i awhām rā kharq namā. Innahu yumidduka wa-yuʾayyiduka faḍlan min ʿindihi wa-huwa al-Qawiyyu al-Ghālibu al-Qadīr. Tā vaqt bāqī va Sidrih-yi Mubārakih mābayn-i bariyyih bi-aʿlā al-nidāʾ nāṭiq khud rā manʿ manamā. Tawakkal ʿalā Allāhi wa-fawwiḍ umūraka ilayhi thumma iḥḍur fī al-Sijni al-Aʿẓami li-tasmaʿa mā lā samiʿati al-ādhānu shibhahu wa-tarā mā lā raʾati al-ʿuyūnu wa-al-abṣār. Āyā baʿd az īn bayān az barā-yi aḥadī ḥujjatī bāqīst? Lā wa-nafsi Allāhi al-qāʾimati ʿalā al-Amr. Bi-rāstī mīgūyam imrūz kalimih-yi mubārakih-yi wa-lākinnahu rasūlu Allāhi wa-khātamu al-nabiyyīn bi-yawma yaqūmu al-nāsu li-rabbi al-ʿālamīn muntahī shud. Ushkur Allāha bi-hādhā al-faḍli al-ʿaẓīm.

O Shaykh! Reflect on what has been mentioned, so that perhaps, through the power of the name of the Self-Subsisting, you may drink of the sealed wine and discover what all are powerless to comprehend. Gird yourself with determination and set your course toward the highest Kingdom, so that perhaps, at the moment of revelation, you may perceive the breezes of revelation and inspiration and attain them. Truly I say, the Cause of God has never had, nor does it have, any peer or likeness. Tear through the veils of vain imaginings. He will indeed assist and strengthen you as a favor from Him, and He is the Strong, the All-Subduing, the All-Powerful. While time remains and the Blessed Lote Tree speaks among the people with the loudest call, do not deprive yourself. Put your trust in God and entrust your affairs to Him; then come into the Most Great Prison, that you may hear what no ears have ever heard the like of, and see what no eyes or vision have seen. After this exposition, does anyone have any excuse left? No, by the very Self of God, Who presides over the Cause! Truly I say, today the blessed words, “But he is the Messenger of God and the Seal of the Prophets,” have culminated in “the day when humanity will stand before the Lord of the worlds.” Thank God for this immense bounty.

170

یا شیخ نفحات وحی بدونش مشتبه نشده و نمیشود حال سدرهٔ منتهی با اثمار لاتحصی امام وجهت حاضر خود را باوهام مثل حزب قبل میالای از نفس بیان فطرة اللّه ظاهر و مشهود اوست گواه کل در اثبات ظهورش باحدی محتاج نبوده و نیست حال قریب صد جلد آیات باهرات و کلمات محکمات از سماء مشیّت منزل آیات نازل و حاضر لک ان تقصد المقصد الأقصی و الغایة القصوی و الذّروة العلیا لتسمع و تری ما ظهر من لدی اللّه ربّ العالمین

Yā Shaykh nafaḥāt-i vaḥy bi-dūnash mushtabih nashudih va namīshavad. Ḥāl Sidrih-yi Muntahā bā athmār-i lā tuḥṣā imām-i vajhat ḥāḍir. Khud rā bi-awhām mithl-i ḥizb-i qabl mayālāy. Az nafs-i bayān fiṭrat-i Allāh ẓāhir va mashhūd. Ūst guvāh-i kull dar ithbāt-i ẓuhūrash bi-aḥadī muḥtāj nabūdih va nīst. Ḥāl qarīb-i ṣad jild āyāt-i bāhirāt va kalimāt-i muḥkamāt az samā-yi mashiyyat-i Munzil-i Āyāt nāzil va ḥāḍir. Laka an taqṣida al-maqṣada al-aqṣā wa-al-ghāyata al-quṣwā wa-al-dhirwata al-ʿulyā li-tasmaʿa wa-tarā mā ẓahara min ladā Allāhi rabbi al-ʿālamīn.

O Shaykh! The breezes of revelation have never been, nor will they ever be, confused with anything else. Now the Lote Tree of the Utmost Boundary, with its innumerable fruits, stands before your face. Do not, like the people of the past, defile yourself with vain imaginings. The innate nature bestowed by God is evident and manifest in the utterance itself. He is the witness to all; to establish His Revelation, He has never needed, nor does He need, anyone. Now nearly a hundred volumes of resplendent verses and firmly established words have descended from the heaven of the will of the Revealer of verses and are at hand. It is for you to set your course toward the furthest destination, the ultimate goal, and the loftiest summit, that you may hear and see what has appeared from God, the Lord of the worlds.

171

قدری در آیات لقا که از مالک ملکوت اسماء در فرقان نازل شده تفکّر نما شاید راه مستقیم را بیابی و سبب و علّت هدایت خلق شوی مثل شما امروز باید بر خدمت امر قیام نماید ذلّت این مظلوم و عزّت شما هر دو بفنا راجع جهد کن شاید فائز شوی بعملی که عرفش از عالم قطع نشود در ذکر لقا نازل شده آنچه که از برای منکرین مجال رد و عدم قبول نمانده و نیست قوله تبارک و تعالی اللّه الّذی رفع السّموات بغیر عمد ترونها ثمّ استوی علی العرش و سخّر الشّمس و القمر کلّ یجری لأجل مسمّی یدبّر الأمر یفصّل الآیات لعلّکم بلقآء ربّکم توقنون و میفرماید من کان یرجو لقآء اللّه فانّ اجل اللّه لآت و هو السّمیع العلیم الی قوله تعالی و الّذین کفروا بآیات اللّه و لقائه اولئک یئسوا من رحمتی و اولئک لهم عذاب الیم و همچنین میفرماید قالوا ائذا ضللنا فی الأرض ائنّا لفی خلق جدید بل هم بلقآء ربّهم کافرون و همچنین میفرماید الا انّهم فی مریة من لقآء ربّهم الا انّه بکلّ شیء محیط و همچنین میفرماید انّ الّذین لا یرجون لقائنا و رضوا بالحیوة الدّنیا و اطمأنّوا بها و الّذینهم عن آیاتنا غافلون اولئک مأواهم النّار بما کانوا یکسبون و هم‌چنین میفرماید و اذا تتلی علیهم آیاتنا بیّنات قال الّذین لا یرجون لقائنا ائت بقرآن غیر هذا او بدّله قل ما یکون لی ان ابدّله من تلقآء نفسی ان اتّبع الّا ما یوحی الیّ انّی اخاف ان عصیت ربّی عذاب یوم عظیم و همچنین میفرماید ثمّ آتینا موسی الکتاب تماماً علی الّذی احسن و تفصیلاً لکلّ شیء و هدی و رحمةً لعلّهم بلقآء ربّهم یؤمنون و همچنین میفرماید اولئک الّذین کفروا بآیات ربّهم و لقائه فحبطت اعمالهم فلا نقیم لهم یوم القیامة وزناً ذلک جزائهم جهنّم بما کفروا و اتّخذوا آیاتی و رسلی هزؤاً و هم‌چنین میفرماید هل اتاک حدیث موسی اذ رأی ناراً فقال لأهله امکثوا انّی آنست ناراً لعلّی آتیکم منها بقبس او اجد على النّار هدی فلمّا اتاها نودی یا موسی انّی انا ربّک فاخلع نعلیک انّک بالواد المقدّس طوی و انا اخترتک فاستمع لما یوحی انّنی انا اللّه لا اله الّا انا فاعبدنی و هم‌چنین میفرماید أ و لم یتفکّروا فی انفسهم ما خلق اللّه السّموات و الأرض و ما بینهما الّا بالحقّ و اجل مسمّی و انّ کثیراً من النّاس بلقآء ربّهم لکافرون و همچنین میفرماید الا یظنّ اولئک انّهم مبعوثون لیوم عظیم یوم یقوم النّاس لربّ العالمین و همچنین میفرماید و لقد آتینا موسی الکتاب فلا تکن فی مریة من لقائه و میفرماید کلّا اذا دکّت الأرض دکّاً دکّاً و جآء ربّک و الملک صفّاً صفّاً و همچنین میفرماید یریدون لیطفئوا نور اللّه بأفواههم و اللّه متمّ نوره ولو کره الکافرون و همچنین میفرماید فلمّا قضی موسی الأجل و سار بأهله آنس من جانب الطّور ناراً قال لأهله امکثوا انّی آنست ناراً لعلّى آتیکم منها بخبر او جذوة من النّار لعلّکم تصطلون فلمّا اتاها نودی من شاطئ الوادی الأیمن فی البقعة المبارکة من الشّجرة ان یا موسی انّی انا اللّه ربّ العالمین انتهی

Qadrī dar āyāt-i liqā kih az Mālik-i Malakūt-i Asmā dar Furqān nāzil shudih tafakkur namā shāyad rāh-i mustaqīm rā biyābī va sabab va ʿillat-i hidāyat-i khalq shavī. Mithl-i shumā imrūz bāyad bar khidmat-i Amr qiyām namāyad. Dhillat-i īn Maẓlūm va ʿizzat-i shumā har du bi-fanā rājiʿ. Jahd kun shāyad fāʾiz shavī bi-ʿamalī kih ʿarfash az ʿālam qaṭʿ nashavad. Dar dhikr-i liqā nāzil shudih ānchih kih az barā-yi munkirīn majāl-i radd va ʿadam-i qabūl namāndih va nīst. Qawluhu tabāraka wa-taʿālā: Allāhu alladhī rafaʿa al-samāwāti bi-ghayri ʿamadin tarawnahā thumma istawā ʿalā al-ʿarshi wa-sakhkhara al-shamsa wa-al-qamara kullun yajrī li-ajalin musamman yudabbiru al-amra yufaṣṣilu al-āyāti laʿallakum bi-liqāʾi rabbikum tūqinūn. Va mīfarmāyad: man kāna yarjū liqāʾa Allāhi fa-inna ajala Allāhi la-ātin wa-huwa al-Samīʿu al-ʿAlīm. Ilā qawlihi taʿālā: wa-alladhīna kafarū bi-āyāti Allāhi wa-liqāʾihi ulāʾika yaʾisū min raḥmatī wa-ulāʾika lahum ʿadhābun alīm. Va hamchunīn mīfarmāyad: qālū a-idhā ḍalalnā fī al-arḍi a-innā la-fī khalqin jadīdin bal hum bi-liqāʾi rabbihim kāfirūn. Va hamchunīn mīfarmāyad: alā innahum fī miryatin min liqāʾi rabbihim alā innahu bi-kulli shayʾin muḥīṭ. Va hamchunīn mīfarmāyad: inna alladhīna lā yarjūna liqāʾanā wa-raḍū bi-al-ḥayāti al-dunyā wa-iṭmaʾannū bihā wa-alladhīna hum ʿan āyātinā ghāfilūn ulāʾika maʾwāhumu al-nāru bi-mā kānū yaksibūn. Va hamchunīn mīfarmāyad: wa-idhā tutlā ʿalayhim āyātunā bayyinātin qāla alladhīna lā yarjūna liqāʾanā iʾti bi-Qurʾānin ghayri hādhā aw baddilhu qul mā yakūnu lī an ubaddilahu min tilqāʾi nafsī in attabiʿu illā mā yūḥā ilayya innī akhāfu in ʿaṣaytu rabbī ʿadhāba yawmin ʿaẓīm. Va hamchunīn mīfarmāyad: thumma ātaynā Mūsā al-kitāba tamāman ʿalā alladhī aḥsana wa-tafṣīlan li-kulli shayʾin wa-hudan wa-raḥmatan laʿallahum bi-liqāʾi rabbihim yuʾminūn. Va hamchunīn mīfarmāyad: ulāʾika alladhīna kafarū bi-āyāti rabbihim wa-liqāʾihi fa-ḥabiṭat aʿmāluhum fa-lā nuqīmu lahum yawma al-qiyāmati waznan dhālika jazāʾuhum jahannamu bi-mā kafarū wa-ittakhadhū āyātī wa-rusulī huzūʾan. Va hamchunīn mīfarmāyad: hal atāka ḥadīthu Mūsā idh raʾā nāran fa-qāla li-ahlihi umkuthū innī ānastu nāran laʿallī ātīkum minhā bi-qabasin aw ajidu ʿalā al-nāri hudan fa-lammā atāhā nūdiya yā Mūsā innī anā rabbuka fa-ikhlaʿ naʿlayka innaka bi-al-wādi al-muqaddasi Ṭuwan wa-anā ikhtartuka fa-istamiʿ li-mā yūḥā innanī anā Allāhu lā ilāha illā anā fa-uʿbudnī. Va hamchunīn mīfarmāyad: a-wa-lam yatafakkarū fī anfusihim mā khalaqa Allāhu al-samāwāti wa-al-arḍa wa-mā baynahumā illā bi-al-ḥaqqi wa-ajalin musamman wa-inna kathīran mina al-nāsi bi-liqāʾi rabbihim la-kāfirūn. Va hamchunīn mīfarmāyad: a-lā yaẓunnu ulāʾika annahum mabʿūthūna li-yawmin ʿaẓīmin yawma yaqūmu al-nāsu li-rabbi al-ʿālamīn. Va hamchunīn mīfarmāyad: wa-laqad ātaynā Mūsā al-kitāba fa-lā takun fī miryatin min liqāʾihi. Va mīfarmāyad: kallā idhā dukkati al-arḍu dakkan dakkan wa-jāʾa rabbuka wa-al-malaku ṣaffan ṣaffan. Va hamchunīn mīfarmāyad: yurīdūna li-yuṭfiʾū nūra Allāhi bi-afwāhihim wa-Allāhu mutimmu nūrihi wa-law kariha al-kāfirūn. Va hamchunīn mīfarmāyad: fa-lammā qaḍā Mūsā al-ajala wa-sāra bi-ahlihi ānasa min jānibi al-Ṭūri nāran qāla li-ahlihi umkuthū innī ānastu nāran laʿallī ātīkum minhā bi-khabarin aw jadhwatin mina al-nāri laʿallakum taṣṭalūn fa-lammā atāhā nūdiya min shāṭiʾi al-wādi al-aymani fī al-buqʿati al-mubārakati mina al-shajarati an yā Mūsā innī anā Allāhu rabbu al-ʿālamīn. Intahā.

Reflect a little on the verses concerning the meeting with God that have been revealed in the Qurʾān by the Sovereign of the Kingdom of Names, so that perhaps you may find the straight path and become the means and cause of guiding the people. Someone such as you should arise today to serve the Cause. The abasement of this Wronged One and your honor will both pass away. Strive, so that perhaps you may accomplish a deed whose fragrance will never cease in the world. Concerning the meeting with God, what has been revealed has left, and leaves, those who deny it no room for rejection or refusal. His words, blessed and exalted is He: “God is the One who raised the heavens without pillars that you can see, then established Himself upon the throne and subjected the sun and the moon, each running for an appointed term. He directs all affairs and sets forth the signs in detail, so that you may be certain of meeting your Lord.” And He says: “Whoever hopes to meet God—the term appointed by God will surely come, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.” Further on, He, exalted is He, says: “Those who disbelieve in the signs of God and in meeting Him have despaired of My mercy, and for them there is a painful punishment.” He also says: “They say: ‘When we have been lost in the earth, will we really be created anew?’ Rather, they deny the meeting with their Lord.” He also says: “Indeed, they are in doubt about meeting their Lord. Indeed, He encompasses all things.” He also says: “Those who do not hope to meet Us, and are content with the life of this world and feel secure in it, and those who are heedless of Our signs—their refuge is the Fire because of what they have earned.” He also says: “When Our clear verses are recited to them, those who do not hope to meet Us say: ‘Bring a Qurʾān other than this, or change it.’ Say: ‘It is not for me to change it of my own accord. I follow only what is revealed to me. I fear, if I disobey my Lord, the punishment of a mighty day.’” He also says: “Then We gave Moses the Book, completing Our favor upon the one who did good, explaining all things in detail, and providing guidance and mercy, so that they might believe in meeting their Lord.” He also says: “These are the ones who disbelieve in the signs of their Lord and in meeting Him, so their deeds have come to nothing, and on the Day of Resurrection We will give them no weight. That is their recompense—Hell—because they disbelieved and made a mockery of My signs and My messengers.” He also says: “Has the story of Moses reached you? When he saw a fire, he said to his family: ‘Stay here. I have perceived a fire. Perhaps I can bring you a burning brand from it, or find guidance at the fire.’ When he came to it, he was called: ‘O Moses! I am indeed your Lord. Take off your sandals: you are in the sacred valley of Ṭuwā. I have chosen you, so listen to what is revealed. I am indeed God; there is no god but Me, so worship Me.’” He also says: “Have they not reflected within themselves? God did not create the heavens and the earth and what is between them except in truth and for an appointed term. Yet many people indeed deny the meeting with their Lord.” He also says: “Do they not think that they will be raised up for a mighty day, the day when humanity will stand before the Lord of the worlds?” He also says: “We indeed gave Moses the Book, so do not be in doubt about meeting Him.” And He says: “No indeed! When the earth is pounded to dust, again and again, and your Lord comes, and the angels, rank upon rank.” He also says: “They wish to extinguish the light of God with their mouths, but God will perfect His light, however much the unbelievers may detest it.” He also says: “When Moses had fulfilled the term and was traveling with his family, he perceived a fire on the side of the Mount. He said to his family: ‘Stay here. I have perceived a fire. Perhaps I can bring you news from it, or a burning ember from the fire, so that you may warm yourselves.’ When he came to it, he was called from the right bank of the valley, in the blessed spot, from the tree: ‘O Moses! I am indeed God, the Lord of the worlds.’” End of quotation.

172

در جمیع کتب الهی وعد‌‌هٔ لقا صریح بوده و هست و مقصود از این لقا لقاء مشرق آیات و مطلع بیّنات و مظهر اسماء حسنی و مصدر صفات علیای حقّ جلّ جلاله است حقّ بذاته و بنفسه غیب منیع لایدرک بوده پس مقصود از لقا لقاء نفسی است که قائم‌مقام اوست مابین عباد و از برای او هم شبه و مثلی نبوده و نیست چه اگر از برای او شبه و مثلی مشاهده شود کیف یثبت تقدیس ذاته و تنزیه کینونته عن الأشباه و الأمثال باری در مقامات لقا و تجلّی در کتاب ایقان نازل شده آنچه که منصفین را کفایت نماید نسأله تعالی ان یؤیّد الکلّ علی الصّدق الخالص و یقرّبهم الیه انّه هو المقتدر القدیر لا اله الّا هو السّامع النّاطق العزیز الحمید

Dar jamīʿ-i kutub-i Ilāhī vaʿdih-yi liqā ṣarīḥ būdih va hast va maqṣūd az īn liqā liqāʾ-i Mashriq-i Āyāt va Maṭlaʿ-i Bayyināt va Maẓhar-i Asmā-yi Ḥusnā va Maṣdar-i Ṣifāt-i ʿUlyā-yi Ḥaqq jalla jalāluhu ast. Ḥaqq bi-dhātih va bi-nafsih ghayb-i manīʿ-i lā yudrak būdih pas maqṣūd az liqā liqāʾ-i nafsī ast kih qāʾim-maqām-i Ūst mābayn-i ʿibād va az barā-yi Ū ham shibh va mithlī nabūdih va nīst chih agar az barā-yi Ū shibh va mithlī mushāhidih shavad kayfa yathbutu taqdīsu dhātihi wa-tanzīhu kaynūnatihi ʿani al-ashbāhi wa-al-amthāl. Bārī dar maqāmāt-i liqā va tajallī dar Kitāb-i Īqān nāzil shudih ānchih kih munṣifīn rā kifāyat namāyad. Nasʾaluhu taʿālā an yuʾayyida al-kulla ʿalā al-ṣidqi al-khāliṣi wa-yuqarribahum ilayhi innahu huwa al-Muqtadiru al-Qadīru lā ilāha illā huwa al-Sāmiʿu al-Nāṭiqu al-ʿAzīzu al-Ḥamīd.

In all the divine Books, the promise of meeting God has been, and remains, explicit. What is meant by this meeting is meeting the Dawning Place of the verses, the Dayspring of the clear proofs, the Manifestation of the most beautiful names, and the Source of the most exalted attributes of God, glorified be His glory. God in His Essence and His own Self has ever been an inaccessible, unknowable mystery. Thus, what is meant by this meeting is meeting the One who stands in His place among His servants. He, too, has never had, nor does He have, any peer or likeness, for if any peer or likeness to Him were found, how could the sanctity of His Essence and the transcendence of His Being above all peers and likenesses be established? In short, concerning the stations of meeting God and His self-revelation, enough has been revealed in the Book of Certitude to satisfy the fair-minded. We ask Him, exalted is He, to aid everyone to attain pure truthfulness and to draw them near to Him. He is indeed the All-Powerful, the Almighty. There is no god but Him, the Hearing, the Speaking, the Invincible, the Praiseworthy.

173

یا ایّها المعروف بالعلم مُر العباد بالمعروف و لا تکن من المتوقّفین ببصر حدید نظر نما آفتاب حقیقت بامر مالک ملکوت بیان و سلطان جبروت عرفان از افق سماء سجن عکّا مشرق و لائح اعراض او را محجوب ننمود و صفوف و الوف منعش نکرد از برای آن جناب هیچ عذری باقی نمانده یا باید اقرار نمائی و یا نعوذ باللّه بر انکار کل قیام کنی

Yā ayyuhā al-maʿrūfu bi-al-ʿilmi mur al-ʿibāda bi-al-maʿrūfi wa-lā takun mina al-mutawaqqifīn. Bi-baṣar-i ḥadīd naẓar namā. Āftāb-i Ḥaqīqat bi-amr-i Mālik-i Malakūt-i Bayān va Sulṭān-i Jabarūt-i ʿIrfān az ufuq-i samā-yi Sijn-i ʿAkkā mushriq va lāʾiḥ. Iʿrāḍ Ū rā maḥjūb nanamūd va ṣufūf va ulūf manʿash nakard. Az barā-yi ān janāb hīch ʿudhrī bāqī namāndih yā bāyad iqrār namāʾī va yā naʿūdhu bi-Allāh bar inkār-i kull qiyām kunī.

O you who are known for learning! Enjoin what is right upon the servants and do not be among those who hesitate. Look with keen vision. By the command of the Sovereign of the Kingdom of Utterance and the Ruler of the Dominion of Recognition, the Sun of Truth has risen and shines from the horizon of the heaven of the Prison of ʿAkkā. Rejection has not veiled Him, nor have ranks and thousands held Him back. No excuse remains for you: either you must acknowledge Him, or—God forbid—you must arise to deny them all.

174

یا شیخ در حزب شیعه تفکّر نما چه مقدار عمارتها که بایادی ظنون و اوهام تعمیر نمودند و چه شهرها بنا نهادند بالأخره آن اوهام برصاص تبدیل شد و بر سیّد عالم وارد و یک نفس از رؤسای آن حزب در یوم ظهور اقبال ننمود نزد ذکر اسم مبارک کل به عجّل اللّه فرجه ناطق ولکن در یوم ظهور آن شمس حقیقت کل به عجّل اللّه فی نقمته متکلّم و ناطق چنانچه دیده شد ساذج وجود و مالک غیب و شهود را آویختند و عمل نمودند آنچه را که لوح گریست و قلم نوحه نمود و زفرات مخلصین مرتفع و عبرات مقرّبین نازل

Yā Shaykh, dar ḥizb-e Shīʿa tafakkor namā, che meqdār ʿemārathā ke be-ayādī-ye ẓonūn va awhām taʿmīr namūdand va che shahrhā banā nahādand. Be-l-ākhera ān awhām be-raṣāṣ tabdīl shod va bar Sayyed-e ʿālam vāred, va yek nafs az roʾasā-ye ān ḥizb dar yawm-e ẓohūr eqbāl nanamūd. Nazd-e dhekr-e esm-e mobārak koll be-ʿajjala Allāhu farajahu nāṭeq, va-lāken dar yawm-e ẓohūr-e ān Shams-e Ḥaqīqat koll be-ʿajjala Allāhu fī niqmatihi motakallem va nāṭeq. Chenānche dīde shod, Sādhej-e Vojūd va Mālek-e ghayb va shohūd rā āvīkhtand va ʿamal namūdand ānche rā ke Lawḥ gerīst va Qalam nawḥe namūd va zafarāt-e mokhleṣīn mortafeʿ va ʿabarāt-e moqarrabīn nāzel.

O Shaykh! Reflect on the Shiʿi community: how many edifices they raised with the hands of conjecture and delusion, and how many cities they built. In the end, those delusions turned into bullets and struck the Lord of the world, and not one of that community’s leaders turned toward Him on the day of His appearance. At the mention of His blessed name, all would say, “May God hasten His advent,” but on the day that Sun of Truth appeared, all spoke and said, “May God hasten His vengeance against Him.” As was witnessed, they suspended the Essence of Being, the Sovereign of the unseen and the seen, and committed deeds that made the Tablet weep and the Pen lament, raised the sighs of the sincere, and caused the tears of those brought near to flow.

175

یا شیخ فکر نما و بانصاف تکلّم کن حزب شیخ احسائی باعانت الهی عارف شدند بآنچه که دون آن حزب از آن محروم و محجوب مشاهده گشتند باری در هر عصری و هر قرنی ایّام ظهور مشارق وحی و مطالع الهام و مهابط علم الهی اختلاف ظاهر و سبب و علّت آن نفوس کاذبهٔ ملحده بوده‌اند شرح این مقام جائز نه آن جناب خود اعرف و اعلمند باوهام متوهّمین و ظنون مریبین

Yā Shaykh, fekr namā va be-enṣāf takallom kon. Ḥizb-e Shaykh-e Aḥsāʾī be-eʿānat-e elāhī ʿāref shodand be-ānche ke dūn-e ān ḥizb az ān maḥrūm va maḥjūb moshāhede gashtand. Bārī, dar har ʿaṣrī va har qarnī ayyām-e ẓohūr-e mashāreq-e vaḥy va maṭāleʿ-e elhām va mahābeṭ-e ʿelm-e elāhī ekhtelāf ẓāher va sabab va ʿellat-e ān nofūs-e kādhebe-ye molḥede būde-and. Sharḥ-e īn maqām jāʾez na. Ān janāb khod aʿraf va aʿlamand be-awhām-e motavahhemīn va ẓonūn-e morībīn.

O Shaykh! Reflect and speak fairly. Through divine assistance, the followers of Shaykh Aḥsāʾī came to recognize that of which those outside that community were seen to be deprived and from which they were veiled. In every age and every century, when the Dawning Places of revelation, the Daysprings of inspiration, and the Repositories of divine knowledge appeared, dissension arose, and lying, faithless souls were its cause. It is not appropriate to elaborate on this matter. You yourself are more fully aware and knowledgeable concerning the delusions of the deluded and the conjectures of those who sow doubt.

176

الیوم این مظلوم از آن جناب و سائر علما که از کأس علم الهی نوشیده‌اند و از کلمات انوار نیّر عدل منوّرند مسئلت مینماید نفسی را معیّن فرمایند من‌دون اطّلاع احدی و او را باین جهات بفرستند و چندی در جزیرهٔ قبرس توقّف نماید و با میرزا یحیی معاشر شود شاید بر اصل امر و مصدر اوامر و احکام الهی آگاه گردد

Al-yawm īn Maẓlūm az ān janāb va sāʾer-e ʿolamā ke az kaʾs-e ʿelm-e elāhī nūshīde-and va az kalemāt-e anvār-e Nayy er-e ʿAdl monavvarand masʾalat mīnamāyad nafsī rā moʿayyan farmāyand min dūn-e eṭṭelāʿ-e aḥadī va ū rā be-īn jehāt beferestand va chandī dar jazīre-ye Qebres tavaqqof namāyad va bā Mīrzā Yaḥyā moʿāsher shavad, shāyad bar aṣl-e amr va maṣdar-e avāmer va aḥkām-e elāhī āgāh gardad.

Today this Wronged One asks you and the other learned men who have drunk from the cup of divine knowledge and are illumined by the words of the Luminary of Justice to appoint someone, without anyone’s knowledge, and send him to these regions. Let him stay for a time on the island of Cyprus and associate with Mīrzā Yaḥyā, so that he may perhaps become acquainted with the true nature of the Cause and the source of the divine commands and laws.

177

اگر قدری تفکّر نمائی شهادت میدهی بر حکمت و قدرت و سلطنت حقّ جلّ جلاله معدودی که از امر آگاه نه و با ما نبوده‌اند گفته‌اند آنچه را که اشیاء کلّها و نفوس مطمئنّهٔ راضیهٔ مرضیّه گواهی داده‌اند بر کذب آن نفوس غافله حال اگر آن جناب همّت فرمایند حقیقت امر بر عالمیان کشف شود و ناس را از این ظلمات مظلم صیلم نجات بخشد لو لا البهآء من یقدر ان ینطق امام وجوه الأنام و لولاه من یقدر ان یتکلّم بما امر به من لدی اللّه ربّ الجنود

Agar qadrī tafakkor namāʾī shahādat mīdahī bar ḥekmat va qodrat va salṭanat-e Ḥaqq, jalla jalāluhu. Maʿdūdī ke az amr āgāh na va bā mā nabūde-and gofte-and ānche rā ke ashyāʾ kolluhā va nofūs-e moṭmaʾenne-ye rāḍīye-ye marḍīye gavāhī dāde-and bar kedhb-e ān nofūs-e ghāfele. Ḥāl agar ān janāb hemmat farmāyand ḥaqīqat-e amr bar ʿālamiyān kashf shavad va nās rā az īn ẓolomāt-e moẓlem-e ṣaylam nejāt bakhshad. Law lā al-Bahāʾ man yaqdiru an yanṭiqa amāma wujūhi al-anām, wa-lawlāhu man yaqdiru an yatakallama bi-mā umira bihi min ladā Allāhi Rabbi al-junūd.

If you reflect a little, you will testify to the wisdom, power, and sovereignty of God, glorified be His glory. A few who know nothing of the Cause and have not been with Us have made claims whose falsehood all things, and souls that are assured, content, and pleasing to God, have attested. Now, if you exert yourself, the truth of the matter will be disclosed to the world and will deliver people from this dark, devastating gloom. Were it not for Bahāʾ, who could speak openly before the faces of humanity? Were it not for Him, who could utter what he has been commanded by God, the Lord of Hosts?

178

حال نفس غافل بحبل روضه‌خوانی تمسّک جسته لعمر اللّه انّه فی کذب مبین چه که این حزب را اعتقاد آنکه در ظهور حضرت قائم ائمّه سلام اللّه علیهم از قبور برخاسته‌اند هذا حقّ لا ریب فیه از حقّ میطلبیم متوهّمین را از کوثر ایقان که از معین قلم اعلی جاریست قسمت عطا فرماید تا کل فائز شوند بآنچه که سزاوار ایّام اوست

Ḥāl nafs-e ghāfel be-ḥabl-e rawḍe-khvānī tamassok joste. La-ʿamru Allāhi innahu la-fī kid hbin mubīn. Che ke īn ḥizb rā eʿteqād ānke dar ẓohūr-e Ḥaḍrat-e Qāʾem aʾemme, salāmu Allāhi ʿalayhim, az qobūr barkhāste-and. Hādhā ḥaqqun lā rayba fīhi. Az Ḥaqq mīṭalabīm motavahhemīn rā az kawthar-e īqān ke az maʿīn-e Qalam-e Aʿlā jārīst qesmat ʿaṭā farmāyad tā koll fāʾez shavand be-ānche ke sazāvār-e ayyām-e Ūst.

Now that heedless soul has clung to the cord of reciting lamentations. By the life of God, he is plainly lying. For this community believes that, at the appearance of the Qāʾim, the Imams, God’s peace be upon them, rose from their graves. This is a truth beyond doubt. We ask God to grant the deluded a share of the Kawthar of certitude flowing from the wellspring of the Most Exalted Pen, so that all may attain what befits His days.

179

یا شیخ در بحبوحهٔ بلایا این مظلوم بتحریر این کلمات مشغول از جمیع جهات نار ظلم و اعتساف مشهود از یک جهت خبر رسیده اولیا را در ارض طاء اخذ نموده‌اند مع آنکه آفتاب و ماه و بر و بحر گواه که این حزب بطراز وفا مزیّنند و جز بارتفاع دولت و نظم مملکت و راحت ملّت بامری تمسّک نجسته و نخواهند جست

Yā Shaykh, dar boḥbūḥe-ye balāyā īn Maẓlūm be-taḥrīr-e īn kalemāt mashghūl. Az jamīʿ-e jehāt nār-e ẓolm va eʿtesāf mashhūd. Az yek jahat khabar resīde awliyā rā dar arḍ-e Ṭāʾ akhdh namūde-and, maʿ-e ānke āftāb va māh va barr va baḥr gavāh ke īn ḥizb be-ṭerāz-e vafā mozayyanand va joz be-ertefāʿ-e dawlat va naẓm-e mamlakat va rāḥat-e mellat be-amrī tamassok najoste va nakhvāhand jost.

O Shaykh! Amid tribulations, this Wronged One is occupied with writing these words. On every side the fire of oppression and tyranny is evident. From one direction, news has come that the loved ones have been arrested in the land of Ṭāʾ, although the sun and moon, land and sea bear witness that this community is adorned with loyalty and has sought, and will seek, nothing but the advancement of the government, the order of the country, and the well-being of its people.

180

یا شیخ مکرّر گفتیم حضرت پادشاه را در سنین معدودات نصرت نموده‌ایم سالهاست در ایران امر مغایری ظاهر نشده زمام مفسدین احزاب در قبضهٔ اقتدار مقبوض احدی از حدّ تجاوز ننمود لعمر اللّه این حزب اهل فساد نبوده و نیستند قلوبشان بنور تقوی منوّر و بطراز محبّة اللّه مزیّن همّشان اصلاح عالم بوده و هست و اراده آنکه اختلاف از میان برخیزد و نار ضغینه و بغضا خاموشی پذیرد تا جمیع ارض قطعهٔ واحده مشاهده گردد

Yā Shaykh, mokarrar goftīm Ḥaḍrat-e Pādeshāh rā dar senīn-e maʿdūdāt noṣrat namūde-īm. Sālhāst dar Īrān amr-e moghāyerī ẓāher nashode. Zemām-e mofsedīn-e aḥzāb dar qabḍe-ye eqtedār maqbūḍ. Aḥadī az ḥadd tajāvoz nanamūd. La-ʿamru Allāh, īn ḥizb ahl-e fasād nabūde va nīstand. Qolūbeshān be-nūr-e taqvā monavvar va be-ṭerāz-e maḥabbat Allāh mozayyan. Hammes hān eṣlāḥ-e ʿālam būde va hast va erāde ānke ekhtelāf az miyān barkhīzad va nār-e ḍaghīne va baghḍā khāmūshī padhīrad tā jamīʿ-e arḍ qeṭʿe-ye vāḥede moshāhede gardad.

O Shaykh! We have repeatedly said that We have aided His Majesty the Shah over a number of years. For years, nothing contrary to this has appeared in Iran. The reins of the troublemakers among the factions are held firmly in the grasp of power. No one has overstepped the bounds. By the life of God, this community has not been, and is not, a people of sedition. Their hearts are illumined by the light of piety and adorned with the love of God. Their concern has been, and remains, the betterment of the world, and their desire is that dissension may cease and the fire of malice and hatred be extinguished, so that the whole earth may be seen as one land.

181

و از جهت دیگر دائرهٔ سفارت ایران در مدینهٔ کبیره بتمام قدرت و قوّت بتضییع این مظلومان مشغول انّهم ارادوا امراً و اللّه اراد امراً آخر حال تفکّر فرمائید در آنچه بر امنای حقّ در هر دیار وارد شده گاهی نسبت سرقت و دزدی داده‌اند و هنگامى بمفتریاتی تکلّم نموده‌اند که در عالم شبه و مثل نداشته حال آن جناب بانصاف تکلّم فرمایند آیا نسبت سرقتی که از جانب سفارت کبری برعیّت خود داده ثمر و اثرش در ممالک خارجه چیست از این فقره این مظلوم خجل شد نه از جهت آنکه سبب و علّت تضییع این عبد بوده بلکه علّت خجلت اطّلاع سفرای اجنبیّه بر مراتب تدبیر و ادراک جمعی از معتبرین ایران در سفارت کبری بوده متّهم داری کسانی را که حقّ کرد امین مخزن هفتم طبق باری از مقامی که باید مقامات عالیه طلب نمایند و اخذ رأی کنند در اطفاء نورش ساعی و جاهدند ولکن در ظهور این فقره از قرار مذکور جناب سفیر کبیر معین‌الملک میرزا محسن خان ایّده اللّه در آستانه تشریف نداشته‌اند و این امور نظر بآن است که حضرت پادشاه ایران ایّده الرّحمن را از محرمان حرم عرفان مکدّر میدانند حقّ شاهد و گواه که این مظلوم لازال باسبابی که سبب عزّت دولت و ملّت است متمسّک بوده و کفی باللّه شهیداً

Va az jahat-e dīgar dāʾere-ye sefārat-e Īrān dar Madīne-ye Kabīre be-tamām-e qodrat va qovvat be-taḍyīʿ-e īn maẓlūmān mashghūl. Innahum arādū amran wa-Allāhu arāda amran ākhar. Ḥāl tafakkor farmāʾīd dar ānche bar omanā-ye Ḥaqq dar har diyār vāred shode. Gāhī nesbat-e serqat va dozdī dāde-and va hengāmī be-moftarayātī takallom namūde-and ke dar ʿālam shebh va methl nadāshte. Ḥāl ān janāb be-enṣāf takallom farmāyand, āyā nesbat-e serqatī ke az jāneb-e sefārat-e kobrā be-raʿīyat-e khod dāde thamar va atharash dar mamālek-e khāreje chīst? Az īn feqre īn Maẓlūm khajel shod, na az jahat-e ānke sabab va ʿellat-e taḍyīʿ-e īn ʿabd būde, balke ʿellat-e khejālat eṭṭelāʿ-e sofarā-ye ajnabīye bar marāteb-e tadbīr va edrāk-e jamʿī az moʿtabarīn-e Īrān dar sefārat-e kobrā būde. Mottaham dārī kasānī rā ke Ḥaqq kard amīn-e makhzan-e haftom ṭabaq. Bārī, az maqāmī ke bāyad maqāmāt-e ʿālīye ṭalab namāyand va akhdh-e raʾy konand dar eṭfā-ye nūrash sāʿī va jāhedand. Va-lāken dar ẓohūr-e īn feqre az qarār-e madhkūr Janāb-e Safīr-e Kabīr Moʿīn al-Molk Mīrzā Moḥsen Khān, ayyadahu Allāh, dar Āstāne tashrīf nadāshte-and. Va īn omūr naẓar be-ān ast ke Ḥaḍrat-e Pādeshāh-e Īrān, ayyadahu al-Raḥmān, rā az maḥramān-e ḥaram-e ʿerfān mokaddar mīdānand. Ḥaqq shāhed va gavāh ke īn Maẓlūm lāzāl be-asbābī ke sabab-e ʿezzat-e dawlat va mellat ast motamassek būde, wa-kafā bi-Allāhi shahīdan.

From another direction, the Persian embassy in the Great City is exerting all its power and strength to discredit these wronged ones. They have intended one thing, and God has intended another. Now reflect on what has befallen God’s trusted ones in every land. At times they have been accused of theft and robbery, and at others, slanders have been uttered that have no parallel or likeness in the world. Now speak fairly: what fruit and effect does the embassy’s accusation of theft against its own subjects have in foreign countries? This affair has made this Wronged One ashamed—not because it has caused this servant to be discredited, but because foreign ambassadors have learned the extent of the judgment and understanding of certain Persian dignitaries at the embassy. “You accuse those whom God has made trustees of the treasury of the seventh heaven.” In short, they strive and labor to extinguish the light of the very source from which they should seek exalted stations and counsel. However, according to what has been reported, His Excellency the ambassador, Moʿīn al-Molk Mīrzā Moḥsen Khān, may God assist him, was not in Constantinople when this affair occurred. These actions arise because they believe His Majesty the Shah of Persia, may the All-Merciful assist him, to be displeased with the intimates of the sanctuary of recognition. God bears witness that this Wronged One has always held fast to whatever promotes the honor of the government and the people. God is sufficient as a witness.

182

در وصف اهل بها از قلم اعلی این کلمات نازل انّهم رجال لو یمرّون علی مدائن الذّهب لا یلتفتون الیها و لو یمرّون علی ملکوت الجمال لا یتوجّهون الیه کذلک نزّل من القلم الأعلی لأهل البهآء من لدن ناصح علیم و در آخر لوح حضرت امپراطور پاریس این کلمهٔ علیا نازل هل تفرح بما عندک من الزّخارف بعد اذ تعلم انّها ستفنی او تسترّ بما تحکم علی شبر من الأرض بعد اذ کلّها لم تکن عند اهل البهآء الّا کسواد عین نملة میّتة دعها لأهلها ثمّ اقبل الى مقصود العالمین

Dar vaṣf-e ahl-e Bahā az Qalam-e Aʿlā īn kalemāt nāzel: Innahum rijālun law yamurrūna ʿalā madāʾini al-dhahabi lā yaltafitūna ilayhā, wa-law yamurrūna ʿalā malakūti al-jamāli lā yatawajjahūna ilayhi. Kadhālika nuzzila mina al-Qalami al-Aʿlā li-ahli al-Bahāʾ min ladun nāṣiḥin ʿalīm. Va dar ākhar-e lawḥ-e Ḥaḍrat-e Emperāṭor-e Pārīs īn kaleme-ye ʿolyā nāzel: Hal tafraḥu bi-mā ʿindaka mina al-zakhārifi baʿda idh taʿlamu annahā satafnā, aw tastarru bi-mā taḥkumu ʿalā shibrin mina al-arḍi baʿda idh kulluhā lam takun ʿinda ahli al-Bahāʾ illā ka-sawādi ʿayni namlatin mayyita. Daʿhā li-ahlihā thumma aqbil ilā Maqṣūdi al-ʿālamīn.

These words were revealed by the Most Exalted Pen in praise of the people of Bahā: “They are men who, were they to pass through cities of gold, would pay them no attention, and were they to pass through the kingdom of beauty, would not turn toward it. Thus has it been revealed by the Most Exalted Pen for the people of Bahā, from One who counsels and knows.” And at the end of the Tablet to His Majesty the Emperor of Paris, these exalted words were revealed: “Do you rejoice in the finery you possess, when you know that it will perish? Or are you pleased that you rule over a span of earth, when all of it is, in the eyes of the people of Bahā, no more than the black of a dead ant’s eye? Leave it to its people, then turn toward the Desire of the worlds.”

183

جز حقّ جلّ جلاله احدی بر آنچه بر این مظلوم وارد شده آگاه نه در هر یوم ذکری در دائرۀ‌ سفارت کبری در آستانه اصغا میشود سبحان‌اللّه جمیع تدابیر منحصر شده باسبابی که سبب و علّت تضییع این عبد است غافل از آنکه ذلّت در سبیل الهی نفس عزّتست در ورق‌ اخبار این کلمات مذکور قوله در تقلّبکاری بعضی از منفیّان عکّا و تعدّیاتی که از آنان بر بعضی وارد شده الى آخر قوله نزد مظاهر عدل و مطالع انصاف قصدش معلوم و مقصودش واضح باری بانواع اذیّت و ظلم و اعتساف قیام نمود لعمر اللّه این مظلوم این منفی را بوطن اعلی تبدیل نمینماید نزد اهل بصر آنچه در سبیل الهی وارد شود عزّیست مبین و مقامیست کبیر از قبل گفتیم سبحانک یا الهی لو لا البلایا فی سبیلک من این یظهر مقام عاشقیک و لو لا الرّزایا فی حبّک بأیّ شیء یثبت شأن مشتاقیک

Joz Ḥaqq, jalla jalāluhu, aḥadī bar ānche bar īn Maẓlūm vāred shode āgāh na. Dar har yawm dhekrī dar dāʾere-ye sefārat-e kobrā dar Āstāne eṣghā mīshavad. Subḥān Allāh, jamīʿ-e tadābīr monḥaṣer shode be-asbābī ke sabab va ʿellat-e taḍyīʿ-e īn ʿabd ast, ghāfel az ānke dhellat dar sabīl-e elāhī nafs-e ʿezzat ast. Dar varaq-e akhbār īn kalemāt madhkūr, qawluhu: Dar taqallobkārī-ye baʿḍī az manfīyān-e ʿAkkā va taʿaddīyātī ke az ānān bar baʿḍī vāred shode, ilā ākhir-e qawlihi. Nazd-e maẓāher-e ʿadl va maṭāleʿ-e enṣāf qaṣdash maʿlūm va maqṣūdash vāḍeḥ. Bārī, be-anvāʿ-e adhīyat va ẓolm va eʿtesāf qiyām namūd. La-ʿamru Allāh, īn Maẓlūm īn manfā rā be-vaṭan-e aʿlā tabdīl namīnamāyad. Nazd-e ahl-e baṣar ānche dar sabīl-e elāhī vāred shavad ʿezzīst mobīn va maqāmīst kabīr. Az qabl goftīm: Subḥānaka yā Ilāhī, law lā al-balāyā fī sabīlika min ayna yaẓharu maqāmu ʿāshiqīka, wa-law lā al-razāyā fī ḥubbika bi-ayyi shayʾin yathbutu shaʾnu mushtāqīk.

No one but God, glorified be His glory, knows what has befallen this Wronged One. Every day some report is heard in the embassy offices in Constantinople. Glory be to God! All their planning has become confined to means of discrediting this servant, heedless that abasement in the path of God is honor itself. These words appeared in the newspaper: “Concerning the fraudulent conduct of some of the exiles of ʿAkkā and the acts of aggression they have committed against certain people,” and so on. To the manifestations of justice and the daysprings of fairness, his intention is known and his purpose clear. In short, he has resorted to every kind of harassment, oppression, and tyranny. By the life of God, this Wronged One would not exchange this place of exile for the most exalted homeland. In the eyes of those endowed with insight, whatever befalls one in the path of God is manifest honor and a lofty station. We have previously said: “Glory be to You, O my God! Were it not for tribulations in Your path, how would the station of Your lovers be revealed? Were it not for afflictions endured out of love for You, by what means would the rank of those who yearn for You be established?”

184

ذلّت بمقامی رسیده که هر یوم بانتشار مفتریات مشغولند ولکن این مظلوم بصبر جمیل تمسّک جسته ایکاش حضرت پادشاه ممالک ایران آنچه در آستانه وارد شده صورت آن را طلب فرمایند تا بر حقیقت امر آگاه شوند یا سلطان اقسمک بربّک الرّحمن در این فقره بنظر عدل ملاحظه فرما هل من ذی عدل یحکم الیوم بما انزله اللّه فی الکتاب و هل من ذی انصاف ینصف فیما ورد علینا من دون بیّنة و برهان

Dhellat be-maqāmī resīde ke har yawm be-enteshār-e moftarayāt mashghūland. Va-lāken īn Maẓlūm be-ṣabr-e jamīl tamassok joste. Ey kāsh Ḥaḍrat-e Pādeshāh-e mamālek-e Īrān ānche dar Āstāne vāred shode ṣūrat-e ān rā ṭalab farmāyand tā bar ḥaqīqat-e amr āgāh shavand. Yā Sulṭān, uqsimuka bi-Rabbika al-Raḥmān, dar īn feqre be-naẓar-e ʿadl molāḥeẓe farmā. Hal min dhī ʿadlin yaḥkumu al-yawma bi-mā anzalahu Allāhu fī al-Kitāb, wa-hal min dhī inṣāfin yunṣifu fī-mā warada ʿalaynā min dūni bayyinatin wa-burhān.

Abasement has reached such a point that every day they are occupied with spreading slanders. Yet this Wronged One has held fast to gracious patience. If only His Majesty the Shah of Persia would request an account of what has occurred in Constantinople, so that he might learn the truth of the matter. O King! I implore you by your Lord, the All-Merciful: look upon this affair with the eye of justice. Is there anyone just who will judge today according to what God has revealed in the Book? Is there anyone fair-minded who will judge fairly concerning what has befallen Us without evidence or proof?

185

یا شیخ در اطوار نفوس تفکّر نما ساکنین مدائن علم و حکمت متحیّر آیا چه واقع شده که حزب شیعه که خود را اعلم و ازهد و اتقی از جمیع احزاب عالم میشمردند در یوم ظهور اعراض نمودند و ظلمی از آن حزب ظاهر شد که شبه نداشته و ندارد فی‌الجمله تفکّر لازم از اوّل ظهور آن حزب الی حین چه مقدار از علما که آمدند و یک نفس از ایشان بر کیفیّت ظهور آگاه نه آیا این غفلت را سبب چه بوده لو نذکره لتنفطر ارکانهم تفکّر لازم بل تفکّر هزارهزار سنه لازم شاید برشحی از بحر علم فائز شوند و بیابند آنچه را که الیوم از آن غافلند

Yā Shaykh, dar aṭvār-e nofūs tafakkor namā. Sākenīn-e madāʾen-e ʿelm va ḥekmat motaḥayyer. Āyā che vāqeʿ shode ke ḥizb-e Shīʿa ke khod rā aʿlam va azhad va atqā az jamīʿ-e aḥzāb-e ʿālam mīshomordand dar yawm-e ẓohūr eʿrāḍ namūdand va ẓolmī az ān ḥizb ẓāher shod ke shebh nadāshte va nadārad? Fī al-jomle tafakkor lāzem. Az avval-e ẓohūr-e ān ḥizb ilā ḥīn che meqdār az ʿolamā ke āmadand va yek nafs az īshān bar kayfīyat-e ẓohūr āgāh na. Āyā īn ghaflat rā sabab che būde? Law nadhkurhu la-tanfaṭiru arkānuhum. Tafakkor lāzem, bal tafakkor-e hezār hezār sane lāzem, shāyad be-rashḥī az baḥr-e ʿelm fāʾez shavand va biyāband ānche rā ke al-yawm az ān ghāfeland.

O Shaykh! Reflect on the conduct of people. The inhabitants of the cities of knowledge and wisdom are bewildered. What has happened that the Shiʿi community, who considered themselves more learned, more ascetic, and more pious than all the world’s communities, turned away on the day of the Manifestation and displayed an oppression without precedent or parallel? Some reflection is needed. From the beginning of that community’s appearance until now, how many learned men have come, yet not one of them has understood how the Manifestation would appear. What has caused this heedlessness? Were We to mention it, their very foundations would be rent asunder. Reflection is needed—indeed, a thousand thousand years of reflection—so that they may perhaps attain a drop from the ocean of knowledge and discover what they are heedless of today.

186

قد کنت ماشیاً فی ارض الطّآء مشرق آیات ربّک سمعت حنین المنابر و مناجاتها مع اللّه تبارک و تعالی نادت و قالت یا اله العالم و سیّد الأمم تری حالنا و ما ورد علینا من ظلم عبادک قد خلقتنا و اظهرتنا لذکرک و ثنائک اذاً تسمع ما یقول الغافلون علینا فی ایّامک وعزّتک ذابت اکبادنا و اضطربت ارکاننا آه آه یا لیت ما خلقتنا و ما اظهرتنا

Qad kuntu māshiyan fī arḍi al-Ṭāʾ, mashriqi āyāti Rabbika, samiʿtu ḥanīna al-manābiri wa-munājātahā maʿa Allāhi tabāraka wa-taʿālā. Nādat wa-qālat: Yā Ilāha al-ʿālami wa-Sayyida al-umam, tarā ḥālanā wa-mā warada ʿalaynā min ẓulmi ʿibādika. Qad khalaqtanā wa-aẓhartanā li-dhikrika wa-thanāʾika, idhan tasmaʿu mā yaqūlu al-ghāfilūna ʿalaynā fī ayyāmika. Wa-ʿizzatika dhābat akbādunā wa-iḍṭarabat arkānunā. Āh āh, yā layta mā khalaqtanā wa-mā aẓhartanā.

I was walking in the land of Ṭāʾ, the dawning place of your Lord’s verses, when I heard the lamentation of the pulpits and their intimate prayers to God, blessed and exalted is He. They called out and said: “O God of the world and Lord of the nations! You see our condition and what has befallen us through the oppression of Your servants. You created us and brought us into being for Your remembrance and praise; yet now You hear what the heedless say upon us in Your days. By Your might, our hearts have melted and our foundations tremble. Alas, alas! If only You had not created us or brought us into being!”

187

قلوب مقرّبین از این کلمات محترق و زفرات مخلصین از آن متصاعد مکرّر علمای اعلام را لوجه اللّه نصیحت نمودیم و بافق اعلی دعوت فرمودیم که شاید در ایّام ظهور از امواج بحر بیان مقصود عالمیان قسمت برند و بالمرّه محروم نمانند

Qolūb-e moqarrabīn az īn kalemāt moḥtareq va zafarāt-e mokhleṣīn az ān motaṣāʿed. Mokarrar ʿolamā-ye aʿlām rā li-wajhi Allāh naṣīḥat namūdīm va be-Ofoq-e Aʿlā daʿvat farmūdīm ke shāyad dar ayyām-e ẓohūr az amvāj-e baḥr-e bayān-e Maqṣūd-e ʿālamiyān qesmat barand va be-l-marre maḥrūm namānand.

The hearts of those brought near are consumed by these words, and the sighs of the sincere rise because of them. Repeatedly, for the sake of God, We have counseled the eminent learned men and invited them to the Most Exalted Horizon, so that in the days of the Manifestation they might perhaps receive a share of the waves of the ocean of utterance of the Desire of the worlds and not remain wholly deprived.

188

در اکثری از الواح این نصیحت کبری از سماء رحمت سابقه نازل قلنا یا معشر الأمرآء و العلمآء اسمعوا النّدآء من افق عکّا انّه یرشدکم و یقرّبکم و یهدیکم الی مقام جعله اللّه مطلع الوحی و مشرق الأنوار یا اهل العالم قد اتی الاسم الأعظم من لدن مالک القدم و بشّر العباد بهذا الظّهور الّذی کان مکنوناً فی العلم و مخزوناً فی کنز العصمة و مرقوماً من القلم الأعلی فی صحف اللّه ربّ الأرباب یا اهل الشّین أ نسیتم عنایتی و رحمتی الّتی سبقت الأشیآء من لدی اللّه مالک الرّقاب

Dar aktharī az alvāḥ īn naṣīḥat-i kubrā az samā-yi raḥmat-i sābiqih nāzil. Qulnā yā maʿshar al-umarāʾ wa-l-ʿulamāʾ ismaʿū al-nidāʾ min ufuq ʿAkkā innahu yurshidukum wa-yuqarribukum wa-yahdīkum ilā maqām jaʿalahu Allāh maṭlaʿ al-waḥy wa-mashriq al-anwār. Yā ahl al-ʿālam qad atā al-ism al-aʿẓam min ladun Mālik al-Qidam wa-bashshara al-ʿibād bi-hādhā al-ẓuhūr alladhī kāna maknūnan fī al-ʿilm wa-makhzūnan fī kanz al-ʿiṣma wa-marqūman min al-qalam al-aʿlā fī ṣuḥuf Allāh Rabb al-Arbāb. Yā ahl al-Shīn a-nasītum ʿināyatī wa-raḥmatī allatī sabaqat al-ashyāʾ min ladā Allāh Mālik al-Riqāb.

In most of the Tablets, this supreme counsel has descended from the heaven of antecedent mercy. We said: “O rulers and learned ones! Hear the call from the horizon of ‘Akkā. It guides you, draws you near, and leads you to a station that God has made the dawning place of revelation and the dayspring of lights. O people of the world! The Most Great Name has come from the Lord of Eternity and has announced to the servants this Revelation, which lay concealed in divine knowledge, treasured in the treasury of infallibility, and inscribed by the Most Exalted Pen in the scriptures of God, the Lord of lords. O people of Shīn! Have you forgotten My loving care and My mercy, which preceded all things, bestowed by God, the Master of all?”

189

و در کتاب اقدس نازل قل یا معشر العلمآء لا تزنوا کتاب اللّه بما عندکم من القواعد و العلوم انّه لقسطاس الحقّ بین الخلق قد یوزن ما عند الأمم بهذا القسطاس الأعظم و انّه بنفسه لو انتم تعلمون تبکی علیکم عین عنایتی لأنّکم ما عرفتم الّذی دعوتموه فی العشیّ و الاشراق و فی کلّ اصیل و بکور توجّهوا یا قوم بوجوه بیضآء و قلوب نورآء الی البقعة المبارکة الحمرآء الّتی فیها تنادی سدرة المنتهی انّه لا اله الّا انا المهیمن القیّوم یا معشر العلمآء فی ایران هل یقدر احد منکم ان یستنّ معی فی میدان المکاشفة و العرفان او یجول فی مضمار الحکمة و التّبیان لا وربّی الرّحمن کلّ من علیها فان و هذا وجه ربّکم العزیز المحبوب یا قوم انّا قدّرنا العلوم لعرفان المعلوم و انتم احتجبتم بها عن مشرقها الّذى به ظهر کلّ امر مکنون قل هذه سمآء فیها کنز امّ الکتاب لو انتم تعلمون هذا لهو الّذی به صاحت الصّخرة و نادت السّدرة علی الطّور المرتفع علی الأرض المبارکة الملک للّه الملک العزیز الودود انّا ما دخلنا المدارس و ما طالعنا المباحث اسمعوا ما یدعوکم به هذا الأمّیّ الی اللّه الأبدیّ انّه خیر لکم عمّا کنز فی الأرض لو انتم تفقهون انّ الّذی یأوّل ما نزّل من سمآء الوحی و یخرجه عن الظّاهر انّه ممّن حرّف کلمة اللّه العلیا و کان من الأخسرین فی کتاب مبین

Va dar Kitāb-i Aqdas nāzil. Qul yā maʿshar al-ʿulamāʾ lā tazinū Kitāb Allāh bi-mā ʿindakum min al-qawāʿid wa-l-ʿulūm innahu la-qisṭās al-ḥaqq bayn al-khalq qad yūzanu mā ʿinda al-umam bi-hādhā al-qisṭās al-aʿẓam wa-innahu bi-nafsihi law antum taʿlamūn. Tabkī ʿalaykum ʿayn ʿināyatī li-annakum mā ʿaraftum alladhī daʿawtumūhu fī al-ʿashiyy wa-l-ishrāq wa-fī kull aṣīl wa-bukūr. Tawajjahū yā qawm bi-wujūh bayḍāʾ wa-qulūb nawrāʾ ilā al-buqʿa al-mubāraka al-ḥamrāʾ allatī fīhā tunādī Sidrat al-Muntahā innahu lā ilāha illā anā al-Muhaymin al-Qayyūm. Yā maʿshar al-ʿulamāʾ fī Īrān hal yaqdiru aḥad minkum an yastanna maʿī fī maydān al-mukāshafa wa-l-ʿirfān aw yajūla fī miḍmār al-ḥikma wa-l-tibyān. Lā wa-rabbī al-Raḥmān kull man ʿalayhā fān wa-hādhā wajh rabbikum al-ʿAzīz al-Maḥbūb. Yā qawm innā qaddarnā al-ʿulūm li-ʿirfān al-maʿlūm wa-antum iḥtajabtum bihā ʿan mashriqihā alladhī bihi ẓahara kull amr maknūn. Qul hādhihi samāʾ fīhā kanz Umm al-Kitāb law antum taʿlamūn. Hādhā la-huwa alladhī bihi ṣāḥat al-ṣakhra wa-nādat al-sidra ʿalā al-ṭūr al-murtafiʿ ʿalā al-arḍ al-mubāraka al-mulk li-llāh al-Malik al-ʿAzīz al-Wadūd. Innā mā dakhalnā al-madāris wa-mā ṭālaʿnā al-mabāḥith ismaʿū mā yadʿūkum bihi hādhā al-ummī ilā Allāh al-Abadī innahu khayr lakum ʿammā kuniza fī al-arḍ law antum tafqahūn. Inna alladhī yuʾawwilu mā nuzzila min samāʾ al-waḥy wa-yukhrijuhu ʿan al-ẓāhir innahu mimman ḥarrafa kalimat Allāh al-ʿulyā wa-kāna min al-akhsarīn fī kitāb mubīn.

And in the Most Holy Book it is revealed: “Say: O learned ones! Do not weigh the Book of God by the rules and sciences you possess. It is the true Balance among creation. Whatever the nations possess is weighed in this Most Great Balance, while it is its own standard, if you only knew. The eye of My loving care weeps over you, because you have not recognized the One you invoked at evening and at dawn, and at every dusk and daybreak. Turn, O people, with radiant faces and luminous hearts, toward the blessed Crimson Spot, where the Tree of the Utmost Boundary calls out: ‘There is no God but Me, the All-Protecting, the Self-Subsisting.’ O learned ones in Iran! Can any of you race with Me in the arena of unveiling and recognition, or range over the field of wisdom and exposition? No, by My Lord, the All-Merciful! All who are on the earth pass away, and this is the face of your Lord, the Almighty, the Beloved. O people! We ordained the sciences for the recognition of the Object of knowledge, yet you have made them a veil between yourselves and their Dayspring, through whom every hidden thing has been revealed. Say: This is a heaven in which lies the treasure of the Mother Book, if you only knew. This is the One through whom the Rock cried out and the Tree proclaimed upon the Mount rising above the blessed land: ‘Sovereignty belongs to God, the King, the Almighty, the All-Loving.’ We did not enter the schools or study scholarly treatises. Listen to the words with which this unlettered One calls you to God, the Eternal. They are better for you than all that is treasured in the earth, if you only understood. Whoever interprets what has descended from the heaven of revelation so as to divert it from its evident meaning is among those who have distorted God’s exalted Word, and is numbered among the greatest losers in a clear Book.”

190

عند ذلک سمعنا ضجیج الفطرة قلنا ما لی یا فطرة اسمع فی اللّیالى صریخک و فی الأیّام ضجیجک و فی الأسحار حنینک قالت یا سیّد العالم الظّاهر بالاسم الأعظم قد عقر الغافلون ناقتک البیضآء و غرقوا سفینتک الحمرآء و ارادوا ان یطفئوا نورک و یستروا وجه امرک بذلک ارتفع حنینی و حنین الأشیآء کلّها و النّاس اکثرهم من الغافلین امروز فطرت باذیال کرم تشبّث نموده و طائف حول گشته

ʿInda dhālika samiʿnā ḍajīj al-fiṭra. Qulnā mā lī yā fiṭra asmaʿ fī al-layālī ṣarīkhaki wa-fī al-ayyām ḍajījaki wa-fī al-asḥār ḥanīnaki. Qālat yā Sayyid al-ʿĀlam al-ẓāhir bi-l-ism al-aʿẓam qad ʿaqara al-ghāfilūn nāqataka al-bayḍāʾ wa-gharraqū safīnataka al-ḥamrāʾ wa-arādū an yuṭfiʾū nūraka wa-yasturū wajh amrika bi-dhālika irtafaʿa ḥanīnī wa-ḥanīn al-ashyāʾ kullihā wa-l-nās aktharuhum min al-ghāfilīn. Imrūz fiṭrat bi-adhyāl-i karam tashabbuth namūdih va ṭāʾif-i ḥawl gashtih.

At that moment We heard the lamentation of inborn nature. We said: “O inborn nature! Why do I hear your cries at night, your lamentation by day, and your moaning at dawn?” She said: “O Lord of the world, manifest through the Most Great Name! The heedless have hamstrung Your white she-camel and sunk Your crimson ark. They have sought to extinguish Your light and veil the face of Your Cause. Thus my lamentation and the lamentation of all things have risen, yet most people remain heedless.” Today, inborn nature has clung to the hem of bounty and circles around Him.

191

یا شیخ احضر لتری ما لا رأت عیون الابداع و تسمع ما لا سمعت آذان الاختراع لعلّک تخلّص نفسک من طین الأوهام و تتوجّه الی المقام الأعلی الّذى فیه ینادی المظلوم الملک للّه العزیز الحمید امید آنکه بهمّت آن جناب اجنحهٔ عباد از طین نفس و هوی مطهّر شود و قابل طیران در هواء محبّت الهی گردد پرهای بطین آلوده قادر بر طیران نبوده و نیست یشهد بذلک مظاهر العدل و الانصاف ولکنّ القوم فی ریب مبین

Yā shaykh uḥḍur li-tarā mā lā raʾat ʿuyūn al-ibdāʿ wa-tasmaʿ mā lā samiʿat ādhān al-ikhtirāʿ laʿallaka tukhalliṣ nafsaka min ṭīn al-awhām wa-tatawajjaha ilā al-maqām al-aʿlā alladhī fīhi yunādī al-Maẓlūm al-mulk li-llāh al-ʿAzīz al-Ḥamīd. Umīd ānkih bi-himmat-i ān janāb ajniḥiy-i ʿibād az ṭīn-i nafs va havā muṭahhar shavad va qābil-i ṭayarān dar havā-yi maḥabbat-i ilāhī gardad. Parhā-yi bi-ṭīn ālūdih qādir bar ṭayarān nabūdih va nīst. Yashhadu bi-dhālika maẓāhir al-ʿadl wa-l-inṣāf wa-lākinna al-qawm fī rayb mubīn.

O Shaykh! Come into Our presence so that you may see what the eyes of creation have never seen and hear what the ears of all that has been brought into being have never heard. Perhaps you may free yourself from the clay of vain imaginings and turn toward the Most Exalted Station, where the Wronged One proclaims: “Sovereignty belongs to God, the Almighty, the Praiseworthy.” It is hoped that, through your efforts, the wings of the servants may be cleansed of the clay of self and desire and become capable of flight in the atmosphere of divine love. Wings soiled with clay have never been, and are not, capable of flight. To this the manifestations of justice and fairness bear witness, yet the people remain in evident doubt.

192

یا شیخ از هر جهتی از جهات عباد اعتراضاتی نموده‌اند که قلم از تحریر آن استغفار مینماید مع‌ذلک نظر برحمت کبری جواب على قدر مراتب ناس داده شد که شاید از نار نفی و انکار بنور اثبات و اقرار منوّر گردند انصاف کمیاب و عدل مفقود

Yā shaykh az har jihatī az jihāt ʿibād iʿtirāḍātī namūdih-and kih qalam az taḥrīr-i ān istighfār mīnamāyad. Maʿa-dhālik naẓar bi-raḥmat-i kubrā javāb ʿalā qadr-i marātib-i nās dādih shud kih shāyad az nār-i nafy va inkār bi-nūr-i ithbāt va iqrār munavvar gardand. Inṣāf kamyāb va ʿadl mafqūd.

O Shaykh! From every quarter, people have raised objections that the Pen seeks forgiveness for recording. Nevertheless, in view of the Most Great Mercy, answers were given according to people’s capacities, so that they might perhaps leave the fire of negation and denial and be illumined by the light of affirmation and acknowledgment. Fairness is scarce, and justice is absent.

193

از جمله این آیات محکمات در جواب بعضی از ملکوت علم الهی ظاهر و نازل یا ایّها المتوجّه الی انوار الوجه قد احاطت الأوهام سکّان الأرض و منعتهم عن التّوجّه الی افق الیقین و اشراقه و ظهوراته و انواره بالظّنون منعوا عن القیّوم یتکلّمون بأهوائهم و لا یشعرون منهم من قال هل الآیات نزّلت قل ای وربّ السّموات هل اتت السّاعة بل قضت ومظهر البیّنات قد جآءت الحاقّة و اتی الحقّ بالحجّة و البرهان قد برزت السّاهرة و البریّة فی وجل و اضطراب قد اتت الزّلازل و ناحت القبائل من خشیة اللّه المقتدر الجبّار قل الصّاخّة صاحت و الیوم للّه الواحد المختار هل الطّامّة تمّت قل ای وربّ الأرباب هل القیامة قامت بل القیّوم بملکوت الآیات هل تری النّاس صرعی بلی وربّی العلیّ الأعلی هل انقعرت الأعجاز بل نسفت الجبال ومالک الصّفات قال این الجنّة و النّار قل الأولی لقائی و الأخری نفسک یا ایّها المشرک المرتاب قال انّا ما نری المیزان قل ای وربّی الرّحمن لا یراه الّا اولو الأبصار هل سقطت النّجوم قل ای اذ کان القیّوم فی ارض السّرّ فاعتبروا یا اولی الأنظار قد ظهرت العلامات کلّها اذ اخرجنا ید القدرة من جیب العظمة و الاقتدار قد نادی المناد اذ اتی المیعاد و انصعق الطّوریّون فی تیه الوقوف من سطوة ربّک مالک الایجاد یقول النّاقور هل نفخ فی الصّور قل بلی وسلطان الظّهور اذ استقرّ علی عرش اسمه الرّحمن قد اضآء الدّیجور من فجر رحمة ربّک مطلع الأنوار قد سرت نسمة الرّحمن و اهتزّت الأرواح فی قبور الأبدان کذلک قضی الأمر من لدی اللّه العزیز المنّان قال الّذین غفلوا متی انفطرت السّمآء قل اذ کنتم فی اجداث الغفلة و الضّلال من الغافلین من یمسح عینیه و ینظر الیمین و الشّمال قل قد عمیت لیس لک الیوم من ملاذ منهم من قال هل حشرت النّفوس قل ای وربّی اذ کنت فی مهاد الأوهام و منهم من قال هل نزّل الکتاب بالفطرة قل انّها فی الحیرة اتّقوا یا اولی الألباب و منهم من قال أ حشرت اعمی قل بلی وراکب السّحاب قد تزیّنت الجنّة بأوراد المعانی و سعّر السّعیر من نار الفجّار قل قد اشرق النّور من افق الظّهور و اضآءت الآفاق اذ اتی مالک یوم المیثاق قد خسر الّذین ارتابوا و ربح من اقبل بنور الیقین الی مطلع الایقان طوبی لک یا ایّها النّاظر بما نزّل لک هذا اللّوح الّذی منه تطیر الأرواح احفظه ثمّ اقرأه لعمری انّه باب رحمة ربّک طوبی لمن یقرأه فی العشیّ و الاشراق انّا نسمع ذکرک فی هذا الأمر الّذی منه اندکّ جبل العلم و زلّت الأقدام البهآء علیک و علی کلّ مقبل اقبل الی العزیز الوّهاب قد انتهی و ما تمّ اصبر انّ ربّک هو الصّبّار

Az jumlih īn āyāt-i muḥkamāt dar javāb-i baʿḍī az malakūt-i ʿilm-i ilāhī ẓāhir va nāzil. Yā ayyuhā al-mutawajjih ilā anwār al-wajh qad aḥāṭat al-awhām sukkān al-arḍ wa-manaʿathum ʿan al-tawajjuh ilā ufuq al-yaqīn wa-ishrāqihi wa-ẓuhūrātihi wa-anwārihi. Bi-l-ẓunūn muniʿū ʿan al-Qayyūm yatakallamūn bi-ahwāʾihim wa-lā yashʿurūn. Minhum man qāla hal al-āyāt nuzzilat qul ay wa-Rabb al-Samāwāt. Hal atat al-sāʿa bal qaḍat wa-Maẓhar al-Bayyināt. Qad jāʾat al-ḥāqqa wa-atā al-Ḥaqq bi-l-ḥujja wa-l-burhān. Qad barazat al-sāhira wa-l-bariyya fī wajal wa-iḍṭirāb. Qad atat al-zalāzil wa-nāḥat al-qabāʾil min khashyat Allāh al-Muqtadir al-Jabbār. Qul al-ṣākhkha ṣāḥat wa-l-yawm li-llāh al-Wāḥid al-Mukhtār. Hal al-ṭāmma tammat qul ay wa-Rabb al-Arbāb. Hal al-qiyāma qāmat bal al-Qayyūm bi-malakūt al-āyāt. Hal tarā al-nās ṣarʿā balā wa-rabbī al-ʿAliyy al-Aʿlā. Hal inqaʿarat al-aʿjāz bal nusifat al-jibāl wa-Mālik al-Ṣifāt. Qāla ayna al-janna wa-l-nār qul al-ūlā liqāʾī wa-l-ukhrā nafsuka yā ayyuhā al-mushrik al-murtāb. Qāla innā mā narā al-mīzān qul ay wa-rabbī al-Raḥmān lā yarāhu illā ulū al-abṣār. Hal saqaṭat al-nujūm qul ay idh kāna al-Qayyūm fī arḍ al-sirr fa-ʿtabirū yā ulī al-anẓār. Qad ẓaharat al-ʿalāmāt kulluhā idh akhrajnā yad al-qudra min jayb al-ʿaẓama wa-l-iqtidār. Qad nādā al-munād idh atā al-mīʿād wa-inṣaʿaqa al-ṭūriyyūn fī tīh al-wuqūf min saṭwat rabbika Mālik al-Ījād. Yaqūlu al-nāqūr hal nufikha fī al-ṣūr qul balā wa-Sulṭān al-Ẓuhūr idh istaqarra ʿalā ʿarsh ismihi al-Raḥmān. Qad aḍāʾa al-dayjūr min fajr raḥmat rabbika Maṭlaʿ al-Anwār. Qad sarat nasmat al-Raḥmān wa-ihtazzat al-arwāḥ fī qubūr al-abdān kadhālika quḍiya al-amr min ladā Allāh al-ʿAzīz al-Mannān. Qāla alladhīna ghafalū matā infaṭarat al-samāʾ qul idh kuntum fī ajdāth al-ghafla wa-l-ḍalāl. Min al-ghāfilīn man yamsaḥ ʿaynayhi wa-yanẓur al-yamīn wa-l-shimāl qul qad ʿamīta laysa laka al-yawm min malādh. Minhum man qāla hal ḥushirat al-nufūs qul ay wa-rabbī idh kunta fī mihād al-awhām. Wa-minhum man qāla hal nuzzila al-kitāb bi-l-fiṭra qul innahā fī al-ḥayra ittaqū yā ulī al-albāb. Wa-minhum man qāla a-ḥushirtu aʿmā qul balā wa-Rākib al-Saḥāb. Qad tazayyanat al-janna bi-awrād al-maʿānī wa-suʿʿira al-saʿīr min nār al-fujjār. Qul qad ashraqa al-nūr min ufuq al-ẓuhūr wa-aḍāʾat al-āfāq idh atā Mālik Yawm al-Mīthāq. Qad khasira alladhīna irtābū wa-rabiḥa man aqbala bi-nūr al-yaqīn ilā maṭlaʿ al-īqān. Ṭūbā laka yā ayyuhā al-nāẓir bi-mā nuzzila laka hādhā al-lawḥ alladhī minhu taṭīr al-arwāḥ. Iḥfaẓhu thumma iqraʾhu la-ʿamrī innahu bāb raḥmat rabbika ṭūbā li-man yaqraʾuhu fī al-ʿashiyy wa-l-ishrāq. Innā nasmaʿ dhikraka fī hādhā al-amr alladhī minhu indakka jabal al-ʿilm wa-zallat al-aqdām. Al-Bahāʾ ʿalayka wa-ʿalā kull muqbil aqbala ilā al-ʿAzīz al-Wahhāb. Qad intahā wa-mā tamm iṣbir inna rabbaka huwa al-Ṣabbār.

Among these are the following unequivocal verses, which appeared and descended from the kingdom of divine knowledge in answer to certain people: “O you who turn toward the lights of the Countenance!
