Vain imaginings have encompassed the inhabitants of the earth and prevented them from turning toward the horizon of certainty, its radiance, its manifestations, and its lights. Through their conjectures they have been kept from the Self-Subsisting. They speak according to their desires and do not perceive. Some of them have said: ‘Have the verses been sent down?’ Say: ‘Yes, by the Lord of the heavens!’ ‘Has the Hour come?’ ‘Rather, it has passed, by the Manifestation of clear proofs! The Inevitable has come, and the True One has appeared with testimony and proof. The plain of resurrection has emerged, and creation is in fear and turmoil. The earthquakes have come, and the tribes have lamented in fear of God, the All-Powerful, the All-Compelling.’ Say: ‘The Deafening Blast has sounded, and this day belongs to God, the One, the Unconstrained.’ ‘Has the Overwhelming Calamity been fulfilled?’ Say: ‘Yes, by the Lord of lords!’ ‘Has the Resurrection arisen?’ ‘Rather, the Self-Subsisting has appeared with the kingdom of verses.’ ‘Do you see the people struck down?’ ‘Yes, by My Lord, the Most High, the Most Exalted!’ ‘Have the trunks been uprooted?’ ‘Rather, the mountains have been scattered, by the Lord of attributes!’ He said: ‘Where are Paradise and Hell?’ Say: ‘The first is reunion with Me, and the other is your own self, O doubting idolater!’ He said: ‘We do not see the Balance.’ Say: ‘Indeed, by My Lord, the All-Merciful, none sees it but those endowed with insight.’ ‘Have the stars fallen?’ Say: ‘Yes, when the Self-Subsisting was in the Land of Mystery. Take heed, then, O people of discernment!’ All the signs appeared when We drew forth the hand of power from the bosom of grandeur and might. The Crier called out when the appointed time came, and those upon Sinai were struck senseless in the wilderness of hesitation by the might of your Lord, the Maker of all existence. The trumpet says: ‘Has the horn been sounded?’ Say: ‘Yes, by the Sovereign of Revelation, when He established Himself upon the throne of His name, the All-Merciful!’ The darkness has been illumined by the dawn of the mercy of your Lord, the Dawning Place of lights. The breeze of the All-Merciful has blown, and the spirits have stirred in the tombs of bodies. Thus has the decree been fulfilled by God, the Almighty, the All-Bountiful. Those who were heedless said: ‘When was heaven split apart?’ Say: ‘When you were in the graves of heedlessness and error.’ Among the heedless is one who rubs his eyes and looks to the right and left. Say: ‘You have become blind; today you have no refuge.’ Some of them have said: ‘Have the souls been gathered?’ Say: ‘Yes, by My Lord, while you lay in the cradle of vain imaginings!’ Some of them have said: ‘Has the Book been sent down through inborn nature?’ Say: ‘She is bewildered. Fear God, O people of understanding!’ Some of them have said: ‘Have I been gathered blind?’ Say: ‘Yes, by the Rider upon the clouds!’ Paradise has been adorned with the roses of inner meanings, and the blaze has been kindled by the fire of the wicked. Say: ‘The light has shone from the horizon of Revelation, and all horizons have been illumined, for the Lord of the Day of the Covenant has come.’ Those who doubted have lost, and whoever has turned with the light of certainty toward the Dawning Place of certitude has gained. Blessed are you, O beholder, because this Tablet, through which spirits take flight, has been sent down for you. Preserve it, then read it. By My life! It is the door to the mercy of your Lord. Blessed is whoever reads it at evening and at dawn. We hear your mention in this Cause, through which the mountain of knowledge has been crushed and feet have slipped. Glory rest upon you and upon everyone who has turned toward the Almighty, the All-Bestowing. It has ended, yet it is not complete. Be patient; your Lord is the Ever-Patient.”

194

هذه آیات انزلناها من قبل فی اوّل ورودنا فی سجن عکّا و ارسلناها الیک لتعرف ما نطقت به السنتهم الکذبة اذ اتی الأمر بقدرة و سلطان قد تزعزع بنیان الظّنون و انفطرت سمآء الأوهام و القوم فی مریة و شقاق قد انکروا حجّة اللّه و برهانه بعد اذ اتی من افق الاقتدار بملکوت الآیات ترکوا ما امروا به و ارتکبوا ما منعوا عنه فی الکتاب وضعوا الههم اخذوا اهوائهم الا انّهم فی غفلة و ضلال یقرؤون الآیات و ینکرونها یرون البیّنات و یعرضون عنها الا انّهم فی ریب عجاب

Hādhihi āyāt anzalnāhā min qabl fī awwal wurūdinā fī sijn ʿAkkā wa-arsalnāhā ilayka li-taʿrifa mā naṭaqat bihi alsinatuhum al-kadhaba idh atā al-amr bi-qudra wa-sulṭān. Qad tazaʿzaʿa bunyān al-ẓunūn wa-infaṭarat samāʾ al-awhām wa-l-qawm fī mirya wa-shiqāq. Qad ankarū ḥujjat Allāh wa-burhānahu baʿda idh atā min ufuq al-iqtidār bi-malakūt al-āyāt. Tarakū mā umirū bihi wa-irtakabū mā muniʿū ʿanhu fī al-kitāb. Waḍaʿū ilāhahum akhadhū ahwāʾahum alā innahum fī ghafla wa-ḍalāl. Yaqraʾūn al-āyāt wa-yunkirūnahā yarawna al-bayyināt wa-yuʿriḍūna ʿanhā alā innahum fī rayb ʿujāb.

These are verses We sent down previously, upon Our first arrival in the prison of ‘Akkā. We have sent them to you so that you may know what their lying tongues uttered when the Cause appeared with power and sovereignty. The foundations of conjecture have been shaken, and the heaven of vain imaginings has been split apart, yet the people remain in doubt and discord. They have denied God’s testimony and His proof after He came from the horizon of might with the kingdom of verses. They have abandoned what they were commanded to do and committed what they were forbidden in the Book. They have set aside their God and embraced their desires. Indeed, they are in heedlessness and error. They read the verses and deny them; they see the clear proofs and turn away from them. Indeed, they are in astonishing doubt.

195

انّا وصّینا اولیائنا بتقوی اللّه الّذی کان مطلع الأعمال و الأخلاق انّه قائد جنود العدل فی مدینة البهآء طوبی لمن دخل فی ظلّ رایته النّورآء و تمسّک به انّه من اصحاب السّفینة الحمرآء الّتی نزّل ذکرها فی قیّوم الأسمآء

Innā waṣṣaynā awliyāʾanā bi-taqwā Allāh alladhī kāna maṭlaʿ al-aʿmāl wa-l-akhlāq innahu qāʾid junūd al-ʿadl fī madīnat al-Bahāʾ. Ṭūbā li-man dakhala fī ẓill rāyatihi al-nawrāʾ wa-tamassaka bihi innahu min aṣḥāb al-safīna al-ḥamrāʾ allatī nuzzila dhikruhā fī Qayyūm al-Asmāʾ.

We have enjoined Our loved ones to fear God, which is the source of deeds and character. It is the commander of the hosts of justice in the city of Bahā. Blessed is whoever enters beneath its luminous banner and holds fast to it. Such a person is among the companions of the Crimson Ark, mention of which was revealed in the Qayyūm al-Asmāʾ.

196

قل یا حزب اللّه زیّنوا هیاکلکم بطراز الأمانة و الدّیانة ثمّ انصروا ربّکم بجنود الأعمال و الأخلاق انّا منعناکم عن الفساد و الجدال فی کتبی و صحفی و زبری و الواحی و ما اردنا بذلک الّا علوّکم و سموّکم تشهد بذلک السّمآء و انجمها و الشّمس و اشراقها و الأشجار و اوراقها و البحار و امواجها و الأرض و کنوزها نسأل اللّه ان یمدّ اولیائه و یؤیّدهم علی ما ینبغی لهم فى هذا المقام المبارک العزیز البدیع

Qul yā ḥizb Allāh zayyinū hayākilakum bi-ṭirāz al-amāna wa-l-diyāna thumma unṣurū rabbakum bi-junūd al-aʿmāl wa-l-akhlāq. Innā manaʿnākum ʿan al-fasād wa-l-jidāl fī kutubī wa-ṣuḥufī wa-zuburī wa-alwāḥī wa-mā aradnā bi-dhālika illā ʿuluwwakum wa-sumuwwakum. Tashhadu bi-dhālika al-samāʾ wa-anjumuhā wa-l-shams wa-ishrāquhā wa-l-ashjār wa-awrāquhā wa-l-biḥār wa-amwājuhā wa-l-arḍ wa-kunūzuhā. Nasʾalu Allāh an yumidda awliyāʾahu wa-yuʾayyidahum ʿalā mā yanbaghī lahum fī hādhā al-maqām al-mubārak al-ʿazīz al-badīʿ.

Say: O people of God! Adorn yourselves with the vesture of trustworthiness and piety, then aid your Lord with the hosts of deeds and character. We have forbidden you to engage in corruption and contention in My books, My scriptures, My writings, and My Tablets. In this We have desired nothing but your exaltation and elevation. To this bear witness heaven and its stars, the sun and its radiance, the trees and their leaves, the seas and their waves, and the earth and its treasures. We ask God to assist His loved ones and strengthen them to do what befits them in this blessed, exalted, and wondrous station.

197

الی ان قلنا فی لوح آخر یا ایّها النّاظر الی الوجه وصّ العباد بتقوی اللّه تاللّه هو القائد الأوّل فی عساکر ربّک و جنوده الأخلاق المرضیّة و الأعمال الطّیّبة و بها فتحت فی الأعصار و القرون مدائن الأفئدة و القلوب و نصبت رایات النّصر و الظّفر علی اعلی الأعلام

Ilā an qulnā fī lawḥ ākhar yā ayyuhā al-nāẓir ilā al-wajh waṣṣi al-ʿibād bi-taqwā Allāh ta-llāh huwa al-qāʾid al-awwal fī ʿasākir rabbika wa-junūduhu al-akhlāq al-marḍiyya wa-l-aʿmāl al-ṭayyiba wa-bihā futiḥat fī al-aʿṣār wa-l-qurūn madāʾin al-afʾida wa-l-qulūb wa-nuṣibat rāyāt al-naṣr wa-l-ẓafar ʿalā aʿlā al-aʿlām.

Further, We said in another Tablet: “O you who gaze upon the Countenance! Counsel the servants to fear God. By God! This is the foremost commander in the armies of your Lord, and its troops are pleasing character and good deeds. Through these, throughout the ages and centuries, the cities of hearts and souls have been conquered, and the banners of victory and triumph have been raised upon the loftiest heights.”

198

انّا نذکر لک الأمانة و مقامها عند اللّه ربّک ربّ العرش العظیم انّا قصدنا یوماً من الأیّام جزیرتنا الخضرآء و لمّا وردنا رأینا انهارها جاریة و اشجارها ملتفّة و کانت الشّمس تلعب فی خلال الأشجار اذاً توجّهنا الی الیمین رأینا ما لا یتحرّک القلم علی ذکره و ذکر ما شهدت عین مولی الوری فی ذاک المقام الألطف الأشرف المبارک الأعلی ثمّ اقبلنا الی الیسار شاهدنا طلعة من طلعات الفردوس الأعلی قائمة علی عمود من النّور و نادت بأعلی النّدآء یا ملأ الأرض و السّمآء انظروا جمالی و نوری و ظهوری و اشراقی تاللّه الحقّ انا الأمانة و ظهورها و حسنها و اجر لمن تمسّک بها و عرف شأنها و مقامها و تشبّث بذیلها انا الزّینة الکبری لأهل البهآء و طراز العزّ لمن فی ملکوت الانشآء و انا السّبب الأعظم لثروة العالم و افق الاطمینان لأهل الامکان کذلک انزلنا لک ما یقرّب العباد الی مالک الایجاد

Innā nadhkuru laka al-amānata wa-maqāmahā ʿinda Allāhi rabbika rabbi al-ʿarshi al-ʿaẓīm. Innā qaṣadnā yawman mina al-ayyāmi jazīratanā al-khaḍrāʾa wa-lammā waradnā raʾaynā anhārahā jāriyatan wa-ashjārahā multaffatan wa-kānati al-shamsu talʿabu fī khilāli al-ashjār. Idhan tawajjahnā ilā al-yamīni raʾaynā mā lā yataḥarraku al-qalamu ʿalā dhikrihi wa-dhikri mā shahidat ʿaynu mawlā al-warā fī dhāka al-maqāmi al-alṭafi al-ashrafi al-mubāraki al-aʿlā. Thumma aqbalnā ilā al-yasāri shāhadnā ṭalʿatan min ṭalaʿāti al-firdawsi al-aʿlā qāʾimatan ʿalā ʿamūdin mina al-nūri wa-nādat bi-aʿlā al-nidāʾi yā malaʾa al-arḍi wa-al-samāʾi unẓurū jamālī wa-nūrī wa-ẓuhūrī wa-ishrāqī. Ta-Allāhi al-ḥaqqi anā al-amānatu wa-ẓuhūruhā wa-ḥusnuhā wa-ajrun li-man tamassaka bihā wa-ʿarafa shaʾnahā wa-maqāmahā wa-tashabbatha bi-dhaylihā. Anā al-zīnatu al-kubrā li-ahli al-Bahāʾi wa-ṭirāzu al-ʿizzi li-man fī malakūti al-inshāʾi wa-anā al-sababu al-aʿẓamu li-tharwati al-ʿālami wa-ufuqu al-iṭmiʾnāni li-ahli al-imkān. Kadhālika anzalnā laka mā yuqarribu al-ʿibāda ilā māliki al-ījād.

We speak to you of trustworthiness and its station before God, your Lord, the Lord of the mighty throne. One day We set out for Our verdant island. When We arrived, We saw its streams flowing and its trees intertwined, while the sun played among the trees. Then We turned to the right and saw what the pen cannot move to describe, nor can it describe what the eye of the Lord of humanity witnessed in that most delightful, most noble, blessed, and exalted place. Then We turned to the left and beheld a figure, one of the figures of the highest Paradise, standing upon a pillar of light. She called out in the loudest voice: “O people of earth and heaven! Behold My beauty, My light, My manifestation, and My radiance. By God, the True One! I am trustworthiness, its manifestation and its beauty, and a reward for whoever holds fast to it, recognizes its standing and station, and clings to its hem. I am the greatest adornment of the people of Bahāʾ and the ornament of glory for all in the kingdom of creation. I am the greatest means of the world’s prosperity and the horizon of assurance for all who dwell in the realm of existence.” Thus We have sent down for you what brings the servants nearer to the Lord of creation.

199

این مظلوم لازال اهل عالم را به ما یرفعهم و یقرّبهم دعوت نموده و از افق اعلی اشراق نموده آنچه که از برای احدی مجال توقّف و اعراض و اعتراض نمانده ولکن غافلین را نفعى نبخشیده و لا یزیدهم الّا خسارا

Īn maẓlūm lā-zāl ahl-e ʿālam rā be mā yarfaʿuhum wa-yuqarribuhum daʿvat namūde va az ofoq-e aʿlā eshrāq namūde ānche ke az barā-ye aḥadī majāl-e tavaqqof va eʿrāż va eʿterāż namānde va-līkan ghāfelīn rā nafʿī nabakhshīde wa-lā yazīduhum illā khasārā.

This Wronged One has always summoned the people of the world to what will elevate them and bring them near, and from the most exalted horizon there has shone forth that which leaves no one any room for hesitation, rejection, or objection. Yet it has brought no benefit to the heedless, and only increases their loss.

200

یا شیخ باید علما با حضرت سلطان ایّده اللّه متّحد شوند و در لیالی و ایّام به ما یرتفع به شأن الدّولة و الملّة تمسّک نمایند این حزب بتمام همّت بتهذیب نفوس و اصلاح امور متشبّث و مشغولند یشهد بذلک ما نزّل من القلم الأعلی فی هذا اللّوح المبین چه بسا از امور که سهل و آسان بنظر میآید ولکن اکثرى از آن غافل و باموری که سبب تضییع ایّام است مشغول

Yā Shaykh, bāyad ʿolamā bā Ḥażrat-e Solṭān, ayyadahu Allāh, mottaḥed shavand va dar layālī va ayyām be mā yartafiʿu bihi shaʾnu al-dawlati wa-al-millati tamassok namāyand. Īn ḥezb be-tamām-e hemmat be-tahdhīb-e nofūs va eṣlāḥ-e omūr motashabbeth va mashghūland. Yashhadu bi-dhālika mā nuzzila mina al-qalami al-aʿlā fī hādhā al-lawḥi al-mubīn. Che basā az omūr ke sahl va āsān be-naẓar mīāyad va-līkan aktharī az ān ghāfel va be-omūrī ke sabab-e tażyīʿ-e ayyām ast mashghūl.

O Shaykh! The religious scholars must unite with His Majesty the sovereign, may God strengthen him, and hold fast, night and day, to what will elevate the standing of the state and the nation. This community is devoted with all its energy to refining souls and setting affairs right. What has been sent down from the Most Exalted Pen in this clear Tablet bears witness to this. Many things appear simple and easy, yet most people are heedless of them and occupied with matters that waste their days.

201

در آستانه یومی از ایّام کمال پاشا نزد مظلوم حاضر و از امور نافعه ذکری بمیان آمد ذکر نمودند که السن متعدّده آموخته‌اند در جواب ذکر شد عمری را تلف نموده‌اید باید مثل آن جناب و سائر وکلای دولت مجلسی بیارایند و در آن مجلس یک لسان از السن مختلفه و همچنین یک خطّ از خطوط موجوده را اختیار نمایند و یا خطّ و لسانی بدیع ترتیب دهند و در مدارس عالم اطفال را بآن تعلیم فرمایند در این صورت دارای دو لسان میشوند یکی لسان وطن و دیگری لسانی که عموم اهل عالم بآن تکلّم نمایند اگر بآنچه ذکر شد تمسّک جویند جمیع ارض قطعهٔ واحده مشاهده شود و از تعلیم و تعلّم السن مختلفه فارغ و آزاد شوند در حضور قبول فرمودند و بسیار هم اظهار فرح و مسرّت کردند و بعد بایشان ذکر شد که این فقره را بوکلا و وزرای دولت برسانند تا حکمش در ممالک جاری گردد و بعد مکرّر تشریف آوردند و از این فقره ذکرى ننمودند و حال آنکه آنچه ذکر شد سبب اتّحاد اهل عالم و اتّفاق بوده

Dar Āstāne yawmī az ayyām Kamāl Pāshā nazd-e maẓlūm ḥāżer va az omūr-e nāfeʿe dhekrī be-miyān āmad. Dhekr namūdand ke alson-e motaʿaddede āmūkhte-and. Dar javāb dhekr shod ʿomrī rā talaf namūde-īd. Bāyad methl-e ān janāb va sāyer-e vokalā-ye dawlat majlesī biyārāyand va dar ān majles yek lesān az alson-e mokhtalefe va hamchenīn yek khaṭṭ az khoṭūṭ-e mawjūde rā ekhtiyār namāyand va yā khaṭṭ va lesānī badīʿ tartīb dehand va dar madāres-e ʿālam aṭfāl rā be-ān taʿlīm farmāyand. Dar īn ṣūrat dārā-ye do lesān mīshavand, yekī lesān-e vaṭan va dīgarī lesānī ke ʿomūm-e ahl-e ʿālam be-ān takallom namāyand. Agar be-ānche dhekr shod tamassok jūyand jamīʿ-e arż qeṭʿe-ye vāḥede moshāhede shavad va az taʿlīm va taʿallom-e alson-e mokhtalefe fāregh va āzād shavand. Dar ḥożūr qabūl farmūdand va besyār ham eẓhār-e faraḥ va masarrat kardand va baʿd be-īshān dhekr shod ke īn faqare rā be-vokalā va vozarā-ye dawlat berasānand tā ḥokmash dar mamālek jārī gardad va baʿd mokarrar tashrīf āvardand va az īn faqare dhekrī nanamūdand va ḥāl ānke ānche dhekr shod sabab-e etteḥād-e ahl-e ʿālam va ettefāq būde.

One day in Constantinople, Kamāl Pāshā came into the presence of this Wronged One, and the conversation turned to useful matters. He mentioned that he had learned several languages. In reply, he was told: “You have wasted a lifetime. People such as yourself and the other representatives of the government should convene an assembly, and in that assembly choose one language from among the various languages, and likewise one script from among the existing scripts, or devise a new script and language, and have children taught these in the schools of the world. They would then possess two languages: one the language of their homeland, and the other a language spoken by all the people of the world. If they hold fast to what has been mentioned, the whole earth will be seen as a single land, and they will be freed and relieved of teaching and learning different languages.” In Our presence he accepted this and expressed much joy and delight. He was then told to convey this matter to the representatives and ministers of the government so that its ruling might be implemented throughout the territories. Afterward he came repeatedly, but made no mention of this matter, even though what was proposed would bring about the unity and concord of the people of the world.

202

امید آنکه دولت ایران بآن تمسّک فرماید و اجرا دارد حال خطّ بدیعی و لسان جدیدی اختراع شده اگر طالب باشند ارسال شود مقصود آنکه کل تمسّک نمایند باموری که از زحمت و مشقّت بکاهد و ایّام در آنچه سزاوار است صرف شود و بانتها رسد انّ اللّه هو المؤیّد العلیم و المدبّر الخبیر

Omīd ānke dawlat-e Īrān be-ān tamassok farmāyad va ejrā dārad. Ḥāl khaṭṭ-e badīʿī va lesān-e jadīdī ekhterāʿ shode agar ṭāleb bāshand ersāl shavad. Maqṣūd ānke koll tamassok namāyand be-omūrī ke az zaḥmat va mashaqqat bekāhad va ayyām dar ānche sazāvār ast ṣarf shavad va be-entehā resad. Inna Allāha huwa al-muʾayyidu al-ʿalīmu wa-al-mudabbiru al-khabīr.

It is hoped that the government of Iran will adopt and implement it. A new script and a new language have now been devised; if they wish, these will be sent. The purpose is that all should hold fast to measures that lessen toil and hardship, and that their days should be spent and brought to a close in worthy pursuits. God is indeed the all-knowing Sustainer and the all-informed Ordainer.

203

انشآءاللّه ایران مزیّن گردد و فائز شود بآنچه که الی حین از آن محروم بوده قل یا سلطان همّت فرما تا جمیع اهل عالم بتجلّیات انوار نیّر عدل آن حضرت منوّر گردند این مظلوم جز بامانت و صدق و صفا و امور نافعه بامری ناظر نبوده و نیست او را از خائنین مشمرید سبحانک یا الهی و سیّدی و سندی ایّد حضرة السّلطان علی اجرآء اوامرک و احکامک و اظهار عدلک بین عبادک انّک انت الفضّال الفیّاض المقتدر القدیر قد اتى امر اللّه بالفضل طوبى للعاملین و طوبى للعارفین و طوبى لمن تمسّک بالحقّ منقطعاً عمّن فى السّموات و الأرضین

In shāʾa Allāh Īrān mozayyan gardad va fāʾez shavad be-ānche ke elā ḥīn az ān maḥrūm būde. Qul yā Solṭān, hemmat farmā tā jamīʿ-e ahl-e ʿālam be-tajalliyāt-e anvār-e nayyer-e ʿadl-e ān Ḥażrat monavvar gardand. Īn maẓlūm joz be-amānat va ṣedq va ṣafā va omūr-e nāfeʿe be-amrī nāẓer nabūde va nīst. Ū rā az khāʾenīn mashmorīd. Subḥānaka yā ilāhī wa-sayyidī wa-sanadī, ayyid Ḥaḍrata al-Sulṭāni ʿalā ijrāʾi awāmirika wa-aḥkāmika wa-iẓhāri ʿadlika bayna ʿibādika. Innaka anta al-faḍḍālu al-fayyāḍu al-muqtadiru al-qadīr. Qad atā amru Allāhi bi-al-faḍli ṭūbā li-al-ʿāmilīna wa-ṭūbā li-al-ʿārifīna wa-ṭūbā li-man tamassaka bi-al-Ḥaqqi munqaṭiʿan ʿamman fī al-samāwāti wa-al-araḍīn.

God willing, Iran will be adorned and attain what it has until now been deprived of. Say: O sovereign! Make an effort so that all the people of the world may be illumined by the radiance of the sun of Your Majesty’s justice. This Wronged One has never had, nor does He now have, any aim other than trustworthiness, truthfulness, sincerity, and useful endeavors. Do not count Him among the treacherous. Glory be to You, my God, my Lord, and my Support! Strengthen His Majesty the sovereign to carry out Your commands and laws and to manifest Your justice among Your servants. You are indeed the All-Bountiful, the All-Munificent, the All-Powerful, the Almighty. The Cause of God has come through His grace. Blessed are those who act, blessed are those who recognize, and blessed is whoever holds fast to the True One, detached from all who are in the heavens and on earth.

204

یا شیخ قصد شاطی بحر اعظم فرما ثمّ ادخل فی السّفینة الحمرآء الّتی قدّرها اللّه لأهل البهآء فی قیّوم الأسمآء و انّها تمرّ علی البرّ و البحر من دخل فیها نجا و من اعرض هلک اذا دخلت و فزت ولّ وجهک شطر کعبة اللّه المهیمن القیّوم و قل اللّهمّ انّی اسألک من بهائک بأبهاه و کلّ بهائک بهیّ اذاً تفتح علی وجهک ابواب الملکوت و تری ما لا رأت العیون و تسمع ما لا سمعت الآذان انّ المظلوم یعظک کما وعظک و ما اراد لک الّا الدّخول فی بحر احدیّة اللّه ربّ العالمین هذا یوم فیه تنادی کلّ الأشیآء و تبشّر النّاس بهذا الظّهور الّذی به ظهر ما کان مکنوناً مخزوناً فی علم اللّه العزیز الحمید

Yā Shaykh, qaṣd-e shāṭī-e baḥr-e aʿẓam farmā. Thumma udkhul fī al-safīnati al-ḥamrāʾi allatī qaddarahā Allāhu li-ahli al-Bahāʾi fī Qayyūmi al-Asmāʾi wa-innahā tamurru ʿalā al-barri wa-al-baḥri man dakhala fīhā najā wa-man aʿraḍa halak. Idhā dakhalta wa-fuzta walli wajhaka shaṭra kaʿbati Allāhi al-muhaymini al-qayyūmi wa-qul Allāhumma innī asʾaluka min bahāʾika bi-abhāhu wa-kullu bahāʾika bahiyy. Idhan tuftaḥu ʿalā wajhika abwābu al-malakūti wa-tarā mā lā raʾati al-ʿuyūnu wa-tasmaʿu mā lā samiʿati al-ādhān. Inna al-maẓlūma yaʿiẓuka kamā waʿaẓaka wa-mā arāda laka illā al-dukhūla fī baḥri aḥadiyyati Allāhi rabbi al-ʿālamīn. Hādhā yawmun fīhi tunādī kullu al-ashyāʾi wa-tubashshiru al-nāsa bi-hādhā al-ẓuhūri alladhī bihi ẓahara mā kāna maknūnan makhzūnan fī ʿilmi Allāhi al-ʿazīzi al-ḥamīd.

O Shaykh! Make your way to the shore of the Most Great Ocean. Then enter the Crimson Ark, which God ordained for the people of Bahāʾ in the Qayyūm al-Asmāʾ. It passes over land and sea. Whoever enters it is saved, and whoever turns away perishes. When you have entered and attained it, turn your face toward the Kaaba of God, the All-Protecting, the Self-Subsisting, and say: “O God! I ask You by the most glorious of Your glory, and all Your glory is glorious.” Then the gates of the Kingdom will be opened before you, and you will see what eyes have never seen and hear what ears have never heard. This Wronged One counsels you as He has counseled you before, and desires for you nothing but entry into the ocean of the oneness of God, the Lord of the worlds. This is a day on which all things call out and announce to humanity the glad tidings of this Revelation, through which what lay concealed and treasured in the knowledge of God, the Almighty, the Praiseworthy, has been made manifest.

205

یا شیخ تغرّدات حمامات بیان را بر افنان سدرهٔ عرفان اصغا نمودی حال تغنّیات طیور حکمت را که در جنّت علیا مرتفع است بشنو انّه یعرّفک ما کنت غافلاً عنه اسمع ما نطق به لسان القوّة و القدرة فی کتب اللّه مقصود العارفین فی هذا الحین ارتفع النّدآء من سدرة المنتهی فی قطب الفردوس الأعلی و امرنی بأن اذکر لجنابک ما نزل فی الزّبر و الألواح و ما نطق به مبشّری الّذى فدی بنفسه لهذا النّبإ العظیم و الصّراط المستقیم قال و قوله الحقّ و قد کتبت جوهرة فی ذکره و هو انّه لا یشار باشارتی و لا بما ذکر فی البیان الی قوله عزّ و جلّ فی ذکر هذا الظّهور الأعظم و النّبإ العظیم انّه اجلّ و اعلی من ان یکون معروفاً بدونه او مستشیراً باشارة خلقه و انّنی انا اوّل عبد قد آمنت به و بآیاته و اخذت من ابکار حدائق جنّة عرفانه حدائق کلماته بلی وعزّته هو الحقّ لا اله الّا هو کلّ بأمره قائمون انتهی حمامهٔ حقیقی بر اغصان سدرهٔ الهی باین کلمات تغنّی فرموده طوبی از برای نفسی که باصغای آن فائز شد و از بحور بیان الهی که در هر کلمه‌ئی مستور اخذ نمود و آشامید و همچنین در مقام دیگر ندای بیان از اعلی الأغصان مرتفع قوله تبارک و تعالی و فی سنة التّسع انتم کلّ خیر تدرکون و در مقام دیگر میفرماید و فی سنة التّسع انتم بلقآء اللّه ترزقون انتهی این نغمات که از طیور مدائن عرفان ظاهر گشته مطابقست به ما انزله الرّحمن فی الفرقان طوبی للمتبصّرین و طوبی للفائزین

Yā Shaykh, tagharrodāt-e ḥamāmāt-e bayān rā bar afnān-e sedre-ye ʿerfān eṣghā namūdī ḥāl taghanniyāt-e ṭoyūr-e ḥekmat rā ke dar jannat-e ʿolyā mortafeʿ ast beshnow. Innahu yuʿarrifuka mā kunta ghāfilan ʿanhu. Ismaʿ mā naṭaqa bihi lisānu al-quwwati wa-al-qudrati fī kutubi Allāhi maqṣūdi al-ʿārifīn. Fī hādhā al-ḥīni irtafaʿa al-nidāʾu min sidrati al-muntahā fī quṭbi al-firdawsi al-aʿlā wa-amaranī bi-an adhkura li-janābika mā nazala fī al-zuburi wa-al-alwāḥi wa-mā naṭaqa bihi mubashshirī alladhī fadā bi-nafsihi li-hādhā al-nabaʾi al-ʿaẓīmi wa-al-ṣirāṭi al-mustaqīm. Qāla wa-qawluhu al-ḥaqqu wa-qad katabtu jawharatan fī dhikrihi wa-huwa innahu lā yushāru bi-ishāratī wa-lā bi-mā dhukira fī al-Bayān. Ilā qawlihi ʿazza wa-jalla fī dhikri hādhā al-ẓuhūri al-aʿẓami wa-al-nabaʾi al-ʿaẓīm: Innahu ajallu wa-aʿlā min an yakūna maʿrūfan bi-dūnihi aw mustashīran bi-ishārati khalqihi wa-innanī anā awwalu ʿabdin qad āmantu bihi wa-bi-āyātihi wa-akhadhtu min abkāri ḥadāʾiqi jannati ʿirfānihi ḥadāʾiqa kalimātihi. Balā wa-ʿizzatihi huwa al-Ḥaqqu lā ilāha illā huwa kullun bi-amrihi qāʾimūn. Intahā. Ḥamāme-ye ḥaqīqī bar aghṣān-e sedre-ye elāhī be-īn kalemāt taghannī farmūde. Ṭūbā az barā-ye nafsī ke be-eṣghā-ye ān fāʾez shod va az boḥūr-e bayān-e elāhī ke dar har kaleme-ī mastūr akhdh namūd va āshāmīd. Va hamchenīn dar maqām-e dīgar nedā-ye bayān az aʿlā al-aghṣān mortafeʿ, qawluhu tabāraka wa-taʿālā: Wa-fī sanati al-tisʿi antum kulla khayrin tudrikūn. Va dar maqām-e dīgar mīfarmāyad: Wa-fī sanati al-tisʿi antum bi-liqāʾi Allāhi turzaqūn. Intahā. Īn naghamāt ke az ṭoyūr-e madāʾen-e ʿerfān ẓāher gashte moṭābeq ast be mā anzalahu al-Raḥmānu fī al-Furqān. Ṭūbā li-al-mutabaṣṣirīna wa-ṭūbā li-al-fāʾizīn.

O Shaykh! You have listened to the warbling of the doves of utterance upon the boughs of the Tree of recognition; now hear the songs of the birds of wisdom rising in the highest Paradise. He makes known to you what you were heedless of. Hear what the tongue of strength and power has spoken in the books of God, the Desire of those who recognize Him. At this moment the call has risen from the Tree beyond which there is no passing, at the heart of the highest Paradise, and has commanded Me to relate to you what has been sent down in the scriptures and Tablets, and what My Herald spoke, who sacrificed Himself for this momentous Announcement and this straight Path. He said—and His word is the truth—“I have written a gem concerning Him, namely, that He cannot be indicated by My allusions, nor by what has been mentioned in the Bayān.” Further on He said, exalted and glorious is He, concerning this Most Great Revelation and this momentous Announcement: “He is too majestic and exalted to be known through anyone other than Himself, or to seek counsel through the indications of His creatures. I am indeed the first servant to have believed in Him and His verses, and from the virgin gardens of the paradise of His recognition I have gathered the gardens of His words. Yes, by His might! He is the True One; there is no god but Him. All stand by His command.” Here ends the quotation. The true Dove has sung these words upon the branches of the divine Tree. Blessed is the soul that has attained to hearing them and has drawn and drunk from the oceans of divine utterance concealed in every word. Likewise, in another passage, the call of the Bayān rises from the highest branches. His words, blessed and exalted is He, are: “In the year nine you will attain all good.” And in another passage He says: “In the year nine you will be granted the meeting with God.” Here ends the quotation. These melodies, which have issued from the birds of the cities of recognition, accord with what the All-Merciful has sent down in the Qurʾān. Blessed are those who see clearly, and blessed are those who attain.

206

یا شیخ لعمر اللّه فرات رحمت جاری و بحر بیان موّاج و شمس ظهور مشرق و منیر بقلب فارغ و صدر منشرح و لسان صدق مبین این کلمات عالیات که از مبشّر یعنی نقطهٔ اولی ظاهر شده قرائت نما قوله عزّ بیانه مخاطباً لحضرة العظیم هذا ما قد وعدناک قبل حین الّذى اجبناک اصبر حتّی یقضی عن البیان تسعة فاذاً قل فتبارک اللّه احسن المبدعین قل هو نبأ لم یحط بعلمه احد الّا اللّه ولکن انتم یومئذ لا تعلمون انتهی و در سنهٔ تسع این ظهور اعظم از مشرق ارادهٔ الهی مشرق و لائح لا ینکره الّا کلّ غافل مریب نسأل اللّه ان یؤیّد عباده علی الرّجوع الیه و الاستغفار عمّا عملوا به فی الحیوة الباطلة انّه هو التّوّاب الغفور الرّحیم و در مقام دیگر میفرماید انّنی انا اوّل عبد قد آمنت به و بآیاته انتهی و همچنین در بیان فارسی میفرماید انّه هو الّذی ینطق فی کلّ شأن انّنی انا اللّه الی آخر بیانه جلّ و عزّ و مقصود از ذکر ربوبیّت و الوهیّت از قبل ذکر شد قد خرقنا الأحجاب و اظهرنا ما یقرّب النّاس الی اللّه مالک الرّقاب طوبی لمن فاز بالعدل و الانصاف فی هذا الفضل الّذی احاط من فی السّموات و الأرضین امراً من لدی اللّه ربّ العالمین

Yā Shaykh, la-ʿamru Allāh, Forāt-e raḥmat jārī va baḥr-e bayān mavvāj va shams-e ẓohūr moshreq va monīr. Be-qalb-e fāregh va ṣadr-e monshareḥ va lesān-e ṣedq-e mobīn īn kalemāt-e ʿāliyāt ke az mobashsher yaʿnī Noqṭe-ye Ūlā ẓāher shode qerāʾat namā. Qawluhu ʿazza bayānuhu mukhāṭiban li-Ḥaḍrati al-ʿAẓīm: Hādhā mā qad waʿadnāka qabla ḥīna alladhī ajabnāka iṣbir ḥattā yuqḍā ʿani al-Bayāni tisʿatun fa-idhan qul fa-tabāraka Allāhu aḥsanu al-mubdiʿīn. Qul huwa nabaʾun lam yuḥiṭ bi-ʿilmihi aḥadun illā Allāhu wa-lākin antum yawmaʾidhin lā taʿlamūn. Intahā. Va dar sane-ye tesʿ īn ẓohūr-e aʿẓam az mashreq-e erāde-ye elāhī moshreq va lāʾeḥ. Lā yunkiruhu illā kullu ghāfilin murīb. Nasʾalu Allāha an yuʾayyida ʿibādahu ʿalā al-rujūʿi ilayhi wa-al-istighfāri ʿammā ʿamilū bihi fī al-ḥayāti al-bāṭilati innahu huwa al-tawwābu al-ghafūru al-raḥīm. Va dar maqām-e dīgar mīfarmāyad: Innanī anā awwalu ʿabdin qad āmantu bihi wa-bi-āyātihi. Intahā. Va hamchenīn dar Bayān-e Fārsī mīfarmāyad: Innahu huwa alladhī yanṭiqu fī kulli shaʾnin innanī anā Allāh. Ilā ākhiri bayānihi jalla wa-ʿazza. Va maqṣūd az dhekr-e robūbiyyat va olūhiyyat az qabl dhekr shod. Qad kharaqnā al-aḥjāba wa-aẓharnā mā yuqarribu al-nāsa ilā Allāhi māliki al-riqāb. Ṭūbā li-man fāza bi-al-ʿadli wa-al-inṣāfi fī hādhā al-faḍli alladhī aḥāṭa man fī al-samāwāti wa-al-araḍīna amran min ladā Allāhi rabbi al-ʿālamīn.

O Shaykh! By the life of God! The Euphrates of mercy is flowing, the ocean of utterance is surging, and the sun of Revelation is shining and radiant. With an unburdened heart, an open breast, and a clearly truthful tongue, read these exalted words that have issued from the Herald, namely, the Primal Point. His words, exalted is His utterance, addressed to His Honor ʿAẓīm, are: “This is what We promised you before, when We answered you: Wait until nine have elapsed from the Bayān; then say: ‘Blessed be God, the best of originators!’ Say: This is an announcement whose knowledge no one but God has encompassed, yet on that day you will not know.” Here ends the quotation. In the year nine this Most Great Revelation shone and gleamed from the dawning-place of the divine will. None denies it except the heedless and doubting. We ask God to help His servants turn back to Him and seek forgiveness for what they have done in this vain life. He is indeed the Ever-Relenting, the Ever-Forgiving, the Merciful. And in another passage He says: “I am indeed the first servant to have believed in Him and His verses.” Here ends the quotation. Likewise, in the Persian Bayān He says: “He is the One who declares in every circumstance: ‘I am indeed God’”—and so continues His utterance, majestic and exalted is He. The intended meaning of the mention of lordship and divinity has already been explained. We have rent the veils and revealed what brings people nearer to God, the Master of all. Blessed is whoever attains justice and fairness amid this grace, which has encompassed all who are in the heavens and on earth, by a command from God, the Lord of the worlds.

207

یا شیخ نغمات انجیل را باذن انصاف بشنو قوله عزّ بیانه که از بعد اخبار میفرماید و امّا ذلک الیوم و تلک السّاعة فلا یعلم بهما احد و لا الملائکة الّذین فی السّمآء و لا الابن الّا الأب و مقصود از اب در این مقام حقّ جلّ جلاله است و اوست مربّی حقیقی و معلّم معنوی

Yā Shaykh, naghamāt-e Enjīl rā be-odhon-e enṣāf beshnow. Qawluhu ʿazza bayānuhu ke az baʿd ekh bār mīfarmāyad: Wa-ammā dhālika al-yawmu wa-tilka al-sāʿatu fa-lā yaʿlamu bihimā aḥadun wa-lā al-malāʾikatu alladhīna fī al-samāʾi wa-lā al-ibnu illā al-ab. Va maqṣūd az ab dar īn maqām Ḥaqq jalla jalālohu ast va ūst morabbī-e ḥaqīqī va moʿallem-e maʿnavī.

O Shaykh! Hear the melodies of the Gospel with the ear of fairness. His words, exalted is His utterance, in which He speaks of what is to come, are: “But of that day and that hour no one knows, neither the angels who are in heaven nor the Son, but only the Father.” By “Father” in this passage is meant God, exalted be His glory. He is the true Educator and spiritual Teacher.

208

یوئیل میفرماید لأنّ یوم الرّبّ عظیم و مخوف جدّا فمن یطیقه اوّل در بیان جلیل مرقوم در انجیل میفرماید احدی بحین ظهور آگاه نه لم یحط به الّا اللّه العلیم الخبیر و در ثانی عظمت ظهور را ذکر مینماید و همچنین در فرقان میفرماید عمّ یتساءلون عن النّبإ العظیم اینست آن نبأئی که عظمتش در اکثری از کتب قبل و بعد مذکور اینست آن نبأئی که ارتعدت به فرائص العالم الّا من شآء اللّه الحافظ النّاصر المعین چنانچه بابصار ظاهره مشاهده شد که جمیع عباد و من فى البلاد منقلب و متحیّر گشتند الّا من شآء اللّه

Yūʾīl mīfarmāyad: «Li-anna yawma al-Rabbi ʿaẓīmun wa-makhūfun jiddan fa-man yuṭīquhu.» Avval dar bayān-i jalīl-i marqūm dar Injīl mīfarmāyad aḥadī bi-ḥīn-i ẓuhūr āgāh nah: «Lam yuḥiṭ bihi illā Allāhu al-ʿAlīmu al-Khabīr.» Va dar thānī ʿaẓamat-i ẓuhūr rā dhikr mīnamāyad va hamchunīn dar Furqān mīfarmāyad: «ʿAmma yatasāʾalūna ʿani al-nabaʾi al-ʿaẓīm.» Īnast ān nabaʾī kih ʿaẓamatash dar aktharī az kutub-i qabl va baʿd madhkūr. Īnast ān nabaʾī kih «irtaʿadat bihi farāʾiṣu al-ʿālam illā man shāʾa Allāhu al-Ḥāfiẓu al-Nāṣiru al-Muʿīn». Chunānchih bi-abṣār-i ẓāhirih mushāhadih shud kih jamīʿ-i ʿibād va man fī al-bilād munqalib va mutaḥayyir gashtand illā man shāʾa Allāh.

Joel says: “For the day of the Lord is great and very terrible; who can endure it?” First, in the glorious utterance recorded in the Gospel, He says that no one knows the time of the Revelation: “None has encompassed it except God, the All-Knowing, the All-Aware.” Second, He speaks of the greatness of the Revelation. Likewise, in the Qurʾān He says: “About what are they questioning one another? About the momentous announcement.” This is that announcement whose greatness is mentioned in most of the Books, both earlier and later. This is that announcement at which “the limbs of the world trembled, except those whom God willed to spare, the Preserver, the Helper, the Sustainer.” As was seen with outward eyes, all the servants and inhabitants of the lands became agitated and bewildered, except those whom God willed to spare.

209

یا شیخ امر عظیم است و نبأ عظیم بصبر و سکون در آیات باهرات و کلمات عالیات و ما ظهر فی هذه الأیّام تفکّر نما شاید اسرار مکنونهٔ در کتب را بیابی و بر هدایت عباد همّت نمائی ندای ارمیا را بسمع حقیقی بشنو میفرماید آه لأنّ ذلک الیوم عظیم و لیس مثله اگر آن جناب بانصاف نظر نمایند بر عظمت یوم آگاه شوند اسمع ندآء هذا النّاصح العلیم و لا تجعل نفسک محرومة عن الرّحمة الّتی سبقت الوجود من الغیب و الشّهود نغمهٔ حضرت داود را بشنو میفرماید من یقودنی الی المدینة المحصّنة مدینهٔ محصّنه عکّاست که سجن اعظم نامیده شده و دارای حصن و قلعهٔ محکم است

Yā Shaykh! Amr ʿaẓīm ast va nabaʾ ʿaẓīm. Bi-ṣabr va sukūn dar āyāt-i bāhirāt va kalimāt-i ʿāliyāt va mā ẓahara fī hādhihi al-ayyām tafakkur namā shāyad asrār-i maknūnih-yi dar kutub rā biyābī va bar hidāyat-i ʿibād himmat namāʾī. Nidā-yi Irmiyā rā bi-samʿ-i ḥaqīqī bishnaw. Mīfarmāyad: «Āh li-anna dhālika al-yawma ʿaẓīmun wa-laysa mithlahu.» Agar ān janāb bi-inṣāf naẓar namāyand bar ʿaẓamat-i yawm āgāh shavand. Ismaʿ nidāʾa hādhā al-Nāṣiḥi al-ʿAlīm wa-lā tajʿal nafsaka maḥrūmatan ʿani al-raḥmati allatī sabaqati al-wujūda mina al-ghaybi wa-al-shuhūd. Naghmih-yi Ḥaḍrat-i Dāvūd rā bishnaw. Mīfarmāyad: «Man yaqūdunī ilā al-madīnati al-muḥaṣṣanah.» Madīnih-yi muḥaṣṣanih ʿAkkāst kih Sijn-i Aʿẓam nāmīdih shudih va dārā-yi ḥiṣn va qalʿih-yi muḥkam ast.

O Shaykh! Great is the Cause, and momentous the announcement. With patience and composure, reflect on the resplendent verses, the exalted words, and what has appeared in these days, so that you may discover the mysteries hidden in the Books and strive to guide the servants. Hear the call of Jeremiah with the true ear. He says: “Alas! For that day is great, and none is like it.” If you look with fairness, you will recognize the greatness of the Day. Hear the call of this all-knowing Counsellor, and do not deprive yourself of the mercy that has preceded all existence, both unseen and seen. Hear the melody of David. He says: “Who will lead me to the fortified city?” The fortified city is ʿAkkā, which has been named the Most Great Prison and possesses a strong fortress and citadel.

210

یا شیخ اقرأ ما نطق به اشعیا فى کتابه قوله علی جبل عال اصعدی یا مبشّرة صهیون ارفعی صوتک بقوّة یا مبشّرة اورشلیم ارفعی لا تخافی قولی لمدن یهوذا هو ذا الهک هو ذا السّیّد الرّبّ بقوّة یأتی و ذراعه تحکم له امروز جمیع علامات نمودار مدینهٔ بزرگی از آسمان نازل شده و صهیون از ظهور حقّ مهتزّ و مسرور چه که ندآء اللّه را از کلّ جهات اصغا نموده امروز اورشلیم ببشارت جدید فائز چه که مقام جمّیز سرو آزاد ایستاده اورشلیم محلّ زیارت جمیع احزاب عالم است و به قدس نامیده شده و آن و صهیون و فلسطین جمیع در این اراضی واقع اینست که میفرماید طوبی لمن هاجر الی عکّا

Yā Shaykh! Iqraʾ mā naṭaqa bihi Ishaʿyā fī kitābihi. Qawluhu: «ʿAlā jabalin ʿālin iṣʿadī yā mubashshirata Ṣahyūn, irfaʿī ṣawtaki bi-quwwatin yā mubashshirata Ūrashalīm, irfaʿī lā takhāfī, qūlī li-muduni Yahūdhā: Huwa dhā ilāhuki, huwa dhā al-Sayyidu al-Rabbu bi-quwwatin yaʾtī wa-dhirāʿuhu taḥkumu lahu.» Imrūz jamīʿ-i ʿalāmāt namūdār. Madīnih-yi buzurgī az āsmān nāzil shudih va Ṣahyūn az ẓuhūr-i Ḥaqq muhtazz va masrūr chih kih nidāʾ Allāh rā az kull-i jihāt iṣghā namūdih. Imrūz Ūrashalīm bi-bishārat-i jadīd fāʾiz chih kih maqām-i jummayz sarv-i āzād īstādih. Ūrashalīm maḥall-i ziyārat-i jamīʿ-i aḥzāb-i ʿālam ast va bi-Quds nāmīdih shudih va ān va Ṣahyūn va Filasṭīn jamīʿ dar īn arāḍī vāqiʿ. Īnast kih mīfarmāyad: «Ṭūbā li-man hājara ilā ʿAkkā.»

O Shaykh! Read what Isaiah has spoken in his book. His words are: “Ascend a high mountain, O herald of good news to Zion! Raise your voice with strength, O herald of good news to Jerusalem! Raise it, do not fear. Say to the cities of Judah: ‘Here is your God! Here the Lord God comes with strength, and His arm rules for Him.’” Today all the signs are manifest. A great city has descended from heaven, and Zion is stirred and joyful at the revelation of God, for it has heard the call of God from every direction. Today Jerusalem has received new glad tidings, for in place of the sycamore stands the noble cypress. Jerusalem is a place of pilgrimage for all the peoples of the world and has been named Quds. It, Zion, and Palestine all lie in these lands. Thus He says: “Blessed is whoever migrates to ʿAkkā.”

211

عاموص میفرماید انّ الرّبّ یزمجر من صهیون و یأتی صوته من اورشلیم فتنوح مراعی الرّعاة و ییبس رأس الکرمل و کرمل در کتاب الهی به کوم اللّه و کرم اللّه نامیده شده کوم تپه را میگویند و این مقامیست که در این ایّام از فضل دارای ظهور خباء مجد بر آن مرتفع گشته طوبی للواردین و طوبى للمقبلین و همچنین میفرماید یأتی الهنا و لا یصمت

ʿĀmūṣ mīfarmāyad: «Inna al-Rabba yuzamjiru min Ṣahyūn wa-yaʾtī ṣawtuhu min Ūrashalīm fa-tanūḥu marāʿī al-ruʿāti wa-yaybasu raʾsu al-Karmal.» Va Karmal dar Kitāb-i Ilāhī bi-Kawm Allāh va Karm Allāh nāmīdih shudih. Kawm tappih rā mīgūyand va īn maqāmīst kih dar īn ayyām az faḍl-i Dārā-yi Ẓuhūr khibāʾ-i majd bar ān murtafiʿ gashtih. Ṭūbā li-al-wāridīn wa-ṭūbā li-al-muqbilīn. Va hamchunīn mīfarmāyad: «Yaʾtī ilāhunā wa-lā yaṣmut.»

Amos says: “The Lord roars from Zion, and His voice comes from Jerusalem; the shepherds’ pastures mourn, and the summit of Carmel withers.” Carmel has been named the “Mound of God” and the “Vineyard of God” in the Book of God. Kawm means a mound, and this is the place on which, in these days, through the grace of the Lord of Revelation, the tabernacle of glory has been raised. Blessed are those who arrive, and blessed are those who turn toward it. He also says: “Our God comes and does not remain silent.”

212

یا شیخ در این بیان مقصود عالمیان که به عاموص فرموده تفکّر نما قوله فاستعدّ للقآء الهک یا اسرائیل فانّه هو ذا الّذی صنع الجبال و خلق الرّیح و اخبر الانسان ما هو فکره الّذی یجعل الفجر ظلاماً و یمشی علی مشارف الأرض یهوه اله الجنود اسمه میفرماید فجر را تاریک مینماید مقصود آنکه اگر در حین ظهور مکلّم طور نفسی خود را صبح صادق داند بقوّت و قدرت الهی تاریک میشود صبح کاذبست و خود را صادق میداند ویل له و ویل لمن اتّبعه من دون بیّنة من اللّه ربّ العالمین

Yā Shaykh! Dar īn bayān-i Maqṣūd-i ʿālamiyān kih bi-ʿĀmūṣ farmūdih tafakkur namā. Qawluhu: «Fa-istaʿidd li-liqāʾi ilāhika yā Isrāʾīl. Fa-innahu huwa dhā alladhī ṣanaʿa al-jibāla wa-khalaqa al-rīḥa wa-akhbara al-insāna mā huwa fikruhu, alladhī yajʿalu al-fajra ẓalāman wa-yamshī ʿalā mashārifi al-arḍ, Yahwah ilāhu al-junūdi ismuhu.» Mīfarmāyad fajr rā tārīk mīnamāyad. Maqṣūd ānkih agar dar ḥīn-i ẓuhūr-i Mukallim-i Ṭūr nafsī khud rā ṣubḥ-i ṣādiq dānad bi-quvvat va qudrat-i ilāhī tārīk mīshavad. Ṣubḥ-i kādhib ast va khud rā ṣādiq mīdānad. Waylun lahu wa-waylun li-man ittabaʿahu min dūni bayyinatin mina Allāhi Rabbi al-ʿālamīn.

O Shaykh! Reflect on this utterance of the Desire of all peoples, which He spoke to Amos. His words are: “Prepare to meet your God, O Israel. For here is He who formed the mountains, created the wind, and tells humanity what His thought is; who turns dawn into darkness and walks upon the heights of the earth—Yahweh, the God of hosts, is His name.” He says that He darkens the dawn. The meaning is that if, at the appearance of Him who spoke on Sinai, a soul considers himself the true dawn, he will be darkened by divine strength and power. He is a false dawn, yet considers himself true. Woe to him, and woe to whoever follows him without a clear proof from God, the Lord of the worlds.

213

اشعیا میفرماید یسمو الرّبّ وحده فی ذلک الیوم و در عظمت ظهور میفرماید ادخل الی الصّخرة و اختبئ فی التّراب من امام هیبة الرّبّ و من بهآء عظمته و در مقام دیگر میفرماید تفرح البرّیّة و الأرض الیابسة و یبتهج القفر و یزهر کالنّرجس یزهر ازهاراً و یبتهج ابتهاجاً و یرنّم یدفع الیه مجد لبنان بهآء کرمل و شارون هم یرون مجد الرّبّ بهآء الهنا انتهى

Ishaʿyā mīfarmāyad: «Yasmū al-Rabbu waḥdahu fī dhālika al-yawm.» Va dar ʿaẓamat-i ẓuhūr mīfarmāyad: «Udkhul ilā al-ṣakhrati wa-ikhtabiʾ fī al-turābi min amāmi haybati al-Rabbi wa-min bahāʾi ʿaẓamatihi.» Va dar maqām-i dīgar mīfarmāyad: «Tafraḥu al-barriyyatu wa-al-arḍu al-yābisatu wa-yabtahiju al-qafru wa-yuzhiru ka-al-narjis. Yuzhiru izhāran wa-yabtahiju ibtihājan wa-yurannimu. Yudfaʿu ilayhi majdu Lubnān, bahāʾu Karmal wa-Shārūn. Hum yarawna majda al-Rabbi, bahāʾa ilāhinā.» Intahā.

Isaiah says: “The Lord alone will be exalted on that day.” Concerning the greatness of the Revelation, he says: “Enter the rock and hide in the dust before the awe of the Lord and the splendor of His majesty.” Elsewhere he says: “The wilderness and the dry land will rejoice; the desert will be glad and blossom like the narcissus. It will blossom abundantly, rejoice greatly, and sing. The glory of Lebanon will be given to it, the splendor of Carmel and Sharon. They will see the glory of the Lord, the splendor of our God.” Here ends the quotation.

214

این فقرات احتیاج بتفسیر ندارد بمثابهٔ آفتاب مشرق و ظاهر و بمثابهٔ نور ساطع و لامع هر منصفی از عرف این بیان بحدیقهٔ عرفان راه یابد و فائز شود بآنچه اکثر اهل عالم از آن محجوب و ممنوعند قل اتّقوا اللّه یا قوم و لا تتّبعوا شبهات النّاعقین الّذین نقضوا عهد اللّه و میثاقه و انکروا رحمته الّتی سبقت من فی السّموات و الأرضین

Īn faqarāt iḥtiyāj bi-tafsīr nadārad. Bi-mathābih-yi āftāb mushriq va ẓāhir va bi-mathābih-yi nūr sāṭiʿ va lāmiʿ. Har munṣifī az ʿarf-i īn bayān bi-ḥadīqih-yi ʿirfān rāh yābad va fāʾiz shavad bi-ānchih akthar-i ahl-i ʿālam az ān maḥjūb va mamnūʿand. Qul ittaqū Allāha yā qawmu wa-lā tattabiʿū shubuhāti al-nāʿiqīna alladhīna naqaḍū ʿahda Allāhi wa-mīthāqahu wa-ankarū raḥmatahu allatī sabaqat man fī al-samāwāti wa-al-araḍīn.

These passages need no interpretation. They are as manifest and radiant as the sun, as brilliant and shining as light. Through the fragrance of this utterance, every fair-minded person will find the way to the garden of recognition and attain what most of the world’s people are veiled from and denied. Say: Fear God, O people, and do not follow the doubts raised by those who clamor, who have broken God’s covenant and pledge and denied His mercy, which has preceded all who are in the heavens and on earth.

215

و همچنین میفرماید قولوا لخائفی القلوب تشدّدوا لا تخافوا هو ذا الهکم انتهی این آیهٔ مبارکه دلیل است بر عظمت ظهور و عظمت امر چه که نفخهٔ صور عالم را مضطرب مینماید زلزله و خوف کل را احاطه میکند طوبی از برای نفسی که بنور توکّل و انقطاع منوّر گشت شدائد آن یوم او را منع نکند و نترساند کذلک نطق لسان البیان امراً من لدی الرّحمن انّه هو المقتدر القویّ الغالب القدیر حال از برای صاحبان آذان و ابصار واجب که در این کلمات عالیات که در هر یک بحور معانی و بیان مستور تفکّر نمایند لعلّ بیان مالک ادیان عباد خود را بکمال روح و ریحان بمقصد اقصی و ذروهٔ علیا که مطلع افق این ندا است فائز فرماید

Va hamchunīn mīfarmāyad: «Qūlū li-khāʾifī al-qulūbi tashaddadū lā takhāfū huwa dhā ilāhukum.» Intahā. Īn āyih-yi mubārakih dalīl ast bar ʿaẓamat-i ẓuhūr va ʿaẓamat-i amr chih kih nafkhih-yi ṣūr ʿālam rā muḍṭarib mīnamāyad. Zilzilih va khawf kull rā iḥāṭih mīkunad. Ṭūbā az barā-yi nafsī kih bi-nūr-i tavakkul va inqiṭāʿ munavvar gasht. Shadāʾid-i ān yawm ū rā manʿ nakunad va natarsānad. Kadhālika naṭaqa Lisānu al-Bayāni amran min ladā al-Raḥmān. Innahu huwa al-Muqtadiru al-Qawiyyu al-Ghālibu al-Qadīr. Ḥāl az barā-yi ṣāḥibān-i ādhān va abṣār vājib kih dar īn kalimāt-i ʿāliyāt kih dar har yak buḥūr-i maʿānī va bayān mastūr tafakkur namāyand laʿall bayān-i Mālik-i adyān ʿibād-i khud rā bi-kamāl-i rūḥ va rayḥān bi-maqṣad-i aqṣā va dhurvih-yi ʿulyā kih maṭlaʿ-i ufuq-i īn nidā ast fāʾiz farmāyad.

Likewise, he says: “Say to the fearful of heart: ‘Be strong, do not fear. Here is your God.’” Here ends the quotation. This blessed verse testifies to the greatness of the Revelation and the greatness of the Cause, for the trumpet blast throws the world into turmoil. Trembling and fear encompass everyone. Blessed is the soul illumined by the light of trust and detachment. The hardships of that Day will neither hold him back nor frighten him. Thus has the Tongue of Utterance spoken at the command of the All-Merciful. He is indeed the All-Powerful, the Strong, the All-Conquering, the Almighty. Now it is incumbent on those with ears and eyes to reflect on these exalted words, in each of which oceans of meaning and utterance lie concealed, so that the utterance of the Lord of religions may enable His servants, with utmost joy and delight, to attain the furthest goal and the highest summit, the dawning-place on the horizon of this call.

216

یا شیخ اگر نفحات بیان را اقلّ از سمّ ابره بیابی عالم و عالمیان را بگذاری و بانوار وجه حضرت مقصود توجّه نمائی باری در کلمات حضرت روح معانی لاتحصى مستور ذکر امور کثیره فرموده ولکن نظر بعدم وجود سامعین و ناظرین اکثری را ستر نموده چنانچه میفرماید ولکن لا تستطیعون ان تحتملوا الآن آن مطلع وحی میفرماید در آن یوم اخبار بعد را حضرت موعود ذکر میفرماید چنانچه در کتاب اقدس و الواح حضرات ملوک و لوح رئیس و لوح فؤاد از قلم اعلی اکثر اموری که در ارض واقع از قبل جاری و نازل گشته

Yā Shaykh! Agar nafaḥāt-i bayān rā aqall az samm-i ibrih biyābī ʿālam va ʿālamiyān rā bigudhārī va bi-anvār-i vajh-i Ḥaḍrat-i Maqṣūd tavajjuh namāʾī. Bārī dar kalimāt-i Ḥaḍrat-i Rūḥ maʿānī-yi lā tuḥṣā mastūr. Dhikr-i umūr-i kathīrih farmūdih va-lākin naẓar bi-ʿadam-i vujūd-i sāmiʿīn va nāẓirīn aktharī rā satr namūdih. Chunānchih mīfarmāyad: «Wa-lākin lā tastaṭīʿūna an taḥtamilū al-ān.» Ān Maṭlaʿ-i Vaḥy mīfarmāyad dar ān yawm akhbār-i baʿd rā Ḥaḍrat-i Mawʿūd dhikr mīfarmāyad. Chunānchih dar Kitāb-i Aqdas va Alvāḥ-i Ḥaḍarāt-i Mulūk va Lawḥ-i Raʾīs va Lawḥ-i Fuʾād az Qalam-i Aʿlā akthar-i umūrī kih dar arḍ vāqiʿ az qabl jārī va nāzil gashtih.

O Shaykh! If you were to perceive the fragrances of utterance through an opening smaller than the eye of a needle, you would abandon the world and its peoples and turn toward the lights of the face of the Desired One. Countless meanings lie hidden in the words of the Spirit. He mentioned many things, but, because there were none to hear or see, He concealed most of them. Thus He says: “But you cannot bear them now.” That Dawning-Place of Revelation says that on that Day the Promised One will speak of things to come. Thus, in the Most Holy Book, the Tablets to the sovereigns, the Tablet of the Chief, and the Tablet of Fuʾād, most of the events occurring on earth flowed from the Most Exalted Pen and were revealed beforehand.

217

در کتاب اقدس نازل یا ارض الطّآء لا تحزنی من شیء قد جعلک اللّه مطلع فرح العالمین لو یشآء یبارک سریرک بالّذى یحکم بالعدل و یجمع اغنام اللّه الّتی تفرّقت من الذّئاب انّه یواجه اهل البهآء بالفرح و الانبساط الا انّه من جوهر الخلق لدی الحقّ علیه بهآء اللّه و بهآء من فی ملکوت الأمر فی کلّ حین این آیات از قبل نازل ولکن در این حین این آیه نازل الهی الهی یدعوک البهآء و یسألک بأنوار وجهک و امواج بحر امرک و تجلّیات شمس بیانک ان تؤیّد السّلطان علی العدل و الانصاف و لو ترید بارک به سریر الأمر و الحکم انّک انت المقتدر علی ما تشآء لا اله الّا انت السّامع المجیب افرحی یا ارض الطّآء بما جعلک اللّه افق النّور بما ولد فیک مطلع الظّهور و سمّیت بهذا الاسم الّذی به لاح نیّر الفضل و اشرقت السّموات و الأرضون سوف تنقلب فیک الأمور و یحکم علیک جمهور النّاس انّ ربّک هو العلیم المحیط اطمئنّی بفضل ربّک انّه لا تنقطع عنک لحظات الألطاف سوف یأخذک الاطمینان بعد الاضطراب کذلک قضی الأمر فی کتاب بدیع

Dar Kitāb-i Aqdas nāzil: «Yā arḍa al-Ṭāʾ lā taḥzanī min shayʾin qad jaʿalaki Allāhu maṭlaʿa faraḥi al-ʿālamīn. Law yashāʾu yubāriku sarīraki bi-alladhī yaḥkumu bi-al-ʿadli wa-yajmaʿu aghnāma Allāhi allatī tafarraqat mina al-dhiʾāb. Innahu yuwājihu ahla al-Bahāʾi bi-al-faraḥi wa-al-inbisāṭ. Alā innahu min jawhari al-khalqi ladā al-Ḥaqq. ʿAlayhi bahāʾu Allāhi wa-bahāʾu man fī malakūti al-amri fī kulli ḥīn.» Īn āyāt az qabl nāzil va-lākin dar īn ḥīn īn āyih nāzil: «Ilāhī Ilāhī yadʿūka al-Bahāʾu wa-yasʾaluka bi-anwāri wajhika wa-amwāji baḥri amrika wa-tajalliyāti shamsi bayānika an tuʾayyida al-sulṭāna ʿalā al-ʿadli wa-al-inṣāf. Wa-law turīdu bārik bihi sarīra al-amri wa-al-ḥukm. Innaka anta al-Muqtadiru ʿalā mā tashāʾu lā ilāha illā anta al-Sāmiʿu al-Mujīb. Ifraḥī yā arḍa al-Ṭāʾ bi-mā jaʿalaki Allāhu ufuqa al-nūr bi-mā wulida fīki Maṭlaʿu al-Ẓuhūr wa-summīti bi-hādhā al-ismi alladhī bihi lāḥa nayyiru al-faḍli wa-ashraqati al-samāwātu wa-al-araḍūn. Sawfa tanqalibu fīki al-umūru wa-yaḥkumu ʿalayki jumhūru al-nās. Inna rabbaki huwa al-ʿAlīmu al-Muḥīṭ. Iṭmaʾinnī bi-faḍli rabbaki innahu lā tanqaṭiʿu ʿanki laḥaẓātu al-alṭāf. Sawfa yaʾkhudhuki al-iṭmiʾnānu baʿda al-iḍṭirāb. Kadhālika quḍiya al-amru fī kitābin badīʿ.»

In the Most Holy Book it is revealed: “O Land of Ṭāʾ! Do not grieve over anything. God has made you the dawning-place of the joy of all peoples. If He wills, He will bless your throne with one who rules with justice and gathers the sheep of God that the wolves have scattered. He will meet the people of Bahāʾ with joy and gladness. Indeed, in the sight of the True One, he is among the choicest of creation. Upon him be the glory of God and the glory of all who are in the kingdom of His Cause at every moment.” These verses were revealed before, but at this time this verse is revealed: “My God, my God! Bahāʾ calls upon You and asks You, by the lights of Your face, the waves of the ocean of Your Cause, and the effulgences of the sun of Your utterance, to assist the sovereign in justice and fairness. If You wish, bless through him the throne of authority and government. You are indeed powerful over whatever You will. There is no God but You, the All-Hearing, the Responsive. Rejoice, O Land of Ṭāʾ, for God has made you the horizon of light, since the Dawning-Place of Revelation was born within you, and you were called by this name through which the luminary of grace shone and the heavens and earth were illumined. Affairs within you will be transformed, and the people at large will rule over you. Your Lord is indeed the All-Knowing, the All-Encompassing. Be assured of your Lord’s grace, for His loving regard will never be withdrawn from you. Tranquillity will overtake you after turmoil. Thus has the matter been decreed in a wondrous Book.”

218

و همچنین در لوح فؤاد و لوح پاریس و الواح اخری نازل شده آنچه که هر صاحب انصافی شهادت میدهد بر قدرت و عظمت و علم حقّ جلّ جلاله اگر بعدل ملاحظه نمایند بر سرّ این آیهٔ مبارکهٔ لا رطب و لا یابس الّا فی کتاب مبین آگاه میشوند و ادراک مینمایند ولکنّ الیوم منع النّاس اعراضهم عن ادراک ما نزّل بالحقّ من لدن منزل قدیم سبحان‌اللّه آیات باهرات از جمیع جهات احاطه نموده مع‌ذلک اکثری از عباد از مشاهده و آگاهی آن محرومند از حقّ میطلبیم توفیق عطا فرماید تا جمیع بر لآلی مستورهٔ در اصداف بحر اعظم آگاه شوند و به لک الحمد یا اله العالم ناطق گردند

Va hamchunīn dar Lawḥ-i Fuʾād va Lawḥ-i Pārīs va Alvāḥ-i ukhrā nāzil shudih ānchih kih har ṣāḥib-i inṣāfī shahādat mīdahad bar qudrat va ʿaẓamat va ʿilm-i Ḥaqq jalla jalāluhu. Agar bi-ʿadl mulāḥiẓih namāyand bar sirr-i īn āyih-yi mubārakih-yi «lā raṭbin wa-lā yābisin illā fī kitābin mubīn» āgāh mīshavand va idrāk mīnamāyand. Wa-lākinna al-yawma manaʿa al-nāsa iʿrāḍuhum ʿan idrāki mā nuzzila bi-al-ḥaqqi min ladun Munzilin Qadīm. Subḥān Allāh! Āyāt-i bāhirāt az jamīʿ-i jihāt iḥāṭih namūdih maʿa-dhālik aktharī az ʿibād az mushāhadih va āgāhī-yi ān maḥrūmand. Az Ḥaqq mīṭalabīm tawfīq ʿaṭā farmāyad tā jamīʿ bar laʾālī-yi mastūrih-yi dar aṣdāf-i Baḥr-i Aʿẓam āgāh shavand va bi-«laka al-ḥamdu yā Ilāha al-ʿālam» nāṭiq gardand.

Likewise, in the Tablet of Fuʾād, the Tablet of Paris, and other Tablets, things have been revealed that lead every fair-minded person to testify to the power, greatness, and knowledge of God, exalted be His glory. If they consider them justly, they will recognize and understand the mystery of this blessed verse: “Nothing moist or dry exists but that it is in a clear Book.” Yet today their turning away has prevented people from understanding what has been revealed in truth by the Ancient Revealer. Glory be to God! Resplendent signs surround them on every side, yet most of the servants are deprived of seeing and recognizing them. We ask God to grant His assistance, so that all may become aware of the pearls concealed within the shells of the Most Great Ocean and proclaim: “Praise be to You, O God of the world!”

219

یا معشر المنصفین در امواج بحر بیان و علم الهی نظر نمائید و تفکّر کنید تا بلسان ظاهر و باطن شهادت دهید بأنّ عنده علم کلّ شیء فی الکتاب لا یعزب عن علمه من شیء انّه اظهر ما کان مکنوناً اذ استوی علی عرش البیان فی المآب آنچه نازل شده کلمه بکلمه در ارض ظاهر گشته و میشود از برای احدی مجال اعراض و اعتراض نه ولکن چون انصاف مخذول و مستور اکثری باوهامات خود تکلّم مینمایند

Yā maʿshara al-munṣifīn! Dar amvāj-i baḥr-i bayān va ʿilm-i ilāhī naẓar namāʾīd va tafakkur kunīd tā bi-lisān-i ẓāhir va bāṭin shahādat dahīd bi-anna ʿindahu ʿilma kulli shayʾin fī al-kitāb. Lā yaʿzubu ʿan ʿilmihi min shayʾ. Innahu aẓhara mā kāna maknūnan idh istawā ʿalā ʿarshi al-bayāni fī al-maʾāb. Ānchih nāzil shudih kalimih bi-kalimih dar arḍ ẓāhir gashtih va mīshavad. Az barā-yi aḥadī majāl-i iʿrāḍ va iʿtirāḍ nah va-lākin chūn inṣāf makhdhūl va mastūr aktharī bi-avhāmāt-i khud takallum mīnamāyand.

O company of the fair-minded! Look at the waves of the ocean of divine utterance and knowledge, and reflect, so that with both your outward and inward tongues you may testify that with Him is the knowledge of all things in the Book. Nothing eludes His knowledge. He revealed what had been hidden when He ascended the throne of utterance in the place of return. Whatever has been revealed has appeared, and continues to appear, word for word on earth. No one has grounds for turning away or objecting. Yet because fairness is forsaken and concealed, most people speak according to their own imaginings.

220

الهی الهی لا تمنع عبادک عن التّوجّه الی نور الایقان الّذی اشرق من افق سمآء مشیّتک و لا تجعلهم یا الهی محرومین عن بحور آیاتک ای ربّ هم عبادک فی بلادک و ارقّائک فی دیارک ان لم ترحمهم من یرحمهم خذ یا الهی ایادی الّذین غرقوا فی بحر الأوهام و خلّصهم بقدرتک و سلطانک ثمّ انقذهم بذراعی اقتدارک انّک انت المقتدر علی ما تشآء و فی یمینک زمام من فی السّموات و الأرضین

Ilāhī Ilāhī lā tamnaʿ ʿibādaka ʿani al-tawajjuhi ilā nūri al-īqāni alladhī ashraqa min ufuqi samāʾi mashīʾatika wa-lā tajʿalhum yā Ilāhī maḥrūmīna ʿan buḥūri āyātik. Ay Rabbi hum ʿibāduka fī bilādika wa-ariqqāʾuka fī diyārik. In lam tarḥamhum man yarḥamhum? Khudh yā Ilāhī ayādiya alladhīna ghariqū fī baḥri al-awhāmi wa-khalliṣhum bi-qudratika wa-sulṭānika thumma anqidhhum bi-dhirāʿay iqtidārik. Innaka anta al-Muqtadiru ʿalā mā tashāʾu wa-fī yamīnika zimāmu man fī al-samāwāti wa-al-araḍīn.

My God, my God! Do not prevent Your servants from turning toward the light of certitude that has shone from the horizon of the heaven of Your will, and do not deprive them, O my God, of the oceans of Your verses. O Lord! They are Your servants in Your lands and Your bondsmen in Your dominions. If You do not have mercy on them, who will? Take the hands, O my God, of those who have drowned in the ocean of vain imaginings, deliver them through Your power and sovereignty, and rescue them with the arms of Your might. You are indeed powerful over whatever You will, and in Your right hand are the reins of all who are in the heavens and on earth.

221

و همچنین نقطهٔ اولی میفرماید بچشم او او را ببینید و اگر بچشم غیر ملاحظه کنید هرگز بشناسائی و آگاهی فائز نشوید انتهی و این فقره مخصوصست باین ظهور اعظم طوبی للمنصفین و همچنین میفرماید نطفهٔ یکسالهٔ ظهور او اقوی است از کلّ بیان این بشارتهای بیان و کتب قبل مکرّر در کتب عدیده باسامی مختلفه ذکر شده لعلّ النّاس ینصفون فیما اشرق و لاح من افق ارادة اللّه ربّ العرش العظیم

Va hamchunīn Nuqṭiy-i Ūlā mī-farmāyad: bi chashm-i ū ū rā bibīnīd va agar bi chashm-i ghayr mulāḥiẓih kunīd hargiz bi shināsāʾī va āgāhī fāʾiz nashavīd. Intahā. Va īn faqarih makhṣūṣ ast bi īn ẓuhūr-i aʿẓam. Ṭūbā li-l-munṣifīn. Va hamchunīn mī-farmāyad: nuṭfiy-i yik-sāliy-i ẓuhūr-i ū aqvā ast az kull-i Bayān. Īn bishārathā-yi Bayān va kutub-i qabl mukarrar dar kutub-i ʿadīdih bi asāmī-yi mukhtalifih dhikr shudih, laʿalla al-nāsa yunṣifūna fīmā ashraqa va lāḥa min ufuqi irādati Allāhi Rabbi al-ʿarshi al-ʿaẓīm.

The Primal Point likewise says: “See Him through His own eyes, for if you regard Him through the eyes of another, you will never attain recognition and knowledge.” End of quotation. This passage applies specifically to this Most Great Revelation. Blessed are the fair-minded! He also says: “The one-year-old embryo of His Revelation is mightier than the whole Bayán.” These glad tidings of the Bayán and the earlier Books have been repeatedly mentioned in numerous books under various names, so that people may judge fairly what has shone and gleamed from the horizon of the will of God, the Lord of the mighty throne.

222

یا شیخ قل لملإ البیان در این کلمهٔ مبارکه تفکّر نمائید میفرماید جمیع بیان ورقیست از اوراق جنّت او انصفوا یا قوم و لا تکونوا من الأخسرین فی کتاب اللّه ربّ العالمین امروز سدرهٔ مبارکه با اثمار جنیّهٔ جدیدهٔ بدیعه امام وجهت موجود انظر الیها منقطعاً عن دونها کذلک نطق لسان القوّة و القدرة فی هذا المقام الّذی جعله اللّه مزیّناً بقدوم اسمه الأعظم و نبإه العظیم

Yā Shaykh, qul li-malaʾi al-Bayān: dar īn kalimiy-i mubārakih tafakkur namāyīd. Mī-farmāyad: jamīʿ-i Bayān varaqī-st az avrāq-i jannat-i ū. Anṣifū yā qawmu va lā takūnū mina al-akhsarīna fī kitābi Allāhi Rabbi al-ʿālamīn. Imrūz Sidriy-i Mubārakih bā athmār-i janiyyiy-i jadīdiy-i badīʿih imām-i vajhat mawjūd. Unẓur ilayhā munqaṭiʿan ʿan dūnihā. Kadhālika naṭaqa lisānu al-quwwati va al-qudrati fī hādhā al-maqāmi alladhī jaʿalahu Allāhu muzayyanan bi-qudūmi ismihi al-Aʿẓami va nabaʾihi al-ʿaẓīm.

O Shaykh! Say to the people of the Bayán: Reflect on these blessed words. He says: “The whole Bayán is a leaf among the leaves of His Paradise.” Be fair, O people, and do not be among those accounted the greatest losers in the Book of God, the Lord of the worlds. Today the blessed Lote-Tree stands before your face, bearing fresh, wondrous fruits ready to be gathered. Look upon it, detached from all else. Thus has the tongue of strength and power spoken in this station, which God has adorned with the arrival of His Most Great Name and His mighty Announcement.

223

و همچنین میفرماید من اوّل ذلک الأمر الی قبل ان یکمل تسعة کینونات الخلق لم تظهر و انّ کلّ ما قد رأیت من النّطفة الی ما کسوناه لحماً ثمّ اصبر حتّی تشهد خلق الآخر قل فتبارک اللّه احسن الخالقین و همچنین از اقتدار ظهور ذکر فرموده و قال حلّ لمن یظهره اللّه ان یردّ من لم یکن فوق الأرض اعلی منه اذ ذلک خلق فی قبضته و کلّ له قانتون فانّ لکم بعد حین امر ستعلمون و میفرماید فاعرف بالیقین الأقطع و الأمر المثبت الأحتم بأنّه جلّ جلاله و عزّ اعزازه و قدّس اقداسه و کبّر کبریائه و مجّد شؤوناته یعرّف کلّ شیء نفسه بنفسه فمن یقدر ان یعرفه بغیره الی قوله عزّ و جلّ ایّاک ایّاک ایّام ظهوره ان تحتجب بالواحد البیانیّة فانّ ذلک الواحد خلق عنده و ایّاک ایّاک ان تحتجب بکلمات ما نزّل فی البیان الی قوله تعالی و لا تنظر الیه الّا بعینه فانّ من ینظر الیه بعینه یدرکه والّا یحتجب ان اردت اللّه و لقائه فأرده و انظر الیه و همچنین میفرماید اگر یک آیه از آیات من یظهره اللّه را تلاوت کنی اعزّتر خواهد بود از آنکه کلّ بیان را ثبت کنی زیرا که آن روز آن یک آیه ترا نجات میدهد ولی کلّ بیان نمیدهد انتهی

Va hamchunīn mī-farmāyad: min awwali dhālika al-amri ilā qabli an yakmula tisʿatan kaynūnātu al-khalqi lam taẓhar, va inna kulla mā qad raʾayta mina al-nuṭfati ilā mā kasawnāhu laḥman, thumma iṣbir ḥattā tashhada khalqa al-ākhar. Qul fa-tabāraka Allāhu aḥsanu al-khāliqīn. Va hamchunīn az iqtidār-i ẓuhūr dhikr farmūdih, va qāla: ḥalla li-man yuẓhiruhu Allāhu an yarudda man lam yakun fawqa al-arḍi aʿlā minhu, idh dhālika khalqun fī qabḍatihi va kullun lahu qānitūn. Fa-inna lakum baʿda ḥīnin amran sa-taʿlamūn. Va mī-farmāyad: fa-iʿraf bi-l-yaqīni al-aqṭaʿi va al-amri al-muthbati al-aḥtami bi-annahu jalla jalāluhu va ʿazza iʿzāzuhu va quddisa aqdāsuhu va kubbira kibriyāʾuhu va mujjida shuʾūnātuhu yuʿarrifu kulla shayʾin nafsahu bi-nafsihi, fa-man yaqdiru an yaʿrifahu bi-ghayrihi? Ilā qawlihi ʿazza va jalla: iyyāka iyyāka ayyāma ẓuhūrihi an taḥtajiba bi-l-wāḥidi al-bayāniyyati, fa-inna dhālika al-wāḥida khalqun ʿindahu, va iyyāka iyyāka an taḥtajiba bi-kalimāti mā nuzzila fī al-Bayān. Ilā qawlihi taʿālā: va lā tanẓur ilayhi illā bi-ʿaynihi, fa-inna man yanẓuru ilayhi bi-ʿaynihi yudrikuhu va illā yaḥtajib. In aradta Allāha va liqāʾahu fa-aridhu va unẓur ilayhi. Va hamchunīn mī-farmāyad: agar yik āyih az āyāt-i Man Yuẓhiruhu Allāh rā tilāvat kunī aʿazz-tar khvāhad būd az ānkih kull-i Bayān rā thabt kunī, zīrā kih ān rūz ān yik āyih turā najāt mī-dahad valī kull-i Bayān namī-dahad. Intahā.

He likewise says: “From the beginning of that Cause until before nine is completed, the realities of creation have not appeared. All that you have seen is from the stage of the embryo to that which We clothed with flesh. Then wait until you witness the other creation. Say: ‘Blessed, then, is God, the best of creators!’” He has also spoken of the power of the Revelation, saying: “It is lawful for Him Whom God will make manifest to reject one above whom there is no one on earth, for such a one is a creature in His grasp, and all are obedient to Him. After a time you will indeed have a Cause that you will come to know.” He also says: “Know, then, with the most decisive certainty and as an established and most irrevocable matter, that He—glorified be His glory, exalted be His might, sanctified be His holiness, magnified be His grandeur, and glorified be His attributes—makes Himself known to all things through Himself. Who, then, can know Him through anyone else?” And further on He, exalted and glorified be He, says: “Beware, beware lest, in the days of His appearance, you be veiled by the Váḥid of the Bayán, for that Váḥid is a creature in His presence. Beware, beware lest you be veiled by the words of what has been revealed in the Bayán.” And further on He, exalted be He, says: “Look upon Him only through His own eyes, for whoever looks upon Him through His eyes will perceive Him; otherwise he will be veiled. If you desire God and His presence, desire Him and look upon Him.” He also says: “If you recite one of the verses of Him Whom God will make manifest, it will be more precious than if you transcribe the whole Bayán, for on that day that one verse will save you, whereas the whole Bayán will not.” End of quotation.

224

قل یا معشر البیان انصفوا انصفوا ثمّ انصفوا انصفوا و لا تکونوا من الّذین ذکروا مظهر امر اللّه فی اللّیالی و الأیّام و لمّا اتی بالفضل و اشرق افق الظّهور افتوا علیه بما ناح به سکّان الملکوت و الجبروت و الّذین طافوا حول ارادة اللّه العلیم الحکیم

Qul yā maʿshara al-Bayān, anṣifū anṣifū thumma anṣifū anṣifū, va lā takūnū mina alladhīna dhakarū maẓhara amri Allāhi fī al-layālī va al-ayyāmi va lammā atā bi-l-faḍli va ashraqa ufuqu al-ẓuhūri aftaw ʿalayhi bi-mā nāḥa bihi sukkānu al-malakūti va al-jabarūti va alladhīna ṭāfū ḥawla irādati Allāhi al-ʿAlīmi al-Ḥakīm.

Say: O people of the Bayán! Be fair, be fair; again, be fair, be fair! Do not be among those who spoke of the Manifestation of the Cause of God by night and day, but when He came with grace and the horizon of Revelation shone forth, pronounced against Him a judgment that caused the inhabitants of the heavenly kingdom and the realm of power, and those who circled around the will of God, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise, to lament.

225

در این کلمهٔ علیا تفکّر نمائید میفرماید انّی مؤمن به و بدینه و بکتابه و بأدلّائه و بمناهجه و بما یظهر من عنده فی کلّ ذلک مفتخراً بنسبتی الیه و متعزّزاً بایمانی به و همچنین میفرماید ان یا کلّ شیء فی البیان فلتعرفنّ حدّ انفسکم فانّ مثل نقطة البیان یؤمن بمن یظهره اللّه قبل کلّ شیء و انّنی انا بذلک افتخرنّ علی من فی ملکوت السّموات و الأرض انتهی لعمر اللّه جمیع ذرّات کائنات بنوحه و ندبه مشغولند از ظلم معرضین بیان آیا صاحبان ابصار و آذان کجا رفتند نسأل اللّه تبارک و تعالی ان یحضرهم و ینصحهم بما ینفعهم و یمنعهم عما یضرّهم انّه هو القویّ الغالب القدیر

Dar īn kalimiy-i ʿulyā tafakkur namāyīd. Mī-farmāyad: innī muʾminun bihi va bi-dīnihi va bi-kitābihi va bi-adillāʾihi va bi-manāhijihi va bi-mā yaẓharu min ʿindihi, fī kulli dhālika muftakhiran bi-nisbatī ilayhi va mutaʿazzizan bi-īmānī bihi. Va hamchunīn mī-farmāyad: an yā kulla shayʾin fī al-Bayān, fa-la-taʿrifunna ḥadda anfusikum, fa-inna mithla Nuqṭati al-Bayāni yuʾminu bi-man yuẓhiruhu Allāhu qabla kulli shayʾin, va innanī anā bi-dhālika aftakhiranna ʿalā man fī malakūti al-samāwāti va al-arḍ. Intahā. La-ʿamru Allāh, jamīʿ-i dharrāt-i kāʾināt bi nawḥih va nudbih mashghūland az ẓulm-i muʿriḍīn-i Bayān. Āyā ṣāḥibān-i abṣār va ādhān kujā raftand? Nasʾalu Allāha tabāraka va taʿālā an yuḥḍirahum va yanṣaḥahum bi-mā yanfaʿuhum va yamnaʿuhum ʿammā yaḍurruhum. Innahu huwa al-Qawiyyu al-Ghālibu al-Qadīr.

Reflect on these exalted words. He says: “I believe in Him, in His religion, in His Book, in His guides, in His ways, and in whatever appears from Him, glorying in all this in My relationship to Him and finding honor in My faith in Him.” He likewise says: “O all things in the Bayán! You must surely know your own limits, for One such as the Point of the Bayán believes in Him Whom God will make manifest before all things, and in this I indeed glory above all who are in the kingdom of the heavens and the earth.” End of quotation. By the life of God! All the atoms of existence are lamenting and mourning because of the injustice of those among the people of the Bayán who have turned away. Where have those with eyes and ears gone? We ask God, blessed and exalted be He, to bring them forth and counsel them with what will benefit them and keep them from what will harm them. He is indeed the Strong, the All-Subduing, the All-Powerful.

226

و همچنین میفرماید لا تحتجبنّ عن اللّه بعد ظهوره فانّ کلّ ما رفع البیان کخاتم فی یدی و انّنی انا خاتم فی یدی من یظهره اللّه جلّ ذکره یقلّب کیف یشآء لما یشآء بما یشآء انّه لهو المهیمن المتعال و همچنین میفرماید فانّه لو یجعل ما علی الأرض نبیّاً لیکوننّ انبیآء عند اللّه و همچنین میفرماید و اذاً یوم ظهور من یظهره اللّه کلّ من علی الأرض عنده سوآء فمن یجعله نبیّاً کان نبیّاً من اوّل الّذی لا اوّل له الی آخر الّذی لا آخر له لأنّ ذلک ممّا قد جعله اللّه و من یجعله ولیّاً فذلک ما کان ولیّاً فی کلّ العوالم فانّ ذلک ممّا قد جعله اللّه لأنّ مشیّة اللّه لن یظهر الّا بمشیّته و ارادة اللّه لم یظهر الّا بارادته و انّه لهو القاهر المقتدر المنیع انتهی

Va hamchunīn mī-farmāyad: lā taḥtajibanna ʿani Allāhi baʿda ẓuhūrihi, fa-inna kulla mā rafaʿa al-Bayānu ka-khātamin fī yadī, va innanī anā khātamun fī yaday man yuẓhiruhu Allāhu jalla dhikruhu, yuqallibu kayfa yashāʾu li-mā yashāʾu bi-mā yashāʾu. Innahu la-huwa al-Muhayminu al-Mutaʿāl. Va hamchunīn mī-farmāyad: fa-innahu law yajʿalu mā ʿalā al-arḍi nabiyyan la-yakūnanna anbiyāʾa ʿinda Allāh. Va hamchunīn mī-farmāyad: va idhan yawma ẓuhūri man yuẓhiruhu Allāhu kullu man ʿalā al-arḍi ʿindahu sawāʾun, fa-man yajʿaluhu nabiyyan kāna nabiyyan min awwali alladhī lā awwala lahu ilā ākhiri alladhī lā ākhira lahu, li-anna dhālika mimmā qad jaʿalahu Allāhu, va man yajʿaluhu waliyyan fa-dhālika mā kāna waliyyan fī kulli al-ʿawālimi, fa-inna dhālika mimmā qad jaʿalahu Allāhu, li-anna mashīʾata Allāhi lan yaẓhara illā bi-mashīʾatihi va irādata Allāhi lam yaẓhar illā bi-irādatihi, va innahu la-huwa al-Qāhiru al-Muqtadiru al-Manīʿ. Intahā.

He likewise says: “Do not be veiled from God after His appearance, for all that the Bayán has exalted is like a ring in My hand, and I Myself am a ring in the hands of Him Whom God will make manifest, glorified be His mention. He turns it however He wills, for whatever He wills, by whatever He wills. He is indeed the All-Protecting, the Most Exalted.” He also says: “If He were to make all that is on earth a prophet, they would assuredly be prophets in the sight of God.” He likewise says: “Thus, on the day of the appearance of Him Whom God will make manifest, all who are on earth are equal before Him. Whomever He makes a prophet is a prophet from the beginning that has no beginning to the end that has no end, for this is what God has ordained. And whomever He makes a saint is a saint in all the worlds, for this is what God has ordained. For the will of God will appear only through His will, and the purpose of God has appeared only through His purpose. He is indeed the All-Subduing, the All-Powerful, the Inaccessible.” End of quotation.

227

باری در هر مقامی ذکر فرموده‌اند آنچه را که سبب اقبال و ارتفاع و ارتقا و هدایت خلق است ولکن معدودی غیر منصفین حجاب شدند و سدّی حائل گشته‌اند و عباد را از توجّه بانوار وجه منع کرده‌اند نسأل اللّه ان یطردهم بسلطانه و یأخذهم بأخذه انّه هو المقتدر العزیز الحکیم

Bārī dar har maqāmī dhikr farmūdih-and ānchih rā kih sabab-i iqbāl va irtifāʿ va irtiqā va hidāyat-i khalq ast, va-likin maʿdūdī ghayr-i munṣifīn ḥijāb shudand va saddī ḥāʾil gashtih-and va ʿibād rā az tavajjuh bi anvār-i vajh manʿ kardih-and. Nasʾalu Allāha an yaṭrudahum bi-sulṭānihi va yaʾkhudhahum bi-akhdhihi. Innahu huwa al-Muqtadiru al-ʿAzīzu al-Ḥakīm.

In short, in every instance He has set forth what will lead people to turn toward God, to rise, to advance, and to find guidance. Yet a few unfair people have become a veil and an intervening barrier, and have prevented His servants from turning toward the light of His face. We ask God to drive them away through His sovereignty and seize them in His grasp. He is indeed the All-Powerful, the Almighty, the All-Wise.

228

و همچنین میفرماید فانّ مثله جلّ ذکره کمثل الشّمس لو یقابلنه الی ما لا نهایة مرایا کلّهنّ لیستعکسن من تجلّی الشّمس فى حدّهم و ان لم یقابلها من احد فیطلع الشّمس و یغرب و الحجاب للمرایا و انّی ما قصّرت عن نصحی ذلک الخلق و تدبیری لاقبالهم الی اللّه ربّهم و ایمانهم باللّه بارئهم و ان یؤمننّ به یوم ظهوره کلّ ما على الأرض فاذاً یسرّ کینونتی حیث کلّ قد بلغوا الی ذروة وجودهم و وصلوا الی طلعة محبوبهم و ادرکوا ما یمکن فی الامکان من تجلّی مقصودهم والّا یحزن فؤادی و انّی قد ربّیت کلّ شیء لذلک فکیف یحتجب احد علی هذا قد دعوت اللّه و لأدعونّه انّه قریب مجیب

Va hamchunīn mī-farmāyad: fa-inna mathalahu jalla dhikruhu ka-mathali al-shamsi, law yuqābilannahu ilā mā lā nihāyata marāyā kulluhunna la-yastaʿkisna min tajallī al-shamsi fī ḥaddihim, va in lam yuqābilhā min aḥadin fa-yaṭluʿu al-shamsu va yaghrubu va al-ḥijābu li-l-marāyā. Va innī mā qaṣṣartu ʿan nuṣḥī dhālika al-khalqa va tadbīrī li-iqbālihim ilā Allāhi Rabbihim va īmānihim bi-Allāhi Bāriʾihim. Va in yuʾminanna bihi yawma ẓuhūrihi kullu mā ʿalā al-arḍi fa-idhan yusarru kaynūnatī ḥaythu kullun qad balaghū ilā dhurwati wujūdihim va waṣalū ilā ṭalʿati maḥbūbihim va adrakū mā yumkinu fī al-imkāni min tajallī maqṣūdihim, va illā yaḥzanu fuʾādī. Va innī qad rabbaytu kulla shayʾin li-dhālika fa-kayfa yaḥtajibu aḥadun? ʿAlā hādhā qad daʿawtu Allāha va la-adʿuwannahu. Innahu qarībun mujīb.

He likewise says: “His likeness, glorified be His mention, is that of the sun. Were an endless number of mirrors to face it, they would all reflect the sun’s radiance according to their capacity. If none should face it, the sun would still rise and set, and it is the mirrors that would be veiled. I have not fallen short in My counsel to these people or in My arrangements for them to turn toward God, their Lord, and believe in God, their Maker. If all that is on earth should believe in Him on the day of His appearance, My being would rejoice, for all would have attained the summit of their existence, reached the presence of their Beloved, and perceived as much of the revelation of their heart’s Desire as is possible in the contingent world. Otherwise My heart would grieve. I have nurtured all things for this purpose; how, then, could anyone remain veiled? For this I have prayed to God, and I will assuredly continue to pray to Him. He is near and responsive.”

229

و همچنین میفرماید بقدر اسم مؤمن هم در حقّ آن شجرهٔ لاشرقیّه و لاغربیّه راضی نمیشوند چه اگر راضی شوند حزن بر او وارد نمیآورند انتهى یا اذن عالم آیا شنیدی بچه عجز این بیانات از مشرق ارادهٔ مطلع اسماء ظاهر گشته میفرماید کل را تربیت نمودم از برای عرفان این ظهور ولکن اهل بیان بقدر اسم مؤمن هم در حقّ آن سدرهٔ مبارکهٔ لاشرقیّه راضی نمیشوند آه آه عمّا ورد علی نفسى لعمر اللّه قد ورد علیّ من الّذی ربّیته فی اللّیالی و الأیّام ما ناح به روح القدس و اهل خبآء عظمة اللّه مالک هذا الیوم البدیع

Va hamchunīn mī-farmāyad: bi qadr-i ism-i muʾmin ham dar ḥaqq-i ān shajariy-i lā-sharqiyyih va lā-gharbiyyih rāḍī namī-shavand, chih agar rāḍī shavand ḥuzn bar ū vārid namī-āvarand. Intahā. Yā udhun-i ʿālam, āyā shinīdī bi chih ʿajz īn bayānāt az mashriq-i irādiy-i Maṭlaʿ-i Asmā ẓāhir gashtih? Mī-farmāyad: kull rā tarbiyat namūdam az barā-yi ʿirfān-i īn ẓuhūr, va-likin ahl-i Bayān bi qadr-i ism-i muʾmin ham dar ḥaqq-i ān Sidriy-i Mubārakiy-i lā-sharqiyyih rāḍī namī-shavand. Āh āh ʿammā warada ʿalā nafsī! La-ʿamru Allāhi qad warada ʿalayya mina alladhī rabbaytuhu fī al-layālī va al-ayyāmi mā nāḥa bihi Rūḥu al-Qudusi va ahlu khibāʾi ʿaẓamati Allāhi Māliki hādhā al-yawmi al-badīʿ.

He likewise says: “They are not willing to accord that Tree, neither of the East nor of the West, even the name of believer, for if they were willing, they would not bring sorrow upon Him.” End of quotation. O ear of the world! Have you heard with what helplessness these words have issued from the dawning place of the will of the Dayspring of Names? He says: “I nurtured all for the recognition of this Revelation, yet the people of the Bayán are not willing to accord that blessed Lote-Tree, which is not of the East, even the name of believer.” Alas, alas for what has befallen Me! By the life of God! From the one whom I nurtured by night and day, there has befallen Me what has caused the Holy Spirit and the inhabitants of the pavilion of the grandeur of God, the Master of this wondrous day, to lament.

230

و همچنین ردّاً لبعضی از معرضین میفرماید چه کسی عالم بظهور نیست غیر اللّه هر وقت شود باید کل تصدیق بنقطهٔ حقیقت نمایند و شکر الهی بجای آورند انتهى معرضین بمثابهٔ امّت یحیی تکلّم نمودند چه که آن نفوس هم بر حضرت روح اعتراض کردند که شریعت یحیی تمام نشد تو از برای چه آمدی حال هم معرضین مع آنکه ابداً با ما نبودند و اطّلاع از اصل امر نداشته و ندارند که از که بوده و چه بوده گفته‌اند آنچه را که اشیاء کلّها بنوحه و ندبه مشغول لعمری انّ الأخرس لا یقدر ان یقوم امام ملکوت البیان اتّقوا اللّه یا قوم ثمّ اقرؤوا ما نزّل بالحقّ فی الباب الثّامن من الواحد السّادس من البیان و لا تکونوا من المعرضین و همچنین امر فرموده که در هر نوزده روز یک دفعه در این باب نظر کنند لعلّ در ظهور من یظهره اللّه محتجب نشوند بشئونی دون شأن آیات که اعظم حجج و براهین بوده و هست انتهی

Va hamchunīn raddan li-baʿḍī az muʿriḍīn mī-farmāyad: chih kasī ʿālim bi ẓuhūr nīst ghayr Allāh; har vaqt shavad bāyad kull taṣdīq bi Nuqṭiy-i Ḥaqīqat namāyand va shukr-i ilāhī bi jāy āvarand. Intahā. Muʿriḍīn bi mathābiy-i ummat-i Yaḥyā takallum namūdand, chih kih ān nufūs ham bar Ḥaḍrat-i Rūḥ iʿtirāḍ kardand kih sharīʿat-i Yaḥyā tamām nashud, tu az barā-yi chih āmadī? Ḥāl ham muʿriḍīn maʿa ānkih abadan bā mā nabūdand va iṭṭilāʿ az aṣl-i amr nadāshtih va nadārand kih az kih būdih va chih būdih, guftih-and ānchih rā kih ashyā kulluhā bi nawḥih va nudbih mashghūl. La-ʿamrī inna al-akhrasa lā yaqdiru an yaqūma imāma malakūti al-bayān. Ittaqū Allāha yā qawmu thumma iqraʾū mā nuzzila bi-l-ḥaqqi fī al-bābi al-thāmini mina al-wāḥidi al-sādisi mina al-Bayāni va lā takūnū mina al-muʿriḍīn. Va hamchunīn amr farmūdih kih dar har nūzdah rūz yik dafʿih dar īn bāb naẓar kunand, laʿall dar ẓuhūr-i Man Yuẓhiruhu Allāh muḥtajib nashavand bi shuʾūnī dūn-i shaʾn-i āyāt kih aʿẓam-i ḥujaj va barāhīn būdih va hast. Intahā.

He likewise says, in refutation of certain opponents: “For no one knows of the Revelation except God. Whenever it occurs, all must acknowledge the Point of Truth and offer thanks to God.” End of quotation. Those who have turned away have spoken like the followers of John, for they too objected to Him Who is the Spirit, saying: “The dispensation of John has not ended; why have you come?” Now, too, those who have turned away, although they were never with Us and neither had nor have any knowledge of the origin of the Cause—of whom it came from or what it was—have said things that have set all things lamenting and mourning. By My life! The mute cannot stand before the kingdom of utterance. Fear God, O people, then read what has been revealed in truth in the eighth chapter of the sixth Váḥid of the Bayán, and do not be among those who turn away. He has likewise commanded them to look at this chapter once every nineteen days, so that, at the appearance of Him Whom God will make manifest, they may not be veiled by anything other than the revelation of verses, which has been and remains the greatest of proofs and testimonies. End of quotation.

231

حضرت یحیی بن زکریّا فرموده آنچه را که مبشّر فرموده قائلاً توبوا لأنّه قد اقترب ملکوت السّموات انّی اعمّدکم بمآء للتّوبة ولکنّ الّذی یأتی بعدی هو اقوی منّی الّذی لست اهلاً ان احمل حذائه اینست که مبشّر میفرماید در مقام خضوع و خشوع که جمیع بیان ورقی است از اوراق جنّت او و همچنین میفرماید من اوّل عابدینم و افتخار میکنم بنسبتی الیه یا قوم مع‌ذلک اهل بیان عمل نمودند آنچه را که ذی‌الجوشن و ابن انس و اصبحی از آن پناه بخدا برده و میبرند این مظلوم در شب و روز بارتفاع امر الهی امام وجوه ادیان مشغول و آن نفوس باسبابی که سبب ذلّت و علّت اذیّت بوده متمسّک

Ḥaḍrat-i Yaḥyā ibn-i Zakariyyā farmūdih ānchih rā kih Mubashshir farmūdih, qāʾilan: tūbū li-annahu qad iqtaraba malakūtu al-samāwāt. Innī uʿammidukum bi-māʾin li-l-tawbati va lākinna alladhī yaʾtī baʿdī huwa aqwā minnī, alladhī lastu ahlan an aḥmila ḥidhāʾahu. Īn ast kih Mubashshir mī-farmāyad dar maqām-i khuḍūʿ va khushūʿ kih jamīʿ-i Bayān varaqī ast az avrāq-i jannat-i ū.
