Va hamchunīn mī-farmāyad: man avval-i ʿābidīnam va iftikhār mī-kunam bi-nisbatī ilayhi. Yā qawm, maʿa-dhālik ahl-i Bayān ʿamal namūdand ānchih rā kih Dhī al-Jawshan va Ibn-i Anas va Aṣbaḥī az ān panāh bi Khudā burdih va mī-barand. Īn Maẓlūm dar shab va rūz bi irtifāʿ-i Amr-i Ilāhī imām-i vujūh-i adyān mashghūl va ān nufūs bi asbābī kih sabab-i dhillat va ʿillat-i adhiyyat būdih mutamassik.

John, son of Zechariah, said what the Herald has said, declaring: “Repent, for the kingdom of heaven has drawn near. I baptize you with water for repentance, but He who comes after me is mightier than I, whose sandals I am not worthy to carry.” Thus the Herald says, in humility and reverence: “The whole Bayán is a leaf among the leaves of His Paradise.” He likewise says: “I am the first of His worshippers, and I glory in My relationship to Him.” O people! Despite this, the people of the Bayán have committed deeds from which Dhí’l-Jawshan, Ibn Anas, and Aṣbaḥí have sought and still seek refuge in God. This Wronged One is occupied night and day with exalting the Cause of God before the eyes of the followers of all religions, while those people cling to means that have brought abasement and caused suffering.

232

و همچنین میفرماید او را شناخته بآیات او و احتیاط در عرفان او نکرده که بقدر همان در نار محتجب خواهید بود انتهی ای معرضین بیان در این کلمهٔ علیا که از مطلع بیان نقطهٔ عرفان جاری شده تفکّر نمائید و در این حین آن کلمه را بشنوید میفرماید در آن روز آن آفتاب حقیقت اهل بیان را خطاب مینماید و این سورهٔ فرقان را تلاوت میفرماید قل یا ایّها الکافرون لا اعبد ما تعبدون و لا انتم عابدون ما اعبد و لا انا عابد ما عبدتم و لا انتم عابدون ما اعبد لکم دینکم و لی دین سبحان‌اللّه مع این بیانات واضحه و آثار لامعهٔ مشرقه کل باوهام خود مشغولند و از حضرت مقصود غافل و محجوب یا معرضین از نوم غفلت بیدار شوید و این کلمهٔ مبشّر را بشنوید میفرماید شجرهٔ اثبات باعراضش از او از نفی محسوب و شجرهٔ نفی باقبالش باو از اثبات محسوب و همچنین میفرماید اگر نفسی ادّعا نماید و اتیان بحجّت ننماید تعرّض منمائید و حزن وارد میاورید انتهی باری این مظلوم در لیالی و ایّام به قل یا ایّها الکافرون ناطق که شاید سبب تنبّه شود و خلق را بطراز انصاف مزیّن دارد

Va hamchunīn mīfarmāyad: Ū rā shinākhte bi-āyāt-i ū va iḥtiyāṭ dar ʿirfān-i ū nakarde ki bi-qadr-i hamān dar nār muḥtajib khvāhīd būd. Intahā. Ay muʿriḍīn-i Bayān, dar īn kalimiy-i ʿulyā ki az maṭlaʿ-i Bayān, Nuqṭiy-i ʿirfān, jārī shude tafakkur namāyīd va dar īn ḥīn ān kalima rā bishnavīd. Mīfarmāyad: Dar ān rūz ān Āftāb-i Ḥaqīqat ahl-i Bayān rā khiṭāb mīnamāyad va īn sūriy-i Furqān rā tilāvat mīfarmāyad: Qul yā ayyuhā al-kāfirūn, lā aʿbudu mā taʿbudūn, wa-lā antum ʿābidūna mā aʿbud, wa-lā anā ʿābidun mā ʿabadtum, wa-lā antum ʿābidūna mā aʿbud, lakum dīnukum wa-liya dīn. Subḥān Allāh! Maʿ-i īn bayānāt-i vāḍiḥa va āthār-i lāmiʿiy-i mushriqa kull bi-avhām-i khvud mashghūland va az Ḥaḍrat-i Maqṣūd ghāfil va maḥjūb. Yā muʿriḍīn, az nawm-i ghaflat bīdār shavīd va īn kalimiy-i Mubashshir rā bishnavīd. Mīfarmāyad: Shajariy-i ithbāt bi-iʿrāḍash az ū az nafy maḥsūb va shajariy-i nafy bi-iqbālash bi-ū az ithbāt maḥsūb. Va hamchunīn mīfarmāyad: Agar nafsī iddiʿā namāyad va ityān bi-ḥujjat nanamāyad taʿarruḍ manamāyīd va ḥuzn vārid mayāvarīd. Intahā. Bārī īn Maẓlūm dar layālī va ayyām bi-Qul yā ayyuhā al-kāfirūn nāṭiq ki shāyad sabab-i tanabbuh shavad va khalq rā bi-ṭirāz-i inṣāf muzayyan dārad.

He likewise says: “Recognize Him by His verses, and do not hesitate in recognizing Him, for to that extent you will remain veiled in the fire.” End of quotation. O you who turn away from the Bayán! Reflect on this exalted utterance that has flowed from the Dayspring of the Bayán, the Point of recognition, and now listen to that utterance. He says: “On that day, that Sun of Truth will address the people of the Bayán and recite this surah of the Qur’an: ‘Say: O unbelievers! I do not worship what you worship, nor do you worship what I worship. Nor am I a worshipper of what you have worshipped, nor are you worshippers of what I worship. To you your religion, and to Me Mine.’” Glorified be God! Despite these clear utterances and these radiant, resplendent writings, all are occupied with their own imaginings, heedless of and veiled from the Desired One. O you who turn away! Awaken from the sleep of heedlessness and listen to this utterance of the Herald. He says: “The tree of affirmation, by turning away from Him, is counted as negation, and the tree of negation, by turning toward Him, is counted as affirmation.” He likewise says: “If anyone advances a claim and produces no proof, do not assail him or cause him sorrow.” End of quotation. In short, this Wronged One utters, night and day, “Say: O unbelievers!” so that it may awaken them and adorn humanity with the ornament of fairness.

233

حال در این کلمات که عرف یأس از آن متضوّع تفکّر نمائید فی مناجاته مع الأحزان الی اللّه ربّ العالمین قوله سبحانک اللّهمّ فاشهد بأنّی بذلک الکتاب قد اخذت عهد ولایة من تظهرنّه عن کلّ شیء قبل عهد ولایتی و کفی بک و بمن آمن بآیاتک علیّ شهدآء و انّک انت حسبی علیک توکّلت و انّک کنت علی کلّ شیء حسیبا

Ḥāl dar īn kalimāt ki ʿarf-i yaʾs az ān mutaḍavviʿ tafakkur namāyīd. Fī munājātihi maʿa al-aḥzān ilā Allāh Rabbi al-ʿālamīn, qawluhu: Subḥānaka Allāhumma fa-shhad bi-annī bi-dhālika al-kitāb qad akhadhtu ʿahda wilāyati man tuẓhirannahu ʿan kulli shayʾ qabla ʿahdi wilāyatī, wa-kafā bika wa-bi-man āmana bi-āyātika ʿalayya shuhadāʾ, wa-innaka anta ḥasbī, ʿalayka tawakkaltu, wa-innaka kunta ʿalā kulli shayʾin ḥasībā.

Now reflect on these words, from which the fragrance of despair wafts. In His sorrowful communion with God, the Lord of the worlds, He says: “Glory be to You, O God! Bear witness that through that Book I have taken from all things a covenant of allegiance to Him Whom You will make manifest before the covenant of allegiance to Me. You and those who have believed in Your verses suffice as witnesses concerning Me. You are indeed sufficient for Me. In You I have placed My trust, and You have ever taken account of all things.”

234

و در مقام دیگر میفرماید ان یا شموس المرایا انتم الی شمس الحقیقة تنظرون فانّ قیامکم بها لو انتم تتبصّرون کلّکم کحیتان بالمآء فی البحر تتحرّکون و تحتجبون عن المآء و تسألون عمّا انتم به قائمون و همچنین میفرماید لأشکونّ الیک ان یا مرآة جودی عن کلّ المرایا کلّ بألوانهم الیّ لینظرون انتهی این خطاب از مصدر امر حضرت وهّاب بجناب آقا سیّد جواد مشهور به کربلائی نازل حقّ شاهد و عالم گواه که آن سیّد با این مظلوم بوده و در ردّ معرضین هم شرحی مبسوط نوشته و دو لوح هم که در آن از ظهور حقّ گواهی داده و از دونش اشارات اعراض ظاهر و هویدا نزد جناب حیدر قبل علی فرستادیم و خطّ او نزد کل معلوم و واضح است و مقصود از این عمل آنکه شاید منکرین بفرات اقرار فائز شوند و معرضین بنور اقبال منوّر گردند حقّ شاهد که این مظلوم مقصودی جز القای کلمهٔ الهی نداشته طوبی للمنصفین و ویل للمعرضین معرضین تدبیرها نموده‌اند و بحیلها تمسّک جسته‌اند از جمله صورت این سیّد را گرفته‌اند و همچنین صور بعضی را بعد هر کدام را در ورقی چسبانده‌اند و فوق اینها صورت میرزا یحیی را باری بهر اسبابی از برای انکار حقّ تمسّک جسته‌اند قل حقّ عیان چون مهر رخشان آمده حیف کاندر شهر کوران آمده و سیّد مذکور منکرین را نصیحت نموده و بافق اعلی دعوت کرده ولکن در احجار ملساء تأثیری ننمود و در باره‌اش گفته‌اند آنچه را که او از آن بحقّ جلّ جلاله پناه برده و حال عرائضی که بساحت اقدس ارسال داشته موجود است طوبی للمنصفین

Va dar maqām-i dīgar mīfarmāyad: An yā shumūsa al-marāyā, antum ilā Shamsi al-Ḥaqīqa tanẓurūn, fa-inna qiyāmakum bihā law antum tatabaṣṣarūn. Kullukum ka-ḥītānin bi-l-māʾi fī al-baḥri tataḥarrakūn, wa-taḥtajibūna ʿani al-māʾi wa-tasʾalūna ʿammā antum bihi qāʾimūn. Va hamchunīn mīfarmāyad: La-ashkuwanna ilayka an yā mirʾāta jūdī ʿan kulli al-marāyā, kullun bi-alwānihim ilayya la-yanẓurūn. Intahā. Īn khiṭāb az maṣdar-i amr-i Ḥaḍrat-i Vahhāb bi-janāb-i Āqā Siyyid Javād mashhūr bi-Karbalāʾī nāzil. Ḥaqq shāhid va ʿālam gavāh ki ān Siyyid bā īn Maẓlūm būde va dar radd-i muʿriḍīn ham sharḥī mabsūṭ nivishte va du lawḥ ham ki dar ān az ẓuhūr-i Ḥaqq gavāhī dāde va az dūnash ishārāt-i iʿrāḍ ẓāhir va huvaydā nazd-i janāb-i Ḥaydar qabl-i ʿAlī firistādīm va khaṭṭ-i ū nazd-i kull maʿlūm va vāḍiḥ ast va maqṣūd az īn ʿamal ānki shāyad munkirīn bi-Furāt-i iqrār fāʾiz shavand va muʿriḍīn bi-nūr-i iqbāl munavvar gardand. Ḥaqq shāhid ki īn Maẓlūm maqṣūdī juz ilqāy-i kalimiy-i ilāhī nadāshte. Ṭūbā li-l-munṣifīn wa-waylun li-l-muʿriḍīn. Muʿriḍīn tadbīrhā namūde-and va bi-ḥīlhā tamassuk juste-and. Az jumla ṣūrat-i īn Siyyid rā girifte-and va hamchunīn ṣuvar-i baʿḍī rā, baʿd har kudām rā dar varaqī chasbānde-and va fawq-i īnhā ṣūrat-i Mīrzā Yaḥyā rā. Bārī bi-har asbābī az barāy-i inkār-i Ḥaqq tamassuk juste-and. Qul: Ḥaqq ʿayān chūn mihr-i rakhshān āmade, ḥayf k-andar shahr-i kūrān āmade. Va Siyyid-i madhkūr munkirīn rā naṣīḥat namūde va bi-Ufuq-i Aʿlā daʿvat karde va-lākin dar aḥjār-i malsāʾ taʾthīrī nanamūd va dar bāra-ash gufte-and ānchi rā ki ū az ān bi-Ḥaqq jalla jalāluhu panāh burde va ḥāl ʿarāʾiḍī ki bi-Sāḥat-i Aqdas irsāl dāshte mawjūd ast. Ṭūbā li-l-munṣifīn.

Elsewhere He says: “O suns of the mirrors! You look toward the Sun of Truth, for your existence depends upon it, if only you could perceive. You are all like fish moving through the sea by virtue of the water, yet you are veiled from the water and ask about that by which you subsist.” He likewise says: “I will surely complain to you, O mirror of My bounty, about all the mirrors: each looks toward Me through its own colors.” End of quotation. This address was revealed from the Source of the command of the All-Bountiful to Áqá Siyyid Javád, known as Karbalá’í. God is witness, and the world bears testimony, that this Siyyid was with this Wronged One and wrote a detailed account refuting those who turned away. We also sent to Ḥaydar-ʿAlí two letters in which he testified to the revelation of God, and in which the indications of his rejection of all others are clear and evident. His handwriting is known and recognizable to all. The purpose of this action was that those who deny might perhaps attain the Euphrates of acknowledgment, and those who turn away might be illumined by the light of acceptance. God is witness that this Wronged One has had no purpose but to impart the word of God. Blessed are the fair-minded, and woe to those who turn away! Those who turn away have devised schemes and resorted to stratagems. Among other things, they have obtained a portrait of this Siyyid, as well as portraits of certain others, then pasted each onto a sheet and placed a portrait of Mírzá Yaḥyá above them. In short, they have resorted to every means of denying God. Say: “The Truth has appeared, manifest as the radiant sun; alas, it has come into a city of the blind.” The aforementioned Siyyid admonished those who denied and invited them to the Most Exalted Horizon, but this had no effect on those smooth stones. They have said things about him from which he has sought refuge in God, exalted be His glory. The petitions he sent to the Most Holy Court are now extant. Blessed are the fair-minded!

235

حال در شکایت نقطهٔ اولی از مرایا تفکّر نمائید شاید سبب انتباه گردد و عباد از شمال اوهام و ظنون بیمین ایمان و ایقان توجّه نمایند و آگاه گردند بآنچه که از او محجوبند مع آنکه از عالم نیستی بهستی مخصوص عرفان این امر اعظم آمده‌اند و همچنین میفرماید و اجعل اللّهمّ تلک الشّجرة کلّها له لیظهرن منها ثمرات ما قد خلق اللّه فیها لمن قد اراد اللّه ان یظهر به ما اراد فانّنی انا وعزّتک ما اردت ان یکون على تلک الشّجرة من غصن و لا ورق و لا ثمر لن یسجد له یوم ظهوره و لا یسبّحک به بما ینبغی لعلوّ علوّ ظهوره و سموّ سموّ بطونه و ان شهدت یا الهی علیّ من غصن او ورق او ثمر لم یسجد له یوم ظهوره فاقطعه اللّهمّ عن تلک الشّجرة فانّه لم یکن منّی و لا یرجع الیّ انتهی

Ḥāl dar shikāyat-i Nuqṭiy-i Ūlā az marāyā tafakkur namāyīd shāyad sabab-i intibāh gardad va ʿibād az shimāl-i avhām va ẓunūn bi-yamīn-i īmān va īqān tavajjuh namāyand va āgāh gardand bi-ānchi ki az ū maḥjūband, maʿ-i ānki az ʿālam-i nīstī bi-hastī makhṣūṣ-i ʿirfān-i īn Amr-i Aʿẓam āmade-and. Va hamchunīn mīfarmāyad: Wa-jʿal Allāhumma tilka al-shajarata kullahā lahu li-yaẓharanna minhā thamarātu mā qad khalaqa Allāhu fīhā li-man qad arāda Allāhu an yuẓhira bihi mā arād. Fa-innanī anā wa-ʿizzatika mā aradtu an yakūna ʿalā tilka al-shajarati min ghuṣnin wa-lā waraqin wa-lā thamarin lan yasjuda lahu yawma ẓuhūrihi wa-lā yusabbiḥaka bihi bi-mā yanbaghī li-ʿuluwwi ʿuluwwi ẓuhūrihi wa-sumūwwi sumūwwi buṭūnihi. Wa-in shahidta yā ilāhī ʿalayya min ghuṣnin aw waraqin aw thamarin lam yasjud lahu yawma ẓuhūrihi fa-qṭaʿhu Allāhumma ʿan tilka al-shajarati fa-innahu lam yakun minnī wa-lā yarjiʿu ilayya. Intahā.

Now reflect on the Primal Point’s complaint against the mirrors, that it may perhaps awaken the servants and turn them from the left hand of imaginings and suppositions toward the right hand of faith and certitude, and make them aware of that from which they are veiled, although they have come from the realm of nonexistence into existence expressly to recognize this Most Great Cause. He likewise says: “O God, make that tree wholly His, so that from it may appear the fruits of what God has created within it for Him through Whom God has willed to manifest whatever He has willed. By Your might! I have not wished that upon that tree there should be any branch, leaf, or fruit that will not bow before Him on the day of His appearance and glorify You through Him as befits the loftiest heights of His manifestation and the sublimest heights of His concealment. And if, O my God, You witness upon Me any branch, leaf, or fruit that does not bow before Him on the day of His appearance, cut it off from that tree, O God, for it is not of Me and does not return to Me.” End of quotation.

236

یا اهل بیان لعمر اللّه این مظلوم خیالی نداشته الّا اظهار امری که بآن مأمور بوده اگر بسمع فطرت توجّه نمائید از جمیع ارکان و اعضا و عروق حتّی از موهای مظلوم اصغا مینمائید آنچه را که سبب توجّه و انجذاب ملأ اعلى و ناسوت انشاء است

Yā ahl-i Bayān, la-ʿamru Allāh, īn Maẓlūm khiyālī nadāshte illā iẓhār-i amrī ki bi-ān maʾmūr būde. Agar bi-samʿ-i fiṭrat tavajjuh namāyīd az jamīʿ-i arkān va aʿḍā va ʿurūq ḥattā az mūhāy-i Maẓlūm iṣghā mīnamāyīd ānchi rā ki sabab-i tavajjuh va injidhāb-i Malaʾ-i Aʿlā va nāsūt-i inshā ast.

O people of the Bayán! By the life of God, this Wronged One has had no thought but to make known the Cause with which He was entrusted. If you listen with the ear of your innate nature, you will hear from every part, limb, and vein, even from the hairs of this Wronged One, that which draws the attention and attracts the hearts of the Concourse on high and the human world of creation.

237

یا هادی حمیّهٔ جاهلیّهٔ قبل عباد بیچاره را از صراط مستقیم منع نمود در حزب شیعه تفکّر نما هزار و دویست سنه یا قائم گفتند و بالأخره جمیع بر شهادتش فتوی دادند و شهیدش نمودند مع آنکه بحقّ جلّ جلاله و حضرت خاتم و اوصیا قائل و مقرّ و معترف بودند حال قدری فکر لازم که شاید معلوم شود سببی که مابین حقّ و خلق حائل شد چه بوده و علّت اعتراض و انکار چه عملی شده

Yā Hādī, ḥamiyyiy-i jāhiliyyiy-i qabl ʿibād-i bīchāra rā az ṣirāṭ-i mustaqīm manʿ namūd. Dar ḥizb-i Shīʿa tafakkur namā. Hizār va duvīst sana Yā Qāʾim guftand va bi-l-ākhara jamīʿ bar shahādatash fatvā dādand va shahīdash namūdand, maʿ-i ānki bi-Ḥaqq jalla jalāluhu va Ḥaḍrat-i Khātam va awṣiyā qāʾil va muqirr va muʿtarif būdand. Ḥāl qadrī fikr lāzim ki shāyad maʿlūm shavad sababī ki mābayn-i Ḥaqq va khalq ḥāʾil shud chi būde va ʿillat-i iʿtirāḍ va inkār chi ʿamalī shude.

O Hádí! The fanatical zeal of the former age of ignorance barred the helpless servants from the straight path. Reflect on the Shíʿih community. For twelve hundred years they cried, “O Qá’im!” and in the end they all issued a verdict for His death and put Him to death, although they professed belief in, acknowledged, and confessed God, exalted be His glory, the Seal of the Prophets, and His successors. Now some reflection is needed, so that it may perhaps become clear what cause came between God and His creatures, and what action occasioned their objection and denial.

238

یا هادی نالهٔ منابر را اصغا نمودیم که علمای عصر ظهور بقول جمیع بر آن ارتقا جستند و حقّ را سب نموده و بر آن جوهر وجود و اصحابش وارد آوردند آنچه که چشم عالم ندید و گوش عالم نشنید حال تو باسم وصایت و مرآتیّت مردم را دعوت نموده و مینمائی مع آنکه اطّلاع از امر نداشته و نداری چه که با ما نبودی

Yā Hādī, nāliy-i manābir rā iṣghā namūdīm ki ʿulamāy-i ʿaṣr-i ẓuhūr bi-qawl-i jamīʿ bar ān irtiqā justand va Ḥaqq rā sabb namūde va bar ān Jawhar-i Vujūd va aṣḥābash vārid āvardand ānchi ki chashm-i ʿālam nadīd va gūsh-i ʿālam nashnīd. Ḥāl tu bi-ism-i viṣāyat va mirʾātiyyat mardum rā daʿvat namūde va mīnamāʾī maʿ-i ānki iṭṭilāʿ az amr nadāshte va nadārī chi ki bā mā nabūdī.

O Hádí! We heard the lamentation of the pulpits upon which, as all attest, the religious scholars at the time of the Revelation ascended, reviling God and inflicting upon that Essence of Being and His companions what the eye of the world had never seen and the ear of the world had never heard. Now you have summoned, and continue to summon, people in the name of successorship and mirrorhood, although you had and have no knowledge of the matter, for you were not with Us.

239

جمیع این حزب میدانند که سیّد محمّد یکی از خدّام بوده در ایّامی که حسب الخواهش دولت علیّهٔ عثمانی بآن شطر توجّه نمودیم همراه بوده و بعد از او ظاهر شد آنچه که لعمر اللّه قلم اعلی گریست و لوح نوحه نمود لذا طردش نمودیم و به میرزا یحیی پیوست و عمل نمود آنچه را که هیچ ظالمی ننمود ترکناه و قلنا اخرج یا غافل بعد از ظهور این کلمه به مولوی‌خانه رفته با آنها بوده الی ان جآء امر الخروج

Jamīʿ-i īn ḥizb mīdānand ki Siyyid Muḥammad yakī az khuddām būde, dar ayyāmī ki ḥasb al-khvāhish-i Dawlat-i ʿAliyyiy-i ʿUthmānī bi-ān shaṭr tavajjuh namūdīm hamrāh būde va baʿd az ū ẓāhir shud ānchi ki la-ʿamru Allāh Qalam-i Aʿlā girīst va Lawḥ nawḥa namūd. Lidhā ṭardash namūdīm va bi-Mīrzā Yaḥyā payvast va ʿamal namūd ānchi rā ki hīch ẓālimī nanamūd. Taraknāhu wa-qulnā ukhruj yā ghāfil. Baʿd az ẓuhūr-i īn kalima bi-Mawlavī-khāna rafte bā ānhā būde ilā an jāʾa amru al-khurūj.

Everyone in this community knows that Siyyid Muḥammad was one of the attendants. He accompanied Us when, at the request of the exalted Ottoman government, We set out for that region. Afterward, he displayed conduct that, by the life of God, made the Most Exalted Pen weep and the Tablet lament. We therefore expelled him, and he joined Mírzá Yaḥyá and did what no oppressor had done. We left him and said, “Depart, O heedless one!” After these words were uttered, he went to the Mawlaví lodge and remained with them until the order to depart arrived.

240

یا هادی سبب اوهام جدیده مشو مرّةً اخری بترتیب حزبی مثل حزب شیعه راضی مباش تفکّر نما چه مقدار خون ریخته شد از جمله خود تو که مدّعی علم بودی و همچنین علمای شیعه طرّاً در سنهٔ اولی و اخری حقّ را لعن نمودید و فتوی بر سفک دم اطهرش دادید اتّق اللّه یا هادی راضی مشو عباد مجدّد باوهام قبل مبتلا شوند اتّق اللّه و لا تکن من الظّالمین این ایّام اصغا شد در جمع بیان و محو آن همّت نموده‌ئی این مظلوم از تو میطلبد این اراده را لوجه اللّه ترک نمائی ادراک و عقل تو از سیّد عالم برتر و بالاتر نبوده و نیست حقّ شاهد و گواهست که این مظلوم بیان را تلاوت ننموده و مطالبش را ندیده اینقدر معلوم و واضح و مبرهنست که کتاب بیان را اسّ کتب خود قرار فرموده از خدا بترس در اموری که شأن تو نیست داخل مشو هزار و دویست سنه شیعهٔ بیچاره را امثال تو ببئر اوهام و ظنون مبتلا نمودند بالأخره در یوم جزا ظاهر شد آنچه که ظالمهای قبل بحقّ پناه بردند

Yā Hādī, sabab-i avhām-i jadīda mashav. Marratan ukhrā bi-tartīb-i ḥizbī mithl-i ḥizb-i Shīʿa rāḍī mabāsh. Tafakkur namā chi miqdār khūn rīkhte shud. Az jumla khvud-i tu ki muddaʿiy-i ʿilm būdī va hamchunīn ʿulamāy-i Shīʿa ṭurran dar saniy-i ūlā va ukhrā Ḥaqq rā laʿn namūdīd va fatvā bar safk-i dam-i aṭharash dādīd. Ittaqi Allāh yā Hādī. Rāḍī mashav ʿibād mujaddad bi-avhām-i qabl mubtalā shavand. Ittaqi Allāh wa-lā takun mina al-ẓālimīn. Īn ayyām iṣghā shud dar jamʿ-i Bayān va maḥv-i ān himmat namūde-ī. Īn Maẓlūm az tu mīṭalabad īn irāda rā li-vajh Allāh tark namāʾī. Idrāk va ʿaql-i tu az Siyyid-i ʿālam bartar va bālātar nabūde va nīst. Ḥaqq shāhid va gavāh ast ki īn Maẓlūm Bayān rā tilāvat nanamūde va maṭālibash rā nadīde. Īnqadr maʿlūm va vāḍiḥ va mubarhan ast ki Kitāb-i Bayān rā uss-i kutub-i khvud qarār farmūde. Az Khudā bitars. Dar umūrī ki shaʾn-i tu nīst dākhil mashav. Hizār va duvīst sana Shīʿiy-i bīchāra rā amthāl-i tu bi-biʾr-i avhām va ẓunūn mubtalā namūdand. Bi-l-ākhara dar Yawm-i Jazā ẓāhir shud ānchi ki ẓālimhāy-i qabl bi-Ḥaqq panāh burdand.

O Hádí! Do not become the cause of new imaginings. Do not consent to the formation, once again, of a community like the Shíʿih community. Reflect on how much blood was shed. You yourself, who claimed knowledge, and likewise all the Shíʿih scholars, cursed God in the first year and the last and issued a verdict for the shedding of His most pure blood. Fear God, O Hádí! Do not consent to the servants being afflicted once again with the imaginings of the past. Fear God, and do not be among the oppressors. In these days We have heard that you have set yourself to collecting the Bayán and obliterating it. This Wronged One asks you to abandon this intention for the sake of God. Your understanding and intellect have never been, and are not, superior to those of the Lord of the world. God bears witness and testimony that this Wronged One has not read the Bayán or examined its contents. This much is known, clear, and proven: He made the Book of the Bayán the foundation of His books. Fear God. Do not involve yourself in matters that are not your concern. For twelve hundred years, people like you consigned the helpless Shíʿih community to the pit of imaginings and suppositions. In the end, on the Day of Recompense, there appeared that from which the oppressors of the past sought refuge in God.

241

حال صریخ حضرت نقطه را از بیانش ادراک نما عرض میکند الهی اگر از این سدره که آن وجود مبارک باشد ثمری یا ورقی یا غصنی ظاهر شود که بتو ایمان نیاورد او را این حین قطع نما و همچنین میفرماید اگر نفسی کلمه‌ئی بگوید من غیر برهان ردّش ننمائید و حال با صد جلد کتاب ردّش کرده‌ئی و مسروری

Ḥāl ṣarīkh-i Ḥaḍrat-i Nuqṭa rā az bayānash idrāk namā. ʿArḍ mīkunad: Ilāhī agar az īn Sidra ki ān Vujūd-i Mubārak bāshad thamarī yā varaqī yā ghuṣnī ẓāhir shavad ki bi-tu īmān nayāvarad ū rā īn ḥīn qaṭʿ namā. Va hamchunīn mīfarmāyad: Agar nafsī kalima-ī bigūyad min ghayr-i burhān raddash nanamāʾīd. Va ḥāl bā ṣad jild kitāb raddash karde-ī va masrūrī.

Now perceive the cry of the Point in His words. He entreats: “My God! If from this Tree”—which is His blessed Being—“there should appear any fruit, leaf, or branch that does not believe in You, cut it off this very moment.” He likewise says: “If anyone speaks a word without proof, do not reject him.” Yet now you have rejected Him despite a hundred volumes of scripture, and you rejoice.

242

مجدّد میگویم و التماس میکنم ببصر حدید در آنچه نازل شده ملاحظه نما نفحات بیان این ظهور غیر بیانات قبل است این مظلوم لازال مبتلا بوده و مقرّ امنی که در کتب حضرت اعلی و یا غیر نظر نماید نداشته بعد از ورود در عراق بامر حضرت پادشاه ایران ایّده اللّه دو ماه او ازید فاصله میرزا یحیی وارد شد ذکر نمودیم ما را حسب الأمر باینجا فرستاده‌اند تو خوبست در ایران باشی و میرزا موسای اخوی را میفرستیم بطرف دیگر چه که اسم شما در دیوان نیامده میتوانید بخدمتی قیام نمائید بعد این مظلوم دو سنه منقطعاً عن العالم هجرت کرد از بغداد بعد از رجوع مشاهده شد توقّف کرده و سفرش در عهدهٔ تأخیر مانده این مظلوم بسیار محزون شد حقّ شاهد و گواه که در جمیع احیان بنشر امر مشغول بوده‌ایم سلاسل و اغلال منع ننمود کند و حبس از اظهار بازنداشت و در آن ارض بر منع از فساد و اعمال غیر مرضیّهٔ غیر طیّبه قیام نمودیم و لیلاً و نهاراً بجمیع اطراف الواح ارسال شد و مقصودی جز تهذیب نفوس و اعلای کلمهٔ مبارکه نبوده

Mujaddad mīgūyam va iltimās mīkunam bi-baṣar-i ḥadīd dar ānchih nāzil shudih mulāḥiẓih namā. Nafaḥāt-i bayān-i īn ẓuhūr ghayr-i bayānāt-i qabl ast. Īn Maẓlūm lāzāl mubtalā būdih va maqarr-i amnī kih dar kutub-i Ḥaḍrat-i Aʿlā va yā ghayr naẓar namāyad nadāshtih. Baʿd az vurūd dar ʿIrāq bi-amr-i Ḥaḍrat-i Pādishāh-i Īrān, ayyadahu Allāh, du māh aw azyad fāṣilih Mīrzā Yaḥyā vārid shud. Dhikr namūdīm mā rā ḥasb al-amr bi-īnjā firistādih-and; tu khūb ast dar Īrān bāshī va Mīrzā Mūsā-yi akhavī rā mīfiristīm bi-ṭaraf-i dīgar, chih kih ism-i shumā dar dīvān nayāmadih, mītavānīd bi-khidmatī qiyām namāyīd. Baʿd īn Maẓlūm du sanih munqaṭiʿan ʿan al-ʿālam hijrat kard az Baghdād. Baʿd az rujūʿ mushāhidih shud tavaqquf kardih va safarash dar ʿuhdih-yi taʾkhīr māndih. Īn Maẓlūm bisyār maḥzūn shud. Ḥaqq shāhid va guvāh kih dar jamīʿ-i aḥyān bi-nashr-i amr mashghūl būdih-īm. Salāsil va aghlāl manʿ nanamūd; kand va ḥabs az iẓhār bāz nadāsht. Va dar ān arḍ bar manʿ az fasād va aʿmāl-i ghayr-i marḍiyyih-yi ghayr-i ṭayyibih qiyām namūdīm va laylan va nahāran bi-jamīʿ-i aṭrāf alvāḥ irsāl shud va maqṣūdī juz tahdhīb-i nufūs va iʿlā-yi kalimih-yi mubārakih nabūdih.

Once again I say, and implore you: examine with keen sight what has been revealed. The fragrances of the utterance of this Revelation are unlike those of earlier utterances. This Wronged One has always been afflicted and has had no secure place in which to examine the books of His Holiness the Most Exalted or any others. Two months or more after Our arrival in Iraq by order of His Majesty the Shah of Iran—may God sustain him—Mírzá Yaḥyá arrived. We said: “We have been sent here by official command. It would be best for you to remain in Iran, and We will send Our brother Mírzá Músá elsewhere, since your names have not been entered in the government register and you can arise to render some service.” After this, the Wronged One departed from Baghdad for two years, detached from the world. Upon returning, We found that he had remained and that his journey had been postponed. This Wronged One was deeply saddened. God bears witness and testimony that at all times We have been occupied with spreading the Cause. Chains and shackles did not prevent Us; fetters and imprisonment did not keep Us from proclaiming it. In that land We arose to prevent wrongdoing and objectionable, unwholesome deeds, and day and night Tablets were sent in every direction. Our purpose has been nothing other than the refinement of souls and the exaltation of the blessed Word.

243

مخصوص چند نفر معیّن نمودیم بر جمع آثار نقطه و بعد از جمع میرزا یحیى و میرزا وهّاب خراسانی که به میرزا جواد معروف بود این دو را در محلّی جمع نمودیم و دو دوره کتب حضرت نقطه را حسب الأمر نوشته و تمام نموده‌اند لعمر اللّه این مظلوم از کثرت مراوده با ناس کتب را ندیده و از آثار نقطه ببصر ظاهر مشاهده ننموده و این آثار نزد این دو بوده که هجرت واقع شد و قرار شد میرزا یحیی این نوشتجات را برداشته بشطر ایران توجّه نماید و در آن اراضی انتشار دهد و این مظلوم حسب الاستدعای وزرای دولت علیّه بآن شطر توجّه نمود بعد از ورود در موصل مشاهده شد میرزا یحیی پیش از حرکت مظلوم رفته و منتظر است باری کتب و آثار در بغداد ماند و او خود بشطر علیّه توجّه نمود و جزء این عباد شد حال حقّ شاهد است بر این مظلوم چه گذشت چه که بعد از زحمتهای زیاد آثار را گذاشت و خود بمهاجرین پیوست مدّتها این مظلوم باحزان نامتناهیه مبتلا تا آنکه بتدبیری که غیر حقّ کسى آگاه نیست آثار را بمقام دیگر و ارض دیگر فرستادیم چه که در عراق عرب باید اوراق را در هر شهر ملاحظه نمود والّا از هم میریخت و ضایع میشد ولکنّ اللّه حفظها و ارسلها الی مقام قدّره اللّه من قبل انّه هو الحافظ المعین

Makhṣūṣ chand nafar muʿayyan namūdīm bar jamʿ-i āthār-i Nuqṭih va baʿd az jamʿ Mīrzā Yaḥyā va Mīrzā Vahhāb-i Khurāsānī kih bi-Mīrzā Javād maʿrūf būd, īn du rā dar maḥallī jamʿ namūdīm va du dawrih kutub-i Ḥaḍrat-i Nuqṭih rā ḥasb al-amr nivishtih va tamām namūdih-and. La-ʿamru Allāh, īn Maẓlūm az kathrat-i murāvadih bā nās kutub rā nadīdih va az āthār-i Nuqṭih bi-baṣar-i ẓāhir mushāhidih nanamūdih va īn āthār nazd-i īn du būdih kih hijrat vāqiʿ shud va qarār shud Mīrzā Yaḥyā īn nivishtijāt rā bardāshtih bi-shaṭr-i Īrān tavajjuh namāyad va dar ān arāḍī intishār dihad va īn Maẓlūm ḥasb al-istidʿā-yi vuzarā-yi Dawlat-i ʿAliyyih bi-ān shaṭr tavajjuh namūd. Baʿd az vurūd dar Mawṣil mushāhidih shud Mīrzā Yaḥyā pīsh az ḥarakat-i Maẓlūm raftih va muntaẓir ast. Bārī kutub va āthār dar Baghdād mānd va ū khud bi-shaṭr-i ʿAliyyih tavajjuh namūd va juzʾ-i īn ʿibād shud. Ḥāl Ḥaqq shāhid ast bar īn Maẓlūm chih gudhasht, chih kih baʿd az zaḥmathā-yi ziyād āthār rā gudhāsht va khud bi-muhājirīn payvast. Muddat-hā īn Maẓlūm bi-aḥzān-i nāmutanāhiyih mubtalā tā ānkih bi-tadbīrī kih ghayr-i Ḥaqq kasī āgāh nīst āthār rā bi-maqām-i dīgar va arḍ-i dīgar firistādīm, chih kih dar ʿIrāq-i ʿArab bāyad awrāq rā dar har shahr mulāḥiẓih namūd va illā az ham mīrīkht va ḍāyiʿ mīshud. Wa-lākinna Allāha ḥafiẓahā wa-arsalahā ilā maqāmin qaddarahu Allāhu min qablu, innahu huwa al-Ḥāfiẓu al-Muʿīn.

We specifically appointed several people to collect the writings of the Point. After they had been collected, We brought Mírzá Yaḥyá and Mírzá Vahháb of Khurásán, who was known as Mírzá Javád, together in one place. At Our direction, these two transcribed and completed two sets of the books of His Holiness the Point. By the life of God! Because of His extensive dealings with people, this Wronged One did not see the books or examine the writings of the Point with His outward eyes. These writings were in the keeping of those two when the departure took place. It was arranged that Mírzá Yaḥyá should take these manuscripts, set out for Iran, and disseminate them in those lands, while this Wronged One, at the request of the ministers of the Sublime State, set out in that direction. After arriving in Mosul, We found that Mírzá Yaḥyá had gone there before the departure of the Wronged One and was waiting. In short, the books and writings remained in Baghdad, while he himself set out toward the Sublime Porte and joined these servants. God now bears witness to what this Wronged One endured, for after so much trouble he left the writings behind and himself joined those who were departing. For a long time this Wronged One was afflicted with boundless sorrows, until, by a measure of which no one but God is aware, We sent the writings to another place and another land. For in Arab Iraq the papers had to be inspected in every town; otherwise they would fall apart and be lost. But God preserved them and sent them to a place God had previously ordained. He is indeed the Preserver, the Helper.

244

هر جا این مظلوم رفت میرزا یحیی از عقب آمد خود تو گواهی و میدانی که آنچه ذکر شد صدقست ولکن در سرّ سیّد اصفهانی او را اغوا نمود و عمل نمودند آنچه را که سبب فزع اکبر شد ایکاش از مأمورین دولت سؤال مینمودید عمل میرزا یحیی را در آن ارض از همه گذشته اقسمک باللّه الفرد الواحد المقتدر القدیر که در نوشتجاتی که باسم او نزد نقطهٔ اولی رفته ملاحظه نما تا آثار حقّ را بمثابهٔ آفتاب ممتاز مشاهده نمائی و همچنین از کلمات نقطهٔ بیان روح ما سواه فداه ظاهر شده آنچه که هیچ سترى آن را منع ننماید و سبحات جلال و حجبات اهل ضلال آن را از ظهور بازندارد قد خرقت الأحجاب من اصبع ارادة ربّک القویّ الغالب القدیر بلی مفترین و مغلّین را چاره نبوده و نیست چندی قبل مذکور شد کتاب ایقان و بعضی از الواح را نسبت بغیر داده‌ئی لعمر اللّه هذا ظلم عظیم غیر از ادراک آن عاجز است تا چه رسد بتنزیل آن

Har jā īn Maẓlūm raft Mīrzā Yaḥyā az ʿaqab āmad. Khud tu guvāhī va mīdānī kih ānchih dhikr shud ṣidq ast, valīkin dar sirr Sayyid-i Iṣfahānī ū rā ighvā namūd va ʿamal namūdand ānchih rā kih sabab-i fazaʿ-i akbar shud. Ay kāsh az maʾmūrīn-i dawlat suʾāl mīnamūdīd ʿamal-i Mīrzā Yaḥyā rā dar ān arḍ. Az hamih gudhashtih, uqsimuka bi-Allāhi al-Fardi al-Wāḥidi al-Muqtadiri al-Qadīr, kih dar nivishtijātī kih bi-ism-i ū nazd-i Nuqṭih-yi Ūlā raftih mulāḥiẓih namā tā āthār-i Ḥaqq rā bi-mathābih-yi āftāb mumtāz mushāhidih namāʾī. Va hamchunīn az kalimāt-i Nuqṭih-yi Bayān, rūḥu mā siwāhu fidāhu, ẓāhir shudih ānchih kih hīch sitrī ān rā manʿ nanamāyad va subuḥāt-i jalāl va ḥujubāt-i ahl-i ḍalāl ān rā az ẓuhūr bāz nadārad. Qad khuriqat al-aḥjābu min iṣbaʿi irādati rabbika al-Qawiyyi al-Ghālibi al-Qadīr. Balī muftarīn va mughillīn rā chārih nabūdih va nīst. Chandī qabl madhkūr shud Kitāb-i Īqān va baʿḍī az alvāḥ rā nisbat bi-ghayr dādih-ī. La-ʿamru Allāh, hādhā ẓulmun ʿaẓīm. Ghayr az idrāk-i ān ʿājiz ast tā chih risad bi-tanzīl-i ān.

Wherever this Wronged One went, Mírzá Yaḥyá followed. You yourself are a witness and know that what has been stated is true. In secret, however, the Sayyid of Isfahan led him astray, and they did what caused the greatest consternation. If only you had asked the government officials about Mírzá Yaḥyá’s conduct in that land! Apart from all this, I adjure you by God, the Unique, the One, the All-Powerful, the Omnipotent, to examine the writings sent in his name to the Primal Point, so that you may see the writings of God as distinctly as the sun. Likewise, from the words of the Point of the Bayán—may the souls of all besides Him be sacrificed for Him—there has appeared that which no covering can conceal, and which neither the veils of glory nor the coverings of the people of error can prevent from appearing. The veils have been rent by the finger of the will of your Lord, the Strong, the All-Conquering, the Omnipotent. Yet the fabricators and the malicious have had, and still have, no other recourse. Some time ago it was reported that you had attributed the Book of Certitude and some of the Tablets to someone else. By the life of God, this is a grievous injustice! Another is incapable of comprehending it, let alone revealing it.

245

حسن مازندرانی حامل هفتاد لوح بوده و چون فوت شد آن الواح را بصاحبانش ندادند و بیکى از اختهای این مظلوم که من غیر جهت اعراض نموده سپردند اللّه یعلم ما ورد علی الواحه و آن اخت ابداً با ما نبوده قسم بآفتاب حقیقت بعد از ظهور این امور میرزا یحیی را ندیده و از امر مطّلع نبوده چه که آن ایّام موافق نبوده‌اند ایشان در محلّه‌ئی و این مظلوم در محلّهٔ دیگر ساکن ولکن محض عنایت و محبّت و شفقت چند یوم قبل از حرکت نزد او و والده‌اش رفته که شاید از کوثر ایمان بیاشامند و بآنچه الیوم سبب تقرّب الی اللّه است فائز گردند حقّ میداند و شاهد و خود او گواه که غیر این بهیچوجه خیالی نبوده تا آنکه الحمد للّه از فضل الهی فائز شد و بطراز محبّت مزیّن گشت ولکن بعد از اسیری و هجرت ما از عراق به آستانه دیگر از او خبری نرسید و بعد از تفریق در ارض طاء با جناب اخوی میرزا رضا قلی ملاقات نشد و خبری از او مخصوصاً نرسید در اوّل ایّام کل در یک بیت ساکن بودیم و بعد آن بیت در خریمه بقیمت نازلی رفت و فرمانفرما و حسام‌السّلطنه این دو برادر خریدند و قسمت نمودند بعد از این حادثه مابین ما و اخوی تفریق حاصل ایشان بدر مسجد شاه و ما در دروازهٔ شمیران ساکن ولکن از اخت از بعد من غیر جهت آثار عناد ظاهر این مظلوم بهیچوجه سخنی نگفته الّا آنکه بنت اخوی مرحوم میرزا محمّد حسن علیه بهآء اللّه و سلامه و رحمته که مخطوبهٔ غصن اعظم بوده او را اخت این مظلوم از نور بخانهٔ خود برده و بمقرّ دیگر فرستاد جمعی از اصحاب و دوستان از اطراف شکایت نمودند چه که این امر بسیار عظیم بود موافق رأی هیچیک از اولیای حقّ واقع نشد عجب در اینکه اخت او را بمحلّ خود برده و ترتیبات داده بمقام دیگر فرستاده مع‌ذلک این مظلوم ساکت و صامت بوده و هست مگر آنکه مخصوص تسکین احباب یک کلمه اظهار رفت و حقّ شاهد و گواه است که آنچه گفته شد حقیقت بوده و براستی گفته و احدی از اولیای این اطراف و آن اراضی گمان نمیکردند که از اخت چنین امری که خلاف حمیّت و محبّت و دوستی است واقع شود بعد از ظهور این امر سبیل را مقطوع دیدند و عمل نمودند آنچه را که کل میدانید و میدانند دیگر معلومست که چه مرتبه حزن از این عمل بر مظلوم وارد شد و بعد به میرزا یحیی پیوست و حال مختلف شنیده میشود معلوم نیست چه میگوید و چه میکند نسأل اللّه تبارک و تعالی ان یرجعها الیه و یؤیّدها علی الانابة لدی باب فضله انّه هو العزیز التّوّاب و هو المقتدر الغفّار

Ḥasan-i Māzandarānī ḥāmil-i haftād lawḥ būdih va chūn fawt shud ān alvāḥ rā bi-ṣāḥibānash nadādand va bi-yikī az ukht-hā-yi īn Maẓlūm kih min ghayr-i jahat iʿrāḍ namūdih sipurdand. Allāhu yaʿlamu mā warada ʿalā alwāḥihi. Va ān ukht abadan bā mā nabūdih. Qasam bi-Āftāb-i Ḥaqīqat, baʿd az ẓuhūr-i īn umūr Mīrzā Yaḥyā rā nadīdih va az amr muṭṭaliʿ nabūdih, chih kih ān ayyām muvāfiq nabūdih-and. Īshān dar maḥallih-ī va īn Maẓlūm dar maḥallih-yi dīgar sākin, valīkin maḥḍ-i ʿināyat va maḥabbat va shafaqat chand yawm qabl az ḥarakat nazd-i ū va vālidih-ash raftih kih shāyad az kawthar-i īmān biyāshāmand va bi-ānchih al-yawm sabab-i taqarrub ilā Allāh ast fāʾiz gardand. Ḥaqq mīdānad va shāhid va khud-i ū guvāh kih ghayr-i īn bi-hīch-vajh khayālī nabūdih tā ānkih al-ḥamdu li-llāh az faḍl-i ilāhī fāʾiz shud va bi-ṭirāz-i maḥabbat muzayyan gasht. Valīkin baʿd az asīrī va hijrat-i mā az ʿIrāq bi-Āstānih dīgar az ū khabarī narasīd va baʿd az tafrīq dar arḍ-i Ṭāʾ bā jināb-i akhavī Mīrzā Riḍā Qulī mulāqāt nashud va khabarī az ū makhṣūṣan narasīd. Dar avval-i ayyām kull dar yik bayt sākin būdīm va baʿd ān bayt dar kharīmih bi-qīmat-i nāzilī raft va Farmān-Farmā va Ḥusām al-Salṭanih īn du barādar kharīdand va qismat namūdand. Baʿd az īn ḥādithih mābayn-i mā va akhavī tafrīq ḥāṣil, īshān bi-dar-i Masjid-i Shāh va mā dar Darvāzih-yi Shimīrān sākin. Valīkin az ukht az baʿd min ghayr-i jahat āthār-i ʿinād ẓāhir. Īn Maẓlūm bi-hīch-vajh sukhanī naguفتih illā ānkih bint-i akhavī-yi marḥūm Mīrzā Muḥammad Ḥasan, ʿalayhi bahāʾu Allāhi wa-salāmuhu wa-raḥmatuhu, kih makhṭūbih-yi Ghuṣn-i Aʿẓam būdih, ū rā ukht-i īn Maẓlūm az Nūr bi-khānih-yi khud burdih va bi-maqarr-i dīgar firistād. Jamʿī az aṣḥāb va dūstān az aṭrāf shikāyat namūdand, chih kih īn amr bisyār ʿaẓīm būd. Muvāfiq-i raʾy-i hīch-yik az awliyā-yi Ḥaqq vāqiʿ nashud. ʿAjab dar īnkih ukht ū rā bi-maḥall-i khud burdih va tartībāt dādih bi-maqām-i dīgar firistādih, maʿa-dhālik īn Maẓlūm sākit va ṣāmit būdih va hast, magar ānkih makhṣūṣ-i taskīn-i aḥbāb yik kalimih iẓhār raft va Ḥaqq shāhid va guvāh ast kih ānchih guftih shud ḥaqīqat būdih va bi-rāstī guftih va aḥadī az awliyā-yi īn aṭrāf va ān arāḍī gumān namīkardand kih az ukht chunīn amrī kih khilāf-i ḥamiyyat va maḥabbat va dūstī ast vāqiʿ shavad. Baʿd az ẓuhūr-i īn amr sabīl rā maqṭūʿ dīdand va ʿamal namūdand ānchih rā kih kull mīdānīd va mīdānand. Dīgar maʿlūm ast kih chih martabih ḥuzn az īn ʿamal bar Maẓlūm vārid shud va baʿd bi-Mīrzā Yaḥyā payvast va ḥāl mukhtalif shinīdih mīshavad. Maʿlūm nīst chih mīgūyad va chih mīkunad. Nasʾalu Allāha tabāraka wa-taʿālā an yurjiʿahā ilayhi wa-yuʾayyidahā ʿalā al-inābati ladā bābi faḍlihi, innahu huwa al-ʿAzīzu al-Tawwābu wa-huwa al-Muqtadiru al-Ghaffār.

Ḥasan of Mázandarán was carrying seventy Tablets. When he died, those Tablets were not given to their recipients but were entrusted to one of this Wronged One’s sisters, who had turned away without any reason. God knows what befell His Tablets. That sister had never been with Us. I swear by the Sun of Truth that, after these events came to pass, she had not seen Mírzá Yaḥyá and had not been informed of the Cause, for in those days they had not been in agreement. She lived in one quarter and this Wronged One in another. Yet, solely out of kindness, love, and compassion, a few days before departing We went to see her and her mother, so that they might drink from the river of faith and attain that which today brings one near to God. God knows and bears witness, and she herself can testify, that there was no other intention whatsoever, until, praise be to God, through divine grace she attained and was adorned with the ornament of love. But after Our captivity and departure from Iraq for Constantinople, no further news came from her. After Our separation in the Land of Ṭá, We did not meet Our brother Mírzá Riḍá Qulí, nor did any particular news of him arrive. In the early days we all lived in one house. Later that house was sold off at a low price, and the two brothers Farmán-Farmá and Ḥusám al-Salṭanih bought and divided it. After this event, We and Our brother lived apart: he near the entrance to the Shah Mosque and We at the Shimírán Gate. Subsequently, however, signs of hostility appeared from Our sister without any reason. This Wronged One said nothing whatsoever, except concerning the daughter of Our late brother Mírzá Muḥammad Ḥasan—upon him be the glory of God, His peace, and His mercy—who was betrothed to the Most Great Branch. This Wronged One’s sister took her from Núr to her own house and sent her elsewhere. A number of companions and friends from various places complained, for this was a very grave matter. It met with the approval of none of the friends of God. It is astonishing that Our sister took her to her own home, made arrangements, and sent her to another place. Nevertheless, this Wronged One has remained, and still remains, silent and uncomplaining, save that a single word was spoken specifically to soothe the friends. God bears witness and testimony that what was said was true and was spoken truthfully. None of the friends in these parts or in those lands imagined that Our sister would do such a thing, contrary to honor, love, and friendship. After this affair came to light, they saw the way cut off and did what you all know and what they know. It is clear, then, how much sorrow this action brought upon the Wronged One. Afterward she joined Mírzá Yaḥyá, and now conflicting reports are heard. It is not known what she says or what she does. We ask God, blessed and exalted, to bring her back to Him and assist her to turn repentantly toward the door of His grace. He is indeed the Almighty, the Ever-Relenting, and He is the All-Powerful, the Ever-Forgiving.

246

و همچنین در مقام دیگر میفرماید اگر در این حین ظاهر شود من اوّل عابدین و اوّل ساجدینم انتهى یا قوم انصاف دهید مقصود حضرت اعلی آنکه قرب ظهور ناس را از شریعهٔ باقیهٔ الهیّه منع ننماید چنانچه اصحاب یحیی را از اقرار به روح منع نمود مکرّر فرموده و میفرماید بیان و آنچه در او نازل شده شما را از آن ساذج وجود و مالک غیب و شهود منع ننماید مع این حکم محکم اگر کسی به بیان تمسّک نماید از ظلّ سدرهٔ مبارکهٔ علیا خارج است انصفوا یا قوم و لا تکونوا من الغافلین

Va hamchunīn dar maqām-i dīgar mīfarmāyad agar dar īn ḥīn ẓāhir shavad man avval-i ʿābidīn va avval-i sājidīnam. Intahā. Yā qawm, inṣāf dihīd. Maqṣūd-i Ḥaḍrat-i Aʿlā ānkih qurb-i ẓuhūr nās rā az sharīʿih-yi bāqiyih-yi ilāhiyyih manʿ nanamāyad, chunānchih aṣḥāb-i Yaḥyā rā az iqrār bi-Rūḥ manʿ namūd. Mukarrar farmūdih va mīfarmāyad Bayān va ānchih dar ū nāzil shudih shumā rā az ān sādhij-i vujūd va Mālik-i ghayb va shuhūd manʿ nanamāyad. Maʿ-i īn ḥukm-i muḥkam agar kasī bi-Bayān tamassuk namāyad az ẓill-i Sidrih-yi Mubārakih-yi ʿUlyā khārij ast. Anṣifū yā qawmu wa-lā takūnū min al-ghāfilīn.

Likewise, in another passage He says: “If He should appear at this very moment, I am the first to worship and the first to bow down.” End of quotation. People, be fair! The purpose of His Holiness the Most Exalted was that the nearness of the Revelation should not keep people from the everlasting river of God, just as it kept the followers of John from acknowledging the Spirit. He has repeatedly said, and continues to say: “Do not let the Bayán and what has been revealed in it keep you from that pure Essence of existence and Lord of the unseen and the seen.” Despite this firm decree, if anyone clings to the Bayán, he is outside the shade of the blessed, exalted Lote Tree. Be fair, people, and do not be among the heedless.

247

و همچنین میفرماید باسماء از مالک آن محتجب ممانید حتّی اسم النّبیّ فانّ ذلک الاسم یخلق بقوله و همچنین در باب سابع از واحد ثانی میفرماید ای اهل بیان نکرده آنچه اهل فرقان کردند که ثمرات لیل خود را باطل کنید الی ان قال عزّ ذکره میفرماید اگر بظهور او فائز شدی و اطاعت نمودی ثمرهٔ بیان را ظاهر کردی والّا لائق ذکر نیستی نزد خداوند ترحّم بر خود کرده اگر نصرت نمیکنی مظهر ربوبیّت را محزون نکرده الی قوله جلّ شأنه اگر بلقآء اللّه فائز نمیگردی آیة اللّه را هم محزون نکرده باشی از نفع مدیّنین به بیان میگذرد هرگاه شما از ضرر باو بگذرید اگرچه میدانم نخواهید کرد انتهی

Va hamchunīn mīfarmāyad bi-asmāʾ az Mālik-i ān muḥtajib mamānīd, ḥattā isma al-nabiyyi fa-inna dhālika al-isma yukhlaqu bi-qawlihi. Va hamchunīn dar bāb-i sābiʿ az vāḥid-i thānī mīfarmāyad ay ahl-i Bayān nakardih ānchih ahl-i Furqān kardand kih thamarāt-i layl-i khud rā bāṭil kunīd. Ilā an qāla ʿazza dhikruhu, mīfarmāyad agar bi-ẓuhūr-i ū fāʾiz shudī va iṭāʿat namūdī thamarِih-yi Bayān rā ẓāhir kardī va illā lāyiq-i dhikr nīstī nazd-i Khudāvand. Taraḥḥum bar khud kardih agar nuṣrat namīkunī Maẓhar-i Rubūbiyyat rā maḥzūn nakardih. Ilā qawlihi jalla shaʾnuhu, agar bi-liqāʾ-i Allāh fāʾiz namīgardī Āyat-i Allāh rā ham maḥzūn nakardih bāshī. Az nafʿ-i mudayyinīn bi-Bayān mīgudharad hargāh shumā az ḍarar bi-ū bigudharīd, agarchih mīdānam nakhāhīd kard. Intahā.

He likewise says: “Do not remain veiled by names from their Lord, even the name ‘Prophet,’ for that name is created by His word.” Likewise, in the seventh chapter of the second Váḥid, He says: “People of the Bayán, do not do what the people of the Qur’an did, thereby nullifying the fruits of your night.” Further on He says—exalted be His mention: “If you attain His Revelation and obey Him, you have brought forth the fruit of the Bayán; otherwise you are not worthy of mention before God. Have mercy on yourselves: if you do not aid the Manifestation of Lordship, do not sadden Him.” And further on He says—glorious is His station: “If you do not attain the meeting with God, at least do not sadden the Sign of God. He will forgo any benefit from those who profess the Bayán if you will forgo harming Him, although I know that you will not.” End of quotation.

248

یا هادی گویا بسبب این بیانات حقّه است اراده نموده‌ئی بیان را محو کنی بشنو ندای مظلوم را و از این ظلم که ارکان بیان از آن مضطربست بگذر من در چهریق نبوده‌ام و در ماکو نبوده‌ام حال مابین مریدهای شما حرفها ظاهر شده بعینه آنچه حزب شیعه میگفتند که این قرآن تمام نیست حضرات هم میگویند این بیان آن بیان نیست خطّ جناب آقا سیّد حسین موجود خطّ میرزا احمد موجود

Yā Hādī, gūyā bi-sabab-i īn bayānāt-i ḥaqqih ast irādih namūdih-ī Bayān rā maḥv kunī. Bishnaw nidā-yi Maẓlūm rā va az īn ẓulm kih arkān-i Bayān az ān muḍṭarib ast bigudhar. Man dar Chihrīq nabūdih-am va dar Mākū nabūdih-am. Ḥāl mābayn-i murīdhā-yi shumā ḥarfhā ẓāhir shudih bi-ʿaynihi ānchih ḥizb-i Shīʿih mīguftand kih īn Qurʾān tamām nīst. Ḥaḍarāt ham mīgūyand īn Bayān ān Bayān nīst. Khaṭṭ-i jināb-i Āqā Sayyid Ḥusayn mawjūd, khaṭṭ-i Mīrzā Aḥmad mawjūd.

O Hádí! It seems that it is because of these true statements that you have resolved to obliterate the Bayán. Hear the call of the Wronged One and desist from this injustice, which causes the foundations of the Bayán to tremble. I was not in Chihríq, nor was I in Mákú. Now statements have emerged among your followers exactly like those made by the Shíʿih community, who said that this Qur’an was incomplete. These gentlemen likewise say that this Bayán is not that Bayán. The handwriting of Áqá Sayyid Ḥusayn exists; the handwriting of Mírzá Aḥmad exists.

249

نفسىی که یک لطمه در دنیا نخورده و همیشه پنج نفس از امآء اللّه نزدش بوده او را مظلوم میگوئی و حقّ که از اوّل عمر تا بحال دست اعدا بوده و ببدترین عذابهای عالم معذّب گشته باو نسبت داده‌ئی آنچه را که یهود در حقّ مسیح نگفته اسمع ندآء المظلوم و لا تکن من الأخسرین

Nafsī kih yik laṭmih dar dunyā nakhurdih va hamīshih panj nafs az imāʾ-i Allāh nazdash būdih ū rā maẓlūm mīgūʾī va Ḥaqq kih az avval-i ʿumr tā bi-ḥāl dast-i aʿdā būdih va bi-badtarīn ʿadhābhā-yi ʿālam muʿadhdhab gashtih bi-ū nisbat dādih-ī ānchih rā kih Yahūd dar ḥaqq-i Masīḥ naguفتih. Ismaʿ nidāʾa al-Maẓlūmi wa-lā takun min al-akhsarīn.

You call a man wronged who has not suffered a single blow in this world and has always had five of the handmaidens of God with him, while to the Truth, who from the beginning of His life until now has been in the hands of enemies and has suffered the worst torments in the world, you have attributed what the Jews did not say of Christ. Hear the call of the Wronged One and do not be among those who suffer the greatest loss.

250

و همچنین میفرماید چه بسا ناری را که خدا نور میکند به من یظهره اللّه و چه بسا نوری را که نار میفرماید به او و می‌بینم ظهور او را مثل این شمس در وسط السّمآء و غروب کل را بمثل نجوم لیل در نهار انتهی یا عالم هل لک اذن لتسمع ندآء الحقّ و تنصف فى هذا الظّهور الّذی اذ ظهر نطق الطّور قد اتی مکلّمی بآیات واضحات و براهین لائحات رغماً لکلّ غافل بعید و کلّ مفتر کذّاب الّذین ارادوا ان یطفئوا نور اللّه بمفتریاتهم و یمحوا آثار اللّه بغلّهم الا انّهم من الظّالمین فی کتاب اللّه ربّ العالمین

Va hamchunīn mīfarmāyad: Chih basā nārī rā kih Khudā nūr mīkunad bih Man Yuẓhiruhu Allāh va chih basā nūrī rā kih nār mīfarmāyad bih ū va mībīnam ẓuhūr-i ū rā mithl-i īn shams dar vasaṭ al-samāʾ va ghurūb-i kull rā bi-mithl-i nujūm-i layl dar nahār. Intahā. Yā ʿālim, hal laka udhun li-tasmaʿa nidāʾ al-Ḥaqq wa tunṣifa fī hādhā al-ẓuhūr alladhī idh ẓahara naṭaqa al-Ṭūr: Qad atā mukallimī bi-āyāt wāḍiḥāt wa barāhīn lāʾiḥāt raghman li-kulli ghāfil baʿīd wa kulli muftarin kadhdhāb alladhīna arādū an yuṭfiʾū nūr Allāh bi-muftarayātihim wa yamḥū āthār Allāh bi-ghillihim. Alā innahum min al-ẓālimīn fī kitāb Allāh Rabb al-ʿālamīn.

He also says: “How often God turns fire into light through Him Whom God will make manifest, and how often He turns light into fire through Him! I see His appearance like this sun in the midst of heaven, and the setting of all others like the stars of the night in the daytime.” End of quotation. O learned one! Do you have an ear to hear the call of the Truth and judge fairly concerning this Revelation, at whose appearance the Mount declared: “He who speaks to me has come with clear verses and manifest proofs, despite every heedless one who is far away and every lying fabricator who sought to extinguish the light of God with their fabrications and erase the traces of God through their malice.” Indeed, they are among the unjust in the Book of God, the Lord of the worlds.

251

و همچنین میفرماید بیان از اوّل تا آخر مکمن جمیع صفات اوست و خزانهٔ نار و نور او انتهی سبحان‌اللّه عرف این بیان انسان را اخذ مینماید چه که بکمال حزن میفرماید آنچه را که مشاهده مینماید و همچنین بجناب حرف حیّ یعنی ملّا باقر علیه بهآء اللّه و عنایته میفرماید لعلّک فی ثمانیة سنة یوم ظهوره تدرک لقائه انتهی

Va hamchunīn mīfarmāyad: Bayān az avval tā ākhir makman-i jamīʿ-i ṣifāt-i ūst va khazānih-yi nār va nūr-i ū. Intahā. Subḥān Allāh, ʿarf-i īn bayān insān rā akhdh mīnamāyad chih kih bi-kamāl-i ḥuzn mīfarmāyad ānchih rā kih mushāhadih mīnamāyad. Va hamchunīn bih janāb-i Ḥarf-i Ḥayy yaʿnī Mullā Bāqir, ʿalayhi Bahāʾ Allāh wa ʿināyatuhu, mīfarmāyad: Laʿallaka fī thamāniyati sanah yawma ẓuhūrihi tudriku liqāʾahu. Intahā.

He also says: “The Bayán, from beginning to end, is the repository of all His attributes and the treasury of His fire and light.” End of quotation. Glory be to God! The fragrance of this utterance seizes the soul, for with the deepest sorrow He speaks of what He beholds. He also says to the Letter of the Living, namely Mullā Bāqir, upon whom be the glory of God and His loving care: “Perhaps in the eighth year, on the day of His appearance, you will attain His presence.” End of quotation.

252

اعرف یا هادی و کن من السّامعین انصاف ده اکثر اصحاب الهی و ادلّای حقّ شهید شدند تو هنوز موجودی آیا حفظ تو از چه بوده لعمر اللّه از انکار و شهادت نفوس مقدّسه از اقرار هر صاحب عدل و انصافی باین فقره گواهی میدهد چه که سبب و علّت این دو بمثابهٔ آفتاب ظاهر و مشهود

Iʿraf yā Hādī wa kun min al-sāmiʿīn. Inṣāf dih, akthar-i aṣḥāb-i ilāhī va adillā-yi Ḥaqq shahīd shudand, tu hanūz mawjūdī. Āyā ḥifẓ-i tu az chih būdih? La-ʿamr Allāh, az inkār va shahādat-i nufūs-i muqaddasih az iqrār. Har ṣāḥib-i ʿadl va inṣāfī bi-īn fiqrih guvāhī mīdihad chih kih sabab va ʿillat-i īn du bi-mathābih-yi āftāb ẓāhir va mashhūd.

Recognize the truth, O Hādī, and be among those who listen. Judge fairly: most of the companions of God and the guides to the Truth were martyred, while you still remain alive. What preserved you? By the life of God, it was denial, while the martyrdom of those holy souls resulted from their acknowledgment. Every just and fair-minded person bears witness to this, for the cause and reason for both are as evident and visible as the sun.

253

و همچنین خطاب به دیّان مظلوم شهید میفرماید ستعرفنّ قدرک بقول من یظهره اللّه و همچنین او را حرف ثالث مؤمن به من یظهره اللّه فرموده بقوله و انّک انت یا حرف الثّالث المؤمن بمن یظهره اللّه و همچنین میفرماید ولکنّ اللّه اذا شآء لیعرّفنّک بقول من یظهره اللّه حضرت دیّان که بقول نقطه روح ما سواه فداه مخزن امانت حقّ جلّ جلاله و مکمن لآلی علم اوست او را بظلمی شهید نمودند که ملأ اعلى گریست و نوحه نمود و اوست نفسی که علم مکنون مخزون را باو تعلیم فرموده و در او ودیعه گذاشته بقوله ان یا اسم الدّیّان هذا علم مکنون مخزون قد اودعناک و آتیناک عزّاً من عند اللّه اذ عین فؤادک لطیف تعرف قدره و تعزّ بهائه و قد منّ اللّه علی نقطة البیان بعلم مکنون مخزون ما نزّل اللّه قبل ذلک الظّهور و هو اعزّ من کلّ علم عند اللّه سبحانه و قد جعله حجّة من عنده بمثل ما قد جعل الآیات حجّة من عنده انتهی آن مظلوم که دارای خزینهٔ علم الهی بود مع جناب میرزا على اکبر از منتسبین نقطه علیه بهآء اللّه و رحمته و جناب آقا ابوالقاسم کاشی و جمعی دیگر بفتوای میرزا یحیی کل را شهید نمودند

Va hamchunīn khiṭāb bih Dayyān-i maẓlūm-i shahīd mīfarmāyad: Sa-taʿrifanna qadraka bi-qawli Man Yuẓhiruhu Allāh. Va hamchunīn ū rā ḥarf-i thālith-i muʾmin bih Man Yuẓhiruhu Allāh farmūdih bi-qawlihi: Wa innaka anta yā ḥarf al-thālith al-muʾmin bi-Man Yuẓhiruhu Allāh. Va hamchunīn mīfarmāyad: Wa lākinna Allāha idhā shāʾa la-yuʿarrifannaka bi-qawli Man Yuẓhiruhu Allāh. Ḥaḍrat-i Dayyān kih bi-qawl-i Nuqṭih, rūḥ-i mā sivāh fidāh, makhzan-i amānat-i Ḥaqq jalla jalāluhu va makman-i laʾālī-yi ʿilm-i ūst, ū rā bih ẓulmī shahīd namūdand kih malaʾ-i aʿlā girīst va nawḥih namūd va ūst nafsī kih ʿilm-i maknūn-i makhzūn rā bi-ū taʿlīm farmūdih va dar ū vadīʿih guẕāshtih bi-qawlihi: An yā ism al-Dayyān, hādhā ʿilm maknūn makhzūn qad awdaʿnāka wa ātaynāka ʿizzan min ʿind Allāh idh ʿayn fuʾādika laṭīf taʿrifu qadrahu wa taʿizzu bahāʾahu wa qad manna Allāhu ʿalā Nuqṭat al-Bayān bi-ʿilm maknūn makhzūn mā nazzala Allāhu qabla dhālika al-ẓuhūr wa huwa aʿazzu min kulli ʿilm ʿinda Allāh subḥānahu wa qad jaʿalahu ḥujjatan min ʿindihi bi-mithli mā qad jaʿala al-āyāti ḥujjatan min ʿindihi. Intahā. Ān maẓlūm kih dārā-yi khazīnih-yi ʿilm-i ilāhī būd maʿa janāb-i Mīrzā ʿAlī Akbar az muntasibīn-i Nuqṭih, ʿalayhi Bahāʾ Allāh wa raḥmatuhu, va janāb-i Āqā Abu’l-Qāsim Kāshī va jamʿī dīgar bi-fatvā-yi Mīrzā Yaḥyā kull rā shahīd namūdand.

He also addresses Dayyān, the wronged martyr, saying: “You will assuredly recognize your worth through the words of Him Whom God will make manifest.” He also called him the third Letter to believe in Him Whom God will make manifest, in His words: “You indeed, O third Letter, are the believer in Him Whom God will make manifest.” He also says: “But God, if He wills, will assuredly make you known through the words of Him Whom God will make manifest.” Dayyān, who, according to the words of the Point—may the soul of all else be sacrificed for Him—is the repository of the trust of the Truth, exalted be His glory, and the treasury of the pearls of His knowledge, was martyred with such injustice that the celestial Assembly wept and lamented. He is the one whom He taught the hidden, treasured knowledge, depositing it within him, in His words: “O you who bear the name Dayyān! This is a hidden, treasured knowledge that We have entrusted to you, and We have bestowed upon you honor from God, for the eye of your heart is discerning: you recognize its worth and cherish its splendor. God has indeed favored the Point of the Bayán with a hidden, treasured knowledge that God had not sent down before that Revelation. It is more precious than all knowledge in the sight of God, glory be to Him, and He has made it a proof from Himself, just as He has made the verses a proof from Himself.” End of quotation. That wronged one, who possessed the treasury of divine knowledge, together with Mīrzā ʿAlī Akbar, one of the relatives of the Point, upon whom be the glory of God and His mercy, and Āqā Abu’l-Qāsim Kāshī and a number of others—all were martyred by the decree of Mīrzā Yaḥyā.

254

یا هادی کتابش نزد تو حاضر است آنکه اسمش را مستیقظ گذارده بخوان اگرچه دیده‌ئی ولکن مکرّر مشاهده نما لعلّک تتّخذ لنفسک فی خبآء الصّدق مقاماً رفیعاً

Yā Hādī, kitābash nazd-i tu ḥāḍir ast, ānkih ismash rā Mustayqiẓ guẕāshtih. Bikhvān agarchih dīdih-ī va lākin mukarrar mushāhadih namā laʿallaka tattakhidhu li-nafsika fī khibāʾ al-ṣidq maqāman rafīʿan.

O Hādī! His book is there with you, the one he named Mustayqiẓ. Read it; although you have seen it, examine it again, so that you may attain for yourself a lofty station within the tent of truthfulness.

255

و همچنین آقا سیّد ابرهیم که در باره‌اش از قلم نقطهٔ اولی این کلمات جاری قوله تعالی ان یا خلیلی فی الصّحف و ان یا ذکری فی الکتب من بعد الصّحف و ان یا اسمی فى البیان انتهی او و دیّان را ابوالشّرور و ابوالدّواهی نامیده حال انصاف ده که بر این مظلومها چه وارد شده مع آنکه یکی در خدمتش مشغول و دیگری بر او وارد باری لعمر اللّه باعمالی عامل بوده که قلم حیا میکند از ذکرش

Va hamchunīn Āqā Siyyid Ibrāhīm kih dar bārih-ash az qalam-i Nuqṭih-yi Ūlā īn kalimāt jārī, qawluhu taʿālā: An yā khalīlī fī al-ṣuḥuf wa an yā dhikrī fī al-kutub min baʿd al-ṣuḥuf wa an yā ismī fī al-Bayān. Intahā. Ū va Dayyān rā Abu’l-Shurūr va Abu’l-Davāhī nāmīdih. Ḥāl inṣāf dih kih bar īn maẓlūmhā chih vārid shudih maʿa ānkih yikī dar khidmatash mashghūl va dīgarī bar ū vārid. Bārī la-ʿamr Allāh bi-aʿmālī ʿāmil būdih kih qalam ḥayā mīkunad az dhikrash.

Likewise, concerning Āqā Siyyid Ibrāhīm, these words flowed from the Pen of the Primal Point—exalted are His words: “O My friend in the Scrolls! O My remembrance in the Books after the Scrolls! O My name in the Bayán!” End of quotation. He has called him and Dayyān the “Father of Evils” and the “Father of Calamities.” Now judge fairly what has befallen these wronged ones, even though one was occupied in his service and the other had come to visit him. In short, by the life of God, he has committed deeds that the pen is ashamed to mention.

256

قدری در عصمت نقطهٔ اولی تفکّر کن ملاحظه نما چه ظاهر گشته وقتی که این مظلوم از هجرت دوساله که در صحاری و جبال سالک بود و بسبب بعضی از نفوس که مدّتها در بیابانها دویدند رجوع به دارالسّلام نمود میرزا محمّد على نامی رشتی بحضور آمد و امام جمعی بکلمه‌ئی نطق نمود در بارهٔ عصمت آن حضرت که فی‌الحقیقه حزن جمیع اقطار را اخذ نمود سبحان‌اللّه چگونه راضی شدند که باین خیانت اعظم تمسّک جستند باری از حقّ میطلبیم که عامل را توفیق بخشد بر توبه و انابه انّه هو المؤیّد الحکیم

Qadrī dar ʿiṣmat-i Nuqṭih-yi Ūlā tafakkur kun. Mulāḥaẓih namā chih ẓāhir gashtih. Vaqtī kih īn Maẓlūm az hijrat-i du-sālih kih dar ṣaḥārī va jibāl sālik būd va bi-sabab-i baʿḍī az nufūs kih muddat-hā dar biyābānhā davīdand rujūʿ bih Dār al-Salām namūd, Mīrzā Muḥammad ʿAlī nāmī Rashtī bi-ḥuḍūr āmad va amām-i jamʿī bih kalimih-ī nuṭq namūd dar bārih-yi ʿiṣmat-i ān Ḥaḍrat kih fī al-ḥaqīqih ḥuzn jamīʿ-i aqṭār rā akhdh namūd. Subḥān Allāh, chigūnih rāḍī shudand kih bi-īn khiyānat-i aʿẓam tamassuk justand. Bārī az Ḥaqq mīṭalabīm kih ʿāmil rā tawfīq bakhshad bar tawbih va inābih. Innahu huwa al-Muʾayyid al-Ḥakīm.

Reflect a little on the infallibility of the Primal Point. Consider what has come to light. When this Wronged One returned to the Abode of Peace from His two-year withdrawal, during which He wandered through deserts and mountains, at the urging of certain souls who had spent a long time searching the wilderness, a man from Rasht named Mīrzā Muḥammad ʿAlī came into His presence. Before a gathering he made a statement concerning the infallibility of that exalted Being which truly caused sorrow to seize every region. Glory be to God! How could they consent to resort to this most grievous betrayal? In short, We ask the Truth to enable its perpetrator to repent and turn back to Him. He is indeed the One who aids, the All-Wise.

257

و جناب دیّان علیه بهآء اللّه و رحمته بحضور فائز مطابق آنچه از قلم نقطهٔ اولی ظاهر شد نسأل اللّه ان یؤیّد الغافلین علی التّوجّه الیه و المعرضین علی الاقبال الی شطره و المنکرین علی التّصدیق علی هذا الأمر الّذی اذ ظهر نطقت الأشیآء کلّها قد اتی من کان مکنوناً فی کنز العلم و مرقوماً من القلم الأعلی فی الکتب و الصّحف و الزّبر و الألواح

Va janāb-i Dayyān, ʿalayhi Bahāʾ Allāh wa raḥmatuhu, bi-ḥuḍūr fāʾiz muṭābiq-i ānchih az qalam-i Nuqṭih-yi Ūlā ẓāhir shud. Nasʾalu Allāha an yuʾayyida al-ghāfilīna ʿalā al-tawajjuh ilayhi wa al-muʿriḍīna ʿalā al-iqbāl ilā shaṭrihi wa al-munkirīna ʿalā al-taṣdīq ʿalā hādhā al-Amr alladhī idh ẓahara naṭaqat al-ashyāʾ kulluhā: Qad atā man kāna maknūnan fī kanz al-ʿilm wa marqūman min al-Qalam al-Aʿlā fī al-kutub wa al-ṣuḥuf wa al-zubur wa al-alwāḥ.

Dayyān, upon whom be the glory of God and His mercy, attained His presence in accordance with what had been revealed by the Pen of the Primal Point. We ask God to help the heedless turn toward Him, those who have turned away to approach Him, and the deniers to acknowledge this Cause, at whose appearance all things declared: “He has come who was concealed in the treasury of knowledge and recorded by the Most Exalted Pen in the Books, the Scrolls, the Scriptures, and the Tablets.”

258

در این مقام لازم شد احادیثی که در شأن این مدینهٔ مبارکهٔ مشرّفه یعنی عکّا وارد شده ذکر شود لعلّک تتّخذ یا هادی الى الصّدق طریقاً و الی اللّه سبیلاً

Dar īn maqām lāzim shud aḥādīthī kih dar shaʾn-i īn madīnih-yi mubārakih-yi musharrafih yaʿnī ʿAkkā vārid shudih dhikr shavad laʿallaka tattakhidhu yā Hādī ilā al-ṣidq ṭarīqan wa ilā Allāh sabīlan.

At this point it has become necessary to mention the traditions concerning this blessed and honored city, namely ʿAkkā, so that you, O Hādī, may take a path toward truthfulness and a way toward God.

259

بسم اللّه الرّحمن الرّحیم

Bism Allāh al-Raḥmān al-Raḥīm.

In the name of God, the All-Merciful, the Ever-Merciful.

260

ما ورد فی فضل عکّا و البحر و عین البقر الّتی بعکّا حدّثنا

Mā warada fī faḍl ʿAkkā wa al-baḥr wa ʿAyn al-Baqar allatī bi-ʿAkkā. Ḥaddathanā

What has been related concerning the excellence of ʿAkkā, the sea, and the Spring of the Cow in ʿAkkā. It was related to us by

261

عبدالعزیز بن عبدالسّلام عن النّبیّ صلّی اللّه علیه و سلّم انّه قال انّ عکّا مدینة بالشّام قد اختصّها اللّه برحمته

ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz ibn ʿAbd al-Salām ʿan al-Nabī ṣallā Allāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam annahu qāla: Inna ʿAkkā madīnah bi-al-Shām qad ikhtaṣṣahā Allāhu bi-raḥmatihi.

ʿAbd al-ʿAzīz ibn ʿAbd al-Salām, on the authority of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, that he said: “ʿAkkā is a city in Syria that God has singled out for His mercy.”

262

و قال ابن مسعود رضی اللّه عنه انّ النّبیّ صلّی اللّه علیه و سلّم قال الا انّ افضل السّواحل عسقلان و انّ عکّا افضل من عسقلان و فضل عکّا علی عسقلان و علی جمیع السّواحل کفضل محمّد علی جمیع الأنبیآء الا اخبرکم بمدینة بین جبلین فی الشّام فی وسط المرج یقال لها عکّا الا و انّ من دخلها راغباً فیها و فی زیارتها غفر اللّه له ما تقدّم من ذنبه و ما تأخّر و من خرج منها غیر زائر الا لم یبارک اللّه له فی خروجه الا و انّ فیها عیناً یقال لها عین البقر من شرب منها شربةً ملأ اللّه قلبه نوراً و امّنه من العذاب الأکبر یوم القیامة

Wa qāla Ibn Masʿūd raḍiya Allāhu ʿanhu inna al-Nabī ṣallā Allāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam qāla: Alā inna afḍala al-sawāḥil ʿAsqalān wa inna ʿAkkā afḍalu min ʿAsqalān wa faḍlu ʿAkkā ʿalā ʿAsqalān wa ʿalā jamīʿ al-sawāḥil ka-faḍli Muḥammad ʿalā jamīʿ al-anbiyāʾ. Alā ukhbirukum bi-madīnah bayna jabalayn fī al-Shām fī wasaṭ al-marj yuqālu lahā ʿAkkā? Alā wa inna man dakhalahā rāghiban fīhā wa fī ziyāratihā ghafara Allāhu lahu mā taqaddama min dhanbihi wa mā taʾakhkhara wa man kharaja minhā ghayra zāʾir alā lam yubārik Allāhu lahu fī khurūjihi. Alā wa inna fīhā ʿaynan yuqālu lahā ʿAyn al-Baqar man shariba minhā sharbatan malaʾa Allāhu qalbahu nūran wa āmmanahu min al-ʿadhāb al-akbar yawma al-qiyāmah.

Ibn Masʿūd, may God be pleased with him, said that the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: “Indeed, the best of the coastal towns is Ascalon, and ʿAkkā is better than Ascalon. The excellence of ʿAkkā over Ascalon and all the coastal towns is like the excellence of Muḥammad over all the Prophets. Shall I not tell you of a city between two mountains in Syria, in the midst of a meadow, called ʿAkkā? Indeed, whoever enters it out of longing for it and to visit it, God will forgive his past and future sins; and whoever leaves it without having visited it, God will not bless his departure. Indeed, within it is a spring called the Spring of the Cow. Whoever drinks a draught from it, God will fill his heart with light and protect him from the greatest torment on the Day of Resurrection.”

263

و عن انس بن مالک رضی اللّه عنه قال قال رسول اللّه صلّی اللّه علیه و سلّم انّ فی السّواحل مدینة معلّقة تحت ساق العرش یقال لها عکّا من بات فیها مرابطاً احتساباً للّه تعالی کتب اللّه له ثواب الصّابرین و القائمین و الرّاکعین و السّاجدین الی یوم القیامة

Wa ʿan Anas ibn Mālik raḍiya Allāhu ʿanhu qāla: Qāla Rasūl Allāh ṣallā Allāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam: Inna fī al-sawāḥil madīnatan muʿallaqatan taḥta sāq al-ʿarsh yuqālu lahā ʿAkkā man bāta fīhā murābiṭan iḥtisāban li-llāh taʿālā kataba Allāhu lahu thawāba al-ṣābirīn wa al-qāʾimīn wa al-rākiʿīn wa al-sājidīn ilā yawmi al-qiyāmah.

Anas ibn Mālik, may God be pleased with him, related: “The Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: ‘Among the coastal towns is a city suspended beneath the leg of the Throne, called ʿAkkā. Whoever spends a night there guarding the frontier, seeking the reward of God, exalted be He, God will record for him the reward of those who are patient, who stand in prayer, who bow, and who prostrate themselves, until the Day of Resurrection.’”

264

و قال صلّی اللّه علیه و سلّم الا اخبرکم بمدینة علی شاطئ البحر بیضآء حسن بیاضها عند اللّه تعالی یقال لها عکّا و انّ من قرصه برغوث من براغیثها کان عند اللّه افضل من طعنة نافذة فی سبیل اللّه الا و انّ من اذّن فیها کان له مدّ صوته فی الجنّة و من قعد فیها سبعة ایّام مقابل العدوّ حشره اللّه مع الخضر علیه السّلام و امّنه اللّه من الفزع الأکبر یوم القیامة و قال صلّی اللّه تعالی علیه و سلّم الا و انّ فی الجنّة ملوکاً و سادات و فقرآء عکّا ملوک الجنّة و ساداتها و انّ شهراً فی عکّا افضل من الف سنة فی غیرها

Wa qāla ṣallā Allāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam: Alā ukhbirukum bi-madīnah ʿalā shāṭiʾ al-baḥr bayḍāʾ ḥasan bayāḍuhā ʿinda Allāh taʿālā yuqālu lahā ʿAkkā wa inna man qaraṣahu burghūth min barāghīthihā kāna ʿinda Allāh afḍala min ṭaʿnah nāfidhah fī sabīl Allāh. Alā wa inna man adhdhana fīhā kāna lahu maddu ṣawtihi fī al-jannah wa man qaʿada fīhā sabʿata ayyām muqābila al-ʿaduww ḥasharahu Allāhu maʿa al-Khiḍr ʿalayhi al-salām wa āmmanahu Allāhu min al-fazaʿ al-akbar yawma al-qiyāmah. Wa qāla ṣallā Allāhu taʿālā ʿalayhi wa sallam: Alā wa inna fī al-jannah mulūkan wa sādāt wa fuqarāʾ ʿAkkā mulūk al-jannah wa sādātuhā wa inna shahran fī ʿAkkā afḍalu min alfi sanah fī ghayrihā.

He, may God bless him and grant him peace, also said: “Shall I not tell you of a white city on the seashore, whose whiteness is beautiful in the sight of God, exalted be He, called ʿAkkā? If someone is bitten by one of its fleas, that is better in the sight of God than a piercing wound received in the path of God. Indeed, whoever gives the call to prayer there will have a place in Paradise as far-reaching as his voice. Whoever remains there for seven days facing the enemy, God will raise him up with al-Khiḍr, peace be upon him, and protect him from the greatest terror on the Day of Resurrection.” He, may God, exalted be He, bless him and grant him peace, also said: “Indeed, in Paradise there are kings and lords, and the poor of ʿAkkā are the kings and lords of Paradise. A month in ʿAkkā is better than a thousand years elsewhere.”

265

و عن رسول اللّه صلّی اللّه علیه و سلّم انّه قال طوبی لمن زار عکّا و طوبی لمن زار زائر عکّا طوبی لمن شرب من عین البقر و اغتسل من مائها فانّ الحور العین یشربن الکافور الّذی فی الجنّة من عین البقر و عین سلوان و بئر زمزم طوبی لمن شرب من هؤلآء العیون و اغتسل من مائهنّ فقد حرّم اللّه علیه و علی جسده نار جهنّم یوم القیامة

Wa ʿan Rasūl Allāh ṣallā Allāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam annahu qāla: Ṭūbā li-man zāra ʿAkkā wa ṭūbā li-man zāra zāʾira ʿAkkā. Ṭūbā li-man shariba min ʿAyn al-Baqar wa ightasala min māʾihā fa-inna al-ḥūr al-ʿīn yashrabna al-kāfūr alladhī fī al-jannah min ʿAyn al-Baqar wa ʿAyn Silwān wa Biʾr Zamzam. Ṭūbā li-man shariba min hāʾulāʾ al-ʿuyūn wa ightasala min māʾihinna fa-qad ḥarrama Allāhu ʿalayhi wa ʿalā jasadihi nāra jahannam yawma al-qiyāmah.

It is related of the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, that he said: “Blessed is the one who visits ʿAkkā, and blessed is the one who visits a visitor to ʿAkkā. Blessed is the one who drinks from the Spring of the Cow and bathes in its water, for the wide-eyed maidens of Paradise drink the camphor of Paradise from the Spring of the Cow, the Spring of Silwān, and the Well of Zamzam. Blessed is the one who drinks from these springs and bathes in their waters, for God has forbidden the fire of hell to touch him or his body on the Day of Resurrection.”

266

و عن النّبیّ صلّی اللّه علیه و سلّم انّه قال فی عکّا نوافل و فواضل یخصّ اللّه بها من یشآء من قال فی عکّا سبحان اللّه و الحمد للّه و لا اله الّا اللّه و اللّه اکبر و لا حول و لا قوّة الّا باللّه العلیّ العظیم کتب اللّه له الف حسنة و محا عنه الف سیّئة و رفع له الف درجة فی الجنّة و غفر له ذنوبه و من قال فی عکّا استغفر اللّه غفر اللّه له ذنوبه کلّها و من ذکر اللّه فی عکّا بالغدوّ و الآصال و العشیّ و الابکار کان عند اللّه افضل من نقل السّیوف و الرّماح و السّلاح فی سبیل اللّه تعالی

Wa ʿan al-Nabī ṣallā Allāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam annahu qāla: Fī ʿAkkā nawāfil wa fawāḍil yakhuṣṣu Allāhu bihā man yashāʾ. Man qāla fī ʿAkkā subḥān Allāh wa al-ḥamdu li-llāh wa lā ilāha illā Allāh wa Allāhu akbar wa lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā bi-llāh al-ʿAlī al-ʿAẓīm kataba Allāhu lahu alfa ḥasanah wa maḥā ʿanhu alfa sayyiʾah wa rafaʿa lahu alfa darajah fī al-jannah wa ghafara lahu dhunūbahu. Wa man qāla fī ʿAkkā astaghfiru Allāh ghafara Allāhu lahu dhunūbahu kullahā wa man dhakara Allāha fī ʿAkkā bi-al-ghuduww wa al-āṣāl wa al-ʿashiyy wa al-ibkār kāna ʿinda Allāh afḍala min naql al-suyūf wa al-rimāḥ wa al-silāḥ fī sabīl Allāh taʿālā.

It is related of the Prophet, may God bless him and grant him peace, that he said: “In ʿAkkā there are bounties and favors that God bestows on whomever He wills. Whoever says in ʿAkkā, ‘Glory be to God, and praise be to God; there is no god but God, and God is most great; there is no power and no strength except through God, the Most High, the Almighty,’ God will record for him a thousand good deeds, erase a thousand evil deeds, raise him a thousand degrees in Paradise, and forgive his sins. Whoever says in ʿAkkā, ‘I ask God for forgiveness,’ God will forgive all his sins. Whoever remembers God in ʿAkkā in the mornings and late afternoons, in the evenings and at daybreak, will be better in the sight of God than the carrying of swords, spears, and weapons in the path of God, exalted be He.”

267

و قال رسول اللّه صلّی اللّه علیه و سلّم من نظر بالبحر عند الزّوال و کبّر اللّه عند الغروب غفر اللّه له ذنوبه ولو کانت مثل رمل عالج و من عدّ اربعین موجة و هو یکبّر اللّه تعالی غفر اللّه له ما تقدّم من ذنبه و ما تأخّر

Wa-qāla rasūlu Allāh ṣallā Allāhu ʿalayhi wa-sallam: man naẓara bi-l-baḥr ʿinda al-zawāl wa-kabbara Allāh ʿinda al-ghurūb ghafara Allāhu lahu dhunūbahu wa-law kānat mithla ramli ʿĀlij, wa-man ʿadda arbaʿīna mawjatan wa-huwa yukabbiru Allāha taʿālā ghafara Allāhu lahu mā taqaddama min dhanbihi wa-mā taʾakhkhar.

And the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: “Whoever gazes at the sea at noon and proclaims God’s greatness at sunset, God will forgive his sins, even if they are like the sands of ʿĀlij. Whoever counts forty waves while proclaiming the greatness of God, exalted be He, God will forgive his past and future sins.”

268

و قال رسول اللّه صلّی اللّه علیه و سلّم من نظر الی البحر لیلة کاملة کان افضل من شهرین کاملین بین الرّکن و المقام و من تربّی فی السّواحل خیر ممّن تربّی فی غیرها و النّائم فی السّواحل کالقائم فی غیرها انتهی

Wa-qāla rasūlu Allāh ṣallā Allāhu ʿalayhi wa-sallam: man naẓara ilā al-baḥr laylatan kāmilatan kāna afḍala min shahrayn kāmilayn bayna al-rukn wa-l-maqām, wa-man tarabbā fī al-sawāḥil khayrun mimman tarabbā fī ghayrihā, wa-l-nāʾim fī al-sawāḥil ka-l-qāʾim fī ghayrihā. Intahā.

And the Messenger of God, may God bless him and grant him peace, said: “For whoever gazes at the sea for an entire night, this is better than two full months between the Corner and the Station. Whoever is brought up on the shores is better than one brought up elsewhere, and one who sleeps on the shores is like one who keeps vigil elsewhere.” End of quotation.

269

صدق رسول اللّه صلّی اللّه تعالی علیه و سلّم

Ṣadaqa rasūlu Allāh ṣallā Allāhu taʿālā ʿalayhi wa-sallam.

The Messenger of God, may God, exalted be He, bless him and grant him peace, has spoken the truth.

Kitab-i-Badi (The Wondrous Book)
Lawh-i-Sarraj (Tablet to Sarraj)
